transcript_json.text: College English Test Band 4, Part 2, Listening Comprehension.
transcript_json.translation: 大学英语四级考试，第二部分，听力理解。

transcript_json.text: Section A.
Section A, directions.
Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports.
transcript_json.translation: 说明：在本节中，你将听到三篇新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: At the end of each news report, you will hear two or three questions.
transcript_json.translation: 每篇新闻报道结束后，你将听到两个或三个问题。

transcript_json.text: Both the news report and the questions will be spoken only once.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道和问题都只朗读一遍。

transcript_json.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C, and D.
transcript_json.translation: 听到问题后，请从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳答案。

transcript_json.text: Then mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet 1 with a single line through the center.
transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上对应的字母中间划一条横线。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1.
At least 16 people were killed and up to 150 trapped under the rubble when a factory collapsed in an industrial area of Lahore in eastern Pakistan.
transcript_json.translation: 巴基斯坦东部拉合尔一个工业区的工厂倒塌，造成至少16人死亡，多达150人被埋在废墟下。

transcript_json.text: Formerly several stories high, no part of the building remained standing after the disaster, and hundreds of rescue workers, including soldiers, have been picking through concrete and bricks to find survivors.
transcript_json.translation: 这座建筑原来有好几层高，灾后没有一处还立着，包括士兵在内的数百名救援人员正在混凝土和砖块中搜寻幸存者。

transcript_json.text: Dozens have been pulled out alive.
transcript_json.translation: 已有数十人被救出，生还。

transcript_json.text: Many more remain trapped, and with heavy machinery being used, search teams were striving to ensure that no one is hurt further in the rescue operation.
transcript_json.translation: 还有更多人被埋，救援队在使用重型机械的同时，努力确保救援行动中不再有人受伤。

transcript_json.text: It is not known what caused the collapse of the factory where plastic bags were manufactured, but reports suggest the building was still under construction and may have suffered damage in last week's earthquake that hit Afghanistan and Pakistan, leaving hundreds dead.
transcript_json.translation: 目前尚不清楚这家生产塑料袋的工厂为何倒塌，但有报道称该建筑仍在施工中，可能在上周袭击阿富汗和巴基斯坦的地震中受损，那场地震造成数百人死亡。

transcript_json.text: Questions one and two are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第1题和第2题基于你刚刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question one: What is the news report mainly about?
transcript_json.translation: 第1题：这则新闻报道主要讲什么？

transcript_json.text: Question two.
What are the products of this factory?
transcript_json.translation: 这家工厂的产品是什么？

transcript_json.text: News report two.
The technology company Apple announced a new, smaller-sized iPhone on Monday at a press conference in Cupertino, California.
transcript_json.translation: 科技公司苹果周一在加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺的一场发布会上公布了新款、小尺寸的iPhone。

transcript_json.text: Apple head Tim Cook said customers had asked that the company continue making four-inch products.
transcript_json.translation: 苹果公司首席执行官蒂姆·库克表示，顾客要求公司继续生产4英寸的产品。

transcript_json.text: He said the new iPhone SE satisfies that demand.
transcript_json.translation: 他说，新款iPhone SE满足了这一需求。

transcript_json.text: It is the same size as the iPhone 5 and 5S, but the SE includes the The better hardware of the most recent iPhone, the 6s.
transcript_json.translation: 它的尺寸与iPhone 5和5S相同，但SE搭载了最新款iPhone 6s的更好硬件。

transcript_json.text: And Apple is offering the iPhone SE for a lower price.
transcript_json.translation: 而且苹果给iPhone SE定了更低的价格。

transcript_json.text: An iPhone SE with 16 GB of storage will cost around $400.
transcript_json.translation: 16GB存储容量的iPhone SE售价约为400美元。

transcript_json.text: One with 64 GB will be about $100 more.
transcript_json.translation: 64GB的那款要贵大约100美元。

transcript_json.text: The iPhone SE shares the same design and materials as the 5 and 5s.
transcript_json.translation: iPhone SE与5和5s采用相同的设计和材料。

transcript_json.text: However, the new model adds a color choice, rose gold.
transcript_json.translation: 不过新机型增加了一种颜色选择：玫瑰金。

transcript_json.text: The company also reported on its sustainability efforts to use 100% renewable energy at this facility.
transcript_json.translation: 该公司还报告了其可持续发展成果，该设施已使用100%可再生能源。

transcript_json.text: Currently, Apple says it uses renewable energy at 93% of its facilities.
transcript_json.translation: 目前苹果称其93%的设施使用可再生能源。

transcript_json.text: Questions three and four are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 问题3和问题4基于你刚听到的这篇新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question three: What does iPhone iPhone SE share in common with iPhone 5 and 5S.
transcript_json.translation: 问题3：iPhone SE与iPhone 5和5S有哪些共同之处？

transcript_json.text: Question four.
How much will an iPhone SE with 64GB of storage cost?
transcript_json.translation: 一台64GB存储容量的iPhone SE要多少钱？

transcript_json.text: News report three.
An experimental therapy uses a person's weak immune system to fight deadly blood cancers.
transcript_json.translation: 一种实验性疗法利用人体较弱的免疫系统来对抗致命的血癌。

transcript_json.text: Stanley Riddle is a researcher at the Fred.
transcript_json.translation: 斯坦利·里德尔是弗雷德·哈钦森癌症研究中心的研究员。

transcript_json.text: Hutchinson Cancer Research Center in the U.S state of Washington.
transcript_json.translation: 该中心位于美国华盛顿州。

transcript_json.text: So that's the one interesting thing about this: it doesn't require repeated treatments or repetitive cycles of chemotherapy, said Riddle.
transcript_json.translation: "有意思的一点是：它不需要反复治疗或一轮又一轮的化疗，"里德尔说。

transcript_json.text: That's what I think in the future may be most important for patients: that it's a single treatment instead of many months of treatment.
transcript_json.translation: "我认为这对患者未来最重要的是：只需一次治疗，而不是治疗好几个月。"

transcript_json.text: It has shown great promise in small trials with patients.
transcript_json.translation: 在小规模患者试验中，它显示出很大希望。

transcript_json.text: In one study of 35 patients with a type of leukemia, 94% experienced a complete remission.
transcript_json.translation: 在一项针对35名某种白血病患者的研究中，94%实现了完全缓解。

transcript_json.text: 50% to 80% of patients with other blood cancers also saw a reduction in symptoms.
transcript_json.translation: 患有其他血癌的患者中，也有50%到80%症状减轻。

transcript_json.text: Riddle said, "This is encouraging because these are all patients who have failed all conventional therapies, including many kinds of bone marrow and stem cell transplants."
transcript_json.translation: 里德尔说："这令人鼓舞，因为这些患者对所有常规疗法都已无效，包括多种骨髓和干细胞移植。"

transcript_json.text: Immune system cells usually fight invading viruses and bacteria.
transcript_json.translation: 免疫系统细胞通常对抗入侵的病毒和细菌。

transcript_json.text: They can also combat cancer, but they are soon overwhelmed by the disease.
transcript_json.translation: 它们也能对抗癌症，但很快就被疾病压垮。

transcript_json.text: The work by Hutchinson researchers increases this natural cancer-fighting ability.
transcript_json.translation: 哈钦森研究人员的工作增强了这种天然的抗癌能力。

transcript_json.text: Using the immune system has also shown promise against skin cancer and some lung cancers.
transcript_json.translation: 利用免疫系统治疗皮肤癌和某些肺癌也显示出前景。

transcript_json.text: Questions five to seven are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第5到7题基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question five: What is the experimental therapy against blood cancer?
transcript_json.translation: 第5题：针对血癌的实验性疗法是什么？

transcript_json.text: Question six: How many patients gained a complete remission in the small trials?
transcript_json.translation: 第6题：在小型试验中有多少患者获得了完全缓解？

transcript_json.text: Question 7: What have Hutchinson researchers contributed to, according to the news report?
transcript_json.translation: 第7题：据新闻报道，哈钦森的研究人员做出了什么贡献？

transcript_json.text: Section B: Directions.
transcript_json.translation: B部分：说明。

transcript_json.text: In this section, you will hear two long conversations.
transcript_json.translation: 在本部分，你将听到两段长对话。

transcript_json.text: At the end of each conversation, you will hear four questions.
transcript_json.translation: 每段对话结束后，你将听到4个问题。

transcript_json.text: Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once.
transcript_json.translation: 对话和问题都只朗读一遍。

transcript_json.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C C and D.
transcript_json.translation: 听到问题后，请从标有A、B、C和D的4个选项中选出最佳答案。

transcript_json.text: Then mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上对应字母的中间划一条横线。

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
Morning, this is TGC.
transcript_json.translation: 早上好，这里是TGC。

transcript_json.text: Good morning.
Uh, Walter Barry here, calling from London.
transcript_json.translation: 呃，我是沃尔特·巴里，从伦敦打来的。

transcript_json.text: Could I speak to Mr.
transcript_json.translation: 我可以和……先生通话吗？

transcript_json.text: Grant, please?
Who's calling, please?
transcript_json.translation: 请问您是哪位？

transcript_json.text: Walter Barry from London.
transcript_json.translation: 伦敦的沃尔特·巴里。

transcript_json.text: What is it about, please?
transcript_json.translation: 请问是什么事？

transcript_json.text: Well, I understand that your company has a chemical processing plant.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我了解到贵公司有一家化工厂。

transcript_json.text: My own company, LCP, Liquid Control Products, is a leader in safety from leaks in the field of chemical processing.
transcript_json.translation: 我自己的公司LCP，液体控制产品公司，在化工领域防泄漏安全方面是行业领先者。

transcript_json.text: I would like to speak to Mr.
transcript_json.translation: 我想和……先生通话。

transcript_json.text: Grant to discuss ways in which we could help TGC protect itself from such problems and save money at the same time.
transcript_json.translation: 找格兰特谈谈，看我们怎么帮TGC避免这类问题，同时还能省钱。

transcript_json.text: Yes, I see.
transcript_json.translation: 是的，我明白。

transcript_json.text: Well, Mr.
Grant is not available just now.
transcript_json.translation: 格兰特现在不在。

transcript_json.text: Can you tell me when I could reach him?
transcript_json.translation: 能告诉我什么时候能找到他吗？

transcript_json.text: He's very busy for the next few days.
transcript_json.translation: 接下来几天他都很忙。

transcript_json.text: Then he'll be away in New York.
transcript_json.translation: 然后他还要去纽约。

transcript_json.text: So it's difficult to give you a time.
transcript_json.translation: 所以很难给您定个时间。

transcript_json.text: Could I speak to someone else, perhaps?
transcript_json.translation: 那我能不能找别人谈谈，也许？

transcript_json.text: Who, in particular?
transcript_json.translation: 具体找谁呢？

transcript_json.text: A colleague, for example.
transcript_json.translation: 比如说，一位同事。

transcript_json.text: You're speaking to his personal assistant.
transcript_json.translation: 您现在正和他的私人助理通话。

transcript_json.text: I can deal with calls for Mr.
transcript_json.translation: 我可以替格兰特先生处理来电。

transcript_json.text: Grant.
Yes, well, could I ring him tomorrow?
transcript_json.translation: 是这样，那我明天打给他行吗？

transcript_json.text: No, I'm sorry, he won't be free tomorrow.
transcript_json.translation: 不行，抱歉，他明天也没空。

transcript_json.text: Listen, let me suggest something.
transcript_json.translation: 听着，我有个建议。

transcript_json.text: You send us details of your products and services, together with references from other companies, and then we'll contact you.
transcript_json.translation: 您把产品和服务的详细资料，连同其他公司的推荐信寄给我们，我们再联系您。

transcript_json.text: Yes, that's very kind of you.
transcript_json.translation: 好的，您真是太好了。

transcript_json.text: I have your address.
transcript_json.translation: 我有您的地址。

transcript_json.text: Very good, Mr...
transcript_json.translation: 好的，您是……先生？

transcript_json.text: Barry.
Walter Barry from LCP in London.
transcript_json.translation: 伦敦LCP公司的沃尔特·巴里。

transcript_json.text: Right, Mr.
Barry.
We look forward to hearing from you.
transcript_json.translation: 我们期待收到您的回复。

transcript_json.text: Thank you.
Goodbye.
Bye.
Questions eight to eleven are based on the conversation you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第8到11题基于你刚刚听到的对话。

transcript_json.text: Question eight.
Question eight, what do we learn about the woman's company?
transcript_json.translation: 第8题，我们能了解到女方公司的什么情况？

transcript_json.text: Question nine, what do we learn about the man?
transcript_json.translation: 第9题，我们能了解到男方的什么情况？

transcript_json.text: Question ten, what is the woman's position in her company?
transcript_json.translation: 第10题，女方在公司里是什么职位？

transcript_json.text: Question 11: What does the woman suggest the man do?
transcript_json.translation: 第11题：女方建议男方做什么？

transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
Miss Yamada, did you ever think that you would find yourself living and working in the Western world?
transcript_json.translation: 山田小姐，你有没有想过自己会在西方国家生活和工作？

transcript_json.text: No, not really, although I've always listened to recordings of great orchestras from Europe.
transcript_json.translation: 没有，真的没想过，不过我一直听欧洲大乐团的唱片。

transcript_json.text: So you enjoyed classical music even when you were very young?
transcript_json.translation: 那你很小的时候就喜欢古典音乐了？

transcript_json.text: Oh, yes.
I was an only child.
transcript_json.translation: 我是独生女。

transcript_json.text: You were born in 1955, is that right?
transcript_json.translation: 你是1955年出生的，对吗？

transcript_json.text: Yes.
I began violin lessons at school when I was six.
transcript_json.translation: 我6岁在学校开始学小提琴。

transcript_json.text: As young as that?
transcript_json.translation: 那么小就开始了？

transcript_json.text: Did you like it?
transcript_json.translation: 你喜欢吗？

transcript_json.text: Oh, yes.
Yes, very much.
transcript_json.translation: 喜欢，非常喜欢。

transcript_json.text: When did you first play on your own?
transcript_json.translation: 你第一次独奏是什么时候？

transcript_json.text: I mean, when did you give your first performance?
transcript_json.translation: 我是说，你的第一次演出是什么时候？

transcript_json.text: I think I was eight, no, nine.
transcript_json.translation: 我想是8岁，不，9岁。

transcript_json.text: I just had my birthday a week before, and my father had bought me a new violin.
transcript_json.translation: 我生日刚过了一周，父亲给我买了一把新小提琴。

transcript_json.text: I played a small piece at a school concert.
transcript_json.translation: 我在学校音乐会上演奏了一首小曲子。

transcript_json.text: Did you know then that you would become a professional violinist?
transcript_json.translation: 那时候你就知道自己会成为职业小提琴家了吗？

transcript_json.text: Yes, I think so.
transcript_json.translation: 是的，我想是的。

transcript_json.text: I enjoyed playing the violin very much, and I didn't mind practicing, sometimes three or four hours a day.
transcript_json.translation: 我非常喜欢拉小提琴，也不介意练习，有时一天练三四个小时。

transcript_json.text: And when did you first come to Europe?
transcript_json.translation: 那你是什么时候第一次去欧洲的？

transcript_json.text: I was very lucky.
transcript_json.translation: 我非常幸运。

transcript_json.text: When I was fifteen, I won a scholarship to a college in Paris.
transcript_json.translation: 15岁那年，我获得了巴黎一所学院的奖学金。

transcript_json.text: That was for a three-year course.
transcript_json.translation: 那是一个为期3年的课程。

transcript_json.text: How did your parents feel about that?
transcript_json.translation: 你父母对此怎么看？

transcript_json.text: I think they were pleased and worried at the same time.
transcript_json.translation: 我想他们既高兴又担心。

transcript_json.text: It was the chance of a lifetime, but of course I would be thousands of miles from home.
transcript_json.translation: 那是千载难逢的机会，但我当然会离家千里之外。

transcript_json.text: Anyway, I studied in Paris for three years and then went back to Tokyo.
transcript_json.translation: 不管怎样，我在巴黎学了3年，然后回到了东京。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
What makes a person famous?
transcript_json.translation: 是什么让一个人出名？

transcript_json.text: This is a mystery that many people have carefully thought about.
transcript_json.translation: 这是个谜，很多人都在仔细琢磨。

transcript_json.text: All kinds of myths surround the lives of well-known people.
transcript_json.translation: 关于名人生活有各种各样的传说。

transcript_json.text: Most people are familiar with the works of William Shakespeare, one of the greatest English writers of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数人都熟悉威廉·莎士比亚的作品，他是16、17世纪最伟大的英国作家之一。

transcript_json.text: Yet how many know Shakespeare the person, the man behind the works?
transcript_json.translation: 可又有多少人了解莎士比亚这个人，也就是作品背后的那个人呢？

transcript_json.text: After centuries of research, scholars are still trying to discover Shakespeare's personal history.
transcript_json.translation: 经过几个世纪的研究，学者们仍在努力探寻莎士比亚的个人经历。

transcript_json.text: It is not easily found in his writings.
transcript_json.translation: 这在他的作品里并不容易找到。

transcript_json.text: Authors of the time could not protect their works.
transcript_json.translation: 当时的作家无法保护自己的作品。

transcript_json.text: An acting company, for example, could change a play if they They wanted to.
transcript_json.translation: 比如说，一个剧团想改剧本，就可以改。

transcript_json.text: Nowadays, writers have copyrights that protect their work.
transcript_json.translation: 如今，作家享有保护作品的版权。

transcript_json.text: Many myths arose about Shakespeare.
transcript_json.translation: 关于莎士比亚出现了许多传说。

transcript_json.text: Some said he had no formal education.
transcript_json.translation: 有人说他没有受过正规教育。

transcript_json.text: Others believed that he began his career by tending the horses of wealthy men.
transcript_json.translation: 还有人认为他起初是靠给富人照看马匹起家的。

transcript_json.text: All of these myths are interesting, but are they true?
transcript_json.translation: 这些传说都很有意思，但它们是真的吗？

transcript_json.text: Probably not.
Shakespeare's father was a respected man in Stratford-upon-Avon, a member of the town council.
transcript_json.translation: 莎士比亚的父亲在埃文河畔斯特拉福德是个受人尊敬的人，是市议会的成员。

transcript_json.text: He sent young William to grammar school.
transcript_json.translation: 他把小威廉送进了文法学校。

transcript_json.text: Most people of Elizabethan times did not continue beyond grammar school, so Shakespeare did have at least an average education.
transcript_json.translation: 伊丽莎白时代大多数人读完文法学校就不读了，所以莎士比亚至少受过普通教育。

transcript_json.text: Some parts of Shakespeare's life will always remain unknown.
transcript_json.translation: 莎士比亚一生中有些事情将永远不为人知。

transcript_json.text: The Great London Fire of 1666 burned many important documents that could have been a source of clues.
transcript_json.translation: 1666年伦敦大火烧毁了许多重要文件，而它们本可以成为线索。

transcript_json.text: We will always be left with many questions.
transcript_json.translation: 我们总会留下很多疑问。

transcript_json.text: And few facts.
transcript_json.translation: 而事实却寥寥无几。

transcript_json.translation: 第17题，我们了解到莎士比亚的父亲是怎样的？

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Wherever you go and for whatever reason, it's important to be safe.
transcript_json.translation: 无论你去哪里、为了什么原因，安全都很重要。

transcript_json.text: While the majority of people you'll meet when traveling are sure to be friendly and welcoming, there are dangers, theft being the most common.
transcript_json.translation: 尽管你旅行时遇到的大多数人肯定都很友善好客，但也存在危险，其中盗窃最为常见。

transcript_json.text: Just as in your home country, do not expect everyone you meet to be friendly and helpful.
transcript_json.translation: 就像在你自己国家一样，不要指望遇到的每个人都友善且乐于助人。

transcript_json.text: It's important to prepare for your trip in advance and to take precautions while you're traveling.
transcript_json.translation: 提前为旅行做好准备，并在旅途中采取预防措施，这很重要。

transcript_json.text: As you prepare for your trip, make sure you have the right paperwork.
transcript_json.translation: 准备旅行时，务必准备好正确的证件。

transcript_json.text: You don't want to get to your destination only to find you have the wrong visa, or worse, that your passport isn't valid anymore.
transcript_json.translation: 你可不想到了目的地才发现签证办错了，或者更糟，护照已经失效了。

transcript_json.text: Also, make sure you travel with proper medical insurance, so that if you're sick or injured during your travels, you'll be able to get treatment.
transcript_json.translation: 另外，务必购买合适的医疗保险，这样万一旅途中生病或受伤，你就能得到治疗。

transcript_json.text: If you want to drive while you're abroad, make sure you have an international driver's license.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你想在国外开车，一定要有国际驾照。

transcript_json.text: When you get to your destination, use official transport.
transcript_json.translation: 到达目的地后，乘坐正规交通工具。

transcript_json.text: Always go to bus and taxi stands.
transcript_json.translation: 一定要去公交车站和出租车站。

transcript_json.text: Don't accept rides from strangers who offer you a lift.
transcript_json.translation: 不要搭乘主动提出让你搭车的陌生人的车。

transcript_json.text: If there's no meter in the taxi, agree on a price before you get in.
transcript_json.translation: 如果出租车没有计价器，上车前先谈好价格。

transcript_json.text: If you prefer to stay in cheap hotels while traveling, make sure you can lock the door of your room from the inside.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你旅行时喜欢住便宜的旅馆，确保房间的门能从里面锁上。

transcript_json.text: Finally, remember to smile.
transcript_json.translation: 最后，记得微笑。

transcript_json.text: It's the friendliest and most sincere form of communication, and is sure to be understood in any part of the world.
transcript_json.translation: 这是最友好、最真诚的交流方式，世界任何地方的人都一定能理解。

transcript_json.text: Passage 3 The British are supposed to be famous for laughing at themselves, but even their sense of humour has a limit, as the British retailer Gerald Ratner found out to his cost.
transcript_json.translation: 短文3 英国人以自我调侃著称，但即使是他们的幽默感也有极限，英国零售商杰拉尔德·拉特纳就为此付出了代价。

transcript_json.text: When Ratner took over his father's chain of 130 jewellery shops in 1984, he introduced a very clear company policy.
transcript_json.translation: 1984年，拉特纳接手父亲的130家珠宝店连锁后，制定了一个非常明确的公司政策。

transcript_json.text: He decided that his shops should sell down-market products at the lowest possible prices.
transcript_json.translation: 他决定让店铺以尽可能低的价格销售低端产品。

transcript_json.text: It was a great success.
transcript_json.translation: 这取得了巨大的成功。

transcript_json.text: The British public loved his cheap gold earrings and his tasteless silver ornaments.
transcript_json.translation: 英国民众很喜欢他那些便宜的金耳环和俗气的银饰品。

transcript_json.text: By 1991, Ratner's company had 2,400 shops and it was worth over £680 million.
transcript_json.translation: 到1991年，拉特纳的公司已有2400家店铺，价值超过6.8亿英镑。

transcript_json.text: But in April of that year, Gerald Ratner made a big mistake.
transcript_json.translation: 但那年4月，杰拉尔德·拉特纳犯了一个大错误。

transcript_json.text: At a big meeting of top British business people, he stood up and explained the secret of his success.
transcript_json.translation: 在一次英国商界高层人士的大型聚会上，他站起来讲解自己成功的秘诀。

transcript_json.text: "People say, 'How can we sell our goods for such a low price?'
transcript_json.translation: "人们说，'我们怎么能以这么低的价格出售商品？'

transcript_json.text: I say, 'Because they're absolute rubbish.'" His audience roared with laughter, but the British newspapers and the British public were not so amused.
transcript_json.translation: 我说，'因为它们全是垃圾。'"听众哄堂大笑，但英国报纸和英国民众可不觉得好笑。

transcript_json.text: People felt insulted and stayed away from Ratner's shops.
transcript_json.translation: 人们觉得受到了侮辱，不再光顾拉特纳的店铺。

transcript_json.text: Sales fell, and six months after his speech, Ratner's share price had fallen by forty-two percent.
transcript_json.translation: 销售额下滑，演讲后6个月，拉特纳的股价下跌了42%。

transcript_json.text: The following year, things got worse, and Gerald Ratner was forced to resign.
transcript_json.translation: 第二年情况更糟，杰拉尔德·拉特纳被迫辞职。

transcript_json.text: By the end of 1992, he had lost his company, his career, and his house.
transcript_json.translation: 到1992年底，他失去了公司、事业和房子。

transcript_json.text: Even worse, twenty-five thousand of his employees had lost their jobs.
transcript_json.translation: 更糟糕的是，25000名员工丢了工作。

transcript_json.text: It had been a very expensive joke.
transcript_json.translation: 这个玩笑的代价实在太高了。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1.
Thousands of rail passengers in China were prevented from leaving after adverse weather delayed trains.
transcript_json.translation: 中国数千名铁路旅客因恶劣天气导致列车延误而滞留。

transcript_json.text: In what's known as the world's largest annual mass migration, millions of people are heading back to families for the Start of the Chinese New Year holiday, which is the most important of the traditional Chinese holidays.
transcript_json.translation: 在被称为全球最大规模年度人口迁徙的过程中，数百万人正赶回家中，迎接中国最重要的传统节日——春节假期的开始。

transcript_json.text: One stranded passenger says the train schedule has changed three times.
transcript_json.translation: 一位滞留旅客说，列车时刻表已经改了3次。

transcript_json.text: He says at first it changed to 9 p.m., then 10 p.m.
transcript_json.translation: 他说，起初改到晚上9点，后来又改成晚上10点。

transcript_json.text: Now it says it's delayed and the time of departure is undecided.
transcript_json.translation: 现在说列车延误了，出发时间未定。

transcript_json.text: More than 55,000 passengers were left stranded at this station in the south of the country after a rare snowfall delayed trains.
transcript_json.translation: 罕见的降雪导致列车延误，在这个位于该国南部的车站，超过5.5万名旅客滞留。

transcript_json.text: Chinese travelers are expected to make 2.9 billion trips during the 40-day period, which started two weeks ago.
transcript_json.translation: 中国旅客预计在这40天的春运期间出行29亿人次，春运两周前已经开始。

transcript_json.text: Most of those trips will fall around next Monday's Lunar New Year.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数出行将集中在下周一的农历新年前后。

transcript_json.text: Questions one and two are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第1题和第2题基于你刚刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.translation: 第1题：为什么许多乘客滞留在火车站？

transcript_json.translation: 第2题：根据新闻报道，今年的中国农历新年是哪一天？

transcript_json.text: News report two: The United States has experienced a decline in happiness during the past ten years, although it remains among the world's happiest countries.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道二：过去10年间，美国人的幸福感有所下降，但它仍然是世界上最幸福的国家之一。

transcript_json.text: The World Happiness Report found that Americans showed significant decreases in happiness from 2005 to 2007, and again from 2013 to 2015.
transcript_json.translation: 《世界幸福报告》发现，美国人的幸福感在2005年至2007年间显著下降，2013年至2015年间再次下降。

transcript_json.text: The happiest country in the world was Denmark, according to the report.
transcript_json.translation: 根据该报告，世界上最幸福的国家是丹麦。

transcript_json.text: The top ten happiest countries also included Switzerland, Iceland, Norway, Finland, Canada, Netherlands, New Zealand, Australia, and Sweden.
transcript_json.translation: 最幸福的前10名国家还包括瑞士、冰岛、挪威、芬兰、加拿大、荷兰、新西兰、澳大利亚和瑞典。

transcript_json.text: Greece had the largest drop in the survey.
transcript_json.translation: 希腊在调查中降幅最大。

transcript_json.text: Researchers blamed the drop on the debt crisis and high unemployment in the country.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员将这一下降归因于该国的债务危机和高失业率。

transcript_json.text: In 2014, the Pew Research Center compiled a life satisfaction poll.
transcript_json.translation: 2014年，皮尤研究中心进行了一项生活满意度调查。

transcript_json.text: In that survey, a top conclusion was that richer countries were happier than poor countries.
transcript_json.translation: 该调查得出的一个主要结论是，富裕国家比贫穷国家更幸福。

transcript_json.text: The Pew Research said Asians and Africans are the most optimistic people about their futures.
transcript_json.translation: 皮尤研究中心表示，亚洲人和非洲人对自己未来最为乐观。

transcript_json.text: Money was a big factor driving happiness, but it was not the most important, according to the Pew organization.
transcript_json.translation: 皮尤机构表示，金钱是推动幸福感的重要因素，但并不是最重要的因素。

transcript_json.text: The majority of those asked thought good health Quality education for their children and safety from crime were more important than wealth.
transcript_json.translation: 多数受访者认为，良好的健康、子女的优质教育以及免受犯罪侵害的安全比财富更重要。

transcript_json.text: News report three.
Scientists found sea levels are rising faster today than any time over the past 3,000 years.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家发现，如今海平面上升的速度比过去3000年中的任何时候都快。

transcript_json.text: The sea level researchers gathered information going back 28 centuries.
transcript_json.translation: 海平面研究人员收集了长达28个世纪的数据。

transcript_json.text: Their findings were released Monday by the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
transcript_json.translation: 他们的研究结果由《美国国家科学院院刊》于周一发布。

transcript_json.text: Robert Coppe from Rutgers University in New Jersey is the paper's lead author.
transcript_json.translation: 新泽西州罗格斯大学的罗伯特·科普是这篇论文的第一作者。

transcript_json.text: He said the 20th century rise was extraordinary when compared to the past 3,000 years, and Coppe said the rise over the last two decades has been even faster.
transcript_json.translation: 他说，与过去3000年相比，20世纪的海平面上升速度堪称惊人，而科普还说，过去20年的上升速度甚至更快。

transcript_json.text: When temperatures rise, so do sea levels.

transcript_json.text: That is because snow and ice melt or break off from glaciers.
transcript_json.translation: 因为冰雪会融化，或者从冰川上崩解。

transcript_json.text: They flow into the sea.
transcript_json.translation: 它们流入大海。

transcript_json.text: The increased water makes the sea levels rise.
transcript_json.translation: 水量增多，海平面就会上升。

transcript_json.text: The best estimates show that temperatures around the Earth have risen more than a half degree Celsius since 18 Scientists say that most of that rise is because of emissions or gases released into the air by machines that humans have built.
transcript_json.translation: 最佳估计显示，自1800年以来，全球气温已上升了半摄氏度以上。科学家说，这主要是因为人类制造的机器排放到空气中的废气。

transcript_json.text: And it is not going to get better.

transcript_json.text: "The water is going to rise," said Stefan Hamstorf.

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
Why is it important to recycle?
transcript_json.translation: 为什么要回收利用？

transcript_json.text: There are many reasons.
transcript_json.translation: 原因有很多。

transcript_json.text: Recycling is one way to keep waste out of landfills.
transcript_json.translation: 回收利用是让垃圾不进填埋场的一种办法。

transcript_json.text: Landfills are places to dump waste, but they're unpopular because they can pollute the soil used to cover them, and that's bad for people who may build new homes there.
transcript_json.translation: 填埋场是用来倾倒垃圾的地方，但它们不受欢迎，因为会污染用来覆盖垃圾的土壤，这对以后可能在那里盖新房的人很不利。

transcript_json.text: Recycling also reuses valuable raw materials, such as aluminium and paper.
transcript_json.translation: 回收利用还能重复使用宝贵的原材料，比如铝和纸。

transcript_json.text: Finally, recycling can mean a lower garbage bill.
transcript_json.translation: 最后，回收利用意味着垃圾处理费可以降低。

transcript_json.text: Recycling lowers the amount of waste put into landfills.
transcript_json.translation: 回收利用减少了送进填埋场的垃圾量。

transcript_json.text: Therefore, less money is spent for garbage disposal.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，垃圾处理的花费就少了。

transcript_json.text: How has recycling changed over the years?
transcript_json.translation: 这些年来回收利用发生了怎样的变化？

transcript_json.text: Ten or twenty years ago, you could buy milk in returnable, refillable glass bottles, and many people recycled voluntarily.
transcript_json.translation: 十年二十年前，你可以买到用可退可续装的玻璃瓶装的牛奶，很多人都是自愿回收的。

transcript_json.text: Now you buy milk and other products in plastic bottles or paper containers.
transcript_json.translation: 现在你买牛奶和其他产品，用的都是塑料瓶或纸盒包装。

transcript_json.text: Because of the high cost of disposing of these things in landfills, many city governments now have recycling programs.
transcript_json.translation: 由于把这些东西放进填埋场处理的成本很高，现在许多城市政府都推出了回收计划。

transcript_json.text: How does recycling help the environment?
transcript_json.translation: 回收利用对环境有什么帮助？

transcript_json.text: Recycling helps the environment mainly by saving energy.
transcript_json.translation: 回收利用主要通过节约能源来保护环境。

transcript_json.text: For example, it takes 95 percent less energy to produce recycled aluminium than to produce new aluminium.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，用回收铝生产铝制品，比生产新铝节省95%的能源。

transcript_json.text: Can one person really make a difference?
transcript_json.translation: 一个人真的能起作用吗？

transcript_json.text: If only a few people recycle, then what's the point?
transcript_json.translation: 如果只有几个人回收，那又有什么意义呢？

transcript_json.text: If not you, then who?
transcript_json.translation: 如果你不做，谁来做？

transcript_json.text: If we combine our efforts, we can make a difference.
transcript_json.translation: 只要我们齐心协力，就能带来改变。

transcript_json.text: Each of us contributes to the waste problem.
transcript_json.translation: 我们每个人都对垃圾问题负有责任。

transcript_json.text: All the millions of tons of waste that go into landfills started as an old pair of slippers, a broken TV set, or a used magazine that came from somebody's house, maybe yours.
transcript_json.translation: 填埋场里那成百上千万吨的垃圾，起初也不过是某人家里的一双旧拖鞋、一台坏电视或一本旧杂志，也许就是你家的。

transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
Could you please give me information on airfares from Miami to Bellingham, Washington?
transcript_json.translation: 请问能给我查一下从迈阿密到华盛顿州贝灵厄姆的机票信息吗？

transcript_json.text: We'd like advice on how to fly as cheaply as possible.
transcript_json.translation: 我们想了解一下怎么飞最省钱。

transcript_json.text: Let's see.
I wouldn't advise you to pay the normal one-way economy class fare of $555.
transcript_json.translation: 我不建议你们买555美元的普通单程经济舱票价。

transcript_json.text: If you can fly on a Tuesday or Wednesday and buy your tickets at least 21 days in advance, I suggest you book a round-trip excursion flight.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你们能选在周二或周三出行，并且至少提前21天买票，我建议订往返观光机票。

transcript_json.text: But we may not need the return tickets.
transcript_json.translation: 但回程票我们可能用不上。

transcript_json.text: That's all right.
transcript_json.translation: 那没关系。

transcript_json.text: Even if you don't use them, you should be able to save $89 over the one-way fare.
transcript_json.translation: 就算不用回程票，也比单程票能省89美元。

transcript_json.text: Of course, I'd recommend early booking.
transcript_json.translation: 当然，我建议尽早订票。

transcript_json.text: You ought to try to reserve the super saver seats.
transcript_json.translation: 你们应该尽量订特价座位。

transcript_json.text: There are only a few of them, and they're 15 percent cheaper than the others.
transcript_json.translation: 这种座位不多，比其他座位便宜15%。

transcript_json.text: That sounds like a good idea.
transcript_json.translation: 这主意听起来不错。

transcript_json.text: Wait.
To save another hundred dollars or so, why don't you book a flight to Vancouver, Canada?
transcript_json.translation: 想再省个100美元左右，何不订飞往加拿大温哥华的航班呢？

transcript_json.text: But that's farther than we want to go.
transcript_json.translation: 但那比我们想去的地方远了。

transcript_json.text: I know.
But you can take a bus from Vancouver back to Bellingham and still save money.
transcript_json.translation: 但你可以从温哥华坐大巴回贝灵厄姆，照样能省钱。

transcript_json.text: And if you're traveling with children, you might be able to get a discount if you fly economy class, but they don't get any discount.
transcript_json.translation: 而且如果你带孩子出行，坐经济舱也许能拿到折扣，但孩子没有折扣。

transcript_json.text: But to take advantage of the airline's guaranteed fare policy, you'd have to make reservations and pay for your tickets at least six weeks in advance.
transcript_json.translation: 不过要想享受航空公司的保证票价政策，你必须至少提前6周订票并付款。

transcript_json.text: Shall I begin the search for available seats?

transcript_json.text: No, thank you.
transcript_json.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

transcript_json.text: Excuse me?
I may call you back if we don't decide to drive.

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
What makes a person famous?
transcript_json.translation: 是什么让人出名？

transcript_json.text: This is a mystery that many people have carefully thought about.
transcript_json.translation: 这是许多人苦思冥想的一个谜。

transcript_json.text: All kinds of myths surround the lives of well-known people.
transcript_json.translation: 名人的生活中环绕着各种各样的传说。

transcript_json.text: Most people are familiar with the works of William Shakespeare, one of the greatest English writers of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数人都熟悉威廉·莎士比亚的作品，他是16、17世纪最伟大的英国作家之一。

transcript_json.text: Yet, how many know Shakespeare the person, the man behind the works?
transcript_json.translation: 然而，有多少人了解莎士比亚这个人，了解作品背后的那个人？

transcript_json.text: After centuries of research, scholars are still trying to discover Shakespeare's personal history.
transcript_json.translation: 经过几个世纪的研究，学者们仍在努力探寻莎士比亚的个人经历。

transcript_json.text: It is not easily found in his His writings.
transcript_json.translation: 这一点在他的著作中并不容易找到。

transcript_json.text: Authors of the time could not protect their works.
transcript_json.translation: 当时的作家无法保护自己的作品。

transcript_json.text: An acting company, for example, could change a play if they wanted to.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，一个剧团想改剧本就可以改。

transcript_json.text: Nowadays, writers have copyrights that protect their work.
transcript_json.translation: 如今，作家享有保护其作品的版权。

transcript_json.text: Many myths arose about Shakespeare.
transcript_json.translation: 关于莎士比亚有许多传说。

transcript_json.text: Some said he had no formal education.
transcript_json.translation: 有人说他没有受过正规教育。

transcript_json.text: Others believed that he began his career by tending the horses of wealthy men.
transcript_json.translation: 还有人认为他最初是靠给富人照看马匹起家的。

transcript_json.text: All of these myths are interesting, but are they true?
transcript_json.translation: 这些传说都很有趣，但它们是真的吗？

transcript_json.text: Probably not.
Shakespeare's father was a respected man in Stratford-upon-Avon, a member of the town council.
transcript_json.translation: 莎士比亚的父亲在埃文河畔斯特拉特福是个受人尊敬的人，是市议会成员。

transcript_json.text: He sent young William to grammar school.
transcript_json.translation: 他把小威廉送进了文法学校。

transcript_json.text: Most people of Elizabethan times did not continue beyond grammar school, so Shakespeare did have at least an average education.
transcript_json.translation: 伊丽莎白时代大多数人读完文法学校就不读了，所以莎士比亚至少受过一般水平的教育。

transcript_json.text: Some parts of Shakespeare's life will always remain unknown.
transcript_json.translation: 莎士比亚生平的某些部分将永远不为人知。

transcript_json.text: The Great London Fire of 1666 Six burned many important documents that could have been a source of clues.
transcript_json.translation: 1666年的伦敦大火烧毁了许多重要文件，而这些文件本可能提供线索。

transcript_json.text: We will always be left with many questions and few facts.
transcript_json.translation: 我们将永远面对许多疑问，而事实寥寥。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Almost everyone suffers from a headache occasionally, but some people suffer from repeated, frequent headaches.
transcript_json.translation: 几乎每个人偶尔都会头痛，但有些人会反复、频繁地头痛。

transcript_json.text: A headache is important because it can be the first warning of a serious condition that could probably be controlled if discovered early.
transcript_json.translation: 头痛值得重视，因为它可能是某种严重疾病的第一个警告信号，而这种病如果早期发现，很可能可以控制。

transcript_json.text: If a person removes the warning day after day with a painkiller, he or she may pass the point of easy control.
transcript_json.translation: 如果一个人天天用止痛药来消除这种警报，他可能就会错过容易控制的阶段。

transcript_json.text: The professional name for covering up a symptom is masking.
transcript_json.translation: 掩盖症状的专业说法叫"掩盖"。

transcript_json.text: A headache specialist once said, "Masking symptoms Is not the best way of treatment.
transcript_json.translation: 一位头痛专家曾说："掩盖症状并不是最好的治疗方法。

transcript_json.text: Sometimes it is wiser to stand still than to advance in darkness.
transcript_json.translation: 有时候，原地不动比在黑暗中前进更明智。

transcript_json.text: A headache often interferes needlessly with normal, happy living.
transcript_json.translation: 头痛常常不必要地妨碍正常、幸福的生活。

transcript_json.text: The employee with a headache does less work.
transcript_json.translation: 患头痛的员工工作效率更低。

transcript_json.text: In a flash of temper, he or she may upset fellow workers or customers, causing a direct or indirect loss to the organization.
transcript_json.translation: 他可能会一时发脾气，得罪同事或客户，给公司造成直接或间接的损失。

transcript_json.text: The mother with a headache suffers and disturbs the family.
transcript_json.translation: 患头痛的母亲自己受苦，也让全家不得安宁。

transcript_json.text: She upsets her husband and children.
transcript_json.translation: 她让丈夫和孩子心烦意乱。

transcript_json.text: Rest, quiet, and fresh air stop many common headaches.
transcript_json.translation: 休息、安静和新鲜空气能止住许多常见的头痛。

transcript_json.text: Lying down and possibly falling asleep may help.
transcript_json.translation: 躺下、也许睡一觉会有帮助。

transcript_json.text: One can often handle tension headaches by rubbing and pressing the neck muscles.
transcript_json.translation: 紧张性头痛常常可以通过揉捏、按压颈部肌肉来缓解。

transcript_json.text: Heat from an electric pad or a warm bath can also help.
transcript_json.translation: 电热垫的热量或洗个热水澡也有帮助。

transcript_json.text: Because hunger may be overlooked as a headache source, one must make a habit of regular meals.
transcript_json.translation: 饥饿作为头痛的原因常被忽视，所以必须养成按时吃饭的习惯。

transcript_json.text: If a meal must be postponed for more than an hour, a snack helps to avoid a hunger headache.
transcript_json.translation: 如果一餐饭必须推迟一个多小时，吃点零食有助于避免饥饿性头痛。

transcript_json.translation: 第19到21题基于你刚才听到的短文。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
If your paycheck seems to be disappearing into thin air, you may be stuck in money traps.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你的工资似乎凭空消失了，你可能陷入了金钱陷阱。

transcript_json.text: But don't despair.
transcript_json.translation: 但别灰心。

transcript_json.text: Most people can get unstuck without going bankrupt.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数人都能走出困境而不至于破产。

transcript_json.text: The biggest budget mistake is no budget at all.
transcript_json.translation: 最大的预算错误就是根本没有预算。

transcript_json.text: As one reader put it, we just put all the bills in a pile, then try to decide which to pay.
transcript_json.translation: 正如一位读者所说，我们只是把所有账单堆成一堆，然后才想该先付哪个。

transcript_json.text: As she and others have learned, however, the money usually runs out before the bills do.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，她和其他人都发现，钱往往还没等到账单付完就花光了。

transcript_json.text: The same problem plagues many who do have a budget.
transcript_json.translation: 同样的问题也困扰着许多确实做了预算的人。

transcript_json.text: In letter after letter, we read, "It looks good on paper, but it never seems to work."
transcript_json.translation: 在一封又一封来信中，我们读到："预算看上去不错，但从来不管用。"

transcript_json.text: Why not?
Often because the budgets are unrealistic.
transcript_json.translation: 这往往是因为预算不切实际。

transcript_json.text: The solution: make a detailed record of where all your money goes now, then study it carefully.
transcript_json.translation: 解决办法是：详细记录你现在的钱都花在哪里，然后仔细研究。

transcript_json.text: Look for expenses that can be cut back, and don't give up in the face of high fixed expenses.
transcript_json.translation: 找出可以削减的开支，即使面对高额的固定支出也不要放弃。

transcript_json.text: Many of these can be reduced too.
transcript_json.translation: 其中很多也是可以减少的。

transcript_json.text: In fact, it's often easier to save on essentials than on enjoyable extras.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，在必需品上省钱往往比在享受型消费上更容易。

transcript_json.text: If housing takes more than 25% of your income, for example, consider moving to a cheaper place or renting out an extra room.
transcript_json.translation: 比如说，如果住房占了你收入的25%以上，可以考虑搬到更便宜的地方，或者出租一个空房间。

transcript_json.text: If utility bills are high, get the whole family involved in a conservation plan.
transcript_json.translation: 如果水电费很高，就让全家一起参与节能计划。

transcript_json.text: Some bills can be eliminated altogether.
transcript_json.translation: 有些开支甚至可以完全取消。

transcript_json.translation: 卡罗林斯卡学院的诺贝尔大会今天颁发了2015年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，一半奖金共同授予威廉·C·

transcript_json.text: Campbell and Satoshi Omura for their discoveries concerning a novel therapy against infections caused by roundworm parasites, and the other half to Yo-Yo Tu for her discoveries concerning a novel therapy against malaria.
transcript_json.translation: 坎贝尔和大村智，以表彰他们发现了对抗蛔虫寄生虫感染的新疗法；另一半授予屠呦呦，以表彰她发现了对抗疟疾的新疗法。

transcript_json.translation: 作为一名在中国工作的中国女性，她利用传统中医典籍，重新发现了一种古老的植物疗法来治疗疟疾，这种疗法在现代疗法失效的地方依然有效。

transcript_json.translation: 坎贝尔和大村智采用的则是更高科技的手段，对付危害严重的蛔虫——这种蛔虫会损害经济作物，并能在世界几乎任何地方感染并致人死亡。

When I say I live in Sweden, people People always want to know about the seasons.

transcript_json.text: The seasons?
Yeah, you know, how cold it is in winter, what it's like when the days are so short.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，比如冬天有多冷，白天那么短是什么感觉。

transcript_json.text: So what is it like?
transcript_json.translation: 那到底是什么感觉？

transcript_json.text: Well, it is cold, very cold in winter, sometimes as cold as 26 degrees below centigrade.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，冬天很冷，非常冷，有时冷到零下26摄氏度。

transcript_json.text: And of course, when you go out, you wrap up warm.
transcript_json.translation: 当然了，出门的时候要穿得暖暖和和的。

transcript_json.text: But inside, in the houses, it's always very warm, much warmer than at home.
transcript_json.translation: 可是在屋里，家里总是很暖和，比我们那儿暖和多了。

transcript_json.text: Swedish people always complain that when they visit England, the houses are cold even in a good winter.
transcript_json.translation: 瑞典人总抱怨说，他们去英国时，就算是个暖冬，房子里也很冷。

transcript_json.text: And what about the darkness?
transcript_json.translation: 那黑暗呢？

transcript_json.text: Well, yeah, around Christmas time, there's only one hour of daylight, so you really look forward to the spring.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，对，圣诞节前后只有一小时的日照，所以你真的很盼着春天来。

transcript_json.text: It is sometimes a bit depressing, but you see the summers are amazing.
transcript_json.translation: 有时是有点让人沮丧，不过你要知道，夏天棒极了。

transcript_json.text: From May to July in the north of Sweden, the sun never sets.
transcript_json.translation: 在瑞典北部，从5月到7月，太阳从不落山。

transcript_json.text: It's still light at midnight.
transcript_json.translation: 到了半夜还是亮的。

transcript_json.text: You can walk in the mountains and read a newspaper.
transcript_json.translation: 你可以在山里散步，还能看报纸。

transcript_json.text: Oh, yeah, the land of the midnight sun.
transcript_json.translation: 哦，对，午夜太阳之国嘛。

transcript_json.text: That's right.
But it's wonderful.
transcript_json.translation: 但那真的很美好。

transcript_json.text: You want to stay up all night, and the Swedes make the most of it.
transcript_json.translation: 你会想整夜不睡，而瑞典人也充分利用这一点。

transcript_json.text: Often they start work earlier in summer and then leave at about two or three in the afternoon, so that they can really enjoy the long summer evenings.
transcript_json.translation: 夏天他们常早点开始工作，然后下午两三点就下班，这样就能好好享受漫长的夏日黄昏。

transcript_json.text: They like to work hard, but play hard too.

transcript_json.text: Passage one.

While Gale Opkamp, an American artist, was giving a speech on the art of Japanese brush painting to an audience that included visitors from Japan, she was confused to see that many of her Japanese listeners had their eyes closed.
transcript_json.translation: 美国艺术家盖尔·奥普坎普在向包括日本来访者在内的听众讲授日本毛笔画艺术时，惊讶地发现许多日本听众都闭着眼睛。

transcript_json.text: Were they turned off because an American had the nerve to instruct Japanese in their own art form?
transcript_json.translation: 是不是因为一个美国人竟敢教日本人他们自己的艺术形式，他们反感了？

transcript_json.text: Were they deliberately trying to signal their rejection of her?
transcript_json.translation: 还是他们故意想表示拒绝接受她？

transcript_json.text: Opkempe later found out that her listeners were not being disrespectful.
transcript_json.translation: 奥普坎普后来发现，她的听众并不是不尊重她。

transcript_json.text: Japanese listeners sometimes close their eyes to enhance concentration.
transcript_json.translation: 日本听众有时闭上眼睛是为了更好地集中注意力。

transcript_json.text: Her listeners were showing their respect for her by chewing on her words.
transcript_json.translation: 她的听众细细品味她的话，这正是在向她表示尊重。

transcript_json.text: Someday, you may be either a speaker or a listener in a situation involving people from other countries or members of a minority group in North America.
transcript_json.translation: 有一天，你可能会在有其他国家的人或北美少数族裔参与的场合中，成为演讲者或听众。

transcript_json.text: Learning how different cultures signal respect can help you avoid misunderstandings.
transcript_json.translation: 了解不同文化如何表示尊重，可以帮助你避免误解。

transcript_json.text: Here are some examples.
transcript_json.translation: 下面是一些例子。

transcript_json.text: In the deaf culture of North America, many listeners show applause not by clapping their hands, but by waving them in the air.
transcript_json.translation: 在北美的聋人文化中，许多听众不是用鼓掌，而是把双手举在空中挥动来表示喝彩。

transcript_json.text: In some cultures, both overseas and in some minority groups in North America, listeners are considered disrespectful respectful if they look directly at the speaker.
transcript_json.translation: 在某些文化中，包括海外的一些文化和北美的少数族裔，听众如果直视演讲者会被认为是不尊重的表现。

transcript_json.text: Respect is shown by looking in the general direction, but avoiding direct eye contact.
transcript_json.translation: 表示尊重的方式是朝演讲者的大致方向看，但避免直接的目光接触。

transcript_json.text: In some countries, whistling by listeners is a sign of approval, while in other countries, it is a form of insult.
transcript_json.translation: 在一些国家，听众吹口哨是表示赞赏，而在另一些国家，这是一种侮辱。

transcript_json.text: He's soon going to have an evaluation interview with his supervisor and the personnel director to discuss the work he has done in the past year.

transcript_json.text: Salary, promotion, and plans for the coming year will also be discussed at the meeting.

transcript_json.text: Chris has made several changes for his division in the past Last year, first, he bought new equipment for one of the departments.
transcript_json.translation: 克里斯在过去一年里为他的部门做了几项改进，首先，他为其中一个部门购置了新设备。

transcript_json.text: He has been particularly happy about the new equipment because many of the employees have told him how much it has helped them.

transcript_json.text: Along with improving the equipment, Chris began a program to train employees to use equipment better and do simple maintenance themselves.

transcript_json.text: Unfortunately, one serious problem developed during the year.

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
Proverbs, sometimes called sayings, are examples of folk wisdom.
transcript_json.translation: 谚语，有时也叫格言，是民间智慧的例子。

transcript_json.text: They are little lessons which older people of a culture pass down to the younger people to teach them about life.
transcript_json.translation: 它们是简短的教训，由一个文化中的长者传给年轻人，教他们认识人生。

transcript_json.text: Many proverbs remind people of the values that are important in the culture.
transcript_json.translation: 许多谚语让人想起本文化中重要的价值观。

transcript_json.text: Values teach people how to act, what is right and what is wrong.
transcript_json.translation: 价值观教人如何行事，什么是正确的，什么是错误的。

transcript_json.text: Because the values of each culture are different, understanding the values of another culture helps explain how people think and act.
transcript_json.translation: 由于每种文化的价值观都不同，了解另一种文化的价值观有助于解释人们的思维方式和行为方式。

transcript_json.text: Understanding your own cultural values is important too.
transcript_json.translation: 了解自己文化的价值观也很重要。

transcript_json.text: If you can accept that people from other cultures act according to their values, not yours, getting along with them will be much easier.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你能接受其他文化的人是按他们的价值观行事，而不是按你的，那么与他们相处就会容易得多。

transcript_json.text: Many proverbs are very old, so some of the values they teach may not be as important in the culture as they once were.
transcript_json.translation: 许多谚语非常古老，所以它们所教的某些价值观在这个文化中可能已不像从前那样重要了。

transcript_json.text: For example, Americans today do not pay much attention to the proverb "Haste makes waste," because patience is not important to them.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，今天的美国人不太在意"欲速则不达"这句谚语，因为耐心对他们来说并不重要。

transcript_json.text: But if you know about past values, it helps you to understand the present, and many of the older values are still strong Today, Benjamin Franklin, a famous American diplomat, writer, and scientist, died in 1790.
transcript_json.translation: 但如果你了解过去的价值观，就有助于理解现在，而且许多古老的价值观至今仍然很有影响。本杰明·富兰克林是美国著名的外交家、作家和科学家，于1790年去世。

transcript_json.text: But his proverb, "Time is money," is taken more seriously by Americans of today than ever before.
transcript_json.translation: 但他的谚语"时间就是金钱"，今天比以往任何时候都更受美国人重视。

transcript_json.text: A study of proverbs from around the world shows that some values are shared by many cultures.
transcript_json.translation: 对世界各地谚语的研究表明，有些价值观是许多文化所共有的。

transcript_json.text: In many cases, though, the same idea is expressed differently.
transcript_json.translation: 不过在很多情况下，同一个观念的表达方式却不同。

Some unusual weather from around the world.

transcript_json.translation: 这起事故于2月23日上报给加利福尼亚州机动车管理局。

transcript_json.text: According to Wired technology publication, the car changed traffic lanes and moved into the path of a bus.
transcript_json.translation: 据科技媒体《连线》报道，这辆车变道后驶入了一辆公交车的行驶路线。

transcript_json.text: The driverless car was a Lexus SUV.
transcript_json.translation: 这辆无人驾驶汽车是一辆雷克萨斯SUV。

transcript_json.text: When it hit the bus, the Google car was moving at around three kilometers per hour.
transcript_json.translation: 撞上公交车时，谷歌汽车的时速约为3公里。

transcript_json.text: The speed of the bus was 24 kilometers per hour at the time of the collision.
transcript_json.translation: 碰撞发生时，公交车的时速为24公里。

transcript_json.text: No injuries were reported.
transcript_json.translation: 没有人员伤亡的报告。

transcript_json.text: The left front wheel and fender of the Google car were damaged.
transcript_json.translation: 谷歌汽车的左前轮和挡泥板受损。

transcript_json.text: In a May 2015 monthly report, Google said, "We'll inevitably be involved in accidents.
transcript_json.translation: 在2015年5月的一份月度报告中，谷歌表示："我们难免会卷入事故。

transcript_json.text: Sometimes it's impossible to overcome the realities of speed and distance.
transcript_json.translation: 有时，速度和距离的客观现实是无法克服的。

transcript_json.text: In the six years of our project, we've been involved in 12 minor accidents during more than 1.8 million miles of autonomous and manual driving combined."
transcript_json.translation: 在项目开展的6年里，自动驾驶和手动驾驶合计行驶超过180万英里，其间我们卷入了12起轻微事故。"

transcript_json.text: Google has predicted the cars will be ready for the road by 2020.
transcript_json.translation: 谷歌预计，这些汽车将在2020年前上路。

Steve, can you tell me how long you've been a pub owner?
transcript_json.translation: 史蒂夫，你能告诉我你开酒吧多久了吗？

transcript_json.text: Well, four years, I suppose.

transcript_json.text: I've been involved with pubs off and on for ten years.
transcript_json.translation: 我断断续续接触酒吧这一行有10年了。

transcript_json.text: I've sort of done hotel work, and I've also run a restaurant pub, and now I've got what you call a good old fashioned pub.
transcript_json.translation: 我做过酒店的工作，也经营过餐厅酒吧，现在我有一家你说的那种地道的老式酒吧。

transcript_json.text: That is, a public bar with all the social games going with it, which is what we've always wanted to have, you know.
transcript_json.translation: 也就是一个有各种社交游戏的公共酒吧，这一直是我们想要的，你知道的。

transcript_json.text: It sounds like you've always worked in pubs, but not always in this one.
transcript_json.translation: 听起来你一直在酒吧工作，但不是一直在这一家。

transcript_json.text: No, no, I've worked in quite a variety of pubs.
transcript_json.translation: 不是，不是，我在各种各样的酒吧干过。

transcript_json.text: What makes a good pub?
transcript_json.translation: 什么样的酒吧才是一家好酒吧？

transcript_json.text: I mean, you said, you know, it has got a good variety of things.
transcript_json.translation: 我是说，你说过，你知道，它得有各种各样的东西。

transcript_json.text: Well, I think having the right customers to start with, selling the right beer, keeping it good, and most of all keeping a good attitude yourself, even though you probably feel very tired.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我觉得首先要有对的客人，卖对的啤酒，把酒保持好，最最重要的是你自己要保持好的态度，哪怕你可能已经很累了。

transcript_json.text: But the ideal is, if you generate it from your side, it's got to affect the other side, if you're getting the right customers in.
transcript_json.translation: 但理想的情况是，如果你从自己这边发力，就应该能带动另一边，只要你招来的是对的顾客。

transcript_json.text: Yeah.
I must say that's one thing that's always struck me about being a pub owner.
transcript_json.translation: 我得说，这一点一直让我对当酒吧老板这件事很有感触。

transcript_json.text: I mean, a lot of people seem to think that it's a nice job, you know.
transcript_json.translation: 我是说，很多人似乎觉得这是个不错的工作，你知道。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
To help ourselves and others, it's important to know something about drugs.
transcript_json.translation: 为了自己和他人，了解一些有关毒品的知识很重要。

transcript_json.text: A drug is a chemical substance.
transcript_json.translation: 毒品是一种化学物质。

transcript_json.text: It can bring about a physical, emotional, or mental change.
transcript_json.translation: 它能引起身体、情绪或心理上的变化。

transcript_json.text: Change in people.
transcript_json.translation: 引起人的变化。

transcript_json.text: Alcohol and tobacco are drugs.
transcript_json.translation: 酒精和烟草都是毒品。

transcript_json.text: Caffeine, a substance found in coffee and some soft drinks, is also a drug.
transcript_json.translation: 咖啡因是存在于咖啡和某些软饮料中的一种物质，也是毒品。

transcript_json.text: Drug abuse is the use of a drug, legal or illegal, that hurts a person or someone close to him.
transcript_json.translation: 药物滥用是指使用某种合法或非法的药物，从而伤害到本人或其身边的人。

transcript_json.text: A drug user is the person who takes the drug.
transcript_json.translation: 吸毒者就是服用药物的人。

transcript_json.text: There are many kinds of drug users.
transcript_json.translation: 吸毒者有很多种类型。

transcript_json.text: Experimental users may try drugs once or twice.
transcript_json.translation: 体验型吸毒者可能只尝试一两次。

transcript_json.text: They want to see what the effects will be.
transcript_json.translation: 他们想看看会有什么效果。

transcript_json.text: Recreational users take drugs to get high.
transcript_json.translation: 娱乐型吸毒者用药是为了追求快感。

transcript_json.text: They use drugs with friends or at parties to get into the mood of things.
transcript_json.translation: 他们和朋友一起或在聚会上吸毒，来助兴找感觉。

transcript_json.text: Regular users take drugs all the time, but they are often able to keep up with a normal routine of work.
transcript_json.translation: 经常型吸毒者一直吸毒，但通常还能维持正常的工作和生活。

transcript_json.text: Dependent users can't relate to anything but drugs.
transcript_json.translation: 依赖型吸毒者除了毒品什么也顾不上。

transcript_json.text: Their whole life centers around drugs.
transcript_json.translation: 他们的整个生活都围着毒品转。

transcript_json.text: They feel Extreme mental or physical pain without drugs.
transcript_json.translation: 离开毒品，他们就会感到极度的精神或肉体痛苦。

transcript_json.text: It's not always easy to tell if someone is using drugs.
transcript_json.translation: 要判断一个人是否吸毒并不总是那么容易。

transcript_json.text: In the early stages, drug use is often hard to see.
transcript_json.translation: 在早期阶段，吸毒往往很难看出来。

transcript_json.text: Sometimes people like drugs or need drugs so much they can't do without them.
transcript_json.translation: 有时人们对毒品如此喜爱或需要，以至于离不开它们。

transcript_json.text: They're dependent upon drugs.
transcript_json.translation: 他们对毒品产生了依赖。

transcript_json.text: Only a few kinds of drugs can cause physical dependence, but almost any drug, when it's misused, can make a person think he needs it all the time.
transcript_json.translation: 只有少数几种毒品会导致身体依赖，但几乎任何毒品被滥用时，都会让人觉得必须时刻离不开它。

transcript_json.text: By this time, it's too late, and the person is hooked.
transcript_json.translation: 到了这个时候，就为时已晚，这个人已经上瘾了。

transcript_json.text: Passage two: According to Charles Harper, chairman of Conagra, the Healthy Choice line of frozen dinners began with his own heart attack.
transcript_json.translation: 第二段：据康尼格拉公司董事长查尔斯·哈珀说，"健康之选"系列冷冻餐的诞生源于他自己的心脏病发作。

transcript_json.text: It had been brought on by years of eating anything he could get his hands on.
transcript_json.translation: 这是多年见到什么吃什么落下的病。

transcript_json.text: As he lay in the hospital recovering, Harper imagined a line of healthy frozen foods that tasted good.
transcript_json.translation: 哈珀躺在医院休养时，设想出一系列既健康又好吃的冷冻食品。

transcript_json.text: The Healthy Choice product line was carefully tested with consumers before being introduced to the general public.
transcript_json.translation: "健康之选"产品线在推向大众之前，经过了精心的消费者测试。

transcript_json.text: Conagra's research and development staff spent a year working under the instruction, "Whatever the cost, don't sacrifice taste."
transcript_json.translation: 康尼格拉的研发人员花了一年时间，遵循一条指示："不惜一切代价，不要牺牲口味。"

transcript_json.text: The first test market results surprised even the Conagra team.
transcript_json.translation: 第一次试销的结果连康尼格拉团队都感到惊讶。

transcript_json.text: The low sodium, low fat frozen dinners sold much better than expected.
transcript_json.translation: 这种低钠、低脂冷冻餐的销售远超预期。

transcript_json.text: According to the firm's vice president of marketing and sales, "We benefited from low expectations.
transcript_json.translation: 该公司营销与销售副总裁说："我们受益于人们的低期望。

transcript_json.text: The products were much better than people thought they would be."
transcript_json.translation: 产品比人们预想的好得多。"

transcript_json.text: This finding supported Conagra's decision to position the product against other high quality frozen dinners rather than as a diet or health food.
transcript_json.translation: 这一发现支持了康尼格拉的决定：把产品定位为与其他高品质冷冻餐竞争，而不是作为减肥或保健食品。

transcript_json.text: The new product's brand name and packaging were an important part of the development process.
transcript_json.translation: 新产品的品牌名和包装是开发过程中的重要环节。

transcript_json.text: The name "Healthy Choice" was chosen for the positive implication it held for consumers.
transcript_json.translation: 选择"健康之选"这个名字，是因为它对消费者有积极的含义。

transcript_json.text: Because Conagra felt the product would be an impulse purchase, it was important to make the items stand out in the freezer case.
transcript_json.translation: 由于康尼格拉认为该产品会是冲动购买，让商品在冷柜中脱颖而出就很重要。

transcript_json.text: This was accomplished through the dark green packaging that not only differed from the competitors, but also suggested freshness and richness in vitamins.
transcript_json.translation: 这是通过深绿色包装实现的，它不仅区别于竞争对手，还让人联想到新鲜和丰富的维生素。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
In the United States, thirty-six states currently allow capital punishment for serious crimes such as murder.
transcript_json.translation: 在美国，目前有36个州允许对谋杀等严重犯罪判处死刑。

transcript_json.text: Americans have always argued about the death penalty.
transcript_json.translation: 美国人一直对死刑争论不休。

transcript_json.text: Today, there is a serious question about this issue: should there be a minimum age limit for executing criminals?
transcript_json.translation: 如今，这个问题存在一个严肃的争论点：处决罪犯是否应该有最低年龄限制？

transcript_json.text: In other words, is it right for convicted murderers who kill when they are minors, that is, under the age of eighteen, to receive the death penalty?
transcript_json.translation: 换句话说，对那些在未成年时，也就是18岁以下犯下谋杀罪的罪犯判处死刑，这样做对吗？

transcript_json.text: In most other countries of the world, there is no capital punishment for minors.
transcript_json.translation: 在世界上大多数其他国家，不判处未成年人死刑。

transcript_json.text: In the United States, though, each state makes its own decision.
transcript_json.translation: 但在美国，每个州自行决定。

transcript_json.text: Of the thirty-six states that allow the death penalty, thirty permit the execution of minors.
transcript_json.translation: 在允许死刑的36个州中，有30个州允许处决未成年人。

transcript_json.text: In the state of South Carolina, a convicted murderer was given the death penalty for a crime he committed while he was a minor.
transcript_json.translation: 在南卡罗来纳州，一名谋杀犯因未成年时犯下的罪行被判处死刑。

transcript_json.text: In 1977, when he was 17 years old, James Terry Roach and two friends cruelly murdered three people.
transcript_json.translation: 1977年，詹姆斯·特里·罗奇17岁时，与两名朋友残忍地杀害了3个人。

transcript_json.text: Roach's lawyer fought the decision to execute him.
transcript_json.translation: 罗奇的律师对处决他的判决提出上诉。

transcript_json.text: The young murderer remained on death row for ten years while his lawyer appealed to the governor.
transcript_json.translation: 这名年轻的谋杀犯在死囚牢房里待了10年，期间他的律师不断向州长申诉。

transcript_json.text: The lawyer argued that it is wrong to execute a person for a crime he committed while he was a minor.
transcript_json.translation: 律师辩称，因为一个人未成年时犯下的罪行而将其处决是错误的。

transcript_json.text: In the United States, the governor of a state has the power to change a sentence from the death penalty to life in prison.
transcript_json.translation: 在美国，州长有权将死刑改判为终身监禁。

transcript_json.text: Nonetheless, the governor of South Carolina refused to stop the execution.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，南卡罗来纳州州长拒绝阻止行刑。

transcript_json.text: Roach was finally executed in 1986.

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg wrote a letter to his baby girl Max on Tuesday.
transcript_json.translation: Facebook创始人马克·扎克伯格周二给他的宝贝女儿麦克斯写了一封信。

transcript_json.text: He wants her to grow up in a world better than ours today.
transcript_json.translation: 他希望女儿能在一个比今天更好的世界里长大。

transcript_json.text: Zuckerberg wrote that he and his wife Priscilla Chan would donate 99 percent of his Facebook stock shares worth about 45 billion US dollars to do just that.
transcript_json.translation: 扎克伯格写道，他和妻子普莉希拉·陈将捐出他所持有的Facebook 99%的股份，价值约450亿美元，来实现这一目标。

transcript_json.text: Even with the large donation, Zuckerberg will remain extremely rich.
transcript_json.translation: 即使捐出这么一大笔钱，扎克伯格依然会非常富有。

transcript_json.text: After the news came out, Zuckerberg was one of the most searched names on Google.
transcript_json.translation: 消息公布后，扎克伯格成为谷歌上被搜索最多的名字之一。

transcript_json.text: His Facebook post received more than 1 million likes.
transcript_json.translation: 他在Facebook上的帖子获得了超过100万个赞。

transcript_json.text: Well-known people like Shakira and Arnold Schwarzenegger also gave the thumbs up.
transcript_json.translation: 夏奇拉和阿诺德·施瓦辛格等名人也纷纷点赞。

transcript_json.text: Financial analysts say it is a good move to prevent the shares from being taxed when they are sold.
transcript_json.translation: 金融分析师表示，这是防止这些股份在出售时被征税的好办法。

transcript_json.text: The shares will be donated to the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative over Zuckerberg's lifetime.
transcript_json.translation: 这些股份将在扎克伯格的有生之年陆续捐给"陈-扎克伯格计划"。

transcript_json.text: Zuckerberg and his wife Chan head the organization, of course.
transcript_json.translation: 当然，扎克伯格和妻子陈共同领导该组织。

transcript_json.text: Questions one and two are based on the news report you have just heard.

transcript_json.text: News report two: Delegates from almost 200 nations at the UN climate change summit in Paris have reached a draft agreement on how to move forward on the issue.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道二：出席巴黎联合国气候变化峰会的近200个国家的代表，已就该问题的下一步行动达成协议草案。

transcript_json.text: The text, which runs to 42 pages, was approved on Saturday after four years of work that started in Durban in 2011.
transcript_json.translation: 这份长达42页的文本于周六获得通过，相关工作始于2011年的德班，历时4年。

transcript_json.text: Presents options for dealing with everything from the long-term goals of combating climate change to financial assistance for developing nations that will need help to move away from fossil fuels.
transcript_json.translation: 文本为应对各种问题提供了多种选择，从应对气候变化的长期目标，到为需要帮助摆脱化石燃料的发展中国家提供财政援助。

transcript_json.text: There's a broad political will to come to a global agreement here in Paris, and that is good news.
transcript_json.translation: 此地巴黎有广泛的政治意愿要达成一项全球协议，这是个好消息。

transcript_json.text: What is still missing in the text is a clear vision to go 100% renewable energy by mid-century, which gives us a chance to help those people who suffer from catastrophic climate change.
transcript_json.translation: 文本中仍然缺少的是到本世纪中叶实现100%可再生能源的明确愿景，这让我们有机会帮助那些遭受灾难性气候变化之苦的人们。

transcript_json.text: To draw attention to what they see as the time pressure on the issue, campaigners led by Danish artist Oliver Eliasen have installed 12 mini icebergs in the shape of a clock in the Place de Pantheon.
transcript_json.translation: 为了让人们注意到他们眼中这一问题的紧迫性，由丹麦艺术家奥利弗·埃利亚森带领的活动人士在先贤祠广场安放了12座时钟形状的小冰山。

transcript_json.text: The ice was brought all the way from Greenland in temperature-controlled containers.
transcript_json.translation: 这些冰是用温控集装箱一路从格陵兰运来的。

transcript_json.translation: 问题3和问题4基于你刚刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.translation: 问题3：关于协议草案，我们能了解到什么？

transcript_json.translation: 问题4：12座小冰山被安放在哪里？

On Sunday, Argentinians voted for their country's next president.
transcript_json.translation: 周日，阿根廷人选出了下一任总统。

transcript_json.text: Many opinion surveys show That the ruling party candidate Daniel Scioli will be the clear winner.
transcript_json.translation: 多项民意调查显示，执政党候选人丹尼尔·肖利将大获全胜。

transcript_json.text: Mr.
Scioli is governor of Buenos Aires province and the chosen successor of Argentina's president Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner.
transcript_json.translation: 肖利是布宜诺斯艾利斯省省长，也是阿根廷总统克里斯蒂娜·费尔南德斯·德基什内尔选定的接班人。

transcript_json.text: But the surveys were wrong.
transcript_json.translation: 但调查结果错了。

transcript_json.text: Mr.
Scioli won 35.9 percent, but not enough to win the presidency.
transcript_json.translation: 肖利获得了35.9%的选票，但不足以赢得总统职位。

transcript_json.text: Mauricio Macri, the mayor of Buenos Aires, finished in second place with 35.2 percent of the vote.
transcript_json.translation: 布宜诺斯艾利斯市长毛里西奥·马克里以35.2%的得票率位居第二。

transcript_json.text: This means Argentina will hold its first ever runoff election next month.
transcript_json.translation: 这意味着阿根廷将在下月举行史上首次决选投票。

transcript_json.text: Voters will choose between the two men on November 22nd.
transcript_json.translation: 选民将在11月22日在两人之间做出选择。

transcript_json.text: Mr.
Macri says he wants to lift some financial controls and trade restrictions in an effort to help the country's economy.
transcript_json.translation: 马克里表示，他希望取消部分金融管制和贸易限制，以帮助国家经济。

transcript_json.text: Mr.
Scioli has promised to defend the central ideas of what observers are calling Kirchnerism.
transcript_json.translation: 肖利则承诺捍卫观察人士所称的"基什内尔主义"的核心理念。

transcript_json.text: These are populist beliefs built around trade protectionism, social welfare programs, and defense of the working class.
transcript_json.translation: 这些是围绕贸易保护主义、社会福利计划和捍卫工人阶级而形成的民粹主义主张。

transcript_json.text: Mr.
Siole adds that he will seek a more measured approach to economic reform.
transcript_json.translation: 西奥利还表示，他会在经济改革上采取更为稳妥的方式。

transcript_json.text: Under Argentine law, a candidate must have more than 45 percent of the vote to be declared the winner.
transcript_json.translation: 根据阿根廷法律，候选人必须获得超过45%的选票才能被宣布为获胜者。

transcript_json.text: A candidate can also win with at least 40 percent of the vote and a margin of 10 points over the next candidate.
transcript_json.translation: 候选人也可以以至少40%的得票率、并且领先下一位候选人10个百分点而获胜。

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
Hi, Leo.
Why do you say English will become the world language?
transcript_json.translation: 你为什么说英语会成为世界语言呢？

transcript_json.text: Well, for one thing, it's so commonly used.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，首先呢，它用得非常广泛。

transcript_json.text: The only language that is used by more people is Chinese.
transcript_json.translation: 使用人数比它更多的只有汉语。

transcript_json.text: Why do so many people speak English?
transcript_json.translation: 那为什么这么多人说英语呢？

transcript_json.text: It's spoken in many countries of the world because of the British Empire, and now, of course, there's the influence of America as well.
transcript_json.translation: 世界上很多国家都在说英语，这是大英帝国的遗产，当然现在还有美国的影响。

transcript_json.text: Many students find English a difficult language to learn.
transcript_json.translation: 很多学生觉得英语很难学。

transcript_json.text: Oh, all languages are difficult to learn, but English does have two great advantages.
transcript_json.translation: 哦，所有语言都很难学，不过英语确实有两大优势。

transcript_json.text: What are they?
transcript_json.translation: 哪两大优势？

transcript_json.text: Well, first of all, it has a very international vocabulary.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，首先，它的词汇非常国际化。

transcript_json.text: It has many German, Dutch, French, Spanish, and Italian words in it, so speakers of those languages will find many familiar words.
transcript_json.translation: 英语里有很多德语、荷兰语、法语、西班牙语和意大利语的词汇，所以这些语言的使用者会发现很多熟悉的词。

transcript_json.text: In English.
In fact, English has words from many other languages as well.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，英语里还有很多来自其他语言的词。

transcript_json.text: Why is that?
transcript_json.translation: 为什么呢？

transcript_json.text: Well, partly because English speakers have travelled a lot.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，部分原因是说英语的人经常到处旅行。

transcript_json.text: They bring back words with them.
transcript_json.translation: 他们会把词语带回来。

transcript_json.text: So English really does have an international vocabulary.
transcript_json.translation: 所以英语的词汇确实很国际化。

transcript_json.text: And what's the other advantage of English?
transcript_json.translation: 那英语的另一个优势是什么？

transcript_json.text: It's that English grammar is really quite easy.
transcript_json.translation: 就是英语语法其实相当简单。

transcript_json.text: For example, it doesn't have dozens of different endings for its nouns, adjectives and verbs.
transcript_json.translation: 比如说，它的名词、形容词和动词没有几十种不同的词尾变化。

transcript_json.text: Not like Latin, Russian and German, for example.
transcript_json.translation: 不像拉丁语、俄语和德语那样。

transcript_json.text: Why is that?
transcript_json.translation: 这是为什么呢？

transcript_json.text: Well, it's quite interesting, actually.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，说起来挺有意思的。

transcript_json.text: It's because of the French.
transcript_json.translation: 这是因为法国人的缘故。

transcript_json.text: When the French ruled England, French was the official language, and only the common people spoke English.
transcript_json.translation: 法国人统治英国的时候，法语是官方语言，只有普通老百姓说英语。

transcript_json.text: They tried to make the language as simple as possible, so they made the grammar easier.
transcript_json.translation: 他们尽量把语言弄得简单些，所以语法就变得更简单了。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
No one knows for sure just how old kites are.
transcript_json.translation: 没有人确切知道风筝有多古老。

transcript_json.text: In fact, they have been in use for centuries.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，它们已经被使用了几个世纪。

transcript_json.text: Twenty-five centuries ago, kites were well known in China.
transcript_json.translation: 25个世纪前，风筝在中国就很有名了。

transcript_json.text: These first kites were probably made of wood.
transcript_json.translation: 这些最早的风筝很可能是木头做的。

transcript_json.text: They may even have been covered with silk, because silk was used a lot at that time.
transcript_json.translation: 它们甚至可能用丝绸蒙面，因为那时丝绸用得很多。

transcript_json.text: Early kites were built for certain uses.
transcript_json.translation: 早期的风筝是为特定用途而制作的。

transcript_json.text: In ancient China, they were used to carry ropes across rivers.
transcript_json.translation: 在古代中国，人们用它们把绳子送过河。

transcript_json.text: Once across, the ropes were tied down and wooden bridges were hung from them.
transcript_json.translation: 绳子过去后被固定住，木桥就吊在绳子上。

transcript_json.text: Legend tells of one general who flew musical kites over the enemy's camp.
transcript_json.translation: 传说有一位将军在敌营上空放飞会发出音乐的风筝。

transcript_json.text: The enemy fled, believing the sounds to be the warning voices of angels.
transcript_json.translation: 敌人以为那是天使的警告声，纷纷逃跑了。

transcript_json.text: By the 15th century, many people flew kites.
transcript_json.translation: 到了15世纪，很多人都放风筝。

transcript_json.text: In Europe, Marco Polo may have brought the kite back from his visit to China.
transcript_json.translation: 在欧洲，马可·波罗访华时可能把风筝带了回去。

transcript_json.text: The kite has been linked to great names and events.
transcript_json.translation: 风筝与许多著名人物和事件联系在一起。

transcript_json.text: For instance, Benjamin Franklin used a kite to prove that lightning is electricity.
transcript_json.translation: 比如，本杰明·富兰克林用风筝证明了闪电是电。

transcript_json.text: He flew the kite in a storm.
transcript_json.translation: 他在暴风雨中放飞了风筝。

transcript_json.text: He did this in order to draw lightning from the clouds.
transcript_json.translation: 他这样做是为了把闪电从云中引下来。

transcript_json.text: He tied a metal key and a strip of silk to the kite line.
transcript_json.translation: 他把一把金属钥匙和一条丝带系在风筝线上。

transcript_json.text: The silk ribbon would stop the lightning from passing through his body.
transcript_json.translation: 丝带可以防止闪电穿过他的身体。

transcript_json.text: Benjamin's idea was first laughed at, but later on it led to the invention of the lightning rod.
transcript_json.translation: 本杰明的想法起初被嘲笑，但后来促成了避雷针的发明。

transcript_json.text: With such grand history, kite flying is sure to remain an entertaining and popular sport.
transcript_json.translation: 有着如此悠久的历史，放风筝一定会继续是一项有趣又受欢迎的运动。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
I have learned many languages, but I have not mastered them the way a professional interpreter or translator has.
transcript_json.translation: 我学过很多语言，但并没有像专业口译员或笔译员那样精通。

transcript_json.text: Still, they have opened doors for me.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，它们为我打开了一扇扇门。

transcript_json.text: They have allowed me the opportunity to seek jobs in international contexts and helped me get those jobs.
transcript_json.translation: 它们让我有机会在国际环境中求职，也帮我得到了那些工作。

transcript_json.text: Like many people who have lived overseas for a while, I simply got crazy about it.
transcript_json.translation: 和许多在海外生活过一段时间的人一样，我就是彻底迷上了这种生活。

transcript_json.text: I can't imagine living my professional or social life without international interactions.
transcript_json.translation: 我无法想象我的职业或社交生活没有国际交流会是什么样。

transcript_json.text: Since 1977, I have spent much more time abroad than in the United States.
transcript_json.translation: 自1977年以来，我在国外的时间远多于在美国。

transcript_json.text: I like going to new places, eating new foods, and experiencing new cultures.
transcript_json.translation: 我喜欢去新的地方，吃新的食物，体验新的文化。

transcript_json.text: If you can speak the language, it's easier to get to know the country and its people.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你会说当地语言，就更容易了解这个国家和它的人民。

transcript_json.text: If I had the time and money, I would live for a year in as many countries as possible.
transcript_json.translation: 如果有时间和金钱，我会尽可能多地去各个国家住上一年。

transcript_json.text: Beyond my career, my facility with languages has given me a few rare opportunities.
transcript_json.translation: 除了事业，我熟练的语言能力还给了我一些难得的机会。

transcript_json.text: Once, just after I returned from my year in Vienna, I was asked to translate for a German judge at an Olympic-level horse event, and learned a lot about the sport.
transcript_json.translation: 有一次，我刚从维也纳住了一年回来，就被请去在一场奥运级别的马术比赛中为一位德国裁判做翻译，学到了不少关于这项运动的知识。

transcript_json.text: In Japan, once when I was in the studio audience of a TV cooking show, I was asked to go up on the stage and taste the beef dish that was being prepared and tell what I thought.
transcript_json.translation: 在日本，有一次我在一档电视烹饪节目的观众席上，被请上台品尝正在做的牛肉菜，并说说我的看法。

transcript_json.text: They asked, "Was it as good as American beef?"
transcript_json.translation: 他们问："有美国牛肉好吃吗？"

transcript_json.text: It was very exciting for me to be on Japanese TV speaking in Japanese about how delicious the beef was.
transcript_json.translation: 能上日本电视，用日语说这牛肉有多美味，对我来说真是太兴奋了。
