transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
There is new data out today that confirms that many Americans are not good at math, and when it comes to everyday technology skills, we are dead last when compared to other developed countries.
transcript_json.translation: 今天公布的最新数据证实，许多美国人的数学都不太好，而在日常科技技能方面，与其他发达国家相比，我们排在最后一名。

transcript_json.text: Here's Gabriel Emanuel of National Public Radio.
transcript_json.translation: 下面是全国公共广播电台的加布里埃尔·伊曼纽尔。

transcript_json.text: Let's start with the bad news that Americans are terrible at technology skills: using email, naming a file on a computer, using a link on a web page, or just texting someone.
transcript_json.translation: 先说坏消息吧，美国人的技术技能很糟糕：用电子邮件、在电脑上给文件命名、点击网页上的链接，或者仅仅是给人发短信。

transcript_json.text: No country scored below the U.S.
transcript_json.translation: 没有哪个国家得分比美国还低。

transcript_json.text: Only one country, Poland, performed as poorly as we did.
transcript_json.translation: 只有一个国家，波兰，跟我们一样差。

transcript_json.text: Who came out the first?
transcript_json.translation: 谁排第一？

transcript_json.text: Japan did the best, and then Finland.
transcript_json.translation: 日本做得最好，其次是芬兰。

transcript_json.text: If you look at data about reading and math, you'll notice something interesting.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你看看阅读和数学方面的数据，你会发现一些有意思的事。

transcript_json.text: Young adults who went to college or graduate school were doing pretty well.
transcript_json.translation: 上过大学或研究生院的年轻人表现相当不错。

transcript_json.text: In literacy, they were actually doing better than their peers in other countries.
transcript_json.translation: 在读写能力方面，他们甚至比其他国家的同龄人做得更好。

transcript_json.text: So that's a bit of good news.
transcript_json.translation: 所以这是个小小的好消息。

transcript_json.text: But when you look at Americans who have a high school diploma, they look a lot like other countries' high school dropouts.
transcript_json.translation: 但看看只有高中文凭的美国人，他们跟其他国家的高中辍学者很像。

transcript_json.text: We have a lot of work to do.
transcript_json.translation: 我们有很多工作要做。

transcript_json.text: That is especially true when it comes to math.
transcript_json.translation: 在数学方面尤其如此。

transcript_json.text: You go to the store and there's a sale: buy one, get the second one half off.
transcript_json.translation: 你去商店，正好有促销：买一件，第二件半价。

transcript_json.text: You decide to buy two.
transcript_json.translation: 你决定买两件。

transcript_json.text: How much do you pay?
transcript_json.translation: 你要付多少钱？

transcript_json.text: You mean high school graduates can't do this task in general?
transcript_json.translation: 你是说高中毕业生一般都不会做这道题？

transcript_json.text: You're right.
What does that tell us about our education system?
transcript_json.translation: 这说明我们的教育体系怎么了？

transcript_json.text: Well, it tells us that we need to think about the preparedness of our students as they are leaving high school.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，这说明我们需要关注学生高中毕业时的准备程度。

transcript_json.text: Right.
And schools, employers, in fact, we all need to do something about it.
transcript_json.translation: 学校、雇主，事实上，我们所有人都得为此做点什么。

transcript_json.text: Thank you, Gabriel.
transcript_json.translation: 谢谢你，加布里埃尔。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Wild carrots probably evolved with the other flowering plants about 360 million years ago.
transcript_json.translation: 野生胡萝卜大约在3.6亿年前与其他开花植物一起进化出来。

transcript_json.text: Like apples, carrots are native to Central Asia.
transcript_json.translation: 和苹果一样，胡萝卜原产于中亚。

transcript_json.text: That's why horses, which also come from Central Asia, like both apples and carrots so much.
transcript_json.translation: 所以同样来自中亚的马既喜欢苹果又喜欢胡萝卜。

transcript_json.text: With wild carrots, the roots are white, small, and skinny, so you'd have to pick a lot of wild carrots to get enough to eat.
transcript_json.translation: 野生胡萝卜的根又白又小又细，所以你得摘很多才能凑够一顿吃的。

transcript_json.text: Doctors used carrot seeds and roots as medicine on the theory that foods that taste bad must be good for you.
transcript_json.translation: 医生曾用胡萝卜籽和根入药，理由是难吃的东西对身体一定有好处。

transcript_json.text: Around 800 A.D.
transcript_json.translation: 大约在公元800年。

transcript_json.text: People in Central Asia managed to develop a new kind of carrot, a purple carrot, that attracted more interest from international traders.
transcript_json.translation: 中亚人培育出了一种新品种——紫色胡萝卜，吸引了国际商贩的更多兴趣。

transcript_json.text: Then, in the late 1500s, food scientists in the Netherlands cultivated large, straight, sweet red carrots, like the ones we eat today.
transcript_json.translation: 后来，在16世纪末，荷兰的食品科学家培育出了又大又直又甜的红胡萝卜，就像我们今天吃的那种。

transcript_json.text: But people still mostly fed carrots to horses, donkeys, and pigs, and didn't eat them themselves.
transcript_json.translation: 但人们仍然主要是把胡萝卜喂给马、驴和猪，自己并不吃。

transcript_json.text: In the 1600s, people in China used carrots as medicine, but they also ate carrots boiled in soup.
transcript_json.translation: 在1600年代，中国人把胡萝卜当作药材，但他们也会把胡萝卜煮在汤里吃。

transcript_json.text: The red color was popular for Chinese New Year celebrations.
transcript_json.translation: 红色在中国新年庆祝活动中很受欢迎。

transcript_json.text: But carrots got their biggest boost during the two World Wars, when food shortages forced people to eat them, and governments told everyone how healthy carrots were.
transcript_json.translation: 但胡萝卜在两次世界大战期间获得了最大的推动，当时食物短缺迫使人们吃胡萝卜，政府也告诉每个人胡萝卜有多健康。

transcript_json.text: Today, cooler countries grow most of the world's carrots.
transcript_json.translation: 如今，气候较凉爽的国家种植了世界上大部分的胡萝卜。

transcript_json.text: Machines do most of the planting and picking, and carrots are easy to store and ship, so they are cheap almost everywhere.
transcript_json.translation: 种植和采摘大部分由机器完成，而且胡萝卜容易储存和运输，所以在几乎所有地方都很便宜。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Catherine loved Facebook.
transcript_json.translation: 凯瑟琳很喜欢脸书。

transcript_json.text: With Facebook, she could stay connected with her family, no matter how far away they were.
transcript_json.translation: 有了脸书，不管家人住得多远，她都能和他们保持联系。

transcript_json.text: She could see their photos and read their status updates.
transcript_json.translation: 她可以看到他们的照片，读到他们的状态更新。

transcript_json.text: With Facebook, she could keep her relatives up to date on what she was doing.
transcript_json.translation: 通过脸书，她能让亲戚们随时了解自己在做什么。

transcript_json.text: Another thing Catherine loved about Facebook was that she didn't have to think about time zones when updating family.
transcript_json.translation: 凯瑟琳喜欢脸书的另一个原因是，她更新家人的动态时不用考虑时区。

transcript_json.text: Whenever she called her parents or other relatives, she always had to think about the time difference so that she wouldn't wake someone up or call when she knew they were at church.
transcript_json.translation: 每次给父母或其他亲戚打电话，她都得考虑时差，以免吵醒他们，或者在她知道他们去做礼拜时打过去。

transcript_json.text: Facebook Was so convenient.
transcript_json.translation: 脸书真是太方便了。

transcript_json.text: When Catherine joined Facebook, some of her classmates at high school started to add her as a friend.
transcript_json.translation: 凯瑟琳加入脸书后，她高中的一些同学开始加她为好友。

transcript_json.text: At first, this didn't bother her.
transcript_json.translation: 起初，这并没有让她感到困扰。

transcript_json.text: She loved learning about the success of people she knew when she was just a teenager.
transcript_json.translation: 她很乐意了解自己十几岁时认识的人所取得的成功。

transcript_json.text: She loved finding out people were getting married, having babies, and traveling.
transcript_json.translation: 她喜欢知道大家结婚、生孩子和旅行的消息。

transcript_json.text: Soon, however, Catherine found herself comparing herself with the people she was reading about on Facebook.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，凯瑟琳很快就开始拿自己和在Facebook上看到的那些人作比较。

transcript_json.text: It began to make her feel bad that some people seemed to be doing so much better than she was.
transcript_json.translation: 有些人似乎过得比她好得多，这让她感觉很糟。

transcript_json.text: She was also spending a lot of time on Facebook.
transcript_json.translation: 她还花了很多时间泡在Facebook上。

transcript_json.text: It took a lot of time and energy to keep up with everyone's status updates.
transcript_json.translation: 追踪每个人的状态更新，耗费了她大量的时间和精力。

transcript_json.text: Catherine started to think.
transcript_json.translation: 凯瑟琳开始思考。

transcript_json.text: She looked at the list of over five hundred friends she had on Facebook, and realized some of them were not really friends at all.
transcript_json.translation: 她看着自己在Facebook上那500多个好友的名单，意识到其中有些人根本算不上朋友。

transcript_json.text: Questions 19 to 21 are based on the passage you have just heard.

transcript_json.text: Passage 3.
Do you know where a mule comes from?
transcript_json.translation: 你知道骡子是怎么来的吗？

transcript_json.text: It is the child of a donkey and a horse.
transcript_json.translation: 它是驴和马生的后代。

transcript_json.text: Mules have strong muscles like horses, but they eat less, can work longer, and are gentler like donkeys.
transcript_json.translation: 骡子像马一样肌肉发达，但吃得少、干活时间长，性情又像驴一样温顺。

transcript_json.text: George Washington was the first person in the United States to own mules.
transcript_json.translation: 乔治·华盛顿是美国第一个拥有骡子的人。

transcript_json.text: He had heard that mules made good farm animals, and he contacted the U.S ambassador in Spain to ask about them.
transcript_json.translation: 他听说骡子是很好的农场牲畜，便联系美国驻西班牙大使询问此事。

transcript_json.text: In 1785, King Charles III of Spain sent Washington a male donkey as a gift.
transcript_json.translation: 1785年，西班牙国王查理三世送给华盛顿一头公驴作为礼物。

transcript_json.text: That male donkey became the father of the mule industry in the U.S.
transcript_json.translation: 那头公驴成了美国骡子业的鼻祖。

transcript_json.text: Every April, Prince County holds is a Mule Day celebration.
transcript_json.translation: 每年4月，普林斯县都会举办骡子日庆典。

transcript_json.text: Held in Columbia, Tennessee, Mule Day had its beginning as Breeder's Day in the 1840s.
transcript_json.translation: 骡子日在田纳西州哥伦比亚市举行，始于1840年代的"繁育者日"。

transcript_json.text: Farmers and farm animal breeders would bring their animals to market every April to show, buy, and trade.
transcript_json.translation: 每年4月，农民和牲畜繁育者都会带着他们的牲口到集市上展示、买卖和交换。

transcript_json.text: This was an important business before the days of tractors, when many families made a living from farming, and mules were used as work animals.
transcript_json.translation: 在拖拉机问世之前，这是一门重要的营生，当时许多家庭以务农为生，骡子被用作役畜。

transcript_json.text: Eventually, tractors began to replace mules, making them less in demand.
transcript_json.translation: 最终，拖拉机开始取代骡子，骡子的需求量随之减少。

transcript_json.text: A parade was added to Mule Day in 1934 to attract more people.
transcript_json.translation: 1934年，骡子日增加了游行活动，以吸引更多人前来。

transcript_json.text: Over the years, other activities have been added, and today more than 200,000 people show up each year to watch and participate.
transcript_json.translation: 多年来又陆续增添了其他活动，如今每年有超过20万人前来观看和参与。

transcript_json.text: If you visit during Mule Day celebrations, you might see mule driving contests, square dances, horse shows, or even tree cutting competitions.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你在骡子日期间来访，可能会看到赶骡比赛、方块舞、马术表演，甚至伐木比赛。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1: A nine-year-old girl in New Mexico has raised more than $500 for her little brother, who needs heart surgery in Houston, Texas, this July.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道1：新墨西哥州一名9岁的女孩为她需要做心脏手术的弟弟筹集了500多美元，手术将于今年7月在得克萨斯州休斯敦进行。

transcript_json.text: Addison Witolsky's grandmother, Kim Orred, said Addison probably overheard a conversation between family members talking about the funds needed to get her little brother to treatment.
transcript_json.translation: 艾迪生·威托尔斯基的祖母金·奥雷德说，艾迪生大概是无意中听到家人在讨论送她弟弟去治疗所需的资金。

transcript_json.text: "I guess she overheard her grandfather and me talking about how we are worried about how we are going to get to Houston for my grandson's heart surgery," said Alred.
transcript_json.translation: 奥雷德说："我想她是听到我和她爷爷在谈，我们很发愁该怎么带孙子去休斯敦做心脏手术。"

transcript_json.text: "She decided to go outside and have a lemonade stand and make some drawings and pictures and sell them.
transcript_json.translation: 她决定到外面摆个柠檬水摊，再画一些画和图片拿去卖。

transcript_json.text: That's when Addison and her friends, Erica and Emily Borden, decided to sell lemonade for fifty cents a cup and sell pictures for twenty-five cents each.
transcript_json.translation: 就这样，阿迪森和她的朋友埃丽卡和艾米丽·博登决定以每杯50美分的价格卖柠檬水，以每幅25美分的价格卖画。

transcript_json.text: Before Alred knew it, New Mexico State Police officers were among the many stopping by, helping them reach a total of $568.
transcript_json.translation: 奥尔雷德还没反应过来，新墨西哥州的警察就已加入众多光顾者之列，帮她们筹到了总共568美元。

transcript_json.text: The family turned to social media, expressing their gratitude, saying, "From the bottom of our hearts, we would like to deeply thank each and every person that stopped by."
transcript_json.translation: 这一家人随即在社交媒体上表达感激之情，写道："我们由衷地深深感谢每一位光顾的人。"

transcript_json.text: News report two.
Last week, France announced that the country will pave 621 miles of road with solar panels over the next five years, with the goal of providing cheap, renewable energy to five million people.
transcript_json.translation: 上周，法国宣布将在未来5年内铺设621英里长的太阳能公路，目标是为500万人提供廉价的可再生能源。

transcript_json.text: Called the Wattway, the roads will be built Through joint efforts with the French road-building company Colas and the National Institute of Solar Energy, the company spent the last five years developing solar panels that are only about a quarter of an inch thick and are strong enough to stand up to heavy highway traffic without breaking or making the roads more slippery.
transcript_json.translation: 这些被称为"瓦特路"的公路将与法国道路建设公司科拉斯和国家太阳能研究所合作建造，该公司过去5年研发出的太阳能面板仅约四分之一英寸厚，足以承受繁忙的高速公路车流而不破裂，也不会让路面变得更滑。

transcript_json.text: The panels are also designed so that they can be installed directly on top of existing roadways, making them relatively cheap and easy to install.
transcript_json.translation: 这些面板还设计为可以直接安装在现有路面上，因此安装成本低且简便。

transcript_json.text: France isn't the first country to kick around the idea of paving its roads with solar panels.
transcript_json.translation: 法国并不是第一个设想用太阳能面板铺设公路的国家。

transcript_json.text: In November 2015, the Netherlands completed a 229-foot-long bike path paved with solar panels as a test for future projects.
transcript_json.translation: 2015年11月，荷兰建成了一条长229英尺的太阳能面板自行车道，作为未来项目的试验。

transcript_json.text: However, this is the first time a panel has been designed to be laid directly on top of existing roads, and the first project to install The panels on public highways.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，这是首次设计出可直接铺在现有路面上的面板，也是首个将面板安装在公共高速公路上的项目。

transcript_json.text: News report three.
Lions have disappeared from much of Africa, but for the past few years, scientists have wondered if the big cats were hanging on in remote parts of Sudan and Ethiopia.
transcript_json.translation: 狮子已从非洲大部分地区消失，但过去几年里，科学家一直在猜测这些大型猫科动物是否仍在苏丹和埃塞俄比亚的偏远地区存活。

transcript_json.text: Continuous fighting in the region has made surveys difficult, but scientists released a report Monday documenting, with hard evidence, the discovery of lost lions.
transcript_json.translation: 该地区持续的战乱使调查工作难以开展，但科学家周一发布了一份报告，用确凿证据记录了对失踪狮群的发现。

transcript_json.text: A team with Oxford University's Wildlife Conservation Research Unit, supported by a charity organization, spent two nights in November camping in a national park in northwest Ethiopia, on the Ethiopia-Sudan border.
transcript_json.translation: 由牛津大学野生动物保护研究部组成的一个团队，在一家慈善机构的资助下，于11月在埃塞俄比亚西北部、埃塞俄比亚与苏丹边境的一座国家公园里扎营两晚。

transcript_json.text: The researchers set out six camera traps, capturing images of lions, and they identified lion tracks.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员架设了6台红外触发相机，拍到了狮子的影像，还识别出狮子的足迹。

transcript_json.text: The scientists concluded that lions are also likely to live in a neighboring national park across the border in Sudan.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家得出结论，狮子也很可能生活在边境另一侧苏丹的一个邻近国家公园里。

transcript_json.text: The International Union for Conservation of Nature had previously considered the area a possible range for the species, and local people had reported seeing lions in the area, but no one presented convincing evidence.
transcript_json.translation: 世界自然保护联盟此前曾把该地区视为这一物种可能的栖息范围，当地居民也报告说在那里见到过狮子，但没有人拿出令人信服的证据。

Green, what do you think makes a successful negotiator?

transcript_json.text: Well, that's hard to define, but I think successful negotiators Good negotiators have several things in common.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，这很难定义，但我认为成功的谈判者、优秀的谈判者有几个共同点。

transcript_json.text: They are always polite and rational people.
transcript_json.translation: 他们总是彬彬有理、理性冷静。

transcript_json.text: They are firm but flexible.
transcript_json.translation: 他们坚定但不失灵活。

transcript_json.text: They can recognize power and know how to use it.
transcript_json.translation: 他们能认清权力所在，也懂得如何运用它。

transcript_json.text: They are sensitive to the dynamics of a negotiation, the way it rises and falls, and how it may change direction.
transcript_json.translation: 他们对谈判的动态很敏感，能察觉谈判的起伏，以及可能改变方向的时机。

transcript_json.text: They project an image of confidence.
transcript_json.translation: 他们展现出自信的形象。

transcript_json.text: And, perhaps most importantly, they know when to stop.
transcript_json.translation: 而且，也许最重要的是，他们知道何时该收手。

transcript_json.text: And what about an unsuccessful negotiator?
transcript_json.translation: 那不成功的谈判者呢？

transcript_json.text: Well, this is probably all of us when we start out.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我们刚入行时大概都这样。

transcript_json.text: We are probably immature and over trusting, too emotional or aggressive.
transcript_json.translation: 我们可能不成熟、过于轻信，太情绪化或太有攻击性。

transcript_json.text: We are unsure of ourselves, and we want to be liked by everyone.
transcript_json.translation: 我们缺乏自信，又想让所有人都喜欢自己。

transcript_json.text: Good negotiators learn fast.
transcript_json.translation: 优秀的谈判者学得很快。

transcript_json.text: Poor negotiators remain like that and go on losing negotiations.
transcript_json.translation: 差劲的谈判者一直这样，不断输掉谈判。

transcript_json.text: In your opinion, can the skills of negotiation be taught?
transcript_json.translation: 在你看来，谈判技巧可以教吗？

transcript_json.text: Well, you can teach someone how to prepare for negotiation.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，你可以教别人如何为谈判做准备。

transcript_json.text: There are perhaps six stages in every negotiation: get to know the other side, state your goals, start the process, clarify areas of disagreement or conflict, reassess your position, making acceptable compromises, and finally, reach some agreement in principle.
transcript_json.translation: 每场谈判大概有六个阶段：了解对方、说明你的目标、开启谈判进程、明确分歧或冲突所在、重新评估你的立场、作出可接受的妥协，最后达成原则性协议。

transcript_json.text: These stages can be studied, and the strategies to be used in each can be planned beforehand.
transcript_json.translation: 这些阶段是可以研究的，每个阶段该用什么策略也可以事先规划好。

transcript_json.text: But I think the really successful negotiator is probably born with a sixth sense about responding appropriately to the situation at hand.
transcript_json.translation: 但我认为，真正成功的谈判者大概天生就有第六感，能对当时的情况做出恰当的反应。

transcript_json.text: The artistic sense you've just described?
transcript_json.translation: 你刚才说的那种艺术感？

transcript_json.text: Yes, that's right.
transcript_json.translation: 对，没错。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Some people wonder why countries spend millions of dollars on space projects.
transcript_json.translation: 有些人不明白，为什么各国要在太空项目上花费数百万美元。

transcript_json.text: They want to know how space research helps people on Earth.
transcript_json.translation: 他们想知道太空研究对地球上的人有什么帮助。

transcript_json.text: Actually, space technology helps people on Earth every day.
transcript_json.translation: 实际上，太空技术每天都在帮助地球上的人。

transcript_json.text: This is called spin-off technology.
transcript_json.translation: 这叫做衍生技术。

transcript_json.text: Spin-off technology is space technology that is now used on Earth.
transcript_json.translation: 衍生技术是指现在在地球上使用的航天技术。

transcript_json.text: In early space programs, such as the Apollo missions of the 1960s and 1970s, and in the space shuttle missions today, scientists developed objects for the astronauts to use on the Moon and in space.
transcript_json.translation: 在早期的太空计划中，比如1960和1970年代的阿波罗登月任务，以及今天的航天飞机任务中，科学家们研制出供宇航员在月球和太空中使用的物品。

transcript_json.text: We now use some of these objects every day.
transcript_json.translation: 现在我们每天都用到其中一些物品。

transcript_json.text: For example, we have quartz crystal clocks and watches accurate to within one minute a year.
transcript_json.translation: 比如，我们有走时精准到每年误差不超过1分钟的石英钟和石英表。

transcript_json.text: We purify the water we drink with a water filter designed for the astronauts' use in space.
transcript_json.translation: 我们用为宇航员太空使用而设计的滤水器来净化饮用水。

transcript_json.text: The cordless, handheld tools we use in our homes, such as vacuum cleaners, flashlights, drills, and saws came from the technology of these early space programs.
transcript_json.translation: 我们家里用的无线手持工具，比如吸尘器、手电筒、电钻和电锯，都来自早期这些太空计划的技术。

transcript_json.text: On cold winter days, we can stay warm with battery-operated gloves and socks, and specially made coats and jackets.
transcript_json.translation: 在寒冷的冬日，我们可以戴上电池供电的手套和袜子，以及特制的外套和夹克来保暖。

transcript_json.text: All of these clothes are similar to the spacesuit designs that kept astronauts comfortable in the temperatures of the moon, and are spin-offs from space technology.
transcript_json.translation: 所有这些衣服都类似于让宇航员在月球温度下保持舒适的宇航服设计，都是航天技术的衍生产品。

transcript_json.text: These products are only a few examples of the many ways space technology helps us in our everyday lives.
transcript_json.translation: 这些产品只是航天技术在我们日常生活中帮助我们的众多方式中的几个例子。

transcript_json.text: No one knows how new spin-off technology from the International Space Station will help us in the future.
transcript_json.translation: 没有人知道国际空间站的新衍生技术将来会如何帮助我们。

transcript_json.text: Question 16: What do some people want to know about space exploration?
transcript_json.translation: 问题16：有些人想了解关于太空探索的什么？

transcript_json.text: Passage two: Well, if I could go back in history and live, I'd like to go back to the 18th century and perhaps in colonial America, in Yankee New England, where one of my ancestors lived.
transcript_json.translation: 短文二：嗯，如果我能回到历史中生活，我想回到18世纪，也许是在殖民时期的美国，新英格兰的扬基地区，我的一位祖先曾住在那里。

transcript_json.text: Because it was the beginning of something.
transcript_json.translation: 因为那是一个新时代的开端。

transcript_json.text: By the eighteenth century, there was a feeling of community that had grown.
transcript_json.translation: 到了18世纪，已经形成了一种社区意识。

transcript_json.text: My ancestor was a preacher, traveling around the countryside.
transcript_json.translation: 我的祖先是位传教士，在乡间四处传道。

transcript_json.text: People lived in small communities.
transcript_json.translation: 人们住在小社区里。

transcript_json.text: There were fishermen and farmers who provided fresh food that tasted and looked like food, unlike that in today's supermarkets.
transcript_json.translation: 那里有渔夫和农夫，提供新鲜的食物，味道和卖相都像是真正的食物，不像今天超市里的那样。

transcript_json.text: And there were small towns, and New York wasn't that far away.
transcript_json.translation: 还有小城镇，纽约也没那么远。

transcript_json.text: I'm deeply attached to the Puritan tradition, not in a religious sense, but they believed in working for something, working for goals, and I like that.
transcript_json.translation: 我对清教徒传统很有感情，不是从宗教角度，而是他们相信为某件事而工作，为奋斗目标而工作，我喜欢这一点。

transcript_json.text: They worked hard at whatever they did, but they had a sense of achievement.
transcript_json.translation: 他们干什么都很卖力，而且有成就感。

transcript_json.text: They believed in goodness, in community, in helping one another.
transcript_json.translation: 他们相信善良，相信社区，相信互相帮助。

transcript_json.text: I love the colonial fabrics, all the silverwork, the furnishings, the combination of elegance and simplicity.
transcript_json.translation: 我喜欢殖民地时期的织物，还有那些银器、家具，优雅与朴素的结合。

transcript_json.text: I love it.
transcript_json.translation: 我真是太喜欢了。

transcript_json.text: The printing, the books, I'm very attached to all that kind of thing.
transcript_json.translation: 印刷品、书籍，这类东西我都非常喜欢。

transcript_json.text: It may not all be very entertaining in the modern sense of the word, but I would have enjoyed spending my evenings in that environment, discussing new ideas, building a new world.
transcript_json.translation: 按现代的标准来说可能不算很有意思，但我会很乐意在那种环境里度过夜晚，讨论新思想，建设新世界。

transcript_json.text: And I can see myself sitting on a small chair by the fire doing needlework.
transcript_json.translation: 我也能想象自己坐在炉火旁的小椅子上做针线活。

transcript_json.text: Passage 3.
If you are lost in the woods, a little knowledge can turn what some people call a hardship into an enjoyable stay away from the troubles of modern society.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你在树林里迷了路，懂一点知识，就能把有些人眼里的苦差变成一次远离现代社会烦恼的愉快旅程。

transcript_json.text: When you think you are lost, sit down on a log or a rock or lean against a tree, and recite something that you have memorized to bring your mind to a point where it is under control.
transcript_json.translation: 当你觉得迷路时，就坐在圆木或石头上，或者靠在树上，背诵一些你记住的东西，让脑子静下来，能控制住自己。

transcript_json.text: Don't run blindly.
transcript_json.translation: 不要盲目乱跑。

transcript_json.text: If you must move, don't follow a stream unless you know it, and in that case you are not lost.
transcript_json.translation: 如果一定要走动，不要顺着溪流走，除非你认识这条路，不过那样的话你也就没有迷路。

transcript_json.text: Streams normally flow through wetland before they reach a lake or a river.
transcript_json.translation: 溪流一般流经湿地，然后才汇入湖泊或河流。

transcript_json.text: Though there are more eatable plants, there may also be wild animals, poisonous snakes, and other hazards.
transcript_json.translation: 虽然可吃的植物更多，但也可能有野生动物、毒蛇和其他危险。

transcript_json.text: Many experts feel that it is wisest to walk uphill.
transcript_json.translation: 许多专家认为，最明智的做法是往山上走。

transcript_json.text: At the top of most hills and mountains are trails leading back to civilization.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数丘陵和山顶都有小路通回有人居住的地方。

transcript_json.text: If there are no trails, you are much easier to be seen on top of a hill, and you may even spot a highway or a railroad from this point.
transcript_json.translation: 如果没有小路，在山顶上你更容易被发现，而且从那里你甚至可能看到公路或铁路。

transcript_json.text: Nowadays, the first way someone will search for you is by air.
transcript_json.translation: 如今，搜寻你的人首先会采用空中搜索的方式。

transcript_json.text: In a wetland or in dense growth, you are very hard to spot.
transcript_json.translation: 在湿地或茂密的植被中，你很难被发现。

transcript_json.text: Any time you go Into the woods, somebody should know where you are going and when you expect to return.
transcript_json.translation: 每次进树林，都应该有人知道你要去哪里、预计什么时候回来。

transcript_json.text: Also, when someone comes looking, you should be able to signal to them.
transcript_json.translation: 另外，当有人来找你时，你应该能给他们发信号。

transcript_json.text: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 22至25题基于你刚听到的短文。

transcript_json.translation: 第22题：如果在树林里迷路，说话人建议你首先做什么？

transcript_json.text: News Report 1: A New Jersey black bear that walks upright on its two back legs and has become a social media darling has reemerged and has been captured on video months after its last sighting.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道1：新泽西州一只用两条后腿直立行走、在社交媒体上走红的黑熊再次现身，人们在它上次露面数月后拍到了它的视频。

transcript_json.text: The bear, named Pedals, was spotted in the town of Oak Ridge in a video posted.
transcript_json.translation: 一只名叫"佩德尔斯"的熊在一段发布于橡树岭镇的视频中被拍到。

transcript_json.text: To Facebook featuring the bear, it appeared to be in relatively good health and was moving quickly.
transcript_json.translation: 这段发布在脸书上的视频显示，这只熊看起来身体状况还不错，行动也很迅速。

transcript_json.text: Pedals apparently has an injured leg or paw that doesn't allow it to walk comfortably on all fours, according to experts.
transcript_json.translation: 据专家说，佩德尔斯显然有一条腿或爪子受了伤，无法正常用四肢行走。

transcript_json.text: Lawrence Hajner, spokesman for the State Department of Environmental Protection, said officials expect the bear to make it through next winter.
transcript_json.translation: 新泽西州环境保护部发言人劳伦斯·哈伊纳说，官员们预计这只熊能熬过下一个冬天。

transcript_json.text: The bear first gained fame after it was spotted wandering around neighborhoods and was caught on videos that were posted on social media and shown on national television.
transcript_json.translation: 这只熊最初是因为在居民区附近游荡被人拍到，相关视频在社交媒体上传播并上了全国电视，才出了名。

transcript_json.text: Last year, supporters pushed for Pedals to be moved to a shelter, but New Jersey officials have said they won't allow the bear to be captured and transferred to the facility.

transcript_json.text: Traffic in the U.S is actually getting worse.

transcript_json.text: The U.S.
Department of Transportation says Americans drove nearly 3,150 billion miles last year.

transcript_json.text: That's about the same distance as 337 round trips from Earth to Pluto.
transcript_json.translation: 这大约相当于从地球到冥王星往返337次的距离。

transcript_json.translation: 之前的纪录是2007年的30030亿英里，那是经济衰退和高油价之前。

transcript_json.text: The traffic increase comes at the same time as gas prices dropped significantly.
transcript_json.translation: 交通量上升的同时，油价大幅下跌。

transcript_json.text: The current average gas price in the U.S is $1.71 per gallon.
transcript_json.translation: 目前美国的平均油价是每加仑1.71美元。

transcript_json.text: A year ago, it was $2.31 per gallon, and was often much higher in recent years.
transcript_json.translation: 一年前是每加仑2.31美元，而且近年来常常还要高得多。

transcript_json.text: A transportation expert told the reporter that job growth likely plays a part as well, along with some people driving longer distances to and from work.
transcript_json.translation: 一位交通专家告诉记者，就业增长可能也是一个因素，此外还有一些人上下班开车的距离变长了。

transcript_json.text: And so, all this means more traffic jams on the road.
transcript_json.translation: 所以，这一切意味着路上的交通堵塞会更加严重。

transcript_json.text: The Texas A&M Travel Institute found that rush hour travelers spent an extra 42 hours on the road last year because of travel delays.
transcript_json.translation: 德州农工大学交通研究所发现，去年由于出行延误，高峰时段的出行者在路上多花了42小时。

transcript_json.text: Now, that is depressing.

transcript_json.text: What happened next will pull at your heartstrings.

transcript_json.text: A wonderful bond formed between the two, and within a couple of weeks, the stranger, named White, helped raise $190,000 on a website to support the Memphis teenager and his disabled mother.
transcript_json.translation: 两人之间建立了美好的情谊，几周之内，这位名叫怀特的陌生人在一个网站上筹集了19万美元，用来资助这位孟菲斯少年和他残疾的母亲。

transcript_json.text: "When Chauncey approached me, it just pulled at my heart," White said.
transcript_json.translation: 怀特说："昌西来找我的时候，我的心一下就被打动了。"

transcript_json.text: "Here comes Chauncey, just trying to get food for him and his mom off the grace of other people.
transcript_json.translation: "昌西走过来，只是想靠别人的善意给他和妈妈弄点吃的。

transcript_json.text: When I looked at him and saw what he was doing and what he was asking for, I said he was my hero.
transcript_json.translation: 当我看着他，看到他在做什么、在请求什么的时候，我说他是我的英雄。

transcript_json.text: Chauncey is a top student who is doing his best to make it in a world with no money and very few resources," White explained on the crowdfunding site.
transcript_json.translation: 昌西是个优等生，在一个没有钱、资源又极其匮乏的世界里努力生活，"怀特在众筹网站上解释道。

transcript_json.text: "He wants to work and help his mother financially.
transcript_json.translation: "他想工作，在经济上帮助他的母亲。

transcript_json.text: It's so rare that we get an opportunity to effect so much change on one life," White wrote.
transcript_json.translation: 我们很少有机会能如此深刻地改变一个人的命运，"怀特写道。

transcript_json.text: "I cannot thank you enough for caring about Chauncey."
transcript_json.translation: "万分感谢你们对昌西的关心。"

transcript_json.text: This is his big chance, and you're making it possible.

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
That was my last economics lecture of the week, and here's the weekend again.
transcript_json.translation: 这是我本周最后一节经济学课了，周末又到了。

transcript_json.text: What are you up to tonight?
transcript_json.translation: 你今晚打算干嘛？

transcript_json.text: I was just wondering if we could try out the new restaurant on Charles Street, then go on to Queen Victoria for a drink.
transcript_json.translation: 我在想我们能不能去查尔斯街那家新餐馆尝尝，然后去维多利亚女王酒吧喝一杯。

transcript_json.text: Sorry, I'm heading home this weekend for my brother's eighteenth birthday.
transcript_json.translation: 不好意思，我这周末要回家，我弟弟过18岁生日。

transcript_json.text: Oh, that's Great.
transcript_json.translation: 哦，那太好了。

transcript_json.text: All my relatives are going to be there, as well as my brother's horrible friends, of course.
transcript_json.translation: 所有亲戚都会去，当然还有我弟弟那些讨厌的朋友。

transcript_json.text: Listen, why don't you come along?
transcript_json.translation: 听着，你何不一起来呢？

transcript_json.text: Mum would be absolutely delighted to see you again.
transcript_json.translation: 我妈看到你肯定会很高兴的。

transcript_json.text: She's always asking after you.
transcript_json.translation: 她总念叨你呢。

transcript_json.text: Yes, I'd love to see her too.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，我也很想见她。

transcript_json.text: So, please, do come.
transcript_json.translation: 所以，一定要来啊。

transcript_json.text: It'll be great.
transcript_json.translation: 一定会很棒的。

transcript_json.text: And besides, with Jonathan's wild game to contend with, I'd really welcome an ally.
transcript_json.translation: 再说，要应付乔纳森那些疯狂的游戏，我真希望能有个帮手。

transcript_json.text: That sounds tempting, but I won't be ready till five, as I've got my statistics seminar now.
transcript_json.translation: 听起来挺诱人的，但我现在有统计学研讨课，要到5点才能完事。

transcript_json.text: What time are you heading off?
transcript_json.translation: 你几点出发？

transcript_json.text: Well, I was going to leave right away.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我本来打算马上走的。

transcript_json.text: However, I can hang around for you if you like.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，如果你愿意，我可以等你。

transcript_json.text: It just means that I'll need to change my ticket.
transcript_json.translation: 只不过我得改签车票。

transcript_json.text: But would that be too much trouble for you?
transcript_json.translation: 但那会不会太麻烦你了？

transcript_json.text: No, not at all.
transcript_json.translation: 不，一点也不麻烦。

transcript_json.text: I'll go to the station first, and see if I can get tickets for us on the 6:30 train.
transcript_json.translation: 我先去车站，看看能不能买到6点半那班车的票。

transcript_json.text: Then you can join me there.
transcript_json.translation: 然后你到车站来跟我会合。

transcript_json.text: I'll text you when it's done.
transcript_json.translation: 搞定了我发短信给你。

transcript_json.text: Brilliant.
Are you absolutely positive it's okay.
transcript_json.translation: 你真的确定没问题吗？

transcript_json.text: I wouldn't want to impose.
transcript_json.translation: 我不想给你添麻烦。

transcript_json.text: Don't worry.
You're most welcome to join our party.
transcript_json.translation: 非常欢迎你来参加我们的聚会。

transcript_json.text: And, as I always say, the more the merrier.
transcript_json.translation: 而且，我常说，人越多越热闹。

transcript_json.text: Look, I'd better go or I'll be late.
transcript_json.translation: 哎，我得走了，不然要迟到了。

transcript_json.text: So I'll meet you down at the station around six.
transcript_json.translation: 那我们6点左右在车站见。

transcript_json.text: Fine.
See you later.
transcript_json.translation: 回头见。

transcript_json.text: I've got A little put aside for a rainy day, but I might need to earn a little more before we go.
transcript_json.translation: 我存了一点应急的钱，不过出发前可能还得再多挣一点。

transcript_json.text: By the way, what's it like working in a restaurant?

transcript_json.text: Well, it's really tough, as working a ten-hour shift is like hell.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，真的很辛苦，上10小时的班简直像受罪。

transcript_json.text: I'm not sure it'll suit you, but it's pretty cool if your boss is alright.
transcript_json.translation: 我不确定这工作适不适合你，不过要是老板人不错，还是挺好的。

transcript_json.text: Do you think we should invite some others to come along?

transcript_json.text: Yes, we could ask Tom and Tracy if they're interested.

transcript_json.text: I haven't been abroad for a long while, and it would be great to go somewhere by the sea.

transcript_json.translation: 我们尽量多存点钱，明年7月去航海。

But first we'd better contact Tom and Tracy and see if they're up for it.

transcript_json.text: One.
Most people know Marie Curie was the first woman to win the Nobel Prize and the first person to win it twice.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数人都知道居里夫人是第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性，也是第一位两次获得该奖的人。

transcript_json.text: However, few people know that she was also the mother of a Nobel Prize winner.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，很少有人知道她还是一位诺贝尔奖得主的母亲。

transcript_json.text: Irene Curie was born on September 12, 1897.
transcript_json.translation: 伊雷娜·居里出生于1897年9月12日。

transcript_json.text: At the age of ten, Irene's talents and interest in mathematics were apparent.
transcript_json.translation: 10岁时，伊雷娜在数学方面的才华和兴趣就已显露出来。

transcript_json.text: Irene entered Sorbonne University in October 1914 to prepare for a degree in mathematics and physics.
transcript_json.translation: 1914年10月，伊雷娜进入索邦大学，攻读数学和物理学位。

transcript_json.text: When World War I began, she left Sorbonne University to help her mother, who was using X-ray facilities to help save the lives of wounded soldiers.
transcript_json.translation: 第一次世界大战爆发后，她离开索邦大学去帮助母亲，当时她母亲正利用X光设备抢救受伤士兵的生命。

transcript_json.text: Irene continued this work by developing X-ray facilities for military hospitals in France and Belgium.
transcript_json.translation: 伊雷娜继续这项工作，为法国和比利时的军队医院开发X光设备。

transcript_json.text: After the war, she received a military medal for her work.
transcript_json.translation: 战后，她因自己的工作获得了一枚军功章。

transcript_json.text: In 1918, Irene became her mother's assistant at the Curie Institute.
transcript_json.translation: 1918年，伊雷娜成为她母亲在居里研究所的助手。

transcript_json.text: In December 1924, Frederick Joliot visited the institute, where he met Marie Curie.
transcript_json.translation: 1924年12月，弗雷德里克·约里奥来到研究所，在那里见到了玛丽·居里。

transcript_json.text: Frederick became one of her assistants, and Irene taught him the techniques required to work with radioactivity.
transcript_json.translation: 弗雷德里克成了她的助手之一，伊雷娜教他从事放射性研究所需的技巧。

transcript_json.text: Irene and Frederick soon fell in love, and got married on October 29, 1926.
transcript_json.translation: 伊雷娜和弗雷德里克很快坠入爱河，并于1926年10月29日结婚。

transcript_json.text: Their daughter was born in 1927, and their son in 1932.
transcript_json.translation: 他们的女儿1927年出生，儿子1932年出生。

transcript_json.text: Like her mother, Irene combined family with career.
transcript_json.translation: 和母亲一样，伊雷娜兼顾家庭与事业。

transcript_json.text: Like her mother, Irene was awarded a Nobel Prize, along with her husband Frederick, in 1935, for producing new radioactive elements.
transcript_json.translation: 和母亲一样，1935年，伊雷娜和丈夫弗雷德里克因制造出新的放射性元素而获得诺贝尔奖。

transcript_json.text: Unfortunately, also like her mother, she developed blood cancer because of her exposure to radiation.
transcript_json.translation: 不幸的是，也和母亲一样，她因接触辐射而患上了血癌。

transcript_json.text: Irene Joliot-Curie died on March 17, 1956.
transcript_json.translation: 伊雷娜·约里奥-居里于1956年3月17日去世。

transcript_json.text: Passage Two Have you ever heard of the Vikings?
transcript_json.translation: 第二篇短文。你听说过维京人吗？

transcript_json.text: They were sea travelers from Norway.
transcript_json.translation: 他们是来自挪威的航海者。

transcript_json.text: More than a thousand years ago, they made three important geographical discoveries.
transcript_json.translation: 一千多年前，他们有3个重要的地理发现。

transcript_json.text: The Vikings' first major discovery occurred in the ninth century.
transcript_json.translation: 维京人的第一个重大发现发生在9世纪。

transcript_json.text: A man called Naddod was on his way from Norway to the Faroe Islands, north of England, when his ship was caught in a storm.
transcript_json.translation: 一个叫纳多德的人从挪威前往英格兰以北的法罗群岛，途中船只遇上了风暴。

transcript_json.text: The storm blew the ship west for several days.
transcript_json.translation: 风暴把船往西吹了好几天。

transcript_json.text: When the weather cleared, Naddod found himself on the coast of a new land.
transcript_json.translation: 天气放晴后，纳多德发现自己来到了一片新大陆的海岸。

transcript_json.text: Later, Viking travelers named it Iceland.
transcript_json.translation: 后来，维京旅行者把它命名为冰岛。

transcript_json.text: In 982, a Viking called Eric the Red sailed west in search of new land.
transcript_json.translation: 982年，一个叫红发埃里克的维京人向西航行，寻找新大陆。

transcript_json.text: Five hundred miles west of Iceland, he and his men reached an icy, rocky mass of land.
transcript_json.translation: 在冰岛以西500英里处，他和船员们到达了一片冰封多石的陆地。

transcript_json.text: They sailed around it until they reached the western side.
transcript_json.translation: 他们绕着它航行，直到来到西侧。

transcript_json.text: Here they found some green areas, so they named the island Greenland.
transcript_json.translation: 在这里他们发现了一些绿色区域，于是把这个岛命名为格陵兰。

transcript_json.text: Then, in 1001, the Vikings made their most important discovery.
transcript_json.translation: 然后，在1001年，维京人做出了他们最重要的发现。

transcript_json.text: The son of Eric the Red, named Leif Ericson, had heard rumors about land west of Greenland.
transcript_json.translation: 红发埃里克的儿子莱夫·埃里克森听说格陵兰以西有陆地的传闻。

transcript_json.text: He sailed west and soon found it.
transcript_json.translation: 他向西航行，很快就找到了。

transcript_json.text: He and his men landed in three places.
transcript_json.translation: 他和船员们在三个地方登陆。

transcript_json.text: They called the first one Heluland, which means Land of Flat Stones.
transcript_json.translation: 他们把第一个叫赫鲁兰，意思是"平石之地"。

transcript_json.text: The Vikings then sailed south and made their second landing.
transcript_json.translation: 维京人随后向南航行，进行了第二次登陆。

transcript_json.text: They named this place Markland.
transcript_json.translation: 他们把这个地方命名为马克兰。

transcript_json.text: Their third landing was at a place they called Vinland.
transcript_json.translation: 他们的第三次登陆是在一个叫文兰的地方。

transcript_json.text: Erikson and his men were the first Europeans to walk on the shores of North America, almost 500 years earlier than Columbus.
transcript_json.translation: 埃里克森和船员们是最早踏上北美海岸的欧洲人，比哥伦布早了将近500年。

transcript_json.translation: 问题19：关于维京人我们了解到什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 20: What does the passage say about Greenland?
transcript_json.translation: 问题20：短文对格陵兰说了什么？

transcript_json.translation: 问题21：讲话者主要讲了什么？

transcript_json.text: Passage 3.
Where do you think you'll be in ten years?
transcript_json.translation: 你觉得十年后你会在哪里？

transcript_json.text: It's difficult to know exactly where you'll be and what you'll be doing, but everyone dreams about the future.
transcript_json.translation: 很难准确知道你将来会在哪里、会做什么，但每个人都会憧憬未来。

transcript_json.text: You might imagine the job you'll get when you finish school.
transcript_json.translation: 你可能会想象毕业后会找到什么样的工作。

transcript_json.text: You may daydream about meeting your life partner, or living in a big house by the sea.
transcript_json.translation: 你可能会幻想遇到一生的伴侣，或者住在海边的一栋大房子里。

transcript_json.text: In my dreams, I would have twins, a boy and a girl.
transcript_json.translation: 在我的梦想中，我会有一对龙凤胎，一男一女。

transcript_json.text: We would live in a large two-story house with floors and a staircase made of wood.
transcript_json.translation: 我们会住在一栋两层的大房子里，地板和楼梯都是木头做的。

transcript_json.text: Now, at the age of 46, I look back on those dreams and Smile.
transcript_json.translation: 现在，46岁的我回想起那些梦想，不禁笑了。

transcript_json.text: Things haven't turned out exactly as I imagined, but I wouldn't change what I have now for that imaginary world.
transcript_json.translation: 事情并没有完全像我想象的那样，但我不会用现在拥有的一切去换那个想象中的世界。

transcript_json.text: In college, I studied international business and planned to enter law school.
transcript_json.translation: 上大学时，我学的是国际商务，还打算去读法学院。

transcript_json.text: In my third year of university, I realized that I didn't want to become a lawyer.
transcript_json.translation: 大三那年，我意识到自己不想当律师。

transcript_json.text: Instead, I chose to become a language teacher.
transcript_json.translation: 于是，我选择成为一名语言教师。

transcript_json.text: I did get married, but had more than two children.
transcript_json.translation: 我确实结婚了，但孩子不止两个。

transcript_json.text: We had five.
transcript_json.translation: 我们有5个孩子。

transcript_json.text: Do I live in the dream house with wooden floors?
transcript_json.translation: 我住在梦想中那栋有木地板的房子里吗？

transcript_json.text: No, I don't.
transcript_json.translation: 不，我没有。

transcript_json.text: But I love my home, and I wouldn't want to live in any other place.
transcript_json.translation: 但我很爱我的家，我不想住在其他任何地方。

transcript_json.text: I believe that as a young person, it's important to dream and make plans.
transcript_json.translation: 我认为，年轻时有梦想、做计划是很重要的。

transcript_json.text: However, it's also important to realize that not all of your plans will turn out exactly as you wish.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，同样重要的是要明白，并非所有计划都会如你所愿。

transcript_json.text: One of the biggest lessons I've learned in life is this: be happy with what you have.
transcript_json.translation: 我在人生中学到的最大教训之一就是：珍惜你所拥有的，知足常乐。

transcript_json.text: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第22至25题基于你刚才听到的短文。

transcript_json.text: Question 22: What does the speaker think everyone tends to do?
transcript_json.translation: 第22题：说话者认为每个人都倾向于做什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 23: What does the speaker say he would refuse to do?
transcript_json.translation: 问题23：说话者说他拒绝做什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 24: What did the speaker major in during the first two years of college?
transcript_json.translation: 问题24：说话者在大学头两年主修什么专业？

transcript_json.text: Question twenty-five: What is one of the biggest lessons the speaker has learned in life?
transcript_json.translation: 问题25：说话者人生中学到的最重要的教训之一是什么？

transcript_json.translation: 听力理解部分到此结束。

transcript_json.text: College English Test Band 4, Part 2, Listening Comprehension.
transcript_json.translation: 大学英语四级考试，第二部分，听力理解。

transcript_json.text: Section A.
Section A, Directions.
Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports.
transcript_json.translation: 说明：在本节中，你将听到3篇新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: At the end of each news report, you will hear two or three questions.
transcript_json.translation: 每篇新闻报道结束后，你将听到2到3个问题。

transcript_json.text: Both the news report and the questions will be spoken only once.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道和问题都只朗读一遍。

transcript_json.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C, and D.
transcript_json.translation: 听到问题后，你必须从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳答案。

transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上相应的字母中间划一条横线。

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
A message in a bottle sent out to sea by a New Hampshire man more than five decades ago was found 1,500 miles away and has been returned to his daughter.
transcript_json.translation: 50多年前，一名新罕布什尔州男子扔进大海的漂流瓶在1500英里外被人发现，如今已交还给他的女儿。

transcript_json.text: The long-lost message was discovered by Clint Buffington of Utah while he was vacationing says he found a soda bottle half buried in the sand that looked like it had been there since the beginning of time.
transcript_json.translation: 这个失落已久的漂流瓶是犹他州的克林特·巴芬顿在度假时发现的，他说他找到一个半埋在沙里的汽水瓶，看上去好像从开天辟地起就在那儿了。

transcript_json.text: The note inside the bottle said, "Return to 419 Ocean Street and receive a reward of $150 from Richard and Tina Pierce, owners of the Beachcomber Motel."
transcript_json.translation: 瓶子里的纸条上写着："请送回海洋街419号，海滩拾荒者汽车旅馆的老板理查德和蒂娜·皮尔斯将付给你150美元酬金。"

transcript_json.text: The motel was owned by the parents of Paula Pierce in 1960.
transcript_json.translation: 1960年，这家汽车旅馆属于葆拉·皮尔斯的父母。

transcript_json.text: Her father had written the note as a joke and had thrown it into the Atlantic Ocean.
transcript_json.translation: 她父亲写下这张纸条只是开个玩笑，然后把它扔进了大西洋。

transcript_json.text: Buffington flew to New Hampshire to deliver the message to Paula Pierce.
transcript_json.translation: 巴芬顿乘飞机前往新罕布什尔州，把纸条交给了葆拉·皮尔斯。

transcript_json.text: She held up to her father's promise, giving Buffington that reward.
transcript_json.translation: 她兑现了父亲的承诺，把酬金给了巴芬顿。

transcript_json.text: But the biggest reward is the message in a bottle finding its way back home.
transcript_json.translation: 但最大的回报是这个漂流瓶终于回到了家。

transcript_json.text: News report two: Millions of bees have died in South Carolina during aerial insect spraying operations that were carried out to combat the Zika virus.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻2：南卡罗来纳州在为抗击寨卡病毒而进行的空中喷洒杀虫剂作业中，数百万只蜜蜂死亡。

transcript_json.text: The insect spraying over the weekend left more than two million bees dead on the spot in Dorchester County, South Carolina, where four travel-related Cases of Zika disease have been confirmed in the area.
transcript_json.translation: 周末的喷洒作业导致南卡罗来纳州多切斯特县200多万只蜜蜂当场死亡，该地区已确认4例输入性寨卡病例。

transcript_json.text: Most of the deaths came from Flower Town Bee Farm, a company in Somerville that sells bees and honey products.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数死亡的蜜蜂来自"鲜花镇"养蜂场，这是一家位于萨默维尔、销售蜜蜂和蜂蜜产品的公司。

transcript_json.text: Juanita Stanley, who owns the company, said the farm looks like it's been destroyed.
transcript_json.translation: 公司老板胡安妮塔·斯坦利说，农场看起来像是被摧毁了。

transcript_json.text: The farm lost about 2.5 million bees.
transcript_json.translation: 农场损失了约250万只蜜蜂。

transcript_json.text: Dorchester County officials apologized for the accidental mass killing of bees.
transcript_json.translation: 多切斯特县官员就这起蜜蜂大规模意外死亡事件道歉。

transcript_json.text: "Dorchester County is aware that some beekeepers in the area that was sprayed on Sunday lost their bee colonies," County Manager Jason Ward said in a statement.
transcript_json.translation: "多切斯特县注意到，周日喷洒区域的一些养蜂人失去了蜂群，"县行政长官杰森·沃德在声明中说。

transcript_json.text: "I'm not pleased that so many bees were killed."
transcript_json.translation: "这么多蜜蜂被杀死，我感到很不高兴。"

transcript_json.text: News report three: The world's largest aircraft has taken to the skies for the first time.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻3：世界上最大的飞行器首次升空。

transcript_json.text: The Airlander 10 spent nearly two hours in the air, having taken off from Cardington Airfield in Bedfordshire.
transcript_json.translation: "天空登陆者10号"从贝德福德郡的卡丁顿机场起飞，在空中飞行了近两个小时。

transcript_json.text: During its flight, it reached 3,000 feet and performed a series of gentle turns all over a safe area.
transcript_json.translation: 飞行过程中，它升至3000英尺，在安全区域内完成了一系列平缓的转向。

transcript_json.text: The aircraft is massive as long as a football field and as tall as six double-decker buses, and capable of flying for up to five days.
transcript_json.translation: 这架飞行器体型巨大，长度相当于一个足球场，高度相当于6辆双层巴士，能够连续飞行5天。

transcript_json.text: It was first developed for the US Government as a long-range spy aircraft, but was abandoned following budget cutbacks.
transcript_json.translation: 它最初是为美国政府研发的远程侦察飞行器，但因预算削减而被放弃。

transcript_json.text: The aircraft cost £25 million and can carry heavier loads than huge jet planes, while also producing less noise and emitting less pollution.
transcript_json.translation: 造价2500万英镑，载重量超过大型喷气式飞机，同时噪音更小、污染更少。

transcript_json.text: The makers believe it's the future of aircraft, and one day we'll be using them to go places.
transcript_json.translation: 制造商认为它是飞行器的未来，总有一天我们会乘坐它出行。

transcript_json.text: But there's still a long way to go.
transcript_json.translation: 但前方的路还很长。

transcript_json.text: The Airlander will need to have 200 hours' flying time before being allowed to fly by the aviation administration.
transcript_json.translation: Airlander 需要积累200小时的飞行时间，才能获准由民航管理部门放飞。

transcript_json.text: If it passes, though, we can hope we'll all get some extra legroom.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，如果通过了，我们就有望都能多些腿部空间了。

transcript_json.translation: 第7题：Airlander 10相比巨型喷气式飞机有什么优势？

transcript_json.translation: 我觉得讲的是气候变化如何影响日常生活。

transcript_json.translation: 我想知道他们怎么把它拍得有趣。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Have you ever felt like you would do just about anything to satisfy your hunger?
transcript_json.translation: 你有没有过那种为了填饱肚子什么都愿意做的感觉？

transcript_json.text: A new study in mice may help to explain why hunger can feel like such a powerful motivating force.
transcript_json.translation: 一项在老鼠身上进行的新研究，可能有助于解释为什么饥饿会成为如此强大的驱动力。

transcript_json.text: In the study, researchers found that hunger outweighed other physical drives, including fear, thirst, and social needs.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员在研究中发现，饥饿会压过其他生理需求，包括恐惧、口渴和社交需求。

transcript_json.text: To determine which feeling won out, the researchers did a series of Experiments.
transcript_json.translation: 为了确定哪种感觉占上风，研究人员做了一系列实验。

transcript_json.text: In one experiment, the mice were both hungry and thirsty.
transcript_json.translation: 在一个实验中，老鼠既饿又渴。

transcript_json.text: When given the choice of either eating food or drinking water, the mice went for the food, the researchers found.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员发现，当老鼠可以选择吃东西或喝水时，它们选择了食物。

transcript_json.text: However, when the mice were well-fed but thirsty, they opted to drink, according to the study.
transcript_json.translation: 而研究显示，当老鼠吃饱了但口渴时，它们选择了喝水。

transcript_json.text: In the second experiment, meant to pit the mice's hunger against their fear, hungry mice were placed in a cage that had certain fox-scented areas and other places that smelled safer, in other words, not like an animal that could eat them, but also had food.
transcript_json.translation: 第二个实验是让老鼠的饥饿感与恐惧感对抗：把饥饿的老鼠放进一个笼子里，笼中某些区域有狐狸的气味，另一些区域闻起来更安全——也就是说，闻起来不像有能吃掉它们的动物，而且还有食物。

transcript_json.text: It turned out that when the mice were hungry, they ventured into the unsafe areas for food, but when the mice were well-fed, they stayed in areas of the cage that were considered safe.
transcript_json.translation: 结果发现，老鼠饥饿时会冒险进入不安全的区域觅食，而吃饱后则待在笼子里被认为是安全的区域。

transcript_json.text: Hunger also outweighed the mice's social needs, the researchers found.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员发现，饥饿感也超过了小鼠的社交需求。

transcript_json.text: Mice are usually social animals and prefer to be in the company of other mice, according to the study.
transcript_json.translation: 研究表明，小鼠通常是群居动物，喜欢和其他小鼠待在一起。

transcript_json.text: When the mice were hungry, they opted to leave the company of other mice to go get food.
transcript_json.translation: 当小鼠饥饿时，它们会选择离开同伴去找食物。

transcript_json.text: Passage two: The United States has one of the best highway systems in the world.
transcript_json.translation: 短文二：美国拥有世界上最好的公路系统之一。

transcript_json.text: Interstate highways connect just about every large and mid-sized city in the country.
transcript_json.translation: 州际公路几乎连接了全国每座大中型城市。

transcript_json.text: Did you ever wonder why such a complete system of excellent roads exists?
transcript_json.translation: 你有没有想过，为什么会有如此完善的优质公路系统？

transcript_json.text: For an answer, you would have to go back to the early 1920s.
transcript_json.translation: 要找到答案，就得回到20世纪20年代初。

transcript_json.text: In those years, just after World War I, the military wanted to build an American highway system for national defense.
transcript_json.translation: 那些年，一战刚结束，军方想为国防建设一套美国公路系统。

transcript_json.text: Such a system could, if necessary, move troops quickly from one area to another.
transcript_json.translation: 这样的系统在必要时可以把部队从一个地区迅速调往另一个地区。

transcript_json.text: It could also get people out of cities in danger of being bombed.
transcript_json.translation: 它还能在城市面临轰炸危险时把民众疏散出去。

transcript_json.text: So-called roads of national importance were designated, but they were mostly small country roads.
transcript_json.translation: 当时划定了所谓的"国家重要道路"，但大多是乡间小路。

transcript_json.text: In 1944, Congress passed a bill to upgrade the system, but did not fund the plan right away.
transcript_json.translation: 1944年，国会通过了一项升级该系统的法案，但没有立即拨款。

transcript_json.text: In the 1950s, the plan began to become a reality.
transcript_json.translation: 到20世纪50年代，该计划开始变为现实。

transcript_json.text: Over $25 billion was appropriated by Congress, and construction began on about 40,000 miles of new roads.
transcript_json.translation: 国会拨款超过250亿美元，开始修建约40000英里的新公路。

transcript_json.text: The idea was to connect the new system to existing expressways and freeways.
transcript_json.translation: 设想是把新系统与现有的高速公路和快速路连接起来。

transcript_json.text: And though the system was built mostly to make car travel easier, defense was not forgotten.
transcript_json.translation: 虽然修建这套系统主要是为了让驾车出行更方便，但国防需求并没有被忽视。

transcript_json.text: For instance, highway overpasses had to be high enough to allow trailers carrying military missiles to pass under them.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，公路立交桥必须建得足够高，以便让装载军用导弹的拖车从下面通过。

transcript_json.text: By 1974, this system was mostly completed.
transcript_json.translation: 到1974年，这个系统基本建成。

transcript_json.text: A few additional roads would come later.
transcript_json.translation: 后来又增加了一些道路。

transcript_json.text: Quick and easy travel between all parts of the country was now possible.
transcript_json.translation: 从此，全国各地之间都能快捷方便地出行了。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
Texting while driving was listed as a major cause of road deaths among young Americans back in 2013.
transcript_json.translation: 早在2013年，开车发短信就被列为美国年轻人交通死亡的主要原因之一。

transcript_json.text: A recent study said that 40 percent of American teens claim to have been in a car when the driver used a cell phone in a way that put people in danger.
transcript_json.translation: 最近一项研究称，40%的美国青少年表示，他们曾坐在司机以危险方式使用手机的车里。

transcript_json.text: This sounds like a widespread disease, but it's one that technology may now help to cure.
transcript_json.translation: 听起来这像是一种普遍的流行病，但现在技术或许能帮我们治好它。

transcript_json.text: T.J.
Evarts, a 20-year-old inventor, has come up with a novel solution that could easily put texting drivers on notice.
transcript_json.translation: 20岁的发明者埃瓦茨想出了一个新颖的解决方案，可以轻松提醒发短信的司机。

transcript_json.text: It's called Smart Wheel, and it's designed to fit over the steering wheel of most standard vehicles to track whether or not the driver has two hands on the wheel at all times.
transcript_json.translation: 它叫智能方向盘套，设计用来套在大多数标准汽车的方向盘上，随时监测司机是否双手都握着方向盘。

transcript_json.text: Evarts' invention warns the drivers with a light and a sound when they hold the wheel with one hand only, but as soon as they place the other hand back on the wheel, the light turns back to green and the sound stops.
transcript_json.translation: 当司机只用一只手握方向盘时，埃瓦茨的发明会用灯光和声音警告他们；但只要另一只手放回方向盘，灯就会变回绿色，声音也停止。

transcript_json.text: It also watches for what's called close-by hands, where both hands are close together near the top of the wheel, so the driver can type with both thumbs and drive at the same time.
transcript_json.translation: 它还能识别所谓的"双手靠拢"，即两只手都靠近方向盘顶部，这样司机就能用两个拇指一边打字一边开车。

transcript_json.text: All the data Smart Wheel collects is also sent to a connected app, so any parents Who installs Smart wheel can keep track of the teen's driving habits.
transcript_json.translation: 智能方向盘套收集的所有数据还会发送到配套应用，所以装了它的家长可以随时了解青少年的驾驶习惯。

transcript_json.text: If they try to remove or damage the cover, that's reported as well.
transcript_json.translation: 如果他们试图拆下或损坏这个装置，也会被报告。

Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports.

transcript_json.text: News Report One.

Kelly Swisher, an Arkansas woman, escaped injury and managed to safely stop her car after a four-foot-long rat snake came out from under her car seat and slid across her feet as she was driving down the highway.
transcript_json.translation: 阿肯色州女子凯莉·斯威舍在高速公路开车时，一条4英尺长的鼠蛇从汽车座椅下钻出来，从她脚上滑过，她没有受伤，并设法安全停下了车。

transcript_json.text: Rat snakes aren't poisonous or a threat to people.
transcript_json.translation: 鼠蛇没有毒，对人也不构成威胁。

transcript_json.text: Generally, but the woman says the snake she encountered Thursday terrified her out of her wits.
transcript_json.translation: 一般来说是这样，但这位女士说，她周四遇到的那条蛇把她吓得魂飞魄散。

transcript_json.text: "It was rough, with big scales," said Swisher, who was on her way to pick up her friend at the airport when it happened.
transcript_json.translation: "它很粗糙，鳞片很大，"斯威舍说。事发时她正开车去机场接朋友。

transcript_json.text: "I don't know whether I had my hands on the steering wheel or not.
transcript_json.translation: "我不知道我当时手还扶不扶着方向盘。

transcript_json.text: I am not the most flexible person in the world, but I can guarantee my knees were up next to my ears."
transcript_json.translation: 我算不上身体最灵活的人，但我敢保证我的膝盖都快顶到耳朵了。"

transcript_json.text: She said the snake first slid back under the seat, and she hoped it would stay there until she was able to get off the highway and stop.
transcript_json.translation: 她说那条蛇先滑回了座椅底下，她希望它能待在那里，直到她能驶离高速公路停下来。

transcript_json.text: "That didn't work out," she said.
transcript_json.translation: "结果没成，"她说。

transcript_json.text: "Here he comes, and he wound up in my back seat before I could finally get off the road, stop, and get out of the car."
transcript_json.translation: "它又爬出来了，在我终于开下公路、停下车、下车之前，它跑到了后座上。"

transcript_json.text: She called for help, and Washington County Animal Control officers came and captured the snake.
transcript_json.translation: 她打电话求助，华盛顿县动物管制处的工作人员赶来抓住了这条蛇。

transcript_json.text: Questions 1 and 2 are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 问题1和2基于你刚才听到的这篇新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question one: How did Kelly Swisher feel when she first came across the rat snake?
transcript_json.translation: 问题一：凯莉·斯威舍第一次遇到鼠蛇时是什么感觉？

transcript_json.text: Question two: What does the report say about the snake?
transcript_json.translation: 问题二：报道中对这条蛇有什么说法？

transcript_json.text: News report two.
Fast food, it turns out, isn't quite as fast as it used to be.
transcript_json.translation: 事实证明，快餐不像过去那么"快"了。

transcript_json.text: A new study finds that McDonald's posted its slowest drive-through times since this survey was first conducted 15 years ago.
transcript_json.translation: 一项新研究发现，麦当劳的汽车餐厅取餐时间创下15年前开始这项调查以来的最慢纪录。

transcript_json.text: At McDonald's, customers will spend, on average, three minutes and nine seconds from the time they place their orders until they receive their food.
transcript_json.translation: 在麦当劳，顾客从下单到拿到食物平均要花3分9秒。

transcript_json.text: That's about ten seconds more than the industry average, and a lot slower than a decade ago, according to the study, which was commissioned by QSR, an industry trade publication.
transcript_json.translation: 据这项由行业刊物《QSR》委托开展的研究，这比行业平均水平长约10秒，也比10年前慢了很多。

transcript_json.text: And McDonald's wasn't alone in slowing down.
transcript_json.translation: 而且变慢的不只是麦当劳。

transcript_json.text: Other chains also saw their drive-through performance slow down.
transcript_json.translation: 其他连锁品牌的汽车餐厅服务速度也有所下降。

transcript_json.text: Among the reasons for the slower service, today there are more choices on the menu, and the products themselves are more complex and take longer to prepare.
transcript_json.translation: 服务变慢的原因包括：如今菜单上的选择更多，产品本身也更复杂，准备时间更长。

transcript_json.text: Speed, of course, is essential to the drive-through experience, and drive-throughs are hugely important to chains such as McDonald's, Burger King, and Taco Bell.
transcript_json.translation: 当然，速度对汽车餐厅体验至关重要，而汽车餐厅对麦当劳、汉堡王和塔可钟这样的连锁品牌来说也极为重要。

transcript_json.text: Usually, the drive-through accounts for sixty to seventy percent of all business that goes through a fast food restaurant, notes Sam Ochis, editor of QSR.
transcript_json.translation: 《QSR》主编萨姆·奥奇斯指出，汽车餐厅通常占一家快餐店总营业额的60%到70%。

transcript_json.text: Of course, consumers also want their orders prepared correctly, and on that score, Ochis says accuracy is still really high.
transcript_json.translation: 当然，消费者也希望订单不出差错，奥奇斯说，在这方面准确率仍然非常高。

transcript_json.text: Questions three and four are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 问题三和问题四基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question three: What is the news report mainly about?
transcript_json.translation: 问题三：这则新闻报道主要讲什么？

transcript_json.text: Question four: What has slowed down McDonald's drive-through service?
transcript_json.translation: 问题四：是什么导致麦当劳的汽车餐厅服务变慢？

transcript_json.text: News report three.
The first private mission outside of Earth's orbit is closer than many of us think.
transcript_json.translation: 首次飞出地球轨道的私人航天任务，比我们许多人想的更近。

transcript_json.text: U.S government officials are set to approve a mission by privately held space company Moon Express to travel outside of Earth's orbit in late 2017.
transcript_json.translation: 美国政府官员即将批准私营航天公司"月球快车"在2017年底飞出地球轨道的任务。

transcript_json.text: Moon Express's mission involves plans to land a suitcase-sized package of scientific equipment on the Moon for ongoing exploration and commercial development.
transcript_json.translation: "月球快车"的任务计划在月球着陆一个手提箱大小的科学设备包裹，用于持续探测和商业开发。

transcript_json.text: The decision involved months of lobbying and coordinated conversations between a number of federal agencies.
transcript_json.translation: 这一决定经历了数月的游说，以及多个联邦机构之间的协调沟通。

transcript_json.text: Under international treaties, the U.S is responsible for the cargo of both public and private spacecraft.
transcript_json.translation: 根据国际条约，美国对公共和私人航天器的货物都负有责任。

transcript_json.text: This makes commercial space travel a complex legal issue, not just domestically, but abroad.
transcript_json.translation: 这使得商业太空旅行成为一个复杂的法律问题，不仅在国内，国外也是如此。

transcript_json.text: A Moon Express representative declined to comment on this story, but noted that the company is very optimistic about its proposal.
transcript_json.translation: 月球快车公司的一位代表拒绝对此事发表评论，但表示公司对这一计划非常乐观。

transcript_json.text: Moon Express is not the only company seeking for the rights to travel to outer space.
transcript_json.translation: 月球快车并不是唯一一家争取外太空旅行权利的公司。

transcript_json.text: Elon Musk's Space X aims to send an unmanned aircraft to Mars by 2018.
transcript_json.translation: 埃隆·马斯克的太空探索技术公司计划在2018年前向火星发射一架无人飞行器。

transcript_json.text: Questions five to seven are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 问题5到7基于你刚刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question five: What is the news report mainly about?
transcript_json.translation: 问题5：这则新闻报道主要讲了什么？

transcript_json.text: Question six: What is Moon Express planning to do?
transcript_json.translation: 问题6：月球快车计划做什么？

transcript_json.text: Question seven: What does Moon Express think of its mission?
transcript_json.translation: 问题7：月球快车如何看待它的任务？

transcript_json.translation: 在这一节中，你将听到两段长对话。

transcript_json.translation: 对话和问题都只读一遍。

transcript_json.translation: 听到问题后，你必须从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳答案。

transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上，用一条单线划过所选字母的中间。

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
Hey Sophia, how are you doing?
transcript_json.translation: 嘿，索菲娅，你怎么样？

transcript_json.text: Hi Bob, I'm good, thanks.
transcript_json.translation: 嗨，鲍勃，我挺好的，谢谢。

transcript_json.text: Actually, I'm on holiday with my family in Thailand at the moment, although I wish it were with my friends instead.
transcript_json.translation: 其实我现在和家人在泰国度假，不过我倒希望能和朋友一起来。

transcript_json.text: Really?
You never said you were going to Thailand.
transcript_json.translation: 你从没说过要去泰国啊。

transcript_json.text: How I envy you!
transcript_json.translation: 我真羡慕你！

transcript_json.text: I've only been here a week, but, you know, Thailand's an amazing place.
transcript_json.translation: 我才来了一周，不过你知道吗，泰国真是个了不起的地方。

transcript_json.text: I'm having a great time here.
transcript_json.translation: 我在这里玩得可开心了。

transcript_json.text: In fact, I'm now lying on the beach in Phuket.
transcript_json.translation: 其实，我现在正躺在普吉岛的沙滩上呢。

transcript_json.text: I've been in the sun for around fifteen minutes only, and I'm already getting sunburnt.
transcript_json.translation: 我晒了大概才15分钟太阳，就已经要晒伤了。

transcript_json.text: Have you been here before?
transcript_json.translation: 你以前来过这里吗？

transcript_json.text: No, I wish I had.
transcript_json.translation: 没有，真希望我来过。

transcript_json.text: What else have you been doing in Thailand besides enjoying the sun?
transcript_json.translation: 除了晒太阳，你在泰国还做了些什么？

transcript_json.text: Well, I met a guy from Germany yesterday.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我昨天认识了一个德国人。

transcript_json.text: He showed me around the orphanage he works at.
transcript_json.translation: 他带我参观了他工作的那家孤儿院。

transcript_json.text: There, I met many volunteer teachers who are mainly young people from Europe.
transcript_json.translation: 在那里，我遇到了很多志愿老师，大多是来自欧洲的年轻人。

transcript_json.text: Ah, that's interesting.
transcript_json.translation: 啊，那挺有意思的。

transcript_json.text: Yes, I also made a new little friend, Sarah.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，我还交了个小朋友，叫萨拉。

transcript_json.text: She was so cute.
transcript_json.translation: 她太可爱了。

transcript_json.text: I was so sad when I had to leave at the end of the day.
transcript_json.translation: 傍晚不得不走的时候，我可难过了。

transcript_json.text: If I ever come back to Thailand, I'd definitely visit this place again as a volunteer.
transcript_json.translation: 要是我以后再来泰国，我肯定还会以志愿者的身份再来这个地方。

transcript_json.text: Well, you can tell me all about it when you get back.
transcript_json.translation: 好啊，你回来的时候再慢慢跟我讲。

transcript_json.text: My phone battery is almost dead now.
transcript_json.translation: 我的手机快没电了。

transcript_json.text: Remember to get me something from the souvenir shops.
transcript_json.translation: 记得在纪念品商店给我带点东西。

transcript_json.text: I like to collect bits and pieces from different parts of the world.
transcript_json.translation: 我喜欢收集世界各地的小玩意儿。

transcript_json.text: Bye now.
Enjoy yourself, Sophia.
transcript_json.translation: 玩得开心，索菲娅。

transcript_json.text: Bye.

transcript_json.translation: 第8到11题基于你刚才听到的对话。

What does the woman say she is doing now?
transcript_json.translation: 那位女士说她现在在做什么？

transcript_json.text: Question nine: What did the woman do yesterday?
transcript_json.translation: 第9题：那位女士昨天做了什么？

transcript_json.translation: 第10题：那位男士为什么必须结束对话？

transcript_json.text: Question eleven: Why does the man ask the woman to bring him something from Thailand?
transcript_json.translation: 第11题：那位男士为什么请那位女士从泰国给他带东西回来？

transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
Hi, David.
There's a new gym opening in town today.
transcript_json.translation: 镇上今天新开了一家健身房。

transcript_json.text: Would you like to go with me this afternoon?
transcript_json.translation: 你今天下午想和我一起去吗？

transcript_json.text: Yes, more than glad to.
transcript_json.translation: 好啊，非常乐意。

transcript_json.text: I haven't been to a gym for ages.
transcript_json.translation: 我已经好久没去健身房了。

transcript_json.text: I need to do some exercise to tone up.
transcript_json.translation: 我得做点运动，把身材练结实些。

transcript_json.text: Then this is a good chance.
transcript_json.translation: 那这正好是个好机会。

transcript_json.text: They sent me an invitation with a note saying I could take a friend for free on the first day.
transcript_json.translation: 他们给我寄了张邀请函，上面说开业第一天我可以免费带一位朋友去。

transcript_json.text: Also, if we both sign up before Friday, we can get a discount on a six-month membership.
transcript_json.translation: 而且，如果我们俩都在周五前办卡，半年会员还能打折。

transcript_json.text: Great.
Count me in.
transcript_json.translation: 算我一个。

transcript_json.text: I really want to lose some of this belly fat and turn it into muscle.
transcript_json.translation: 我真的想把肚子上这些赘肉减掉，练成肌肉。

transcript_json.text: But I'm not sure which of the gym equipment would best help.
transcript_json.translation: 但我不太确定用哪种健身器材最管用。

transcript_json.text: Well, I'm no expert at that, but I think you can try lifting weights and do at least two hundred sit-ups twice a day.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，这方面我也不是专家，不过我觉得你可以试试举重，每天做至少200个仰卧起坐，一天两次。

transcript_json.text: I've never tried weightlifting before.
transcript_json.translation: 我以前从没举过重。

transcript_json.text: Is it dangerous?
transcript_json.translation: 危险吗？

transcript_json.text: No, not at all.
transcript_json.translation: 不，一点都不危险。

transcript_json.text: If you know some of the basics, don't worry, I'll show you the ropes.
transcript_json.translation: 你只要懂一些基本要领就行，别担心，我教你入门。

transcript_json.text: I used to practice this at another gym before my membership ended.
transcript_json.translation: 我以前在另一家健身房练过，后来会员到期了。

transcript_json.text: I'll be your personal trainer.
transcript_json.translation: 我是你的私人教练。

transcript_json.text: Thank you.
What other equipment do they have?
transcript_json.translation: 他们还有什么别的器材？

transcript_json.text: Well, like all gyms, they have all sorts of things to help build up muscles in different parts of the body, like upright bicycles, chest stretching machines, and running machines.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，跟所有健身房一样，他们有各种各样的器材，用来锻炼身体不同部位的肌肉，比如立式自行车、扩胸拉伸器械和跑步机。

transcript_json.text: You could use any of these to suit your purpose.
transcript_json.translation: 你可以根据自己的需要选用其中任何一种。

transcript_json.text: Now, the gym opens at noon, so can we meet up in town at 1:30 p.m.
transcript_json.translation: 健身房中午12点开门，那我们下午1:30在市里碰头好吗？

transcript_json.text: Perfect.
See you there, Coach.
transcript_json.translation: 到时候见，教练。

transcript_json.translation: 问题12：说话人在谈论什么？

transcript_json.translation: 问题13：健身房开业时提供什么？

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
In today's job market, it's not uncommon for job seekers to submit applications for many positions.
transcript_json.translation: 在如今的就业市场上，求职者同时申请多个职位的情况并不少见。

transcript_json.text: That involves lots of time and lots of work to organize.
transcript_json.translation: 这要花很多时间，也要费很多功夫去整理。

transcript_json.text: Certainly, you don't want to waste your precious hours on following the developments in a disorderly fashion and miss important deadlines, confuse interview times, or forget to follow up as a result.
transcript_json.translation: 当然，你也不想把宝贵的时间浪费在毫无头绪地追踪进展上，结果错过重要的截止日期、搞混面试时间，或者忘了跟进。

transcript_json.text: Accordingly, managing your job search properly is just as important as identifying job opportunities and submitting your applications.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，妥善管理你的求职过程，和发现职位机会、投递申请同样重要。

transcript_json.text: If you're familiar with Microsoft Excel or a similar program, creating a table is a simple and effective way to keep track of your job applications.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你熟悉微软Excel或类似的软件，建一张表格是记录求职申请简单而有效的方法。

transcript_json.text: If Excel isn't quite your cup of tea, don't worry.
transcript_json.translation: 如果Excel不是你的菜，别担心。

transcript_json.text: You can create a table in Microsoft Word or a similar word processor.
transcript_json.translation: 你可以在微软Word或类似的文字处理软件里建表格。

transcript_json.text: Google is another tool to help you get organized effectively.
transcript_json.translation: 谷歌是另一个帮你高效整理的工具。

transcript_json.text: If you have a Gmail account, you can create, save, and send tables in addition to written documents like your cover letter and resume.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你有Gmail账户，除了求职信和简历这样的书面文件，你还可以创建、保存和发送表格。

transcript_json.text: You can also link up with Google calendar to make sure you stay on top of important dates.
transcript_json.translation: 你还可以关联谷歌日历，确保自己掌握重要日期。

transcript_json.text: Clearly, there are plenty of ways to keep track of your job search, and making the effort to simplify your job search will pay off.
transcript_json.translation: 显然，追踪求职进展的方法有很多，花点心思简化你的求职过程是值得的。

transcript_json.text: Nevertheless, you should always focus on quality, not quantity.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，你始终要注重质量，而不是数量。

transcript_json.text: Only apply for positions you're qualified for, and make each application count, personalizing each cover letter and updating and editing your resume.
transcript_json.translation: 只申请你够资格的职位，让每一份申请都发挥作用：求职信要个性化，简历要更新和修改。

transcript_json.text: Question sixteen: What does the speaker say about today's job seekers?
transcript_json.translation: 问题16：演讲者对今天的求职者是怎么说的？

transcript_json.text: Passage two: Some people say, 'If kids didn't have to go to school, they'd all be out in the streets.'
transcript_json.translation: 第二篇短文：有人说，"如果孩子们不用上学，他们就都会跑到街上去了。"

transcript_json.text: My reply is, 'No, they wouldn't.'
transcript_json.translation: 我的回答是："不，他们不会。"

transcript_json.text: First, even if schools stayed just the way they are, children would spend at least some time there because that's where they'd be likely to find friends.
transcript_json.translation: 首先，即使学校还是老样子，孩子们也会在那儿待上至少一段时间，因为在那里最容易找到朋友。

transcript_json.text: Second, schools wouldn't stay the way they are; they'd get better, because we would have to start making them what they ought to be right now.
transcript_json.translation: 其次，学校不会一成不变；它们会变得更好，因为我们必须从现在就开始把它们建成应有的样子。

transcript_json.text: Last, if we stirred up our brains and gave children a little help, those who did not want to go to school could find other things to do-things many children now do during their holidays.
transcript_json.translation: 最后，如果我们动动脑筋，给孩子们一点帮助，那些不想上学的孩子就能找到别的事情做——也就是很多孩子如今在假期里做的事。

transcript_json.text: There's something easier we could do.
transcript_json.translation: 还有一件更容易的事我们可以做。

transcript_json.text: We need to get kids out of the school buildings, give them a chance to learn about the world at first hand.
transcript_json.translation: 我们得把孩子们从教学楼里带出来，让他们有机会亲身了解世界。

transcript_json.text: In Philadelphia and Portland, Oregon, plans are being drawn up for public schools that won't have any school buildings at all.
transcript_json.translation: 在费城和俄勒冈州的波特兰，人们正在规划没有教学楼的公立学校。

transcript_json.text: That will take the students out into the city and help them to use it and its people as a resource.
transcript_json.translation: 这将让学生走进城市，帮助他们把城市和城市里的人当作学习资源。

transcript_json.text: In other words, students, perhaps in groups, perhaps independently, will go to libraries, museums, exhibitions, courtrooms, radio and TV stations, meetings, businesses and laboratories to learn about their world and society at first hand.
transcript_json.translation: 换句话说，学生们可能结伴，也可能独自前往图书馆、博物馆、展览馆、法庭、广播电视台、会议、企业和实验室，亲身了解他们的世界和社会。

transcript_json.text: A small private school in Washington is already doing this.
transcript_json.translation: 华盛顿的一所小型私立学校已经在这么做了。

transcript_json.text: It makes sense.
transcript_json.translation: 这很有道理。

transcript_json.text: We need more of it.
transcript_json.translation: 我们需要更多这样的做法。
