transcript_json.text: Passage three.
Before there was the written word, there was the language of dance.
transcript_json.translation: 在文字出现之前，就有了舞蹈的语言。

transcript_json.text: Dance expresses love and hate, joy and sorrow, life and death, and everything else in between.
transcript_json.translation: 舞蹈表达爱与恨、喜与悲、生与死，以及两者之间的一切。

transcript_json.text: Dance in America is everywhere.
transcript_json.translation: 舞蹈在美国无处不在。

transcript_json.text: We dance from Florida to Alaska, from horizon to horizon and coast to coast.
transcript_json.translation: 我们从佛罗里达到阿拉斯加、从天涯到海角、从东海岸到西海岸，到处都有人在跳舞。

transcript_json.text: We dance at weddings, birthdays, office parties, or Just to fill the time.
transcript_json.translation: 我们在婚礼、生日、办公室聚会上跳舞，或者只是为了打发时间。

transcript_json.text: "I adore dancing," says Lester Bridges, the owner of a dance studio in a small town in Iowa.
transcript_json.translation: "我热爱跳舞，"莱斯特·布里奇斯说，他是爱荷华州一个小镇上一家舞蹈工作室的老板。

transcript_json.text: "I can't imagine doing anything else with my life."
transcript_json.translation: "我无法想象我这辈子还能做别的事情。"

transcript_json.text: Bridges runs dance classes for all ages.
transcript_json.translation: 布里奇斯开设各个年龄段的舞蹈课。

transcript_json.text: "Teaching dance is wonderful.
transcript_json.translation: "教舞蹈非常棒。

transcript_json.text: My older students say it makes them feel young.
transcript_json.translation: 我年纪大一些的学生说，跳舞让他们觉得自己年轻了。

transcript_json.text: It's marvelous to watch them.
transcript_json.translation: 看着他们跳舞真是太棒了。

transcript_json.text: For many of them, it's a way of meeting people and having a social life."
transcript_json.translation: 对他们中的很多人来说，这是结识朋友、拥有社交生活的一种方式。"

transcript_json.text: So why do we dance?
transcript_json.translation: 那么，我们为什么要跳舞呢？

transcript_json.text: "I can tell you about one young couple," says Bridges.
transcript_json.translation: "我可以给你讲一对年轻情侣的事，"布里奇斯说。

transcript_json.text: "They arrive at the class in a bad mood, and they leave with a smile.
transcript_json.translation: "他们来上课时心情不好，走的时候却带着笑容。

transcript_json.text: Dancing seems to change their mood completely."
transcript_json.translation: 跳舞似乎能彻底改变他们的心情。"

transcript_json.text: So, do we dance in order to make ourselves feel better, calmer, healthier?
transcript_json.translation: 那么，我们跳舞是为了让自己感觉更好、更平静、更健康吗？

transcript_json.text: Andrea Hillier, a dance teacher, says, "Dance, like the rhythm of a beating heart," is life.
transcript_json.translation: 舞蹈老师安德烈娅·希利尔说："舞蹈就像心脏跳动的节奏一样，就是生命。"

transcript_json.text: Even after all these years, I want to get better and better.
transcript_json.translation: 即使过了这么多年，我还是想跳得越来越好。

transcript_json.text: I keep practicing even when I'm exhausted.
transcript_json.translation: 哪怕累得不行，我也坚持练习。

transcript_json.text: I find it hard to stop.
transcript_json.translation: 我发现自己很难停下来。

transcript_json.text: Dancing reminds me I'm alive.
transcript_json.translation: 跳舞让我感到自己还活着。

Listening Comprehension.

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
A device that weighs less than one kilogram is part of a mission that will allow scientists to deliver fourth generation, or 4G, mobile coverage to the moon in 2019.
transcript_json.translation: 一台重量不到1公斤的设备，是一项任务的一部分，该任务将让科学家在2019年把4G移动网络覆盖送上月球。

transcript_json.text: If successful, the tiny device will provide the moon with its first ever mobile The lunar network will support high-definition streaming of video and data between the Moon and Earth.
transcript_json.translation: 如果成功，这个微型设备将使月球拥有史上第一个移动网络。月球网络将支持月球与地球之间的高清视频和数据流传输。

transcript_json.text: The network is part of Mission to the Moon.
transcript_json.translation: 该网络是登月计划的一部分。

transcript_json.text: This is a project with the goal of landing the first privately paid-for mission to the Moon.
transcript_json.translation: 这是一个旨在实现首次由私人出资的登月任务的项目。

transcript_json.text: The 4G mission is set to launch from Cape Canaveral in the United States on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket in 2019.
transcript_json.translation: 这项4G任务计划于2019年在美国卡纳维拉尔角，由SpaceX猎鹰9号火箭发射。

transcript_json.text: Mission to the Moon intends to establish and test the first elements of a communications network on the Moon.
transcript_json.translation: 登月计划打算在月球上建立并测试通信网络的首批组件。

transcript_json.text: The scientists working on the project opted to build a 4G rather than a fifth-generation or 5G network.
transcript_json.translation: 参与该项目的科学家选择搭建4G网络，而不是5G网络。

transcript_json.text: This is because fifth-generation networks are still in testing and trial phases.
transcript_json.translation: 这是因为5G网络仍处于测试和试验阶段。

transcript_json.text: This means that a 5G network may not yet be stable enough to work on the Moon's surface.
transcript_json.translation: 也就是说，5G网络可能还不够稳定，无法在月球表面工作。

transcript_json.translation: 问题1和问题2基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.translation: 问题1：科学家打算做什么？

transcript_json.text: News report two.
Firefighters responded to a fire Wednesday night at an abandoned mall in Hayward.
transcript_json.translation: 周三晚上，消防员赶往海沃德一座废弃商场扑救火灾。

transcript_json.text: The fire was reported at 9:26 p.m at an old shopping center on Mission Avenue near St.
transcript_json.translation: 火警于晚上9点26分报警，地点在米申路圣……附近的一处旧购物中心。

transcript_json.text: Mary's Church.
Six fire engines, two trucks, and two chiefs responded to the scene.
transcript_json.translation: 6辆消防车、2辆卡车和2名消防队长赶赴现场。

transcript_json.text: Crews had the fire under control in about 45 minutes and managed to contain the fire to its point of origin.
transcript_json.translation: 消防人员大约45分钟就控制住了火势，并设法将火势控制在起火点范围内。

transcript_json.text: There were some people inside the building when the fire broke out, but there were no reports of any injuries.
transcript_json.translation: 火灾发生时楼内有一些人，但没有人员受伤的报告。

transcript_json.text: Fire investigators have responded to the scene, but have not yet determined the cause of the fire.
transcript_json.translation: 火灾调查人员已经赶到现场，但尚未确定起火原因。

transcript_json.text: Firefighters will remain on the scene until later this morning to ensure that the fire doesn't start up again.
transcript_json.translation: 消防员将在现场留守到今天上午晚些时候，以确保火灾不会复燃。

transcript_json.text: The shopping mall had not been in use since 2002.
transcript_json.translation: 这家购物中心自2002年以来一直闲置。

transcript_json.text: In 2014, City Hall developed a plan to knock down the building and replace it with affordable housing.
transcript_json.translation: 2014年，市政府制定了拆除该建筑、改建经济适用房的计划。

transcript_json.text: However, the plan was dropped due to lack of funds.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，由于资金不足，该计划被搁置。

transcript_json.text: News report 3: Potato chips in Japan are being sold for six times their normal price.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道3：日本的薯片卖到了正常价格的6倍。

transcript_json.text: This is after the country's main manufacturer stopped sales due to a potato shortage.
transcript_json.translation: 原因是该国主要生产商因土豆短缺而停止销售。

transcript_json.text: Storms and floods in its main potato-growing region last year caused the worst harvest in more than three decades.
transcript_json.translation: 去年，其主要土豆种植区遭遇风暴和洪水，导致30多年来最差的收成。

transcript_json.text: Local media reports suggest Kalbi and its main rival, Koikya, are halting almost 50 products.
transcript_json.translation: 当地媒体报道称，卡乐比及其主要竞争对手湖池屋正在停售近50款产品。

transcript_json.text: "We don't know when we'll be able to restart," a company spokesman said.
transcript_json.translation: 一位公司发言人说："我们不知道什么时候能恢复生产。"

transcript_json.text: Snack lovers are panic buying, and many supermarket shelves are bare.
transcript_json.translation: 零食爱好者们正在恐慌性抢购，许多超市货架被一扫而空。

transcript_json.text: Japanese laws limit the amount of imported potatoes that can be used in Japanese-made products.
transcript_json.translation: 日本法律限制日本产食品中可使用的进口土豆数量。

transcript_json.text: Japan says fear of disease is its main reason to block fresh imports.
transcript_json.translation: 日本表示，担心病虫害是其阻止鲜土豆进口的主要原因。

transcript_json.text: It still only allows potatoes from selected U.S states.
transcript_json.translation: 它目前仍只允许从美国部分州进口土豆。

transcript_json.text: This is only at certain times and on condition that they are processed at factories based near Japanese ports.
transcript_json.translation: 而且只能在特定时间进口，条件是这些土豆须在靠近日本港口的工厂进行加工。

transcript_json.text: But global warming has raised the possibility that domestic produce could be seriously affected by rare weather events more often.
transcript_json.translation: 但全球变暖增加了这样一种可能性：国内农产品会更频繁地受到罕见天气事件的严重影响。

transcript_json.text: Question seven: What might affect Japanese domestic produce?
transcript_json.translation: 第7题：什么可能影响日本的国产农产品？

transcript_json.text: Conversation One.
Mr.
Brown's lectures are so boring.
transcript_json.translation: 布朗的课太无聊了。

transcript_json.text: Yes, he is not a very exciting speaker, but the subject is interesting.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，他讲课确实不怎么吸引人，但内容挺有意思的。

transcript_json.text: During every one of his lectures, I try to listen.
transcript_json.translation: 他每节课我都努力去听。

transcript_json.text: I really try, but after about ten minutes, my mind begins to wander and I lose concentration.
transcript_json.translation: 我真的很努力，可大约十分钟后，我就走神了，注意力也集中不了。

transcript_json.text: But I see that you seem to be okay.
transcript_json.translation: 不过我看你好像没问题。

transcript_json.text: How do you stay focused through the entire hour?
transcript_json.translation: 整整一个小时你是怎么保持专注的？

transcript_json.text: Well, what I do is keep my pen moving.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我的办法就是让笔一直动着。

transcript_json.text: What do you mean?
transcript_json.translation: 什么意思？

transcript_json.text: It's a method of active concentration I read about.

transcript_json.text: Passage 1.

A Pew Research Center survey of more than 1,000 Americans conducted in April 2016 finds that Americans continue to express largely positive views about the current state of their local public libraries.
transcript_json.translation: 皮尤研究中心于2016年4月对1000多名美国人进行的调查发现，美国人对当地公共图书馆的现状总体上仍持积极看法。

transcript_json.text: For instance, around three-quarters say that public libraries provide them with the resources they need, and Sixty-six percent say the closing of their local public library would have a major impact on their community, although notably, just 33 percent say this would have a major impact on them personally or on their family.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，约四分之三的人表示公共图书馆为他们提供了所需的资源，66%的人表示当地公共图书馆关闭会对社区产生重大影响，不过值得注意的是，只有33%的人表示这会对自己个人或家庭产生重大影响。

transcript_json.text: A majority of Americans feel libraries are doing a good job of providing a safe place for people to hang out or spend time, as well as opening up educational opportunities for people of all ages.
transcript_json.translation: 多数美国人认为，图书馆在为人们提供休闲聚会的安全场所以及为各年龄段的人提供教育机会方面做得很好。

transcript_json.text: And roughly half think their libraries contribute a lot to their communities in terms of helping spark creativity among young people and providing a trusted place for people to learn about new technologies.
transcript_json.translation: 约有一半人认为，图书馆在激发年轻人创造力、为人们了解新技术提供可信场所等方面，对社区贡献很大。

transcript_json.text: As in past Pew Research Center surveys of library use, the April 2016 survey also measured Americans' usage of and engagement with libraries.
transcript_json.translation: 与以往皮尤研究中心开展的图书馆使用调查一样，2016年4月的调查也考察了美国人使用图书馆及参与图书馆活动的情况。

transcript_json.text: Overall, Thirty-three percent of Americans ages 16 and older have had some interaction with a public library in the past year, either through an in-person visit or using a library website.
transcript_json.translation: 总体来看，16岁及以上的美国人中有33%在过去一年里与公共图书馆有过接触，或是亲自到馆，或是使用图书馆网站。

transcript_json.text: Some 48 percent of adults specifically visited a library in the past 12 months, a modest increase from the 44 percent who said that in late 2015.
transcript_json.translation: 约48%的成年人在过去12个月里专门去过图书馆，比2015年底的44%略有上升。

transcript_json.text: Passage 2: A Savannah cat is a crossbreed between a domestic cat and a medium-sized wild African cat called the serval.
transcript_json.translation: 短文2：萨凡纳猫是家猫与一种叫薮猫的中型非洲野猫的杂交品种。

transcript_json.text: The unusual cross became popular among breeders at the end of the 1990s, and in 2001 the International Cat Association accepted it as a new registered breed.
transcript_json.translation: 这种奇特的杂交品种在1990年代末受到繁育者的青睐，2001年国际猫协会将其认定为新的注册品种。

transcript_json.text: The Savannahs are tall and slim, and can weigh up to 9.1 kilograms, making them one of the largest breeds of cats that people can own.
transcript_json.translation: 萨凡纳猫身材高瘦，体重可达9.1公斤，是人们可以饲养的体型最大的猫品种之一。

transcript_json.text: They have a spotted coat similar to that of many types of wild cats, and their ears are very large.
transcript_json.translation: 它们的皮毛有斑点，与许多野猫相似，耳朵非常大。

transcript_json.text: They are also commonly compared to dogs in their loyalty, and can be trained to walk on a lead and to fetch.
transcript_json.translation: 它们的忠诚常被拿来与狗相比，可以训练它们牵绳散步和捡东西。

transcript_json.text: An often noted characteristic of the Savannah is its jumping ability.
transcript_json.translation: 萨凡纳猫的一个常被提及的特点是跳跃能力。

transcript_json.text: They are known to jump on top of doors and high cabinets.
transcript_json.translation: 据说它们能跳到门顶和高柜上面。

transcript_json.text: Some can leap about 2.5 meters high from a standing position.
transcript_json.translation: 有些能从站立姿势起跳约2.5米高。

transcript_json.text: Cats are typically known for being very inquisitive, and so are the Savannahs.
transcript_json.translation: 猫以好奇心强著称，萨凡纳猫也不例外。

transcript_json.text: They often learn how to open doors and cupboards.
transcript_json.translation: 它们常常学会开门和开橱柜。

transcript_json.text: Many Savannah cats do not fear water, and will play with or even dive into water.
transcript_json.translation: 许多萨凡纳猫不怕水，会在水里玩耍甚至跳入水中。

transcript_json.text: Some owners even shower with their Savannah cats.
transcript_json.translation: 有些主人甚至和萨凡纳猫一起洗澡。

transcript_json.text: Presenting a water bowl to a Savannah may also prove a challenge, as some will promptly begin to bat all the water out of the bowl until it is empty, using their front paws.
transcript_json.translation: 给萨凡纳猫放一碗水也可能是个难题，因为有些猫会立刻用前爪把碗里的水一下下拍出来，直到弄光为止。

transcript_json.text: Passage 3.
When children start school for the very first time, parents often feel a sense of excitement coupled with a touch of sadness at the end of an era.
transcript_json.translation: 孩子第一次上学时，父母常常既兴奋，又带着一丝时代落幕的伤感。

transcript_json.text: This is the start of a new adventure for children, playing and interacting with new friends, sharing, taking turns and settling into a new routine.
transcript_json.translation: 对孩子来说，这是新冒险的开始：和新朋友玩耍互动，学会分享、轮流，适应新的作息。

transcript_json.text: But of course, this is not the start of your child's education, which in fact began at birth.
transcript_json.translation: 当然，这并不是孩子教育的开始，教育其实从出生就开始了。

transcript_json.text: Back then, you would have been your child's most influential teachers. During this time at home, your child would have learned
transcript_json.translation: 那时，你们就是对孩子影响最大的老师。在家的这段时间里，孩子会学到

transcript_json.text: During your child's first year in school much time will be spent in learning to read and they need to know that this is fun and worthwhile.
transcript_json.translation: 孩子上学的第一年，很多时间都会花在学习阅读上，要让他们知道这很有趣、也很值得。

transcript_json.text: Your child will naturally copy you, so it is important that you are seen reading and enjoying books, newspapers, and magazines, rather than just absorbed in screens.
transcript_json.translation: 孩子会自然而然地模仿你，所以重要的是让他们看到你在读书、看报、看杂志并乐在其中，而不是只盯着屏幕。

transcript_json.text: Ultimately, an excellent education should be a close partnership between parents and teachers.
transcript_json.translation: 说到底，优质的教育应该是家长和老师之间的紧密合作。

transcript_json.text: A child's year splits fairly neatly into thirds, a third at school, a third asleep, and a third awake at home or on holiday.
transcript_json.translation: 孩子的一年大致可以均分成三份：三分之一在学校，三分之一在睡觉，三分之一在家或度假时醒着。

transcript_json.text: Irrespective of the quality of a school, a child's home life is of key importance.
transcript_json.translation: 无论学校质量如何，孩子的家庭生活都至关重要。

transcript_json.text: It is the determining factor of their academic success.
transcript_json.translation: 这是决定他们学业成败的关键因素。

transcript_json.text: Your child may have started on a new journey, but your work is far from finished.
transcript_json.translation: 孩子也许已经踏上了新的旅程，但你的任务远未结束。

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
Rescue crews pulled a man to safety after a collapse at a construction site in Brooklyn on Tuesday.
transcript_json.translation: 周二，布鲁克林一处建筑工地发生坍塌，救援人员将一名男子救出。

transcript_json.text: The incident happened on the 400 block of Rutland Road just after 12:30 p.m.
transcript_json.translation: 事件发生在中午12点30分刚过，地点是鲁特兰路400号街区。

transcript_json.text: The Fire Department of New York says the vacant 100-year-old building building being pulled down partially collapsed.
transcript_json.translation: 纽约消防局称，这栋有100年历史、正在拆除的空置大楼部分坍塌。

transcript_json.text: A man described as a non-worker civilian was buried up to his waist in the basement.
transcript_json.translation: 一名据称是非施工人员的平民被埋在地下室，深度及腰。

transcript_json.text: The man was collecting building materials when the first floor collapsed underneath him.
transcript_json.translation: 该男子当时正在收集建筑材料，他脚下的1楼突然坍塌。

transcript_json.text: He was trapped under a beam about ten feet below the surface for nearly an hour and a half.
transcript_json.translation: 他被压在一根横梁下，位于地下约10英尺处，被困了近一个半小时。

transcript_json.text: The man was then taken to hospital.
transcript_json.translation: 随后该男子被送往医院。

transcript_json.text: Officials said he is in stable condition with non-life-threatening injuries.
transcript_json.translation: 官员称他伤势无生命危险，情况稳定。

transcript_json.text: The building was reportedly purchased by a neighboring church in 2011.
transcript_json.translation: 据报道，这栋楼在2011年被附近的一座教堂买下。

transcript_json.text: It was the site of a 2006 fire and has remained vacant ever since.
transcript_json.translation: 这里曾是2006年一场火灾的发生地，此后一直空置。

transcript_json.text: News report two: Millions of people are struggling to understand their paychecks or calculate money in shops, campaigners have said.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道二：有活动人士表示，数百万人连看懂工资单或在商店算账都很吃力。

transcript_json.text: Being bad at maths should no longer be seen as a badge of honour or down to genetics, according to National Numeracy, a new organisation which aims to challenge the nation's negative view of the subject.
transcript_json.translation: 国家算术组织表示，数学差不该再被当作一种荣誉勋章，也不该归咎于遗传；该新组织旨在改变英国人对数学的消极看法。

transcript_json.text: Chris Humphreys, chairman of the group, said that poor maths skills can affect an individual's life, leaving them at a higher risk of being excluded from schools, or out of work.
transcript_json.translation: 该组织主席克里斯·汉弗莱斯说，数学能力差会影响一个人的生活，使他们更可能被学校拒之门外或找不到工作。

transcript_json.text: Figures from a government survey published last year show that 17 million adults in England have basic maths skills that are, at best, the same as an 11-year-old, he said.
transcript_json.translation: 他说，去年发布的一项政府调查数据显示，英格兰有1700万成年人的数学能力充其量只相当于11岁孩子的水平。

transcript_json.text: Speaking at the launch of National Numeracy, Mr Humphreys said, "That's a scary figure because what it means is they often can't calculate or give change."
transcript_json.translation: 汉弗莱斯先生在国家算术组织成立仪式上说："这个数字很吓人，因为这意味着他们常常算不了账、也找不了零钱。"

transcript_json.text: Mike Ellicock, chief executive of National Numeracy, said, "We want to challenge this 'I can't do maths' attitude that is prevalent in the UK," adding that it was vital that all primary school teachers understand key maths concepts, as young children who fail to learn the basics will suffer later on.
transcript_json.translation: 国家算术组织首席执行官迈克·埃利科特说："我们要挑战英国普遍存在的'我学不好数学'这种态度。"他还说，让所有小学教师掌握关键的数学概念至关重要，因为小时候学不好基础的孩子以后会吃苦头。

transcript_json.text: News report 3.
The Dutch king has revealed that for more than two decades he has held down a part-time second job, alongside his royal duties.
transcript_json.translation: 荷兰国王透露，20多年来，他在履行王室职责之余，一直兼着一份第二职业。

transcript_json.text: King Willem Alexander of the Netherlands said that he recently ended his role as a regular guest pilot after 21 years with the national airline's fleet of now outdated aircraft.
transcript_json.translation: 荷兰国王威廉-亚历山大说，他在国家航空公司的机队飞行了21年，最近才结束担任客座飞行员的角色，该机队的飞机现已过时。

transcript_json.text: As a As a guest flyer, the king worked about twice a month, always as co-pilot.
transcript_json.translation: 作为客座飞行员，国王大约每月飞两次，每次都担任副驾驶。

transcript_json.text: He will now retrain to fly the bigger Boeing 737s, as the old planes are being phased out of service.
transcript_json.translation: 由于老飞机正逐步退役，他现在将接受改装训练，驾驶更大的波音737。

transcript_json.text: The 50-year-old father of three and king to 17 million Dutch citizens calls flying a hobby.
transcript_json.translation: 这位50岁、有3个孩子、1700万荷兰子民的国王把飞行称为爱好。

transcript_json.text: It lets him leave his royal duties on the ground and fully focus on something else.
transcript_json.translation: 这让他能把王室职责留在地面，全身心投入另一件事。

transcript_json.text: "You have an aircraft, passengers and crew.
transcript_json.translation: "你有一架飞机、乘客和机组人员。

transcript_json.text: You have responsibility for them," the king said.
transcript_json.translation: 你要对他们负责，"国王说。

transcript_json.text: "You can't take your problems from the ground into the skies.
transcript_json.translation: "你不能把地面上的烦恼带上天空。

transcript_json.text: You can completely change focus and concentrate on something else.
transcript_json.translation: 你可以彻底转换注意力，专注于别的事情。

transcript_json.text: That, for me, is the most relaxing part of flying."
transcript_json.translation: 对我来说，这是飞行中最让人放松的部分。"

transcript_json.text: Willem Alexander said he is rarely recognized by passengers.
transcript_json.translation: 威廉-亚历山大说，他很少被乘客认出来。

transcript_json.text: Very few people pay attention to him as he walks through the airport in his airline uniform and cap.
transcript_json.translation: 他穿着航空制服、戴着帽子走过机场时，几乎没人注意他。

Morning, Miss Aminu.
transcript_json.translation: 早上好，阿米努小姐。

transcript_json.text: Welcome to our studio.
transcript_json.translation: 欢迎来到我们的演播室。

transcript_json.text: Thanks.
My pleasure.
Okay then, let me start by asking you how old your company is.
transcript_json.translation: 好吧，我先问一下，你们公司成立多久了？

transcript_json.text: My grandparents started the company in 1955.
transcript_json.translation: 公司是我祖父母在1955年创办的。

transcript_json.text: Why did they decide to open a furniture plant in Bucharest?
transcript_json.translation: 他们为什么决定在布加勒斯特开一家家具厂？

transcript_json.text: At the time, there was a construction boom.
transcript_json.translation: 当时正值建设热潮。

transcript_json.text: There was a great need for furniture, and my grandparents saw a business opportunity.
transcript_json.translation: 家具的需求量很大，我祖父母看到了商机。

transcript_json.text: Their aim was to provide quality yet affordable wooden furniture, and this goal has never changed.
transcript_json.translation: 他们的目标是提供质量好、价格又实惠的木制家具，这个目标至今没变。

transcript_json.text: Do you still only work with wood?
transcript_json.translation: 你们现在还是只做木制家具吗？

transcript_json.text: That's right.
It's what we know and what we do best.
transcript_json.translation: 这是我们熟知并最擅长的事。

transcript_json.text: If we started trying different materials, our quality would probably suffer.
transcript_json.translation: 如果我们尝试用不同的材料，质量可能会下降。

transcript_json.text: And all the wood is local?
transcript_json.translation: 所有木材都是本地的吗？

transcript_json.text: Correct.
A hundred percent of our raw material comes from Romania.
transcript_json.translation: 我们100%的原材料都来自罗马尼亚。

transcript_json.text: Could you please outline how the company has grown over time?
transcript_json.translation: 能请您概述一下公司的发展历程吗？

transcript_json.text: What have been the main challenges and opportunities that you have faced?
transcript_json.translation: 你们面临过哪些主要的挑战和机遇？

transcript_json.text: Well, back in the 50s and 60s, Romania was a lot poorer than it is today.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，早在五六十年代，罗马尼亚比现在穷得多。

transcript_json.text: My grandfather and father did not have much capital, and our customers didn't have much money either.
transcript_json.translation: 我祖父和父亲没有多少资金，我们的客户也没有多少钱。

transcript_json.text: So That limited growth.
transcript_json.translation: 所以这限制了发展。

transcript_json.text: The big change was in 2007, when Romania joined the European Union.
transcript_json.translation: 最大的变化发生在2007年，罗马尼亚加入了欧盟。

transcript_json.text: Suddenly, our market exploded in size, and we could now sell our products all across the continent.
transcript_json.translation: 我们的市场规模突然扩大，现在可以把产品卖到整个欧洲大陆。

transcript_json.text: There was also more financial investment, and, as a result, we went from having 20 employees to 200.
transcript_json.translation: 也有了更多的资金投入，结果我们的员工从20人增加到200人。

transcript_json.text: Which countries are your biggest market?
transcript_json.translation: 哪些国家是你们最大的市场？

transcript_json.text: Besides Romania, our biggest market is Germany.
transcript_json.translation: 除了罗马尼亚，我们最大的市场是德国。

transcript_json.text: There is strong demand there for our traditional style of furniture.
transcript_json.translation: 那里对我们传统风格的家具需求很大。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
All parents know it is difficult to get children to eat their vegetables.
transcript_json.translation: 所有家长都知道，让孩子吃蔬菜不容易。

transcript_json.text: Some of them offer rewards or treats for children finishing Their share.
transcript_json.translation: 有些家长会用奖励或零食，来鼓励孩子吃完自己那份。

transcript_json.text: But researchers have discovered that youngsters who are not praised for trying vegetables are more likely to eat them eventually.
transcript_json.translation: 但研究人员发现，那些尝试吃蔬菜却没有得到表扬的孩子，最终反而更可能吃它们。

transcript_json.text: The study found that the best way to get children to eat food they do not like is simply to give them repeated exposure to it.
transcript_json.translation: 研究发现，让孩子吃他们不喜欢的食物，最好的办法就是反复让他们接触它。

transcript_json.text: Psychologists from Ghent University in Belgium studied 98 children.
transcript_json.translation: 比利时根特大学的心理学家研究了98名儿童。

transcript_json.text: They gave them five kinds of vegetables to eat: mushrooms, peas, eggplants, carrots, and cabbages.
transcript_json.translation: 他们给孩子吃5种蔬菜：蘑菇、豌豆、茄子、胡萝卜和卷心菜。

transcript_json.text: The taste tests revealed that carrots were the least liked vegetable among youngsters.
transcript_json.translation: 品尝测试显示，胡萝卜是孩子们最不喜欢的蔬菜。

transcript_json.text: The children were then given a bowl of boiled carrots and told to choose how much to eat.
transcript_json.translation: 随后，研究人员给孩子们一碗煮胡萝卜，让他们自己决定吃多少。

transcript_json.text: After eight minutes, they were asked to rate the dish as delicious, just okay, or disgusting.
transcript_json.translation: 8分钟后，研究人员让他们给这道菜打分：好吃、一般，或者难吃。

transcript_json.text: The trial went on twice a week for a month, with a follow-up taste test after eight weeks.
transcript_json.translation: 试验每周进行两次，持续一个月，8周后又做了一次品尝测试。

transcript_json.text: Children were split into three groups.
transcript_json.translation: 孩子们被分成3组。

transcript_json.text: With one group asked to try the bowl of carrots repeatedly with no further encouragement.
transcript_json.translation: 其中一组被要求反复试吃这碗胡萝卜，不给任何额外的鼓励。

transcript_json.text: The other two groups were given rewards of a toy or verbal praise.
transcript_json.translation: 另外两组则分别得到玩具或口头表扬作为奖励。

transcript_json.text: After the trial, 81 percent of children who simply tried the carrots consistently liked them.
transcript_json.translation: 试验结束后，一直试吃胡萝卜的孩子中有81%喜欢上了胡萝卜。

transcript_json.text: This is in contrast to 68 percent for the group given a toy and 75 percent for the group given verbal praise.
transcript_json.translation: 相比之下，得到玩具的一组是68%，得到口头表扬的一组是75%。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
One thing about the moon many people don't know is that it has a lot of garbage on its surface, left over from human space exploration.
transcript_json.translation: 关于月球，很多人不知道的一件事是，它的表面有很多垃圾，是人类太空探索留下的。

transcript_json.text: But how much garbage exactly have humans left on the moon?
transcript_json.translation: 但人类到底在月球上留下了多少垃圾？

transcript_json.text: It's hard to be accurate, but the trash likely weighs more than 181,000 kilograms on Earth.
transcript_json.translation: 很难给出准确数字，但这些垃圾在地球上可能重达181,000公斤以上。

transcript_json.text: Much of it was left by American astronauts who landed on the lunar surface between 1969 and 1972 during NASA's Apollo missions.
transcript_json.translation: 其中大部分是美国宇航员在1969至1972年间执行NASA阿波罗任务登月时留下的。

transcript_json.text: The other rubbish comes from missions that did not have human crews.
transcript_json.translation: 其余的垃圾来自没有人类乘员的任务。

transcript_json.text: These missions were conducted by various space exploring agencies, including those from the U.S., Russia, Japan, India, and Europe.
transcript_json.translation: 这些任务由各个航天探索机构执行，包括美国、俄罗斯、日本、印度和欧洲的机构。

transcript_json.text: Many of the older pieces are equipment sent to learn about the moon.
transcript_json.translation: 许多较早的碎片是为了解月球而送去的设备。

transcript_json.text: The equipment stayed there after its missions ended.
transcript_json.translation: 任务结束后，这些设备就留在了那里。

transcript_json.text: The moon is also home to lunar orbiters that mapped the moon before they crashed into its surface, adding to the garbage heap.
transcript_json.translation: 月球上还有月球轨道飞行器，它们曾绘制月球地图，后来坠毁在月球表面，使垃圾堆越来越大。

transcript_json.text: The objects left by the Apollo astronauts included equipment that was no longer needed.
transcript_json.translation: 阿波罗宇航员留下的物品包括不再需要的设备。

transcript_json.text: Bringing back unneeded equipment would have used up precious resources such as fuel.
transcript_json.translation: 把不需要的设备带回来会消耗燃料等宝贵资源。

transcript_json.text: But as the saying goes, one person's trash is another's Researchers can study the garbage left on the moon to see how its materials weathered the radiation and vacuum of space over time.
transcript_json.translation: 但俗话说，一个人的垃圾是另一个人的宝贝。研究人员可以研究留在月球上的垃圾，看看这些材料是如何在漫长岁月中经受太空辐射和真空考验的。

transcript_json.text: Moreover, some of the objects on the moon are still being used, including a laser range reflector left by the Apollo 11 crew.
transcript_json.translation: 此外，月球上的一些物品仍在使用，包括阿波罗11号乘组留下的激光测距反射器。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
In my line of work, I receive a lot of emails.
transcript_json.translation: 在我的工作中，我会收到很多电子邮件。

transcript_json.text: I also send a lot of emails.
transcript_json.translation: 我也会发很多邮件。

transcript_json.text: Though social media and messaging apps have taken over some of the roles from email as a form of communication, email is likely to retain an important role for business communication in the future.
transcript_json.translation: 虽然社交媒体和即时通讯应用已经取代了电子邮件的部分通信功能，但电子邮件在未来很可能仍将在商务沟通中发挥重要作用。

transcript_json.text: Surprisingly, though, a lot of companies and organizations lack formal guidelines for emailing.
transcript_json.translation: 不过令人惊讶的是，很多公司和机构缺乏正式的邮件规范。

transcript_json.text: As most of you will soon be entering the workforce, I would like to share with you my own rules for emailing.
transcript_json.translation: 由于你们大多数人很快就要步入职场，我想和大家分享一下我自己发邮件的规则。

transcript_json.text: If someone sends you an email, reply to them, acknowledging the email.
transcript_json.translation: 如果有人给你发了邮件，就回复他们，确认收到了邮件。

transcript_json.text: A simple "thank you" lets the sender know that their email has arrived safely, that it has not been lost among what could be 50 other emails that have arrived in your email inbox that day.
transcript_json.translation: 一句简单的"谢谢"能让发件人知道邮件已安全送达，没有在当天可能涌入你收件箱的50封邮件中丢失。

transcript_json.text: It's not necessary to reply to a mass email sent to numerous recipients.
transcript_json.translation: 发给众多收件人的群发邮件不必回复。

transcript_json.text: These emails are often informative rather than personalised correspondence requiring a response or action.
transcript_json.translation: 这类邮件通常是告知性质的，而不是需要回复或采取行动的私人通信。

transcript_json.text: But it's common politeness to respond to a personal message, preferably within 24 hours of receiving it.
transcript_json.translation: 但回复私人邮件是基本礼貌，最好在收到后24小时内回复。

transcript_json.text: It's also important to use proper English.
transcript_json.translation: 使用规范的英语也很重要。

transcript_json.text: Just because emails are a quick form of communication doesn't mean emails, especially business emails, should be written using informal Shortened forms of words.
transcript_json.translation: 邮件虽然是一种快捷的沟通方式，但这并不意味着邮件，尤其是商务邮件，可以随便用不正式的缩略词来写。

transcript_json.text: Think of an email as a letter.
transcript_json.translation: 把电子邮件当成一封信来写。

transcript_json.text: Spelling, grammar, and punctuation should not be overlooked.
transcript_json.translation: 拼写、语法和标点都不容忽视。

transcript_json.text: And never use capitals to emphasize a word or words in an email.
transcript_json.translation: 还有，在邮件中绝不要用大写字母来强调某个词或词组。

transcript_json.text: It's the same as yelling.
transcript_json.translation: 这跟大喊大叫是一样的。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1.
A nine-year-old Central California boy braved strong currents and cold water to swim from San Francisco to Alcatraz Island and back.
transcript_json.translation: 加州中部一名9岁男孩不畏激流和冷水，从旧金山游到阿尔卡特拉斯岛并游了回来。

transcript_json.text: A California television station in Fresno reported Tuesday that James Savage set a record as the youngest swimmer to make the journey to the former prison.
transcript_json.translation: 弗雷斯诺一家加州电视台周二报道称，詹姆斯·萨维奇创下了游到这座前监狱的最年轻游泳者纪录。

transcript_json.text: The TV station reported that by completing the swim, the fourth-grade student from Los Banos broke a record previously held by a ten-year-old boy.
transcript_json.translation: 电视台称，这名来自洛斯巴诺斯的四年级学生完成这次游泳后，打破了一名10岁男孩此前保持的纪录。

transcript_json.text: James said that waves in the San Francisco Bay hitting him in the face 30 minutes into his swim made him want to give up.
transcript_json.translation: 詹姆斯说，游了30分钟后，旧金山湾的浪打在他脸上，让他想放弃。

transcript_json.text: His father said he had offered his son $100 as a reward.
transcript_json.translation: 他父亲说，他曾许诺给儿子100美元作为奖励。

transcript_json.text: To encourage his struggling son, he doubled it to $200.
transcript_json.translation: 为了鼓励苦苦挣扎的儿子，他把奖金提高到200美元。

transcript_json.text: James pushed forward, making it to Alcatraz Island and back in a little more than two hours.
transcript_json.translation: 詹姆斯奋力向前，用两个多小时游到了阿尔卡特拉斯岛并返回。

transcript_json.text: Alcatraz is over a mile from the mainland.
transcript_json.translation: 阿尔卡特拉斯岛距离大陆一英里多。

transcript_json.text: The holiday bonus was designed to encourage young people to delay getting married, in line with China's one-child policy.
transcript_json.translation: 这一假期奖励旨在鼓励年轻人晚婚，与中国独生子女政策相一致。

transcript_json.translation: 政府表示，随着该政策现已废除，这项假期激励措施也就不需要了。

transcript_json.text: In Shanghai, a young couple at a marriage registration office told the paper that they decided to register their marriage as soon as possible to take advantage of the existing policy, because an extra holiday was a big deal for them.
transcript_json.translation: 在上海，一对年轻情侣在婚姻登记处告诉该报，他们决定尽快登记结婚，以利用现有政策，因为多一天假期对他们来说很重要。

transcript_json.translation: 是昨天考的，对吧？

I prepared as much as I could, but I was so nervous since it was my second try.
transcript_json.translation: 我尽自己所能准备了，但因为是第二次考，我还是很紧张。

transcript_json.text: The people who worked at the test center were very kind though.
transcript_json.translation: 不过考试中心的工作人员都很友善。

transcript_json.text: We had a little conversation which calmed Calmed me down a bit, and that was just what I needed.
transcript_json.translation: 我们聊了几句，让我稍微平静了一些，这正是我当时需要的。

transcript_json.text: Then, after the exam, they printed out my result, but I was afraid to open it until I was outside.
transcript_json.translation: 然后考完后，他们把成绩打印出来，但我一直到外面才敢打开。

transcript_json.text: It was such a relief to pass.
transcript_json.translation: 能考过真是太让人松一口气了。

transcript_json.text: Congratulations!

transcript_json.translation: 我就知道你能行。

transcript_json.translation: 我想你第一次是低估了它的难度，对吧？

transcript_json.translation: 但第二次能通过，干得不错。

transcript_json.text: I'm so proud of you.

transcript_json.text: Twenty pounds an hour, and the instructor says I'll need about thirty to forty lessons in total.

transcript_json.text: So this time I'll need to make a lot more effort and hopefully will be successful the first time.

transcript_json.text: Well, good luck.
transcript_json.translation: 好吧，祝你好运。

transcript_json.text: Passage one: Scientists have identified thousands of known ant species around the world, and only a few of them bug humans.
transcript_json.translation: 短文一：科学家已经在全球发现数千种已知的蚂蚁物种，其中只有少数几种会骚扰人类。

transcript_json.text: Most ants live in the woods or out in nature.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数蚂蚁生活在树林里或大自然中。

transcript_json.text: There, they keep other creatures in check, distribute seeds, and clean dead and decaying materials from the ground.
transcript_json.translation: 在那里，它们控制其他生物的数量、传播种子，并清理地面上的死亡和腐烂物质。

transcript_json.text: A very small percentage of ants do harm to humans, but those are incredibly challenging to control.
transcript_json.translation: 只有极少数蚂蚁对人类有害，但这些蚂蚁却极难控制。

transcript_json.text: They are small enough to easily slip inside your house, live in colonies that number in the tens of thousands to the hundreds of thousands, and reproduce quickly.
transcript_json.translation: 它们个头小，很容易溜进你家，群居数量从几万到几十万不等，而且繁殖很快。

transcript_json.text: That makes them good at getting in and hard to kick out.
transcript_json.translation: 这让它们很容易进来，却很难赶走。

transcript_json.text: Once they settle in, these insects start affecting your home.
transcript_json.translation: 一旦它们安顿下来，这些昆虫就会开始影响你的家。

transcript_json.text: In addition to biting ants, other species can cause different kinds of damage.
transcript_json.translation: 除了会咬人的蚂蚁，其他种类还会造成不同的破坏。

transcript_json.text: Some, like carpenter ants, can undermine a home's structure, while others interfere with electrical units.
transcript_json.translation: 有些蚂蚁，比如木蚁，会破坏房屋结构，而另一些则会干扰电器设备。

transcript_json.text: Unfortunately, our homes are very attractive to ants because they provide everything the colony needs to survive, such as food, water, and shelter.
transcript_json.translation: 不幸的是，我们的家对蚂蚁很有吸引力，因为那里提供了蚁群生存所需的一切，比如食物、水和栖息地。

transcript_json.text: So, how can we prevent ants from getting into our homes?
transcript_json.translation: 那么，我们怎样才能防止蚂蚁进入家中呢？

transcript_json.text: Most important of all, avoid giving ants any access to food, particularly sugary food, because ants have a sweet tooth.
transcript_json.translation: 最重要的是，别让蚂蚁有任何接触食物的机会，尤其是甜食，因为蚂蚁特别爱吃甜的。

transcript_json.text: We also need to clean up spills as soon as they occur and store food in airtight containers.
transcript_json.translation: 我们还需要一有洒落就马上清理干净，并把食物存放在密封容器里。

transcript_json.text: Even garbage attracts ants, so empty your trash as often as possible, and store your outside garbage in a lidded can well away from doors and windows.
transcript_json.translation: 连垃圾也会吸引蚂蚁，所以要尽量勤倒垃圾，室外垃圾桶要用带盖的桶，远离门窗存放。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
My research focus is on what happens to our immune system as we age.
transcript_json.translation: 我的研究重点是免疫系统随年龄增长会发生什么变化。

transcript_json.text: So the job of the immune system is to fight infections.
transcript_json.translation: 免疫系统的作用是抵御感染。

transcript_json.text: It also protects us from viruses and from autoimmune diseases.
transcript_json.translation: 它还保护我们免受病毒和自身免疫性疾病的侵害。

transcript_json.text: We know that as we get older, it's easier for us to get infections.
transcript_json.translation: 我们知道，随着年龄增长，我们更容易感染。

transcript_json.text: So older adults have more chances of falling ill.
transcript_json.translation: 所以老年人生病的几率更高。

transcript_json.text: This is evidence that our immune system really doesn't function so well when we age.
transcript_json.translation: 这表明我们的免疫系统在衰老时确实没那么好用了。

transcript_json.text: In most of our work, when we're looking at older adults who've got an illness, we always have to have health controls.
transcript_json.translation: 在我们大部分研究中，当我们研究患有疾病的老年人时，总要设置健康对照组。

transcript_json.text: So we work very closely with a great group of volunteers called the 1,000 Elders.
transcript_json.translation: 所以我们与一个名为"千名长者"的优秀志愿者团队紧密合作。

transcript_json.text: These volunteers are all 65 or over, but in good health.
transcript_json.translation: 这些志愿者都在65岁及以上，但身体健康。

transcript_json.text: They come to the university to provide us with blood samples, to be interviewed, and to help us carry out a whole range of research.
transcript_json.translation: 他们来大学为我们提供血样、接受访谈，并协助我们开展一系列研究。

transcript_json.text: The real impact of our research is going to be on health in old age.
transcript_json.translation: 我们研究的真正意义将体现在老年健康方面。

transcript_json.text: At the moment, we're living much longer.
transcript_json.translation: 目前，我们的寿命长多了。

transcript_json.text: Life expectancy is increasing at two years for every decade.
transcript_json.translation: 预期寿命每10年增加2岁。

transcript_json.text: That means an extra five hours a day.
transcript_json.translation: 也就是说每天多出5小时。

transcript_json.text: I want to make sure that older adults are still able to enjoy their old age, and that they're not spending time in hospital with infections, feeling unwell, and being weak.
transcript_json.translation: 我要确保老年人依然能享受晚年，而不是因感染住在医院里，身体不适、虚弱无力。

transcript_json.text: We want people to be healthy, even when they are old.
transcript_json.translation: 我们希望人们即使年老也能保持健康。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
When Ted Komada started teaching 14 years ago at Killip Elementary, he didn't know how to manage a classroom and was struggling to connect with students.
transcript_json.translation: 14年前泰德·科马达刚开始在基利普小学任教时，他不知道如何管理课堂，也很难与学生建立联系。

transcript_json.text: He noticed a couple of days after school that a group of kids would get together to play chess.
transcript_json.translation: 放学后几天，他注意到有一群孩子会聚在一起下国际象棋。

transcript_json.text: "I know how to play chess.
transcript_json.translation: "我会下国际象棋。

transcript_json.text: Let me go and show these kids how to do it," he said.
transcript_json.translation: 让我去教这些孩子怎么下吧。"他说。

transcript_json.text: Now Komada coaches the school's chess team.
transcript_json.translation: 如今，科马达担任该校国际象棋队的教练。

transcript_json.text: The whole program started as a safe place for kids to come after school, and this week, dozens of those students are getting ready to head out to Nashville, Tennessee, to compete with about 5,000 other young people at the Super Nationals of Chess.
transcript_json.translation: 整个项目一开始只是让孩子们放学后有个安全的去处，而这周，这些学生中有几十个正准备前往田纳西州的纳什维尔，与大约5000名其他青少年一起参加国际象棋超级全国赛。

transcript_json.text: The competition only happens every four years, and the last time the team went, they won the third place in the nation.
transcript_json.translation: 这项比赛每四年才举办一次，上次参赛时他们获得了全国第三名。

transcript_json.text: Kamada says chess gives him and his students control.
transcript_json.translation: 卡马达说，国际象棋让他和学生们拥有了掌控感。

transcript_json.text: The school has the highest number of kids from low-income families.
transcript_json.translation: 这所学校来自低收入家庭的孩子数量最多。

transcript_json.text: Police frequent the area day and night, as two months ago a young man was shot just down the street.
transcript_json.translation: 警察昼夜在该区域巡逻，因为两个月前有个年轻人就在附近街头被枪击。

transcript_json.text: Kamada likes to teach his students that they should think about their move before they do it.
transcript_json.translation: 卡马达喜欢教导学生：行动之前要先想好下一步。

transcript_json.text: The lessons prove valuable outside the classroom as well.
transcript_json.translation: 这些课程在课堂之外也证明很有价值。

transcript_json.text: Many parents see these lessons translate into the real world.
transcript_json.translation: 许多家长看到这些道理在现实生活中得到了体现。

transcript_json.text: Students are more likely to think about their actions and see whether they will lead to trouble.
transcript_json.translation: 学生们更有可能三思而后行，看看自己的行为是否会惹上麻烦。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1: France is facing potentially more than one billion dollars in lost revenue this year due to huge declines in tourism.

transcript_json.text: Safety concerns have been one of the biggest reasons why the country has lost over half a billion.

transcript_json.text: In revenue already in the first six months of 2016.

transcript_json.text: The terror attacks in Paris last November were called Europe's worst in the past decade.

transcript_json.text: Passage one: Mount Etna is one of the most active volcanoes on Earth.
transcript_json.translation: 短文一：埃特纳火山是地球上最活跃的火山之一。

transcript_json.text: The mountain has been in a state of near continuous eruption for half a million years.
transcript_json.translation: 这座火山近50万年来几乎一直处于喷发状态。

transcript_json.text: Exploring the Etna geographical area reveals a history written in fire.
transcript_json.translation: 探索埃特纳地区，你会发现一部用火写就的历史。

transcript_json.text: Before the eruptions, it was covered by forests of pine trees.
transcript_json.translation: 在火山喷发之前，这里曾被松树林覆盖。

transcript_json.text: Located in southern Italy, Etna is the highest active volcano in Europe.
transcript_json.translation: 埃特纳火山位于意大利南部，是欧洲最高的活火山。

transcript_json.text: However, its height often changes when volcanic material accumulates during eruptions and subsequently collapses.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，由于喷发时火山物质堆积、随后又崩塌，它的高度经常变化。

transcript_json.text: Few volcanoes in the world have an eruption history so thoroughly documented by historical records.
transcript_json.translation: 世界上很少有火山的喷发历史像这样被历史记录详尽地记载下来。

transcript_json.text: Etna's eruption history dates back as far as 1500 B.C.
transcript_json.translation: 埃特纳火山的喷发历史最早可追溯到公元前1500年。

transcript_json.text: Some 200 eruptions have been recorded down through the centuries, but compared with other volcanoes, most of its eruptions have so far been fairly light in terms of death and destruction.
transcript_json.translation: 几个世纪以来，记录在案的喷发约有200次，但与其他火山相比，到目前为止它的大多数喷发在伤亡和破坏方面都相当轻微。

transcript_json.text: Only about 100 deaths have been attributed to the volcano.
transcript_json.translation: 据统计，仅有约100人因这座火山丧生。

transcript_json.text: The mountain hasn't been entirely harmless, however.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，这座山并非完全没有危害。

transcript_json.text: In 1928, it destroyed the town of Maschali.
transcript_json.translation: 1928年，它摧毁了马斯卡利镇。

transcript_json.text: Over the centuries, Etna's lower slopes have been shaped by human hands to take advantage of rich soils for growing grapes, apples, and nuts.
transcript_json.translation: 几个世纪以来，埃特纳火山的下部山坡经人手改造，利用肥沃的土壤种植葡萄、苹果和坚果。

transcript_json.text: Local people have also carved out over 200 caves in the soft rock and used them for everything from sacred burial places to food storage.
transcript_json.translation: 当地人还在松软的岩石中开凿了200多个洞穴，用途五花八门，从神圣的墓葬到食物储存都有。

transcript_json.text: Large mammals once wandered the volcano slopes, but today foxes, wild cats, rabbits, and mice are more common.
transcript_json.translation: 大型哺乳动物曾经漫游在火山坡上，而如今更常见的是狐狸、野猫、兔子和老鼠。

transcript_json.text: Some of those small mammals help to sustain such big birds as golden eagles.
transcript_json.translation: 其中一些小型哺乳动物帮助养活了金雕这样的大型鸟类。

transcript_json.text: We have a popular saying in America which goes, "Do what you love, and you'll never work a day in your life."

transcript_json.text: But I'm here to tell you that instead of focusing on doing what we love, I think we should focus on loving what we do.
transcript_json.translation: 但我今天要告诉你们，与其专注于做我们热爱的事，我认为我们更应该专注于热爱我们所做的事。

transcript_json.text: In my line of work, you hear a lot about talent, which is an idea we've mostly invented to give ourselves an excuse to be lazy.
transcript_json.translation: 在我这行，你经常听到"天赋"这个词，而这多半是我们自己发明出来、好给自己偷懒找借口的说辞。

transcript_json.text: Here's why: If you see someone doing something really well, you would say it's because they're talented.
transcript_json.translation: 原因是：如果你看到某人把某件事做得非常好，你会说那是因为他有天赋。

transcript_json.text: You think they're somehow special.
transcript_json.translation: 你觉得他们天生就与众不同。

transcript_json.text: You discount the tremendous amount of work they've done to get to where they are.
transcript_json.translation: 你忽略了他们为达到今天的位置所付出的巨大努力。

transcript_json.text: Research has shown that talent is nothing without hard work.
transcript_json.translation: 研究表明，没有勤奋努力，天赋一文不值。

transcript_json.text: I choose to believe in hard work, but not so much in talent.
transcript_json.translation: 我选择相信勤奋努力，但不太相信天赋。

transcript_json.text: There are no special people, just people who put in enough hard work until something special happens.
transcript_json.translation: 没有什么天生的奇才，只有肯持续下苦功的人，直到特别的事情发生。

transcript_json.text: I can promise you one thing.
transcript_json.translation: 我可以向你们保证一件事。

transcript_json.text: Whatever you choose to do for a career, if you work hard at it, eventually special things will happen.
transcript_json.translation: 无论你选择什么职业，只要你努力去做，最终都会有特别的事情发生。

transcript_json.text: They may not happen as quickly as you'd like them to, and they may turn out to be completely different from the special things you imagined at the beginning, but they will happen.
transcript_json.translation: 它们也许不会像你希望的那么快到来，结果也可能和你一开始想象的完全不同，但它们一定会发生。

transcript_json.text: Questions 19 to 21 are based on the passage you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第19到21题基于你刚听到的短文。

transcript_json.text: Question 19: What do we learn about the speaker?
transcript_json.translation: 第19题：关于说话者，我们了解到什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 20: What is the speaker's advice to his audience?
transcript_json.translation: 第20题：说话者给听众的建议是什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 21.
What does the speaker say about talent?
transcript_json.translation: 关于天赋，说话者是怎么说的？

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
A question we often ask others and are also frequently asked by others is, "What do you normally do after school or work?"
transcript_json.translation: 我们经常问别人、也经常被别人问的一个问题是："你放学或下班后一般做什么？"

transcript_json.text: Some commonplace answers are, "Well, I go to the gym."
transcript_json.translation: 一些常见的回答是："嗯，我去健身房。"

transcript_json.text: "Um, I just go home and watch TV."
transcript_json.translation: "呃，我就回家看电视。"

transcript_json.text: "I meet my friends for dinner."
transcript_json.translation: "我和朋友一起吃晚饭。"

transcript_json.text: Or, "I just go to bed because it's so late and I'm tired."
transcript_json.translation: 或者："我就去睡觉，因为太晚了，我很累。"

transcript_json.text: Unlike any of these typical responses, I'm proud to say that I love to dance salsa after a long and tiring day of work.
transcript_json.translation: 与这些典型回答不同，我很自豪地说，在漫长而疲惫的工作日之后，我喜欢跳萨尔萨舞。

transcript_json.text: Salsa is a kind of dancing that evolved in the mid-1970s in New York.
transcript_json.translation: 萨尔萨是一种20世纪70年代中期在纽约发展起来的舞蹈。

transcript_json.text: My dancing life began not because I wanted to do it, but because my mother was sick and tired of seeing me running around after school doing nothing.
transcript_json.translation: 我开始跳舞不是因为我想跳，而是因为我妈妈受够了看我放学后到处瞎跑、无所事事。

transcript_json.text: So she enrolled me into a ballet course when I was six.
transcript_json.translation: 所以我6岁时，她给我报了芭蕾舞课。

transcript_json.text: I fell in love with it instantly and continued with ballet dancing for about ten years.
transcript_json.translation: 我一下子就爱上了它，跳了大约10年芭蕾。

transcript_json.text: Then I left my native country of New Zealand to start my career as an English teacher, which eventually brought my dancing life to a halt.
transcript_json.translation: 后来我离开祖国新西兰，开始我的英语教师生涯，这最终让我的舞蹈生涯停了下来。

transcript_json.text: It wasn't until I rediscovered salsa in a lovely studio while working in Asia that I renewed my passion for dancing.
transcript_json.translation: 直到我在亚洲工作时，在一个很棒的舞蹈工作室重新发现了萨尔萨舞，我才重新燃起对舞蹈的热情。

transcript_json.text: Since then, I have been trying to attend dancing classes twice a week after work.
transcript_json.translation: 从那以后，我一直尽量每周下班后去上两次舞蹈课。

transcript_json.text: It's a great way for me to relieve stress and pressure.
transcript_json.translation: 对我来说，这是缓解压力的好方法。

transcript_json.text: And dance my way towards feeling energetic and happy again.
transcript_json.translation: 还跳着舞，让自己重新充满活力、开心起来。

transcript_json.text: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第22至25题基于你刚才听到的短文。

transcript_json.text: Question 22: What does the speaker say about the dance salsa?
transcript_json.translation: 第22题：关于萨尔萨舞，说话者是怎么说的？

transcript_json.text: Question 23: Why did the speaker's mother enroll her in a ballet course?
transcript_json.translation: 第23题：说话者的母亲为什么让她去上芭蕾舞课？

transcript_json.text: Question 24: When did the speaker's dancing life come to a halt?
transcript_json.translation: 第24题：说话者的舞蹈生涯何时中断了？

transcript_json.text: Question 25.
In what way has salsa dancing benefited the speaker?
transcript_json.translation: 跳萨尔萨舞在哪些方面让说话者受益？

transcript_json.translation: 听力理解部分到此结束。

transcript_json.text: College English Test Band 4, Part 2 Listening Comprehension.
transcript_json.translation: 大学英语四级考试第二部分：听力理解。

transcript_json.text: Section A.
Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports.
transcript_json.translation: 说明：在本部分，你将听到3篇新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: At the end of each news report, you will hear two or three questions.
transcript_json.translation: 每篇新闻报道之后，你将听到2到3个问题。

transcript_json.text: Both the news report and the questions will be spoken only once.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道和问题都只朗读一遍。

transcript_json.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C, and D.
transcript_json.translation: 听到问题后，你必须从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳答案。

transcript_json.text: Then mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上对应字母中间划一条横线。

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
New York City police captured a cow on the loose in Prospect Park on Tuesday after the animal became an attraction for tourists while walking along the streets and enjoying the park facilities.
transcript_json.translation: 周二，纽约市警方在展望公园捕获了一头走失的牛。这头牛在街上闲逛、享用公园设施时，竟成了游客们围观的景点。

transcript_json.text: The confused creature and camera-holding humans stared at each other through a fence for several minutes.
transcript_json.translation: 这头不知所措的动物和拿着相机的人类隔着栅栏对视了好几分钟。

transcript_json.text: At Other times, the cow wandered around the 526-acre park and the artificial grass field normally used for human sporting events.
transcript_json.translation: 其余时间，这头牛在占地526英亩的公园里四处游荡，还踩上了平时供人们进行体育活动的人造草坪。

transcript_json.text: Officers used soccer goals to fence the animal in.
transcript_json.translation: 警察用足球球门把这头牛围了起来。

transcript_json.text: However, the cow then moved through one of the nets, knocking down a police officer in the process.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，这头牛随后穿过了一张球网，还顺势撞倒了一名警察。

transcript_json.text: Police eventually trapped the cow between two vehicles parked on either side of a baseball field's bench area.
transcript_json.translation: 警方最终把这头牛困在了棒球场休息区两侧停放的两辆车之间。

transcript_json.text: An officer then shot an arrow to put it to sleep.
transcript_json.translation: 一名警察随后射出一支麻醉箭，让它昏睡过去。

transcript_json.text: Then officers waited for the drug to take effect.
transcript_json.translation: 然后警员们等药效发作。

transcript_json.text: After it fell asleep, they loaded the cow into a horse trailer.
transcript_json.translation: 奶牛睡着后，他们把它装上了一辆运马拖车。

transcript_json.text: It was not clear where the cow came from or how it got lost.
transcript_json.translation: 目前还不清楚这头奶牛从哪儿来，又是怎么走失的。

transcript_json.text: Police turned it over to the animal control department after they caught it.
transcript_json.translation: 警方抓住它后，把它交给了动物管理部门。

transcript_json.text: Questions one and two are based on the news report you have.
transcript_json.translation: 问题1和问题2基于你手中的这则新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Just heard.
Question 1: What happened in New York's Prospect Park on Tuesday?
transcript_json.translation: 问题1：周二纽约展望公园发生了什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 2: What do we learn about the cow from the end of the news report?
transcript_json.translation: 问题2：从新闻报道的结尾我们可以了解到关于这头奶牛的什么情况？

transcript_json.text: News report 2.
Starting April 28th of this year, the National Museum of Natural History will begin renovating its Fossil Hall.
transcript_json.translation: 从今年4月28日起，国家自然历史博物馆将开始翻修其化石大厅。

transcript_json.text: The Fossil Hall, which displays some of the world's oldest and largest fossil specimens, receives more than 2 million visitors each year.
transcript_json.translation: 化石大厅展出了一些世界上最古老、最大的化石标本，每年接待超过200万游客。

transcript_json.text: It's one of the museum's most famous attractions.
transcript_json.translation: 它是博物馆最著名的景点之一。

transcript_json.text: As a result, the museum plans to expand the hall as well as add to its ancient bird collection.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，博物馆计划扩建大厅，并扩充其古鸟类收藏。

transcript_json.text: Bird lovers, both young and old, have already responded with excitement at the news.
transcript_json.translation: 无论老少，鸟类爱好者们都对这个消息感到兴奋。

transcript_json.text: The museum's social media account has been flooded with messages of support.
transcript_json.translation: 博物馆的社交媒体账号被支持的留言刷屏了。

transcript_json.text: In the meantime, the current collection will be closed.
transcript_json.translation: 与此同时，目前的展厅将关闭。

transcript_json.text: However, visitors will be compensated during the closure.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，闭馆期间游客将获得补偿。

transcript_json.text: The museum's special exhibition area will now be free of charge.
transcript_json.translation: 博物馆的特展区将免费开放。

transcript_json.text: This week, the resident exhibition is a display of ancient wall paintings on loan from Australia.
transcript_json.translation: 本周的常设展览是从澳大利亚借展的古代壁画展。

transcript_json.text: They celebrate the cultural heritage of the country and will be available to view until Sunday.
transcript_json.translation: 这些壁画展现了该国的文化遗产，展出到周日为止。

transcript_json.text: Next week, the exhibition will be taken over by the wildlife photographer of the year competition.
transcript_json.translation: 下周，展览将由年度野生动物摄影师大赛接替。

transcript_json.text: The winner of this year's competition will be awarded a preview of the new fossil hall as well as a cash prize.
transcript_json.translation: 今年大赛的获胜者将获得参观新化石大厅的预览权以及现金奖励。

transcript_json.text: Questions three and four are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第3题和第4题基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question three: What does the news report say about the fossil hall of the National Museum of Natural History?
transcript_json.translation: 第3题：新闻报道对国家自然历史博物馆的化石展厅是怎么说的？

transcript_json.text: Question four: What is on display this week in the museum's resident exhibition hall?
transcript_json.translation: 第4题：本周博物馆的常设展厅里展出了什么？

transcript_json.text: News report three.
News Report 3
Six birds have just been trained to pick up rubbish at a French historical theme park.
transcript_json.translation: 法国一家历史主题公园刚刚训练了6只鸟来捡垃圾。

transcript_json.text: According to the park's manager, Mr.
transcript_json.translation: 据该公园的经理维利耶

transcript_json.text: Villiers, the goal is not just to clear up the park.
transcript_json.translation: 光生说，此举的目的不只是清理公园。

transcript_json.text: He says visitors are already good at keeping things clean.
transcript_json.translation: 他说游客本来就挺注意保持清洁的。

transcript_json.text: Instead, he wants to show that nature itself can teach us to take care of the environment.
transcript_json.translation: 相反，他是想表明大自然本身就能教会我们爱护环境。

transcript_json.text: He says that rooks, the chosen birds, are considered to be particularly intelligent.
transcript_json.translation: 他说，被选中的秃鼻乌鸦被认为格外聪明。

transcript_json.text: In the right circumstances, they even like to communicate with humans and establish a relationship through play.
transcript_json.translation: 在合适的环境下，它们甚至愿意与人类交流，通过玩耍建立关系。

transcript_json.text: The birds will be encouraged to clean the park through the use of a small box that delivers a small amount of bird food each time the rook deposits a cigarette end or small piece of rubbish.
transcript_json.translation: 公园用一个小盒子来激励鸟儿们清理公园：每当乌鸦丢进一个烟头或一小块垃圾，盒子就会掉出少量鸟食。

transcript_json.text: So far, visitors to the theme park have been excited to see the birds in action.
transcript_json.translation: 到目前为止，主题公园的游客看到鸟儿们干活都很兴奋。

transcript_json.text: However, some parents are concerned that it encourages their children to drop litter so they can watch the birds pick it up.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，一些家长担心这会鼓励孩子乱扔垃圾，好看鸟儿把垃圾捡起来。

transcript_json.text: Villiers is not concerned about this criticism.
transcript_json.translation: 维利耶并不在意这种批评。

transcript_json.text: He maintains most of the feedback he has received has been overwhelmingly positive.
transcript_json.translation: 他坚持说，他收到的反馈绝大多数都非常正面。

transcript_json.text: He hopes now to train more birds.
transcript_json.translation: 他现在希望能训练更多的鸟。

transcript_json.text: Questions five to seven are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第5题到第7题基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question five: What have six birds been trained to do at a French historical theme park?
transcript_json.translation: 第5题：法国一家历史主题公园训练6只鸟做什么？

transcript_json.text: Question six: Why were rooks chosen by the park manager?
transcript_json.translation: 第6题：公园经理为什么选择秃鼻乌鸦？

transcript_json.text: Question seven.
What is the concern of some parents?
transcript_json.translation: 一些家长的担忧是什么？

transcript_json.text: Section B.
Directions.
In this section, you'll hear two long conversations.
transcript_json.translation: 在本部分，你将听到两段长对话。

transcript_json.text: At the end of each conversation, you'll hear four questions.
transcript_json.translation: 每段对话结束后，你会听到4个问题。

transcript_json.translation: 对话和问题都只会朗读一遍。

transcript_json.translation: 听到问题后，你要从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳答案。

transcript_json.text: Then mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上用一条线穿过对应字母的中央标出。

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
The name of the TV show we wish to produce is Science Nation.
transcript_json.translation: 我们想制作的电视节目名叫《科学国度》。

transcript_json.text: Tell us more.
transcript_json.translation: 请多介绍一些。

transcript_json.text: What will Science Nation be about?
transcript_json.translation: 《科学国度》会讲些什么？

transcript_json.text: It'll be about science.
transcript_json.translation: 会讲科学。

transcript_json.text: All sorts of science.
transcript_json.translation: 各种各样的科学。

transcript_json.text: Each episode will focus on a different area of science, and tell us what we know, how we know it, and what we still don't know.
transcript_json.translation: 每集会聚焦科学的一个不同领域，告诉我们已知什么、如何得知，以及还有哪些未解之谜。

transcript_json.text: The show will have one host only, and this will be Professor Susan Powell from Harvard University.
transcript_json.translation: 节目只设一位主持人，就是哈佛大学的苏珊·鲍威尔教授。

transcript_json.text: She's a great public speaker.
transcript_json.translation: 她是位很棒的演讲者。

transcript_json.text: So just to be clear, will the show's format be like that of a documentary?
transcript_json.translation: 那么确认一下，节目的形式会像纪录片吗？

transcript_json.text: Kind of.
It'll be like a documentary in the sense that it'll be nonfiction and fact-based.
transcript_json.translation: 说它像纪录片，是因为它也是非虚构的、以事实为基础的。

transcript_json.text: However, our idea is for it to be also fun and entertaining, something which traditional documentaries aren't so much.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，我们的想法是让它同时有趣、有娱乐性，而传统纪录片在这方面做得不多。

transcript_json.text: Please keep in mind this will be a new TV show like nothing ever done before.
transcript_json.translation: 请记住，这将是一档前所未有的全新电视节目。

transcript_json.text: Okay, so it'll be both.
transcript_json.translation: 好吧，那它就是两者兼有。

transcript_json.text: Educational and entertaining.
transcript_json.translation: 既有教育性又有娱乐性。

transcript_json.text: And your audience will be anyone interested in science, right?

What's up with you?
transcript_json.translation: 你怎么了？

transcript_json.text: You don't look very happy.
transcript_json.translation: 你看上去不太高兴。

transcript_json.text: I feel like I'm a failure.

transcript_json.text: I can't seem to do anything very well.
transcript_json.translation: 我好像什么都做不好。

transcript_json.text: I wouldn't say that.
transcript_json.translation: 我可不这么认为。

transcript_json.text: You do very well in a lot of things.
transcript_json.translation: 你有很多事情都做得很好。

transcript_json.text: That presentation you gave last week was excellent.
transcript_json.translation: 你上周做的那个演示非常出色。

transcript_json.text: Yes, but I have this urge to strive for perfection.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，可我就是有种追求完美的冲动。

transcript_json.text: I really want to push harder and progress further.
transcript_json.translation: 我真的想更努力，取得更大的进步。

transcript_json.text: Well, that's very admirable.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，这很让人敬佩。

transcript_json.text: But be careful.
transcript_json.translation: 但要小心。

transcript_json.text: Over concern with being perfect can damage our confidence if we never achieve it.
transcript_json.translation: 过度追求完美，如果永远达不到，会打击我们的信心。

transcript_json.text: Yes, I know.
transcript_json.translation: 是的，我知道。

transcript_json.text: I feel awful whenever I make a mistake in whatever I'm trying to do.
transcript_json.translation: 无论做什么事，我一犯错就觉得很难受。

transcript_json.text: Well, think about it.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，你想想看。

transcript_json.text: You can't make progress without making mistakes and learning from them.
transcript_json.translation: 不犯错、不从中吸取教训，就没法进步。

transcript_json.text: Thomas Edison, the famous inventor, once said, "I've not failed.
transcript_json.translation: 著名发明家托马斯·爱迪生曾说过：“我没有失败。

transcript_json.text: I've just found ten thousand ways that won't work."
transcript_json.translation: 我只是发现了一万种行不通的方法。”

transcript_json.text: You may well be right.
transcript_json.translation: 你说得可能没错。

transcript_json.text: I guess I should recognize my mistakes and learn the lesson they teach me, and move forward.
transcript_json.translation: 我想我应该正视自己的错误，吸取它们给我的教训，然后继续前进。

transcript_json.text: Also, remember a successful ending is not the only thing worthy of a celebration.
transcript_json.translation: 另外，记住，只有成功的结局才值得庆祝，并不是这样的。

transcript_json.text: You need to recognize each step of progress you take towards achieving your goals, and, no matter how tiny it is, it's still good news.
transcript_json.translation: 你要认可自己朝着目标迈出的每一步，无论多么微小，都是好消息。

transcript_json.text: I always feel down when I see others accomplishing things, and I feel miserable about my own achievements.
transcript_json.translation: 每当我看到别人做成事情，我总是很沮丧，对自己的成就感到难过。

transcript_json.text: I'm always trying to be as good as others, but I never seem to get there.
transcript_json.translation: 我总想和别人一样优秀，但似乎永远做不到。

transcript_json.text: Listen, if you always compare yourself with others, you'll never feel good enough.
transcript_json.translation: 听着，如果你总拿自己和别人比，你永远不会觉得自己够好。

transcript_json.text: You're the only person person you should be comparing yourself with.

transcript_json.text: When you compare your current status with the starting point, you'll find you've made progress, right?

transcript_json.text: That's good enough.

transcript_json.text: That's great advice.
transcript_json.translation: 这个建议真不错。

transcript_json.text: Thank you.
I'm feeling better already.

transcript_json.text: Passage one: Single-sex education can have enormous benefits for female students.
transcript_json.translation: 短文一：单性别教育对女学生大有裨益。

transcript_json.text: Numerous studies have shown that women who attend single-sex schools tend to have stronger self-confidence, better study habits, and more ambitious career goals than women who attend coeducational schools.
transcript_json.translation: 大量研究表明，就读单性别学校的女性往往比就读男女同校的女性有更强的自信心、更好的学习习惯和更远大的职业目标。

transcript_json.text: Girls who graduate from single-sex schools are three times more likely to become engineers than those who attend coeducational schools.
transcript_json.translation: 从单性别学校毕业的女生将来成为工程师的可能性是男女同校女生的3倍。

transcript_json.text: The reason is that all-girls schools encourage women to enter fields traditionally dominated by men, such as science, technology, and engineering.
transcript_json.translation: 原因在于，女校鼓励女性进入科学、技术和工程等传统上由男性主导的领域。

transcript_json.text: In coeducational schools, girls are often expected to succeed only in the humanities or the arts.
transcript_json.translation: 在男女同校的学校里，女生常常被期望只在人文或艺术方面取得成功。

transcript_json.text: Research has also shown that in coeducational settings, Teachers are more likely to praise and give in-depth responses to a boy's comments in class.
transcript_json.translation: 研究还表明，在男女同校的环境中，老师更有可能对男生的课堂发言给予表扬和深入的回应。

transcript_json.text: In contrast, they might only respond to a girl's comments with a nod.
transcript_json.translation: 相比之下，他们对女生的发言可能只是点点头。

transcript_json.text: They're also more likely to encourage boys to work through problems on their own, while they tend to step in and help girls who struggle with a problem.
transcript_json.translation: 他们也更倾向于鼓励男生自己解决问题，而对遇到困难的女生则往往会插手帮忙。

transcript_json.text: In an all-girls setting, girls are more likely to speak up frequently and make significant contributions to class than in a coeducational setting.
transcript_json.translation: 在纯女校环境中，女生更敢于频繁发言，对课堂的贡献也比在男女合校时更大。

transcript_json.text: Girls studying in a single-sex setting also earn higher scores on their College Board and Advanced Placement exams than girls who study in coeducational settings.
transcript_json.translation: 在单性别学校就读的女生，大学理事会考试和大学预修课程考试的成绩也高于男女合校的女生。

transcript_json.text: All-girls schools tend to be smaller than coeducational schools, which means teachers will be able to tailor the materials to girls' students' personal learning styles and interests.
transcript_json.translation: 女子学校往往比男女合校规模更小，这意味着老师可以根据女生的学习风格和兴趣来调整教材。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Today, I found out that Seattle doesn't really get that much rain compared with most U.S cities.
transcript_json.translation: 今天我发现，跟美国大多数城市比，西雅图的雨其实没那么多。

transcript_json.text: In fact, Seattle ranks 44th among major U.S cities in average annual rainfall.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，在美国主要城市中，西雅图的年均降雨量排第44位。

transcript_json.text: Cities that get more rainfall than Seattle include Houston, Memphis, Nashville, and pretty much every major city on the eastern coast, such as New York, Boston, and Miami.
transcript_json.translation: 降雨量超过西雅图的城市有休斯敦、孟菲斯、纳什维尔，还有东海岸几乎每个主要城市，比如纽约、波士顿和迈阿密。

transcript_json.text: So, why does everyone think of Seattle as a rainy city?
transcript_json.translation: 那为什么大家都觉得西雅图是座多雨的城市呢？

transcript_json.text: The primary root of this misconception lies in that Seattle has a relatively large number of days per year with rainfall, compared with New York and Boston, which get an average of about 16 percent more rain per year than Seattle, but also average between Between them, about 36 fewer days a year of rainfall.
transcript_json.translation: 这个误解的主要根源在于，西雅图一年中下雨的天数相对较多；而纽约和波士顿的年降雨量比西雅图平均多约16%，但两地加起来一年的雨天却比西雅图少约36天。

transcript_json.text: So it rains a lot less in Seattle, and the rain is spread out over more days than those cities.
transcript_json.translation: 所以西雅图的雨量少得多，只是分散在更多的日子里。

transcript_json.text: This is why few locals in Seattle carry an umbrella generally.
transcript_json.translation: 所以西雅图本地人一般很少带伞。

transcript_json.text: When it does rain, it tends to be a very light rain that isn't troublesome.
transcript_json.translation: 下雨的时候，往往是很小的雨，不碍事。

transcript_json.text: It almost never really rains, as most people think.
transcript_json.translation: 几乎从来不会像大多数人想的那样下大雨。

transcript_json.text: On top of that, it never really storms in Seattle either.
transcript_json.translation: 除此之外，西雅图也从来没有真正的暴风雨。

transcript_json.text: Seattle gets an average of a mere seven days a year with thunder.
transcript_json.translation: 西雅图平均一年只有7天打雷。

transcript_json.text: So in short, if you like sunny but not too hot summers, mild winters, but with lots of cloudy days, Seattle's the place to be.
transcript_json.translation: 总之，如果你喜欢阳光充足但不太热的夏天、温和但阴天多的冬天，西雅图就是理想之地。

transcript_json.text: Anyway, if you visit Seattle, don't bring an umbrella.
transcript_json.translation: 不管怎样，去西雅图别带伞。

transcript_json.text: People will look at you, thinking you're funny.
transcript_json.translation: 人们会看着你，觉得你很滑稽。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
After Tough workout or a day full of physical activity, it's common to find your muscles aching.
transcript_json.translation: 在艰苦锻炼或一整天体力活动之后，肌肉酸痛很常见。

transcript_json.text: But where do these pains come from?
transcript_json.translation: 但这些疼痛从何而来？

transcript_json.text: According to a German professor, the soreness comes from straining your muscles in an uncommon way.
transcript_json.translation: 据一位德国教授说，酸痛源于以不寻常的方式拉伤了肌肉。

transcript_json.text: For example, jumping on a bicycle for a ride.
transcript_json.translation: 比如，跳上自行车骑一趟。

transcript_json.text: Because you haven't ridden in a long time, soreness occurs since your leg muscles aren't used to that movement.
transcript_json.translation: 因为你很久没骑车了，腿部肌肉不习惯这个动作，就会酸痛。

transcript_json.text: When muscles perform an activity they aren't regularly exposed to, the tiny fibers that are inside them are being torn apart.
transcript_json.translation: 当肌肉进行它不常做的活动时，内部的微小纤维会被撕裂。

transcript_json.text: As muscle soreness develops, the body has to work to repair the muscle tears.
transcript_json.translation: 随着肌肉酸痛加重，身体就要努力修复这些肌肉撕裂。

transcript_json.text: But this doesn't happen immediately.
transcript_json.translation: 但这不会立刻发生。

transcript_json.text: First, the body must realize the muscles are damaged.
transcript_json.translation: 首先，身体必须意识到肌肉受损了。

transcript_json.text: When the body realizes the muscles are hurt, the response is to increase blood flow to the area and increase body body heat.
transcript_json.translation: 当身体察觉肌肉受伤时，反应是增加该部位的血流量并提高体温。

transcript_json.text: Damaged cells are then cleaned up, and the body sends cells specially designed to break down the large muscle fiber fragments.
transcript_json.translation: 然后受损细胞被清理掉，身体派出专门分解大块肌肉纤维碎片的细胞。

transcript_json.text: Healing can take place after this.
transcript_json.translation: 之后才能开始愈合。

transcript_json.text: It takes about a day until these cells make it to your aching muscles.
transcript_json.translation: 这些细胞要花大约一天时间才能到达你酸痛的肌肉。

transcript_json.text: That's why there's most often a delay associated with muscle soreness.
transcript_json.translation: 这就是肌肉酸痛通常有延迟的原因。

transcript_json.text: Repair of damaged cells takes about two days, and afterwards the soreness disappears.
transcript_json.translation: 修复受损细胞大约需要两天，之后酸痛就会消失。

transcript_json.text: Unfortunately, there's little that can be done to relieve muscle soreness.
transcript_json.translation: 不幸的是，缓解肌肉酸痛没什么办法。

transcript_json.text: Pain relieving creams don't work, but a hot shower or warm bath can provide some relief.
transcript_json.translation: 止痛药膏没什么用，不过冲个热水澡或泡个温水澡能缓解一些。

transcript_json.text: News Report One: The British government has called for more men to consider a career in nursing.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道一：英国政府呼吁更多男性考虑从事护理工作。

transcript_json.text: Figures show the number of male nurses has fallen in the last three years.
transcript_json.translation: 数据显示，男性护士人数在过去3年有所下降。

transcript_json.text: Now the number of men working in the nursing sector has reached a seven-year low.
transcript_json.translation: 目前护理行业的男性从业人数已降至7年来的最低点。

transcript_json.text: Numbers of male of nurses increased between 2011 and 2014, and reached a peak of 7,168.
transcript_json.translation: 男性护士人数在2011年至2014年间上升，最高达到7,168人。

transcript_json.text: This figure has dropped to only 6,924 in 2017.
transcript_json.translation: 到2017年，这一数字已跌至仅6,924人。

transcript_json.text: The UK Health Secretary said, "This is clearly a cultural problem, and probably one that exists in many parts of the world.
transcript_json.translation: 英国卫生大臣说："这显然是一个文化问题，而且很可能在世界许多地方都存在。

transcript_json.text: But we can make efforts to change that now.
transcript_json.translation: 但我们现在可以努力改变这一状况。

transcript_json.text: We want to persuade males to think about career options of going into nursing.
transcript_json.translation: 我们希望说服男性考虑从事护理方面的职业。

transcript_json.text: There is absolutely no reason why men can't go into this profession."
transcript_json.translation: 男性完全没有理由不能进入这个行业。"

transcript_json.text: The Health Secretary said that the government already has plans to attract a more varied workforce into nursing.
transcript_json.translation: 卫生大臣表示，政府已有计划吸引更多样化的人才加入护理行业。

transcript_json.text: She stated, "We are leading the way on workforce planning.
transcript_json.translation: 她表示："我们在人力资源规划方面走在前列。

transcript_json.text: We will become the first nation in Europe to publish a national health and care workforce plan."
transcript_json.translation: 我们将成为欧洲第一个发布国家卫生与护理人力资源计划的国家。"

transcript_json.text: News report two.
A man from Libya was enjoying a walk along the sands at Southport Beach.
transcript_json.translation: 一名利比亚男子正在南港海滩的沙滩上散步。

transcript_json.text: When he was about half a mile out from the dock he felt a bit tired, so he lay down and fell asleep.
transcript_json.translation: 当他走到离码头约半英里处时，觉得有点累了，于是躺下来睡着了。

transcript_json.text: But the tide swept in quickly at the beach, and the man was shocked to wake up and find the tide had come in and completely surrounded him, cutting him off from the shore.
transcript_json.translation: 但海水迅速涨潮，这名男子醒来后震惊地发现潮水已经涌上来，将他完全包围，把他与岸边隔开了。

transcript_json.text: Fortunately for him, the beach lifeguards were quickly on the scene to stop him from drowning.
transcript_json.translation: 幸运的是，海滩救生员迅速赶到现场，阻止了他溺水。

transcript_json.text: They acted professionally to ensure the man was comfortable until an ambulance arrived.
transcript_json.translation: 他们专业地处置，确保这名男子在救护车到来前保持舒适状态。

transcript_json.text: He was then taken to hospital.
transcript_json.translation: 随后他被送往医院。

transcript_json.text: He is now in a stable condition.
transcript_json.translation: 目前病情稳定。

transcript_json.text: When interviewed, Keith Porter of the Southport Beach said, "Our beach is so flat that it's very common for the tide to come around the back of people and cut them off from the beach."
transcript_json.translation: 南港海滩的基思·波特在接受采访时说："我们的海滩非常平坦，潮水从人们身后绕过来把人困住的情况非常常见。"

transcript_json.text: Thankfully, the emergency services have again worked well together to ensure a positive outcome, and we wish the gentleman a speedy recovery.
transcript_json.translation: 幸运的是，应急服务部门再次通力合作，确保了一个积极的结果，我们祝愿这位先生早日康复。

transcript_json.text: News report three: A raccoon, a small cat-like animal, climbed to the top of a 25-story skyscraper early on Wednesday.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道三：周三凌晨，一只浣熊——一种像猫的小动物——爬上了25层摩天大楼的楼顶。

transcript_json.text: It was captured after becoming an online star across the world.
transcript_json.translation: 它在成为全球网络明星之后被抓住了。

transcript_json.text: At a little before 3 a.m., the animal made it to the roof of the building after it took a long break on a 17th-floor window edge.
transcript_json.translation: 差不多凌晨3点前，这只动物在17楼的窗台上休息了很长时间后，爬到了大楼楼顶。

transcript_json.text: At the top.
transcript_json.translation: 在楼顶。

transcript_json.text: Of the building, animal control officers put cat food in traps and captured the raccoon.
transcript_json.translation: 在楼顶，动物管制人员在陷阱里放上猫粮，抓住了这只浣熊。

transcript_json.text: A private wildlife management company will release the animal into the wild.
transcript_json.translation: 一家私营野生动物管理公司将把这只动物放归野外。

transcript_json.text: The raccoon's upward journey began on Monday.
transcript_json.translation: 这只浣熊向上攀登的旅程始于周一。

transcript_json.text: The brown animal was spotted stuck on a narrow window edge of the office tower.
transcript_json.translation: 有人发现这只棕色的动物困在办公楼一处狭窄的窗台上。

transcript_json.text: On Tuesday, the raccoon slowly climbed the building.
transcript_json.translation: 周二，这只浣熊慢慢向楼上爬去。

transcript_json.text: It reached the 23rd floor, and its legend continued to grow on social media with every floor it climbed.
transcript_json.translation: 它爬到了23楼，每爬一层，它在社交媒体上的传奇故事就更加传开。

transcript_json.text: As it went up, people gathered on the sidewalk below to take photos and cheer for its safety.
transcript_json.translation: 它往上爬时，人们聚集在楼下的人行道上拍照，为它的安全欢呼。

transcript_json.text: Online, office workers posted photos and videos of the raccoon resting on window edges and climbing up the building's concrete exterior.
transcript_json.translation: 在网上，上班族们发布了这只浣熊趴在窗台上休息、攀爬大楼混凝土外墙的照片和视频。

transcript_json.text: One online post said that the raccoon has Succeeded in uniting the country the way no politician could.
transcript_json.translation: 一条网上帖子说，这只浣熊成功团结了这个国家，这是任何政治家都做不到的。
