transcript_json.text: Conversation One.
I have really amazing news.
transcript_json.translation: 我有个天大的好消息。

transcript_json.text: I just got a text message from my bank saying my salary has been deposited in my account.
transcript_json.translation: 我刚收到银行的短信，说工资已经打到我账户上了。

transcript_json.text: Getting paid is good, but I don't understand why you're so excited.
transcript_json.translation: 发工资当然好，但我不明白你为什么这么激动。

transcript_json.text: It happens every month.
transcript_json.translation: 每个月都发一次啊。

transcript_json.text: Well, I..
I've been working for a few years.
transcript_json.translation: 我都工作好几年了。

transcript_json.text: In fact, I worked all through university, but I only had part-time jobs then.
transcript_json.translation: 其实我上大学时一直都在打工，只不过那时做的是兼职。

transcript_json.text: So this is the first time I've ever been paid for a month of full-time work.
transcript_json.translation: 所以这是我第一次因为干满一个月全职工作而拿到工资。

transcript_json.text: Wow!
Then you must feel great.
transcript_json.translation: 那你肯定特别开心吧。

transcript_json.text: I mean, it's been two decades, but I can still remember when I got my first real salary.
transcript_json.translation: 我是说，虽然已经过去20年了，但我还记得拿到第一份正式工资的那一刻。

transcript_json.text: I was happy for days, and I felt like it was a small fortune, even though it wasn't.
transcript_json.translation: 我高兴了好几天，觉得那是一笔小财，虽然其实并不是。

transcript_json.text: Yeah, I've never earned so much money before, and there are so many things I'd like to do with it.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，我从没挣过这么多钱，有好多想拿它去做的事。

transcript_json.text: What did you do with your first pay?
transcript_json.translation: 你的第一份工资是怎么花的？

transcript_json.text: I bought a new suit for work, and took my parents to a nice restaurant to celebrate.
transcript_json.translation: 我买了一套上班穿的新西装，还带爸妈去一家不错的餐厅庆祝了一下。

transcript_json.text: Maybe you could do the same.
transcript_json.translation: 你也可以这样做啊。

transcript_json.text: I have enough professional clothes, and my parents are across the country, so seeing them is impossible.
transcript_json.translation: 我职业装够穿了，而且我爸妈在外地，想见他们根本不可能。

transcript_json.text: But some people from the office are members of a gym I want to join, and my university University classmates are arranging a trip to visit our old campus, and I'd love to go with them.
transcript_json.translation: 不过办公室有几个同事在一家我想加入的健身房，而且我的大学同学正在组织一次回母校的旅行，我很想跟他们一起去。

transcript_json.text: But I can't afford both.
transcript_json.translation: 但我两个都负担不起。

transcript_json.text: If I were you, I'd join the gym, because it's a good way to stay healthy, and it might help you build a stronger relationship with your colleagues, and good relationships are key to a successful career.
transcript_json.translation: 要是我是你，我会去健身房，因为那是保持健康的好方法，而且可能帮你和同事建立更牢固的关系，良好的人际关系是事业成功的关键。

transcript_json.text: Hmm, you're right.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，你说得对。

transcript_json.text: Thanks for the advice.
transcript_json.translation: 谢谢你的建议。

transcript_json.text: I'm taking it.
transcript_json.translation: 我采纳了。

What's going on with you lately?

I'm sorry.
I can't seem to focus on anything because I still haven't decided if I should accept the offer for that PhD program in London or if I should take the job offer in New York.

transcript_json.text: Look, it's a tough decision, but you're running out of time, aren't you?
transcript_json.translation: 听着，这是个艰难的决定，但你时间不多了，不是吗？

transcript_json.text: I thought you said the company expected an answer by the end of the month.
transcript_json.translation: 我记得你说过公司希望月底前答复。

transcript_json.text: Actually, it's the beginning of next month for the job, but the university needs a decision by the end of the week, so I have to act quickly.
transcript_json.translation: 其实工作那边是下个月初，但大学要求本周末前决定，所以我得赶紧行动。

transcript_json.text: You definitely need advice for an important decision like this.
transcript_json.translation: 这么重要的决定，你确实需要有人给你出出主意。

transcript_json.text: So, who have you talked to about it?
transcript_json.translation: 那你都跟谁谈过这事了？

transcript_json.text: What does your family think?
transcript_json.translation: 你家人怎么看？

transcript_json.text: And your advisor for your master's program?
transcript_json.translation: 还有你硕士阶段的导师呢？

transcript_json.text: I've asked their advice, and that's part of the problem.
transcript_json.translation: 我问过他们的意见，而这正是问题的一部分。

transcript_json.translation: 我父母希望我拿到学位，但我的导师觉得我该多积累些工作经验了。

transcript_json.text: Oh.
Wait, it's your girlfriend, isn't it?

transcript_json.text: You've been dating since your first year of university, so that's six years now.

transcript_json.text: Well, I do want to get married, but she thinks we need to wait until we've launched our careers.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我确实想结婚，但她觉得我们应该等事业起步之后再说。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Analytical skills are our ability to understand and solve problems using information we have available.
transcript_json.translation: 分析能力就是我们利用已有信息来理解问题和解决问题的能力。

transcript_json.text: These skills are extremely important for our professional, social, and intellectual lives.
transcript_json.translation: 这些能力在我们的职业、社交和智力生活中极为重要。

transcript_json.text: What are the best ways to improve them?
transcript_json.translation: 提升它们的最好方法是什么？

transcript_json.text: One way is to expand your world view.
transcript_json.translation: 其中一个方法是拓宽你的世界观。

transcript_json.text: Unfortunately, this takes time.
transcript_json.translation: 遗憾的是，这需要时间。

transcript_json.text: Ultimately, it will help.
transcript_json.translation: 但最终会有帮助。

transcript_json.text: You better evaluate information and analyze different ideas and outcomes.
transcript_json.translation: 你会更好地评估信息，分析不同的想法和结果。

transcript_json.text: Traveling is a great way to expand your worldview, although it can be expensive.
transcript_json.translation: 旅行是拓宽世界观的好方法，不过可能会比较贵。

transcript_json.text: An entertaining way of enhancing your analytical skills is to engage them by playing brain games.
transcript_json.translation: 提升分析能力的一个有趣方法，就是玩益智游戏来锻炼它。

transcript_json.text: These are games that challenge you to think deeply and to develop your analytical skills.
transcript_json.translation: 这些游戏会让你深入思考，培养分析能力。

transcript_json.text: These games will get you used to thinking in a certain way.
transcript_json.translation: 这些游戏会让你习惯于用某种方式思考。

transcript_json.text: As a result, they will help improve your ability to think.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，它们有助于提高你的思考能力。

transcript_json.text: However, opinions vary on whether video games are effective.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，关于电子游戏是否有效，大家看法不一。

transcript_json.text: The general consensus is that the best ones avoid mindless violence and instead focus on strategy and challenge us to solve problems and achieve broad goals.
transcript_json.translation: 普遍的共识是，最好的游戏会避免无脑暴力，而是注重策略，挑战我们去解决问题并实现宽泛的目标。

transcript_json.text: Joining A debate or reading club or group is also a good idea.
transcript_json.translation: 参加辩论或读书俱乐部、读书小组也是个好主意。

transcript_json.text: This provides people with the opportunity to come together and discuss ideas, literature and problems.
transcript_json.translation: 这为人们提供了聚在一起讨论想法、文学作品和问题的机会。

transcript_json.text: Groups like these will help you refine your analytical skills and enable you to express yourself better.
transcript_json.translation: 这样的群体会帮助你打磨分析能力，让你更好地表达自己。

transcript_json.text: Any social group that encourages free exchange of ideas and pursuit of knowledge is beneficial.
transcript_json.translation: 任何鼓励自由交流思想和追求知识的社会群体都是有益的。

transcript_json.text: It helps you to actively develop your analytical skills.
transcript_json.translation: 它帮助你积极地培养分析能力。

There's an endless amount of scientific data proving that dogs can develop strong bonds with their owners.

transcript_json.text: The doctor's response to the question of whether or not dogs can fall in love like humans do was a straight, "Of course."

transcript_json.text: He went on to say that if love is defined as a long-term commitment, meaning dogs seek one another out when they're apart, they're happy when they're reunited, they protect one another, they feed one another, they raise their children together, then of course dogs love each other.
transcript_json.translation: 他接着说，如果把爱定义为长期的承诺，也就是说狗狗分开时会去寻找对方，重逢时会高兴，会保护彼此、互相喂食、共同抚养孩子，那狗狗当然是相爱的。

transcript_json.text: Now, our furry friends don't really experience romantic love like in the movies, but they can form deep and lasting bonds with their fellow dogs as As well as humans.
transcript_json.translation: 当然，我们的毛茸茸朋友不会像电影里那样经历浪漫爱情，但它们能与同类以及人类建立起深厚而持久的感情。

transcript_json.text: In fact, evidence shows that most dogs stay with one partner their whole lives.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，有证据表明大多数狗狗一生只和一个伴侣在一起。

transcript_json.translation: 实际上，狗狗之间的爱甚至比人类的感情还要亲密。

transcript_json.translation: 它们互动时不怕闻对方，而且会清楚坦率地表达自己。

transcript_json.text: Once again, it seems we have a lot to learn from dogs.
transcript_json.translation: 看来我们又有很多要向狗狗学习的地方。

A piece of history has been found thanks to a boy tripping on a rare 1.2 million-year-old animal fossil.

transcript_json.translation: 裘德的父亲凯尔·斯帕克斯说，他让儿子自己决定怎么处理这块化石。

transcript_json.text: So Jude reached out to Peter Hode, a professor at New Mexico State University, who had experience with the same type of fossil in the past.
transcript_json.translation: 于是裘德联系了新墨西哥州立大学的教授彼得·霍德，他以前接触过同类化石。

transcript_json.text: The next day, Hode came out to see the fossil for himself.
transcript_json.translation: 第二天，霍德亲自赶来查看这块化石。

transcript_json.text: Hode told ABC News that he was quite excited about the find.
transcript_json.translation: 霍德告诉ABC新闻，他对这一发现相当兴奋。

transcript_json.text: "It was fortunate that the family didn't try to dig up the fossil because that could destroy the specimen.
transcript_json.translation: "幸运的是，这家人没有试图把化石挖出来，那样可能会损坏标本。

transcript_json.text: They did the right thing by calling someone who would know what to do.
transcript_json.translation: 他们打电话给懂行的人，做得很对。

transcript_json.text: It's great for the community because now everybody can appreciate it," he added.
transcript_json.translation: 这对当地社区来说是件好事，因为现在大家都能欣赏到它了，"他补充道。

transcript_json.text: Hode and his fellow faculty members dug up the fossil in late May.
transcript_json.translation: 5月下旬，霍德和同事们把化石挖了出来。

transcript_json.text: They hope to return to the site with geologists for an additional search as there could be more fossils near the site.
transcript_json.translation: 他们希望和地质学家一起重返现场做进一步搜寻，因为附近可能还有更多化石。

transcript_json.text: Jude and his family have been invited by the researchers to see the fossil being preserved at the university.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员邀请裘德和家人到大学观看化石的保存过程。

In today's headlines, Scotland's transport minister has warned of potentially extreme weather conditions as heavy snow is forecast across the country later this week.

transcript_json.translation: 我试过去图书馆，但发现自己其实不太喜欢在那儿工作。

transcript_json.text: No, neither would I.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，我也不会。

transcript_json.text: I find the library a bit too quiet.
transcript_json.translation: 我觉得图书馆有点太安静了。

transcript_json.text: I'd lack inspiration or stimulation, which would be counterproductive to getting a lot of work done.
transcript_json.translation: 那样我会缺乏灵感和刺激，反而不利于完成大量工作。

transcript_json.text: I found the same thing.
transcript_json.translation: 我也有同感。

transcript_json.text: So lately, I've been going out to cafes occasionally.
transcript_json.translation: 所以最近我偶尔会去咖啡馆。

transcript_json.text: I love the noise, the people, the busyness of a cafe, the sense of being out in the world.
transcript_json.translation: 我喜欢咖啡馆里的嘈杂、人群和忙碌感，那种身处外面世界的感觉。

transcript_json.text: Coffee shops seem to have effectively become office spaces for so many people in this digital age, though I'm not sure how cafe owners feel about it, having so many people.
transcript_json.translation: 在这个数字时代，咖啡馆似乎已经成了很多人的办公场所，不过我不确定店主怎么想，来了这么多人。

transcript_json.text: People who go to their places to work rather than drink and eat.
transcript_json.translation: 他们是来工作而不是来吃喝的。

transcript_json.text: Yes, some people seem to spend a lot of time there and not order much.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，有些人好像待很久，却点不了多少东西。

transcript_json.text: The most annoying ones for cafe owners must surely be those, usually only two of them, who occupy a table for six with their laptops and paperwork.
transcript_json.translation: 对咖啡馆店主来说，最烦人的肯定是那种人——通常就两个人，却用笔记本和文件占了六人桌。

transcript_json.text: They should sit at a table for two, not at a table for six.
transcript_json.translation: 他们应该坐双人桌，而不是六人桌。

transcript_json.text: Some obviously stay so long they need to plug their laptops into a power outlet.
transcript_json.translation: 有些人显然待得太久，还得把笔记本插到电源插座上。

transcript_json.text: I nearly tripped over someone's computer electrical lead the other day in my local cafe.
transcript_json.translation: 前几天在附近的咖啡馆，我差点被别人的电脑电源线绊倒。

transcript_json.text: It's a double-edged sword, no doubt about that, for a cafe owner.
transcript_json.translation: 这对咖啡馆店主来说无疑是把双刃剑。

transcript_json.text: While remote workers help to keep the cafe full in quiet times, they can take up valuable table space in busy periods.
transcript_json.translation: 远程办公的人在淡季能让咖啡馆保持人气，但高峰期又会占用宝贵的桌位。

transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
I'm going to start looking for another job.
transcript_json.translation: 我打算开始找另一份工作。

transcript_json.text: I can't see myself getting an opportunity to progress at my company anytime in the near future.
transcript_json.translation: 在不久的将来，我看不到自己在公司有晋升的机会。

transcript_json.text: And I really think my skills and abilities deserve a higher salary.
transcript_json.translation: 而且我真心觉得，凭我的技能和能力，应该拿更高的薪水。

transcript_json.text: You're not going to quit, are you?
transcript_json.translation: 你不会辞职吧？

transcript_json.text: I'm thinking I might as well.
transcript_json.translation: 我想我还不如辞了算了。

transcript_json.text: Then I can devote more time and energy to finding a better position at another company.
transcript_json.translation: 这样我就能把更多时间和精力用来在别的公司找份更好的职位。

transcript_json.text: But you've been at your present company less than two years, haven't you?
transcript_json.translation: 可你在现在这家公司还不到两年，是吧？

transcript_json.text: This will be the third time you've left a job in the last five years.
transcript_json.translation: 这将是你过去5年里第三次辞职。

transcript_json.text: If you do several jobs in a relatively short span of time, prospective employers might perceive that you lack Loyalty.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你在相对短的时间里换几份工作，未来的雇主可能会觉得你不够忠诚。

transcript_json.text: That could make them wary and reluctant to employ you.
transcript_json.translation: 这会让他们有所顾虑，不愿意雇你。

transcript_json.text: Unfortunately, loyalty doesn't pay.
transcript_json.translation: 遗憾的是，忠诚换不来回报。

transcript_json.text: Even if I get a promotion at my company, it's likely to be less sizeable than if I were to get a job elsewhere.
transcript_json.translation: 就算我在公司升了职，加的薪也多半不如我去别处找份工作来得多。

transcript_json.text: And even if I get a promotion, I'm not guaranteed to get a raise.
transcript_json.translation: 而且就算升了职，也不保证能加薪。

transcript_json.text: I had that experience at another company I worked at.
transcript_json.translation: 我在以前工作的另一家公司就碰到过这种事。

transcript_json.text: They wanted you to take on more work and responsibility, but for the same amount of money?
transcript_json.translation: 他们是想让你多干活、多担责任，却一分钱不加？

transcript_json.text: More or less, yes.
transcript_json.translation: 差不多就是这样。

transcript_json.text: The way I see it, through having different jobs, I've gathered a lot of experience in different jobs and in different industries.
transcript_json.translation: 在我看来，通过做不同的工作，我在不同岗位和不同行业都积累了不少经验。

transcript_json.text: But potential employers might worry that that experience is not deep or thorough enough.
transcript_json.translation: 但潜在雇主可能会担心这种经历不够深入或全面。

transcript_json.text: Perhaps, but I feel pretty confident that I can sell myself.
transcript_json.translation: 也许吧，但我很有信心能推销自己。

transcript_json.text: You know what they say: fortune favors the brave.
transcript_json.translation: 俗话说得好：勇者得福。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
There is a saying that goes something along the lines of "You must love yourself first before you can love someone else."
transcript_json.translation: 有句谚语大概是这么说的："你必须先爱自己，才能爱别人。"

transcript_json.text: Similarly, I personally believe that you must be comfortable and happy in your own company before you can truly be yourself in the company of others.
transcript_json.translation: 同样，我个人认为，你必须先能独处得舒适快乐，才能在他人面前真正做自己。

transcript_json.text: There is a massive difference between being lonely and being alone.
transcript_json.translation: 孤独和独处之间有很大的区别。

transcript_json.text: Loneliness is a horrible feeling.
transcript_json.translation: 孤独是一种可怕的感觉。

transcript_json.text: However, you don't have to actually be alone to feel that way.
transcript_json.translation: 但是，你不一定非得独处才会有这种感觉。

transcript_json.text: Many times, I've felt lonely when surrounded by a big group of people.
transcript_json.translation: 很多时候，我被一大群人围着却感到孤独。

transcript_json.text: In contrast, being alone can actually be a blessing, particularly when you've actively chosen it.
transcript_json.translation: 相比之下，独处其实是一种福气，尤其是当你主动选择独处时。

transcript_json.text: In my experience, being bored and alone is dangerous and can easily lead to the feeling of loneliness.
transcript_json.translation: 以我的经验，无聊又一个人是很危险的，很容易让人产生孤独感。

transcript_json.text: The trick is to be active.
transcript_json.translation: 关键是要让自己动起来。

transcript_json.text: Get outside, stretch your legs, do something cultural, buy yourself something Questions 16 to 18 are based on the passage you have just heard.

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
When I turned 12, I worked summers at my father's small brick cleaning business.
transcript_json.translation: 我12岁那年，夏天在我父亲的小型砖墙清洗公司干活。

transcript_json.text: I remember the harsh, acid smell of the cleaning solution and the scraping sound of stiff iron brushes against rough brick.
transcript_json.translation: 我记得清洗液刺鼻的酸味，还有硬铁刷刮擦粗糙砖面的声音。

transcript_json.text: It was tempting to hurry a Job just to finish, but anybody who worked for Thomas Calhoun had to meet his standards, and that included me.
transcript_json.translation: 图省事赶紧干完走人是很诱人的，但给托马斯·卡尔霍恩干活的人，包括我在内，都得达到他的标准。

transcript_json.text: If I messed up, he made me stay late until I got it right.
transcript_json.translation: 要是我搞砸了，他就让我留到很晚，直到干好为止。

transcript_json.text: My father wasn't being mean; he demanded the same of himself.
transcript_json.translation: 我父亲不是在刁难人；他对自己也是同样的要求。

transcript_json.text: Every brick he cleaned on a house stood out like a red jewel in a white setting.
transcript_json.translation: 一栋房子上他清洗过的每一块砖，都像白色底座上的红宝石一样醒目。

transcript_json.text: It was his signature.
transcript_json.translation: 那就是他的招牌。

transcript_json.text: In 1970, when I was 20, I got married and moved out of my parents' modest place into a housing project.
transcript_json.translation: 1970年，我20岁，结了婚，从父母简朴的家搬进了公共住房小区。

transcript_json.text: Drugs and gang violence were just beginning to plague the projects.
transcript_json.translation: 毒品和帮派暴力才刚刚开始祸害这些小区。

transcript_json.text: Some of my friends went to jail.
transcript_json.translation: 我的一些朋友进了监狱。

transcript_json.text: Some were killed.
transcript_json.translation: 有的被人杀了。

transcript_json.text: My wife, Verlin, was 18, and nobody gave our marriage a chance.
transcript_json.translation: 我妻子弗琳18岁，没人看好我们的婚姻。

transcript_json.text: But we believed in each other, and our faith made us strong.
transcript_json.translation: 但我们彼此信任，这份信念让我们变得坚强。

transcript_json.text: When we met When I was married, I worked as a stock clerk at Southwest Superfoods.
transcript_json.translation: 我们相识的时候我结婚后，我在西南超级食品公司当理货员。

transcript_json.text: It was hard, tedious work.
transcript_json.translation: 这活儿又苦又枯燥。

transcript_json.text: Each Friday night, a truck came with cases of food that had to be unloaded, priced, and placed on shelves.
transcript_json.translation: 每周五晚上，都会有一辆卡车送来一箱箱食品，得卸货、贴价签、上架。

transcript_json.text: Most of the stock clerks tried to get Friday night off, but I was always ready to work.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数理货员都想周五晚上休息，但我总是随时待命。

transcript_json.text: By Saturday morning, all the cans and jars in my aisle were placed with the labels facing smartly out, like a line of soldiers on review.
transcript_json.translation: 到周六早上，我负责的那条货架上的瓶瓶罐罐全都摆放得整整齐齐，标签朝外，像一排接受检阅的士兵。

transcript_json.text: That was my signature.
transcript_json.translation: 那是我的招牌。

transcript_json.text: I took pride in a job nobody wanted.
transcript_json.translation: 我为这份没人愿意干的工作感到自豪。

transcript_json.text: Passage three: Watching more than three hours of television a day doubles memory loss in older people, a new study of more than 3,000 adults suggests.
transcript_json.translation: 短文三：一项对3000多名成年人的新研究显示，老年人每天看电视超过3小时，记忆力减退会加倍。

transcript_json.text: Scientists at University College London used memory and fluency tests on the same Group of people six years apart.
transcript_json.translation: 伦敦大学学院的科学家对同一组人进行了间隔6年的记忆力和语言流畅度测试。

transcript_json.text: They found that those who watched on average less than three hours television a day showed a decline of around four to five percent, while those who tended to watch more than three hours a day declined by an average of eight to ten percent.
transcript_json.translation: 他们发现，平均每天看电视不到3小时的人记忆力下降约4%到5%，而每天看电视超过3小时的人平均下降8%到10%。

transcript_json.text: The research team say they believe the alert but passive nature of television watching may be creating stress on the mind, which contributes to memory decline.
transcript_json.translation: 研究团队表示，他们认为看电视虽然清醒但被动，可能会给大脑造成压力，从而导致记忆力下降。

transcript_json.text: Older people who watch more television are also less likely to undertake activities known to preserve mental functioning, such as reading or interactive screen-based pursuits, such as using the internet or playing video games.
transcript_json.translation: 看电视较多的老年人也不太会从事那些有助于保持脑功能的活动，比如阅读，或上网、打游戏等互动性的屏幕活动。

transcript_json.text: The researchers say that television viewing may be a risk factor for Alzheimer's disease, but more research is needed to establish a link.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员表示，看电视可能是阿尔茨海默症的一个风险因素，但还需要更多研究来证实这一联系。

transcript_json.text: While watching television may have educational benefits and relaxation benefits.
transcript_json.translation: 虽然看电视有教育和放松方面的好处。

transcript_json.text: The researchers advise that adults over the age of 50 should try and ensure that television viewing is balanced with other contrasting activities.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员建议，50岁以上的成年人应尽量让看电视与其他不同类型的活动相平衡。

transcript_json.text: If you're concerned that the amount of television you're watching could have a negative impact on your health, you should limit the amount of TV you watch each day and undertake some healthy hobbies.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你担心自己看电视的时间过长会对健康造成不良影响，就应该限制每天看电视的时间，并培养一些健康的爱好。

transcript_json.text: Question 23: What contributed to memory decline in the participants?

transcript_json.text: News Report 1.
A NASA satellite orbiting over Portugal took photographs that reveal the effects of pollution from ships.
transcript_json.translation: NASA的一颗卫星在葡萄牙上空运行时拍摄的照片，揭示了船只污染的影响。

transcript_json.text: One of the photos shows a thin film of clouds above the brilliant blue of the North Atlantic, cut by white lines of thicker clouds that look like scars.
transcript_json.translation: 其中一张照片显示，北大西洋湛蓝的海面上方有一层薄薄的云，被一道道较厚的白色云带划过，看起来像伤疤。

transcript_json.text: NASA officials explained.
transcript_json.translation: NASA官员解释说。

transcript_json.text: Those thicker clouds are signs of ship traffic below.
transcript_json.translation: 那些较厚的云是下方船只通行的标志。

transcript_json.text: When ships power their way through the ocean, they pump exhaust into the atmosphere, just as cars do.
transcript_json.translation: 船只在海上航行时，会像汽车一样向大气排放废气。

transcript_json.text: And those massive amounts of particles can cause clouds to form.
transcript_json.translation: 那些大量的颗粒物会促使云的形成。

transcript_json.text: Get enough of those particles in one place, as from the exhaust of a ship, and they can lead to the creation of new clouds, easily visible from space.
transcript_json.translation: 当一个地方聚集了足够多的这类颗粒物，比如来自船只的废气，它们就能促成新云的产生，从太空很容易看到。

transcript_json.text: These clouds can be huge.
transcript_json.translation: 这些云可能非常巨大。

transcript_json.text: Some of them stretch hundreds of kilometers from end to end, NASA officials said.
transcript_json.translation: NASA官员说，有些云从一端到另一端绵延数百公里。

transcript_json.text: It's likely that these sorts of clouds are having some effect on the global climate, according to NASA officials, but scientists aren't yet sure what effect it has.
transcript_json.translation: 据NASA官员说，这类云很可能对全球气候有一定影响，但科学家还不确定究竟是什么影响。

transcript_json.text: News report two: Staff at a suburban supermarket in Melbourne say they feel unsafe at work after security guards were removed.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道二：墨尔本郊区一家超市的员工说，保安被撤走后，他们在工作中感到不安全。

transcript_json.text: This came after a series of physical attacks and verbal abuse by customers.
transcript_json.translation: 起因是顾客对员工进行了一系列人身攻击和言语辱骂。

transcript_json.text: More than 50 workers at the store have signed a letter calling for a permanent security guard following a series of incidents.
transcript_json.translation: 在一系列事件发生后，该店50多名员工联名签署了一封信，要求配备常驻保安。

transcript_json.text: Incidents, including a customer threatening to attack a supervisor with a knife.
transcript_json.translation: 这些事件包括一名顾客威胁要用刀袭击主管。

transcript_json.text: A security worker had guard at the store each night from 7 p.m until 12 a.m.
transcript_json.translation: 原本每天晚上7点到12点都有一名保安在店里值守。

transcript_json.text: But that had stopped suddenly on Monday, employees said.
transcript_json.translation: 员工说，但周一起这项安排突然取消了。

transcript_json.text: One worker said an angry customer had thrown a chicken at his head after complaining about how long she had waited to be served.
transcript_json.translation: 一名员工说，一位顾客抱怨等得太久，然后把一只鸡砸向他的头。

transcript_json.text: Another worker said the lack of protection at the store made her feel uncomfortable at work.
transcript_json.translation: 另一名员工说，店里缺乏保护让她在工作中感到不安。

transcript_json.text: However, a spokesman of the supermarket said the store had taken strong action in response to incidents.
transcript_json.translation: 不过超市发言人表示，该店已对这些事件采取了有力措施。

transcript_json.text: We have found very few instances of bad customer behavior at our store in the past year.
transcript_json.translation: 过去一年我们店里顾客的不良行为非常少见。

transcript_json.text: In the rare cases we have seen bad behavior, we have taken strong action in response, including banning a customer from the store.
transcript_json.translation: 在极少数出现不良行为的情况下，我们都采取了有力措施应对，包括禁止顾客进店。

transcript_json.text: News report 3.
Drivers on their way to the Polish capital of Warsaw on Wednesday morning found the road blocked by an unusual obstacle, tons of liquid chocolate that spilled onto the motorway.
transcript_json.translation: 周三上午，驾车前往波兰首都华沙的司机发现道路被一种不寻常的障碍物堵住了——数吨液态巧克力洒在了高速公路上。

transcript_json.text: A truck carrying the sweet load hit a road barrier and overturned, blocking two lanes.
transcript_json.translation: 一辆满载甜食的卡车撞上路障后翻车，堵住了两条车道。

transcript_json.text: The cracked tank spilled a pool of rapidly hardening chocolate, which quickly covered the width of the road.
transcript_json.translation: 破裂的罐体洒出一大滩迅速凝固的巧克力，很快铺满了整条路面。

transcript_json.text: While the driver was taken to hospital with a broken arm, firefighters struggled to remove a reported 12 tons of solid chocolate from the road.
transcript_json.translation: 司机手臂骨折被送往医院，而消防员则艰难地从路面上清理据报重达12吨的固态巧克力。

transcript_json.text: A representative for the firefighters told the local TV that removing the chocolate was worse than dealing with snow.
transcript_json.translation: 消防部门的一位发言人对当地电视台说，清理巧克力比铲雪还麻烦。

transcript_json.text: After contacting the chocolate manufacturer, the firefighters resorted to spraying hot, pressurized water to get rid of the sticky substance.
transcript_json.translation: 联系了巧克力生产商后，消防员只好用高压热水冲洗，来清除这些黏糊糊的东西。

transcript_json.text: The local TV also noted that the cleanup spanned more than a mile because drivers simply drove through the chocolate after the crash, leaving a long chocolate trail.
transcript_json.translation: 当地电视台还说，清理范围绵延1英里多，因为事故发生后，司机们直接从巧克力上开了过去，留下一条长长的巧克力印。

transcript_json.text: But despite the sticky situation, firefighters and police attending to the clean-up were reportedly cheerful about the long task ahead.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，尽管情况棘手，参与清理的消防员和警察面对接下来的漫长任务，据报仍心情愉快。

transcript_json.text: After all, who could be mad about 12 tons of chocolate?
transcript_json.translation: 毕竟，面对12吨巧克力，谁生得了气呢？

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
Lisa, why did you pay for your meal with cash instead of the payment apps on your phone?
transcript_json.translation: 丽莎，你为什么用现金付饭钱，而不用手机上的支付软件？

transcript_json.text: Well, I've gone back to cash.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我又用回现金了。

transcript_json.text: I'm only using payment apps if that's the only option.
transcript_json.translation: 只有别无选择时我才会用支付软件。

transcript_json.text: I'm trying to save money for a new phone, and I find that using cash rather than payment apps helps me to save.
transcript_json.translation: 我正在攒钱买新手机，我发现用现金比用支付软件更容易存下钱。

transcript_json.text: But how?
Money is money, isn't it?
transcript_json.translation: 钱就是钱，不是吗？

transcript_json.text: I don't think it matters whether you take it out of the bank and put it in your wallet, or simply transfer it from your bank account to the seller's bank account using an app.
transcript_json.translation: 我觉得不管你把钱从银行取出来放进钱包，还是用软件从银行账户直接转给卖家的账户，都没什么区别。

transcript_json.text: No, I believe it does matter.
transcript_json.translation: 不，我觉得有区别。

transcript_json.text: It's a psychological phenomenon.
transcript_json.translation: 这是一种心理现象。

transcript_json.text: I believe we have less connection with the value of our money when we just tap the approve buttons on our phones.
transcript_json.translation: 我觉得，当我们在手机上只是点一下确认按钮时，对钱的价值就没那么有感觉了。

transcript_json.text: You might have a point.
transcript_json.translation: 你说得有道理。

transcript_json.text: Since I stopped carrying cash around and started using my phone apps to pay, I may have developed a tendency to buy more small or non-essential items.
transcript_json.translation: 自从我不带现金、开始用手机软件付款以来，我好像更容易买一些小东西或者不必要的东西了。

transcript_json.text: That's highly possible.
transcript_json.translation: 很有可能。

transcript_json.text: Think about the amount of time we spend with our phones in our hands, and all the things we do with our phones.
transcript_json.translation: 想想我们一天有多少时间拿着手机，用手机做多少事情。

transcript_json.text: It sometimes seems that our phone is buying the product for us.
transcript_json.translation: 有时候感觉像是手机在替我们买东西。

transcript_json.text: Not ourselves.
So cashless payment affects our ability to budget?
transcript_json.translation: 所以无现金支付会影响我们的预算能力？

transcript_json.text: I believe so.
transcript_json.translation: 我相信是的。

transcript_json.text: If we spend 100 yuan in cash, we realize that we don't have that 100 yuan to spend on something else.
transcript_json.translation: 如果我们花100元现金，我们会意识到那100元不能再用来买别的东西了。

transcript_json.text: But if we're spending electronically, we are less likely to make that mental calculation.
transcript_json.translation: 但如果是电子支付，我们就不太会做这种心理计算。

transcript_json.text: I stopped using my credit card because I found I was spending excessively.
transcript_json.translation: 我不再用信用卡了，因为我发现自己花钱太多了。

transcript_json.text: Perhaps I should take the same approach of paying using my phone.
transcript_json.translation: 也许我应该用手机支付，采取同样的做法。

transcript_json.text: It's worth considering.
transcript_json.translation: 值得考虑。

transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
Hello, Mr.
Brown.
I was expecting your call.
transcript_json.translation: 我一直在等你的电话。

transcript_json.text: My secretary told me you were having some problems with the wooden table.
transcript_json.translation: 我秘书告诉我，您那张木桌出了点问题。

transcript_json.text: Is that right?
transcript_json.translation: 是这样吗？

transcript_json.text: No, no.
The table is fine.
transcript_json.translation: 桌子没问题。

transcript_json.text: The problem is the chairs.
transcript_json.translation: 问题出在椅子上。

transcript_json.text: Oh, the chairs.
transcript_json.translation: 哦，椅子啊。

transcript_json.text: So, what exactly is the issue?
transcript_json.translation: 那具体是什么问题？

transcript_json.text: Well, put simply, these are not the chairs my wife and I selected in your store last week.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，简单说，这不是我跟妻子上周在你们店里选的那些椅子。

transcript_json.text: There must have been some confusion with our order.
transcript_json.translation: 我们的订单肯定弄混了。

transcript_json.text: Oh, I see.
transcript_json.translation: 哦，我明白了。

transcript_json.text: I'm looking through my files now, and I see that the delivery was this morning.
transcript_json.translation: 我正在查档案，看到送货时间是今天上午。

transcript_json.text: Is that correct?
transcript_json.translation: 对吗？

transcript_json.text: Yes.
Do you mind describing the chairs that were delivered to your apartment, Mr.
transcript_json.translation: 您能描述一下送到您公寓的椅子吗，先生。

transcript_json.text: Brown?
Sure.
These have a flat back with a rounded top, and are very heavy.
transcript_json.translation: 这些椅子靠背是平的，顶部是圆的，而且很重。

transcript_json.text: They're light brown, and look kind of cheap.
transcript_json.translation: 它们是浅棕色的，看着有点廉价。

transcript_json.text: The ones we ordered were dark brown to match the table.
transcript_json.translation: 我们订的是深棕色的，要跟桌子配套。

transcript_json.text: Right.
Of course.
It says here you purchased the Arlington table and four Milano chairs.
transcript_json.translation: 这里写着您买的是阿灵顿餐桌和4把米兰诺椅子。

transcript_json.text: As you said, there must have been some confusion with the order.
transcript_json.translation: 正如您所说，订单肯定弄混了。

transcript_json.text: I'm terribly sorry.
transcript_json.translation: 非常抱歉。

transcript_json.text: We will send a van to collect those four and replace them with the Milano you purchased.
transcript_json.translation: 我们会派一辆货车去取那四件，并换成您购买的Milano款。

transcript_json.text: Will tomorrow 9 a.m be okay, Mr.
transcript_json.translation: 明天上午9点可以吗，先生？

transcript_json.text: Brown?
Yes, that would be great.
transcript_json.translation: 好的，那太好了。

transcript_json.text: Thank you.
Good.
Did everything else you ordered from us arrive okay?
transcript_json.translation: 您从我们这儿订的其他东西都到了吗？

transcript_json.text: Yes, I think so.
transcript_json.translation: 是的，应该是的。

transcript_json.text: Let me check.
transcript_json.translation: 我核对一下。

transcript_json.text: The mirror and two paintings are here.
transcript_json.translation: 镜子和两幅画都在这儿。

transcript_json.text: The two coffee tables are also here, and the sofa.
transcript_json.translation: 两张茶几也在，还有沙发。

transcript_json.text: Yes, we haven't noticed anything else wrong or missing, but if we do, we will certainly let you know.
transcript_json.translation: 是的，我们没发现其他问题或缺漏，如果有的话，一定会告诉您。

transcript_json.text: Okay, great.
Once again, I am sorry for the confusion and trouble caused.
transcript_json.translation: 再次为给您造成的混乱和麻烦表示歉意。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Do you have too much stuff?
transcript_json.translation: 你是不是东西太多了？

transcript_json.text: Are you, dare we say it, untidy?
transcript_json.translation: 是不是可以说，你不太爱收拾？

transcript_json.text: Say hello to a TV show called Tidying Up with Marie Kondo, a home improvement show based on her wildly popular book, the The life-changing magic of tidying up.
transcript_json.translation: 向你推荐一档叫《和近藤麻理惠一起整理》的电视节目，这是一档家居改造节目，改编自她那本超级畅销书《怦然心动的人生整理魔法》。

transcript_json.text: In the show, Marie Kondo acts as a tiny garbage fairy for messy people, visiting their houses to share the wisdom of the KonMari method.
transcript_json.translation: 节目中，近藤麻理惠就像一个小小的整理精灵，去邋遢人士家里做客，传授近藤整理法的智慧。

transcript_json.text: This method is simple in theory, but can be endlessly complex in practice.
transcript_json.translation: 这套方法理论上很简单，但实践起来可能无比复杂。

transcript_json.text: You divide all the stuff in your house, all of it, into several categories, and then examine each item, all of them, to see if it sparks joy.
transcript_json.translation: 你要把家里所有的东西，没错，所有东西，分成几大类，然后逐一审视每一件物品，每一件哦，看看它是否让你心动。

transcript_json.text: If it does, you keep it.
transcript_json.translation: 如果心动，就留下。

transcript_json.text: If it doesn't, you thank it and neatly discard it.
transcript_json.translation: 如果不心动，就感谢它，然后整齐地处理掉。

transcript_json.text: So, is the TV show inspiring people to tidy up?
transcript_json.translation: 那么，这档电视节目真的在激励人们整理吗？

transcript_json.text: First-hand accounts seem to indicate a small wave of people bringing piles of donation bags to used goods stores.
transcript_json.translation: 从第一手的反馈来看，似乎有一小波人正扛着一袋袋捐赠品涌向旧货店。

transcript_json.text: One store received thousands of bags of used possessions in one day.
transcript_json.translation: 有一家店一天之内就收到了几千袋二手物品。

transcript_json.text: January is usually the stores' slow season for donations because it's cold and people don't want to bother.
transcript_json.translation: 1月通常是这些店的捐赠淡季，因为天冷，人们懒得折腾。

transcript_json.text: But not this January.
transcript_json.translation: 但这个1月不一样。

transcript_json.text: People seem determined to clean up their homes.
transcript_json.translation: 人们似乎铁了心要把家里收拾干净。

transcript_json.text: One used bookstore received a month's worth of books in donations in a week when a man gave over 50 boxes of books from his home.

transcript_json.text: Passage two: At just 12 years old, Mike Hannon is making a difference in his community, one lunch at a time.
transcript_json.translation: 短文二：才12岁的迈克·汉农正在改变他的社区，一次一份午餐。

transcript_json.text: Mike's Lunches of Love has fed more than 2,000 of the town's most vulnerable residents.
transcript_json.translation: "迈克的爱心午餐"已经为镇上2000多名最弱势的居民提供了食物。

transcript_json.text: Mike delivers meals to the homeless.
transcript_json.translation: 迈克给无家可归的人送餐。

transcript_json.text: "It's like a way to give people joy, maybe spark some "Something in them that can change them," Mike told WBZ-TV.
transcript_json.translation: "这就像是一种给人们带来快乐的方式，也许能激发他们内心某种能改变他们的东西，"迈克告诉WBZ电视台。

transcript_json.text: The mayor of Mike's town feels that Mike is a great community leader, especially in such times of so much negative news.
transcript_json.translation: 迈克所在镇的镇长认为，迈克是一位出色的社区领袖，尤其是在这么多负面新闻的当下。

transcript_json.text: While his father commented on how proud he was of his son.
transcript_json.translation: 而他的父亲则说，他为儿子感到无比骄傲。

transcript_json.text: Yet, Mike isn't looking for praise, but kindness in return.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，迈克并不求赞美，只希望换来善意。

transcript_json.text: He hopes his acts of charity will influence others to spread positive actions in their own towns.
transcript_json.translation: 他希望自己的慈善行为能带动其他人，在各自的城镇传播正能量。

transcript_json.text: Mike includes a handwritten message of joy on each bag.
transcript_json.translation: 迈克在每个袋子上都附了一张手写的快乐留言。

transcript_json.text: His message and star power has spread all over the country.
transcript_json.translation: 他的留言和明星效应已经传遍了全国。

transcript_json.text: To date, his online page to raise funds has brought in more than $44,000 and counting, raising more than $17,000 in just one day, with the help of many famous actors and others.
transcript_json.translation: 到目前为止，他的网上筹款页面已筹得超过44000美元，而且还在增加；在众多知名演员和其他人的帮助下，仅一天就筹得超过17000美元。

transcript_json.text: People from all over the country are sending special handcrafted bags to help the young man with his mission to help those in need.
transcript_json.translation: 来自全国各地的人们寄来特制的手工袋子，帮助这位年轻人完成援助有需要者的使命。

transcript_json.text: Many are hoping the simple act of kindness spreads.
transcript_json.translation: 许多人都希望这份简单的善意能传递开来。

transcript_json.text: Mike is seen as hope for the future of the town, the country, and the world.
transcript_json.translation: 迈克被视为这个镇、这个国家乃至这个世界未来的希望。

transcript_json.text: Passage three: In a recent study carried out by psychologists on the disruptive effects of smartphones, two groups of college students were given word search puzzles.
transcript_json.translation: 材料三：最近心理学家进行了一项关于智能手机干扰作用的研究，两组大学生被要求做单词搜索游戏。

transcript_json.text: The first group was told to complete the puzzles with its participants' smartphones in their line of sight.
transcript_json.translation: 第一组被要求做游戏时，手机要放在视线范围内。

transcript_json.text: The second group, however, was told that the phones would interfere with the equipment in the experiment and would need to be moved away from the testing area.
transcript_json.translation: 而第二组被告知手机会干扰实验设备，必须移出测试区域。

transcript_json.text: Midway through the second group's solving of the puzzles, the experimenter called one of phones and let it ring for a while before hanging up.
transcript_json.translation: 第二组做游戏进行到一半时，实验者拨打其中一部手机的电话，让铃声响了一会儿才挂断。

transcript_json.text: Many of the students in that group were unable to focus from then on, becoming anxious and performing more poorly than the first group.
transcript_json.translation: 该组的许多学生从那时起就无法集中注意力，变得焦虑，表现也比第一组差。

transcript_json.text: Use of electronics has also been known to lead to a decline in human interactions.
transcript_json.translation: 使用电子产品还会导致人际交往减少。

transcript_json.text: Rather than having real-life conversations, many express emotions and engage in deep conversations through social media sites.
transcript_json.translation: 很多人不再进行面对面的交谈，而是通过社交媒体表达情感、深入交流。

transcript_json.text: Many students use their phones and computers during class for non-academic activities, which leads to poor grades.
transcript_json.translation: 很多学生上课时用手机和电脑做与学业无关的事，导致成绩不佳。

transcript_json.text: Perhaps the most dramatic impact is the reduction in the amount of sleep, which leads to poor health and weight gain.
transcript_json.translation: 也许影响最明显的是睡眠时间减少，这会导致健康变差和体重增加。

transcript_json.text: Technology is a great tool.
transcript_json.translation: 科技是个好工具。

transcript_json.text: However, it's important to recognize its downsides.
transcript_json.translation: 但重要的是要认识到它的弊端。

transcript_json.text: Lack of sleep, reduction of productivity, and weight gain are only a few.
transcript_json.translation: 睡眠不足、效率降低和体重增加只是其中一部分。

transcript_json.text: If we are not careful about all these minor problems right now, the effect on the future generation is going to be much bigger.
transcript_json.translation: 如果我们现在不重视这些小问题，对未来一代的影响会大得多。

transcript_json.text: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.

transcript_json.translation: 问题22：在这项研究中，两组大学生都被要求做什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 23: What do we learn about many of the students in the second test group after the phone rang?
transcript_json.translation: 问题23：关于第二组的许多学生，电话响后我们了解到什么？

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
A poisonous fish, which has a sting strong enough to kill a human, is invading the Mediterranean, warn scientists.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家警告说，一种毒性足以致人死亡的鱼类正在入侵地中海。

transcript_json.text: The International Union for the Conservation of Nature has raised concerns after the poisonous fish was spotted in the waters around Turkey, Cyprus, and the eastern Mediterranean.
transcript_json.translation: 这种有毒鱼类在土耳其、塞浦路斯和地中海东部水域被发现后，世界自然保护联盟对此表示了担忧。

transcript_json.text: Native to the South Pacific and Indian Ocean, the potentially deadly fish has poisonous hooks and a painful sting capable of killing people.
transcript_json.translation: 这种可能致命的鱼原产于南太平洋和印度洋，带有毒钩，蜇伤疼痛难忍，足以致人死亡。

transcript_json.text: Although fatalities are rare, the stings can cause extreme pain and stop people breathing.
transcript_json.translation: 尽管死亡案例很少见，但蜇伤会引起剧痛，甚至让人停止呼吸。

transcript_json.text: The fish, often known as devil firefish, is a highly invasive species, and environmentalists fear its arrival could endanger other types of marine life.
transcript_json.translation: 这种鱼常被称为魔鬼火鱼，是一种入侵性极强的物种，环保人士担心它的到来会危及其他海洋生物。

transcript_json.text: After being spotted in the Mediterranean, a marine scientist says, the fish is spreading, and that's a cause for concern.
transcript_json.translation: 一位海洋科学家说，这种鱼在被发现进入地中海后正在扩散，这一点令人担忧。

transcript_json.text: News report two: Almost half the center of Paris will be accessible only by foot or bicycle this Sunday to mark World Car-Free Day.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道二：本周日，为纪念世界无车日，巴黎市中心近一半区域将只允许步行或骑自行车通行。

transcript_json.text: This is in response to rising air pollution that made Paris the most polluted city in the world for a brief time.
transcript_json.translation: 这是对空气污染加剧的回应，污染曾使巴黎在短时间内成为全球污染最严重的城市。

transcript_json.text: Mayor Anne Hidalgo promoted the first World Car-Free Day last year.
transcript_json.translation: 市长安妮·伊达尔戈去年推动了首个世界无车日。

transcript_json.text: Hidalgo also has supported a Paris Breathes Day.
transcript_json.translation: 伊达尔戈还支持设立“巴黎呼吸日”。

transcript_json.text: On the first Sunday of every month, Paris clears traffic from eight lanes of main road.
transcript_json.translation: 每个月的第一个星期日，巴黎会在8条主干道车道上禁止车辆通行。

transcript_json.text: About 400 miles of streets will be closed to cars.
transcript_json.translation: 大约400英里的街道将禁止机动车通行。

transcript_json.text: It is expected to bring significant reduction in pollution levels.
transcript_json.translation: 预计这将显著降低污染水平。

transcript_json.text: Last year's Car Free Day showed a 40 percent drop in pollution levels in some parts of the city, according to an independent air pollution monitor, reports The Guardian, and sound levels dropped by 50 percent in the city's center.
transcript_json.translation: 据《卫报》报道，一家独立的空气污染监测机构称，去年的无车日使该市部分地区的污染水平下降了40%，市中心的噪音水平下降了50%。

transcript_json.text: A Philippine fisherman was feeling down on his luck when a house fire forced him to clear out his possessions and change locations.

transcript_json.text: Then, a good luck charm that he had kept under his bed changed his life.
transcript_json.translation: 然后，他一直放在床下的一个幸运物改变了他的人生。

transcript_json.text: The unidentified man had fished out a giant pearl from the ocean when his anchor got stuck on the rock while sailing off a coastal island in the Philippines ten years ago.
transcript_json.translation: 10年前，这位未透露姓名的男子在菲律宾一座沿海岛屿附近航行时，船锚卡在了礁石上，他从海里捞出了一颗巨型珍珠。

transcript_json.text: When he was forced to sell it, the shocked tourist agent at Puerto Princesa told him that the 77-pound giant pearl that he had kept hidden in his rundown wooden house was the biggest pearl in the world, which was valued at $76 million pounds.
transcript_json.translation: 当他被迫卖掉这颗珍珠时，公主港的一位旅游代理惊讶地告诉他，他一直藏在那间破旧木屋里的这颗重77磅的巨型珍珠是世界上最大的珍珠，价值7600万英镑。

transcript_json.text: The pearl of Allah, which is currently on display in a New York museum, only weighs 14 pounds.
transcript_json.translation: 目前在纽约一家博物馆展出的"真主之珠"仅重14磅。

transcript_json.text: That is five times smaller than the pearl that the fisherman just handed in.
transcript_json.translation: 这比渔民刚上交的珍珠小了5倍。

transcript_json.text: The monstrous pearl, measured at one foot wide and 2.2 feet long, is going to be verified by local experts and international authorities before hopefully going on display to attract more tourists in the little town.
transcript_json.translation: 这颗巨型珍珠宽1英尺、长2.2英尺，将由当地专家和国际机构进行鉴定，之后有望展出，为这个小镇吸引更多游客。

Smith, it's a pleasure meeting you.

transcript_json.text: Astra Consultants has branches in over fifty countries, offering different business services.

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Removing foreign objects from ears and noses costs England almost £3 million a year, a study suggests.
transcript_json.translation: 一项研究显示，在英格兰，从耳朵和鼻子里取出异物每年花费近300万英镑。

transcript_json.text: Children were responsible for the vast majority of cases: 95% of objects removed from noses and 85% from ears.
transcript_json.translation: 绝大多数病例都是儿童：鼻子异物中95%、耳朵异物中85%出自儿童。

transcript_json.text: Every year, an average of 1,218 nose and 2,479 ear removals took place between 2010 and 2016, according to England's hospital episode statistics.
transcript_json.translation: 根据英格兰医院就诊统计数据，2010到2016年间，平均每年取出鼻腔异物1218例、耳道异物2479例。

transcript_json.text: Children aged 1 to 4 were the most likely to need help from doctors for a foreign object in their nose.
transcript_json.translation: 1到4岁的儿童最容易因鼻腔进入异物而需要医生帮助。

transcript_json.text: Five to nine-year-olds come to the hospital with something in their ears the most.
transcript_json.translation: 5到9岁的孩子因耳朵里塞进东西去医院的最多。

transcript_json.text: Jewelry items accounted for up to 40% of cases in both the ears and noses of children.
transcript_json.translation: 在儿童耳鼻异物中，首饰类占了高达40%。

transcript_json.text: Paper and plastic toys were the items removed next most from noses.
transcript_json.translation: 从鼻子里取出的异物中，第二常见的是纸屑和塑料玩具。

transcript_json.text: Cotton beds and pencils were also found in ears.
transcript_json.translation: 耳朵里还发现过棉签和铅笔。

transcript_json.text: According to the study, the occurrence of foreign objects in children is generally attributed to curiosity.
transcript_json.translation: 研究认为，儿童体内出现异物通常源于好奇心。

transcript_json.text: Children have an impulse to explore their noses and ears.
transcript_json.translation: 孩子总想探索自己的鼻子和耳朵。

transcript_json.text: This results in the accidental entry of foreign objects.
transcript_json.translation: 这就导致异物意外进入。

transcript_json.text: Any ear, nose, and throat surgeon has many weird stories about wonderful objects found in the noses and ears of children and adults.
transcript_json.translation: 任何一位耳鼻喉科医生都能讲出许多奇闻，关于在儿童和成人鼻腔、耳道里发现的各种奇妙物品。

transcript_json.text: Batteries can pose a particular danger.
transcript_json.translation: 电池尤其危险。

transcript_json.text: In all cases, prevention is better than cure.
transcript_json.translation: 无论如何，预防胜于治疗。

transcript_json.text: This is why many toys contain warnings about small parts.
transcript_json.translation: 所以很多玩具上都有关于小零件的警示。

transcript_json.text: Recognizing problems early and seeking medical attention is important.
transcript_json.translation: 尽早发现问题并就医很重要。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Good morning.
Today I would like to talk to you about my charity ReBicycle.
transcript_json.translation: 今天我想跟大家谈谈我的慈善机构ReBicycle。

transcript_json.text: But before that, let me introduce someone.
transcript_json.translation: 但在此之前，我先介绍一个人。

transcript_json.text: This is Leila Rahimi.
transcript_json.translation: 这是莱拉·拉希米。

transcript_json.text: She was so scared when she first moved to New Zealand that she struggled to leave the house and would spend days working up the courage to walk to the supermarket for basic supplies.
transcript_json.translation: 她刚搬到新西兰时非常害怕，连出门都很吃力，常常要花好几天鼓起勇气，才走去超市买基本生活用品。

transcript_json.text: After a few months of being quite down and unhappy, she was invited to join a local bike club.
transcript_json.translation: 在情绪低落、闷闷不乐的几个月后，她受邀加入了一个当地的自行车俱乐部。

transcript_json.text: At this time, ReBicycle got involved and gave Leila a second-hand bicycle.
transcript_json.translation: 就在这时，ReBicycle参与进来，送给她一辆二手自行车。

transcript_json.text: Within weeks, her depression had begun to ease as she cycled.
transcript_json.translation: 几周之内，随着骑车，她的抑郁情绪开始缓解。

transcript_json.text: The bicycle totally changed her life, giving her hope and a true feeling of freedom.
transcript_json.translation: 这辆自行车彻底改变了她的生活，给了她希望和真正的自由感。

transcript_json.text: To date, ReBicycle has donated more than two hundred bikes to those in need, and is now expanding bike riding lessons as demand soars.
transcript_json.translation: 至今，ReBicycle已向有需要的人捐赠了200多辆自行车，如今需求激增，骑车课程也在不断扩大。

transcript_json.text: With a bike, newcomers here can travel farther, but for almost no cost.
transcript_json.translation: 有了自行车，新来的人可以去更远的地方，而且几乎不花钱。

transcript_json.text: The three hours a day they used to spend walking to and from English language lessons has been reduced to just one hour.
transcript_json.translation: 他们过去每天花3小时步行往返去上英语课，现在只需1小时。

transcript_json.text: Our bike riding lessons are so successful that we are urgently looking for more volunteers.
transcript_json.translation: 我们的骑车课程非常成功，现在急需更多志愿者。

transcript_json.text: Learning to ride a bike is almost always more difficult for an adult, and this can take days and weeks rather than hours.
transcript_json.translation: 学骑车对成年人来说几乎总是更难，这可能要花上几天、几周，而不是几小时。

transcript_json.text: So, if any of you have some free time during the weekend, please come join us at ReBicycle and make a difference in someone's life.
transcript_json.translation: 所以，如果你们周末有空，请来ReBicycle加入我们，改变某个人的生活。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
Thanks to the International Space Station, we know quite a bit about the effects of low gravity on the human body.
transcript_json.translation: 多亏了国际空间站，我们对低重力对人体的影响已经有相当多的了解。

transcript_json.text: But NASA scientists want to learn more.
transcript_json.translation: 但美国国家航空航天局的科学家们想了解更多。

transcript_json.text: To that end, they have been studying how other species deal with low gravity, specifically focusing on mice.
transcript_json.translation: 为此，他们一直在研究其他物种如何应对低重力，重点放在老鼠身上。

transcript_json.text: The results are both interesting and humorous.
transcript_json.translation: 结果既有趣又逗人。

transcript_json.text: The scientists first sent some mice in a specially designed cage to the International Space Station.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家们首先把一些老鼠装进一个特制的笼子，送往国际空间站。

transcript_json.text: The cage allowed them to study the behavior of the mice remotely from Earth via video.
transcript_json.translation: 这个笼子让他们能通过视频在地球上远程观察老鼠的行为。

transcript_json.text: As you'll notice in the video, the mice definitely seem uncomfortable at the beginning of the experiment.
transcript_json.translation: 正如你会在视频中看到的，实验刚开始时，老鼠显然很不舒服。

transcript_json.text: They move around clumsily, drifting within the small confines of the cage, and do their best to figure out which way is up, but without success.
transcript_json.translation: 它们笨拙地四处乱动，在小小的笼子里飘来飘去，拼命想弄清哪个方向是上，却始终弄不明白。

transcript_json.text: However, it's not long before the mice begin to catch on.
transcript_json.translation: 不过没过多久，老鼠们就摸到了门道。

transcript_json.text: They adapt remarkably well to their new environment, and even use the lack of gravity to their advantage as they push themselves around the cage.
transcript_json.translation: 它们对新环境的适应能力出奇地好，甚至还利用失重来推着自己在笼子里到处跑。

transcript_json.text: That's when things really get wild.
transcript_json.translation: 那时候，情况真正变得疯狂起来。

transcript_json.text: The eleventh day of the experiment shows the mice are not just dealing with the gravity change, but actually seem to be enjoying it.
transcript_json.translation: 实验第11天的画面显示，老鼠们不仅应付得了重力的变化，似乎还挺享受。

transcript_json.text: Several of the mice are observed running around the cage walls.
transcript_json.translation: 人们观察到好几只老鼠在笼壁上跑来跑去。

transcript_json.text: The scientists wanted to see whether the mice would continue doing the same kinds of activities they were observed doing on Earth.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家们想看看老鼠是否会继续做它们在地球上被观察到的那些活动。

transcript_json.text: The study showed that the mice kept much of their routines intact, including cleaning themselves and eating when hungry.
transcript_json.translation: 研究显示，老鼠的大部分日常习惯都保留了下来，包括自我清洁和饿了就吃。

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
A waiter has returned a check worth nearly $424,000 to a retired social worker who lost it.
transcript_json.translation: 一名服务员把一张近42.4万美元的支票还给了一位丢失支票的退休社会工作者。

transcript_json.text: The waiter found a bank envelope while cleaning off a table last Saturday at a restaurant.
transcript_json.translation: 上周六，这位服务员在一家餐厅收拾桌子时发现了一个银行信封。

transcript_json.text: He ran outside, but the customer was gone.
transcript_json.translation: 他追了出去，但那位顾客已经走了。

transcript_json.text: He opened the envelope and got a shock.

transcript_json.text: After an un unsuccessful search, the restaurant's owner called the Daily News for help.

transcript_json.text: The relieved customer was reunited with her check on Wednesday.
transcript_json.translation: 周三，这位如释重负的顾客终于找回了她的支票。

transcript_json.translation: 支票里是她卖公寓的钱，早已计划好用作新房的首付。

transcript_json.text: The customer did not tip the waiter after her meal.
transcript_json.translation: 这位顾客用餐后没有给服务员小费。

transcript_json.text: She tried to give him money later on, but he graciously declined.
transcript_json.translation: 后来她想给他钱，但他婉言谢绝了。

transcript_json.text: The waiter, who's working his way through school, did accept the customer's apology and gratitude, and said he was happy to have helped her.
transcript_json.translation: 这位靠打工供自己上学的服务员接受了顾客的道歉和感谢，并说很高兴能帮到她。

The village of Merif in Alaska voted on Tuesday to move to the state's mainland.
transcript_json.translation: 阿拉斯加的Merif村周二投票决定搬到州内的大陆地区。

transcript_json.text: The move is due to global warming and rising sea levels.
transcript_json.translation: 搬迁的原因是全球变暖和海平面上升。

transcript_json.text: Most of the village's 169 registered voters took part in the town hall meeting.
transcript_json.translation: 村里169名登记选民中的大多数参加了镇民大会。

transcript_json.text: They decided in a vote of 89 to 78 to move from their land on Saratoff Island near the Arctic Circle.
transcript_json.translation: 他们以89票对78票的投票结果，决定搬离位于北极圈附近的Saratoff岛上的土地。

transcript_json.text: Merif council secretary Donna Barr said the vote was largely symbolic.
transcript_json.translation: Merif村委会秘书Donna Barr说，这次投票在很大程度上具有象征意义。

transcript_json.text: It will be costly financially to the community.
transcript_json.translation: 这将给社区带来巨大的经济负担。

transcript_json.text: About 15 years ago, they estimated the cost at 180 million dollars.
transcript_json.translation: 大约15年前，他们估算搬迁费用为1.8亿美元。

transcript_json.text: I "We would figure it's much higher now," Barr said.
transcript_json.translation: Barr说："我们认为现在的费用要高得多。"

transcript_json.text: "We don't see the move happening in our lifetime because of the funding."
transcript_json.translation: "由于资金问题，我们认为这辈子都看不到搬迁实施。"

transcript_json.text: The village's roughly 650 residents have seen warming temperatures, melt sea ice and permanently frozen land.
transcript_json.translation: 村里约650名居民目睹了气温升高、海冰融化和永久冻土消融。

transcript_json.text: This has resulted in houses falling into the water.
transcript_json.translation: 这导致房屋落入水中。

transcript_json.text: At least 31 villages in Alaska face immediate threats due to climate change, the Government Accountability Office reported in 2009.
transcript_json.translation: 美国政府问责局2009年报告称，阿拉斯加至少有31个村庄因气候变化面临直接威胁。

transcript_json.text: News report three.
A man in Halifax, Canada, wanted to find out if people were thankful for someone holding the door open for them.
transcript_json.translation: 加拿大哈利法克斯的一名男子想了解，人们是否会感谢有人为他们扶门。

transcript_json.text: The social experiment showed that 99 out of 100 people expressed gratitude.
transcript_json.translation: 这项社会实验显示，100人中有99人表示了感谢。

transcript_json.text: "I didn't think we were going to get 99.
transcript_json.translation: "我没想到会有99个人。

transcript_json.text: I don't know why, but I was pleasantly surprised because it went beyond just 'thank you.'
transcript_json.translation: 我不知道为什么，但我感到很惊喜，因为这不仅仅是说句"谢谢"那么简单。

transcript_json.text: People got into conversations with us," said Steve Foran, CEO of Gratitude at Work.
transcript_json.translation: "人们开始跟我们聊了起来，"感恩在职场公司首席执行官史蒂夫·福兰说。

transcript_json.text: "What we know from research is that from grateful people come good things," he said.
transcript_json.translation: "研究告诉我们，懂得感恩的人会带来美好的事情，"他说。

transcript_json.text: "A simple way to induce gratitude in people is opening doors, and so we went to six places and opened the doors for people.
transcript_json.translation: "让人们心生感恩的一个简单方法就是帮人开门，所以我们去了6个地方，帮人们开门。

transcript_json.text: For the experiment, Foran's team went to a shopping center, a mall, two office buildings, and a coffee shop.
transcript_json.translation: 在这个实验中，福兰的团队去了一个商业中心、一个商场、两栋写字楼和一家咖啡店。

transcript_json.text: The door was held for 15 to 20 people at a time at each location.
transcript_json.translation: 在每个地点，一次会为15到20个人扶门。

transcript_json.text: We did have one that didn't say thank you.
transcript_json.translation: 确实有一个人没说谢谢。

transcript_json.text: We're not here to judge them, because on any given day that could be me or you.
transcript_json.translation: 我们不是来评判他们的，因为哪天换成你我都可能这样。

transcript_json.text: I suspect out of the 100 people, there were probably a bunch of them having a bad day.
transcript_json.translation: 我猜那100个人里，可能有不少人那天过得不太顺。

transcript_json.text: But grateful people make people grateful, said Foran.
transcript_json.translation: 但懂得感恩的人会让别人也心怀感恩，福兰说。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Tourists.
Taking a holiday in the Indonesian island of Bali are facing a new $14 per person tax when they arrive on the holiday island from next year.
transcript_json.translation: 明年起，前往印度尼西亚巴厘岛度假的人在抵达这座度假岛屿时，将面临一项新的每人14美元的税。

transcript_json.text: But this is a green tax, which Bali Governor Wayan Koster has been working on for months, and which is designed to help clean up the island's natural environment.
transcript_json.translation: 不过这是一种环保税，巴厘岛省长瓦扬·科斯特尔已经为此筹备了好几个月，目的是帮助清理岛上的自然环境。

transcript_json.text: And with good reason too.
transcript_json.translation: 而且这也确实很有道理。

transcript_json.text: Indonesia is drowning in plastics.
transcript_json.translation: 印度尼西亚正被塑料淹没。

transcript_json.text: Recycling is not one of the country's strong points.
transcript_json.translation: 回收利用并不是这个国家的强项。

transcript_json.text: It's not uncommon to be offered many more plastic bags than one could ever need when visiting supermarkets and shopping malls.
transcript_json.translation: 去超市和购物中心时，店家给的塑料袋往往远超所需，这很常见。

transcript_json.text: But slowly, things are starting to change for the better.
transcript_json.translation: 但慢慢地，情况开始好转。

transcript_json.text: Back in 2016, the medium-sized city of Banjarmasin banned single-use plastic bags.
transcript_json.translation: 早在2016年，中等城市马辰就禁止了一次性塑料袋。

transcript_json.text: The city of Bogor followed suit in 2018.
transcript_json.translation: 2018年，茂物市也紧随其后。

transcript_json.text: A few months ago, Koster announced a plan.
transcript_json.translation: 几个月前，科斯特宣布了一项计划。

transcript_json.text: That would not only ban single-use plastic bags from supermarkets and convenience stores, but plastic bags and straws across the island.
transcript_json.translation: 该计划不仅要在超市和便利店禁用一次性塑料袋，还要在整个岛上禁用塑料袋和吸管。

transcript_json.text: The regulation will come into full effect next month.
transcript_json.translation: 这项规定将于下月全面生效。

transcript_json.text: We received a fast and quick response from the Balinese people.
transcript_json.translation: 巴厘民众的反应非常迅速。

transcript_json.text: Not only positive responses from the Balinese, we received good responses from the central government, other local governments, and even from overseas, Costa told the Sydney Morning Herald this week during an interview.

transcript_json.text: The governor is a determined environmentalist, and he has more laws planned to protect the island's waterways in particular, and to support the introduction of electric vehicles too.

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
An endangered species of whale is experiencing a A small baby boom off the coast of America.
transcript_json.translation: 一种濒危鲸鱼在美国海岸附近迎来了一小波婴儿潮。

transcript_json.text: The North Atlantic right whale is one of the rarest species of whale on the planet, numbering only about 411.
transcript_json.translation: 北大西洋露脊鲸是地球上最稀有的鲸类之一，仅存约411头。

transcript_json.text: But the Center for Coastal Studies said Friday that its aerial survey team spotted a mom with two babies in Cape Cod Bay a day earlier.
transcript_json.translation: 但海岸研究中心周五表示，其航空调查队前一天在科德角湾发现了一头带着两只幼崽的鲸鱼。

transcript_json.text: That brings the number seen in nearby waters alone this year to three.
transcript_json.translation: 这使得仅在附近海域今年被发现的数量就达到了3头。

transcript_json.text: That's big news because the whale population has been falling, and no baby whales were seen last year.
transcript_json.translation: 这可是个大新闻，因为鲸鱼数量一直在下降，去年一头幼鲸都没见到。

transcript_json.text: In all, seven baby whales have been spotted so far this year.
transcript_json.translation: 今年到目前为止，一共发现了7头幼鲸。

transcript_json.text: The whale population has become endangered due to commercial whaling activities in recent years.
transcript_json.translation: 近年来，由于商业捕鲸活动，鲸鱼数量已濒临灭绝。

transcript_json.text: This is because they are sometimes hunted for their meat or their skin.
transcript_json.translation: 这是因为它们有时会因为肉或皮而遭到捕杀。

transcript_json.text: Overhunting could lead to the disappearance of the whale population, possibly causing major problems to the global food chain.
transcript_json.translation: 过度捕猎可能导致鲸鱼种群消失，可能给全球食物链带来重大问题。

transcript_json.text: The whales give birth off the southeast coast of America in the winter and travel to feeding grounds off the northeast coast in the early spring.
transcript_json.translation: 鲸鱼冬天在美国东南海岸产仔，早春游到东北海岸的觅食地。

transcript_json.text: The northeast coast is a critically important source of food.
transcript_json.translation: 东北海岸是极为重要的食物来源。

transcript_json.text: The animals often feed close to shore.
transcript_json.translation: 这些动物常常在近岸觅食。

transcript_json.text: This provides watchers on land with unbeatable views of one of the rarest of marine mammals.
transcript_json.translation: 这让岸上的观鲸者能一览无遗地观赏到最稀有的海洋哺乳动物之一。

transcript_json.text: It's illegal to get within 1,500 feet of the animals without a federal research permit, so whale watchers are discouraged from attempting to get close to the whales.
transcript_json.translation: 没有联邦研究许可证，靠近这些动物1500英尺以内是违法的，所以不鼓励观鲸者试图靠近鲸鱼。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
An average person consumes 144 pints of milk a year, but 40% of that is poured onto cereal, and 60% of those People are children.
transcript_json.translation: 一个普通人每年喝144品脱牛奶，但其中40%倒在麦片里，而这些人中60%是儿童。

transcript_json.text: But what was once advertised as nutritious is becoming unpopular.
transcript_json.translation: 但曾经被宣传为营养丰富的牛奶正越来越不受欢迎。

transcript_json.text: Americans drink 37 percent less milk than they did in the 1970s, and in the U.K dairy consumption overall has fallen by a third in the past 20 years.
transcript_json.translation: 美国人喝的牛奶比20世纪70年代少了37%，英国整体乳制品消费在过去20年里下降了三分之一。

transcript_json.text: Milk is increasingly being described in a negative light.
transcript_json.translation: 牛奶越来越多地被负面描述。

transcript_json.text: A recent blog suggested, "Maybe people are drinking less milk because it is poisonous to many of us."
transcript_json.translation: 最近有篇博客写道："也许人们少喝牛奶，是因为它对我们很多人来说是有毒的。"

transcript_json.text: Lactose is the sugar found in milk and dairy products.
transcript_json.translation: 乳糖是牛奶和乳制品中含有的糖。

transcript_json.text: It needs a series of complex proteins to break it down.
transcript_json.translation: 它需要一系列复杂的蛋白质来分解它。

transcript_json.text: Without enough of these proteins, the lactose is broken down by bacteria in the human body.
transcript_json.translation: 如果这些蛋白质不够，乳糖就会被人体内的细菌分解。

transcript_json.text: This can cause physical pain and produce gas in the stomach.
transcript_json.translation: 这会引起身体疼痛，并在胃里产生气体。

transcript_json.text: However, after we have finished breast or formula feeding, most of us don't continue producing the complex proteins in our body, which are necessary to break down the lactose.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，等我们断了母乳或配方奶之后，大多数人就不再分泌体内分解乳糖所必需的这些复杂蛋白质了。

transcript_json.text: Despite the problems in digesting milk, it does provide many benefits.
transcript_json.translation: 虽然消化牛奶有问题，但它确实有很多好处。

transcript_json.text: Milk is nutritious.
transcript_json.translation: 牛奶很有营养。

transcript_json.text: It contains vitamins A and D, as well as protein, and isn't full of calories.
transcript_json.translation: 它含有维生素A和维生素D，还有蛋白质，而且热量不高。

transcript_json.text: You can test yourself by drinking a large glass of milk.
transcript_json.translation: 你可以喝一大杯牛奶来测试一下自己。

transcript_json.text: If you get sick in your stomach within the next 24 hours, you are lacking the proteins to digest milk.
transcript_json.translation: 如果接下来24小时内你胃不舒服，就说明你缺乏消化牛奶的蛋白质。

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
And finally, in tonight's news, a nine-year-old boy named Joe, told not to draw in class, lands a job decorating a restaurant with his drawings.
transcript_json.translation: 最后是今晚的新闻，一个名叫乔的9岁男孩，被告知不许在课堂上画画，却接到了一份用他的画装饰餐厅的工作。

transcript_json.text: Rather than shutting down the habit of drawing in his school's workbook, Joe's parents decided To encourage his creativity, by sending their son to an after-school art class.
transcript_json.translation: 乔的父母没有制止他在学校练习本上画画的习惯，而是决定送儿子去上课外美术班，鼓励他的创造力。

transcript_json.text: His teacher recognized Joe's talent and posted all his work online, which led to something pretty wonderful.
transcript_json.translation: 他的老师发现了乔的天赋，把他的所有作品都发到了网上，这带来了一件相当美好的事。

transcript_json.text: A restaurant named Number Four in Newcastle contacted Joe's teacher to ask if the nine-year-old could come and decorate its dining room with his drawings.
transcript_json.translation: 纽卡斯尔一家名叫"四号"的餐厅联系了乔的老师，问这个9岁男孩能不能来用他的画装饰餐厅的用餐区。

transcript_json.text: Every day after school, Joe's dad drives him to the restaurant so he can put his ideas straight on the wall.
transcript_json.translation: 每天放学后，乔的爸爸都开车送他去餐厅，好让他把想法直接画在墙上。

transcript_json.text: Once he's all done, the work will remain there permanently.
transcript_json.translation: 等他全部画完，这些作品将永久保留在那里。

transcript_json.text: Joe's dad said, "Joe is a really talented little boy.
transcript_json.translation: 乔的爸爸说："乔是一个非常有天赋的小男孩。

transcript_json.text: He's excellent at school.
transcript_json.translation: 他在学校成绩优异。

transcript_json.text: He's great at football, but drawing is definitely what he is most passionate about."
transcript_json.translation: 足球踢得很好，但画画绝对是他最热爱的事情。"

transcript_json.text: After combing through the security video outside a Goebel's shop, Kirsten has now posted an image of a man suspected of stealing the dog.
transcript_json.translation: 柯斯滕仔细查看了Goebel's商店外面的监控录像后，现已公布了一名涉嫌偷狗男子的照片。

transcript_json.translation: 但吃完饭，顾客不必为账单发愁。

transcript_json.text: Hungry customers can pay whatever amount they can afford to eat at the cafe, or nothing at all.
transcript_json.translation: 饥饿的顾客可以在这家咖啡馆付自己付得起的价钱吃饭，也可以一分钱不付。

transcript_json.text: Owner Guy Wilson says his cafe aims to build community rather than profits.

transcript_json.text: He wants to provide a bridge for people to connect, in an area that has been divided by class and wealth, by providing affordable breakfasts.
transcript_json.translation: 他希望通过提供价格实惠的早餐，在这个被阶级和财富割裂的地区，为人们架起一座沟通的桥梁。

transcript_json.text: The cafe is open in the mornings every day of the year, and has two members of staff or supervisors on shift every day.
transcript_json.translation: 这家咖啡馆一年365天早上都营业，每天有两名员工或主管值班。

transcript_json.text: The cafe doesn't use volunteers, but pays its staff to ensure consistency in its service.

transcript_json.text: It doesn't take donations, and doesn't want to be seen as a charity.

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Pigs are not native to North America.
transcript_json.translation: 猪不是北美洲的本土动物。

transcript_json.text: They were first introduced to California by Spanish and Russian explorers and settlers many centuries ago.
transcript_json.translation: 许多世纪以前，西班牙和俄罗斯的探险者及定居者最早把猪引进了加利福尼亚。

transcript_json.text: In the early times, pigs were allowed to wander freely in search of food.
transcript_json.translation: 早期，猪被允许自由游荡，自己找食物。

transcript_json.text: This practice also allowed many pigs to escape from farms and live in the wild, which became a problem.
transcript_json.translation: 这种做法也让许多猪从农场逃走，在野外生活，这就成了一个问题。

transcript_json.text: In fact, they're one of the most damaging invasive species on the continent.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，它们是这片大陆上危害最大的入侵物种之一。

transcript_json.text: Wild pigs cause millions of dollars in crop damage yearly.
transcript_json.translation: 野猪每年造成数百万美元的农作物损失。

transcript_json.text: They also harbor dozens of diseases that threaten both humans and farm animals.
transcript_json.translation: 它们还携带数十种疾病，威胁人类和家畜。

transcript_json.text: Forest patches with wild pigs have been found to have considerably reduced plant and animal diversity.
transcript_json.translation: 有野猪出没的林地，植物和动物多样性明显减少。

transcript_json.text: In addition to either eating other animals or their food supply, wild pigs damage native habitats by rooting up grasses and rubbing on trees.
transcript_json.translation: 野猪除了吃掉其他动物或它们的食物，还会拱食草类、蹭磨树木，破坏本土栖息地。

transcript_json.text: Their activities may also create opportunities for invasive plants to colonize these areas.
transcript_json.translation: 它们的活动还可能为入侵植物在这些地区扎根创造机会。

transcript_json.text: Wild pigs will eat almost anything containing calories.
transcript_json.translation: 野猪几乎什么都吃，只要含有热量。

transcript_json.text: Mice, deer, birds, snakes, and frogs are among their victims.
transcript_json.translation: 老鼠、鹿、鸟类、蛇和青蛙都是它们的受害者。

transcript_json.text: They can also harm other wild species through indirect competition, rather than eating them or shrinking their food supply.
transcript_json.translation: 它们还会通过间接竞争伤害其他野生动物，而不是靠吃掉它们或减少它们的食物。

transcript_json.text: On one particular United States island, wild pigs themselves became an attractive food source for a species of mainland eagle.
transcript_json.translation: 在美国的一个特定岛屿上，野猪本身成了一种大陆猛禽的诱人食物来源。

transcript_json.text: The eagles began breeding on the island and also feeding on a species of native fox.
transcript_json.translation: 这些鹰开始在岛上繁殖，也捕食一种本土狐狸。

transcript_json.text: The foxes were almost wiped out completely.
transcript_json.translation: 这些狐狸几乎被赶尽杀绝。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
A pair of entrepreneurs are planning to build and launch a spacecraft that would carry And roast coffee beans in outer space.
transcript_json.translation: 两位创业者正计划建造并发射一艘航天器，把咖啡豆送入太空进行烘焙。

transcript_json.text: The craft will use the heat of re-entry to roast coffee beans as they float inside it in a pressurized tank.
transcript_json.translation: 航天器将利用重返大气层时产生的热量，对悬浮在加压罐内的咖啡豆进行烘焙。

transcript_json.text: The effect would be to roast the beans all over and produce perfect coffee.
transcript_json.translation: 这样可以把咖啡豆整体均匀烤透，做出完美的咖啡。

transcript_json.text: The businessmen say that on Earth, beans can easily break apart and get burned in the roaster.
transcript_json.translation: 商人们说，在地球上，咖啡豆很容易在烘焙机里碎裂或烤焦。

transcript_json.text: But if gravity is removed, the beans float around in a heated oven, receive 360 degrees of evenly distributed heat, and roast to near perfection.
transcript_json.translation: 但如果没有重力，咖啡豆就会在加热的炉中四处漂浮，受到360度均匀分布的热量，几乎完美地烘烤出来。

transcript_json.text: The spacecraft will reach a height of around 200 kilometers.
transcript_json.translation: 航天器将升至约200公里的高度。

transcript_json.text: The beans would then be roasted in the heat generated by the craft's 20-minute re-entry into Earth's atmosphere.
transcript_json.translation: 随后，咖啡豆将在航天器重返地球大气层的20分钟内，利用产生的热量进行烘焙。

transcript_json.text: Temperatures in the pressurized tank will be kept to around 200 degrees Celsius.
transcript_json.translation: 加压罐内的温度将控制在约200摄氏度。

transcript_json.text: Once back on Earth, the planet's first space-roasted beans would be used used to make coffee that would be sold for the first time in Dubai.
transcript_json.translation: 返回地球后，这批全球首批太空烘焙的咖啡豆将用来制作咖啡，首次在迪拜出售。

transcript_json.text: This is where the pair's company is based.
transcript_json.translation: 那里是他们公司的所在地。

transcript_json.text: It is not clear how much they would charge for a cup.
transcript_json.translation: 目前尚不清楚一杯咖啡会卖多少钱。

transcript_json.text: Surprisingly, the space roaster concept, should it go ahead, will not be the first attempt to take coffee into space.
transcript_json.translation: 令人意外的是，即便这个太空烘焙方案真的付诸实施，它也不是第一次把咖啡带上太空的尝试。

transcript_json.text: In 2015, two Italian companies collaborated on the construction of a similar type of spacecraft, which was the first coffee machine designed for use in space.
transcript_json.translation: 2015年，两家意大利公司合作建造了一艘类似的航天器，那台机器是首个为在太空中使用而设计的咖啡机。

transcript_json.text: Passage 3 In cold and snowy Alaska, there's a village called Tukotna.
transcript_json.translation: 短文3 在寒冷多雪的阿拉斯加，有个叫塔科特纳的村庄。

transcript_json.text: It has a population of a mere 49 souls.
transcript_json.translation: 它的人口只有区区49人。

transcript_json.text: Each March, this tiny village swells up in numbers because it is located in the middle of a race that takes place every year.
transcript_json.translation: 每年3月，这个小村庄的人数就会激增，因为它位于一项每年举行的赛事的中途。

transcript_json.text: It is a seven-day race called the Iditarod Trail, and participants stop at Tukotna for their obligatory 24-hour rest.
transcript_json.translation: 这是一场为期7天的艾迪塔罗德小道比赛，参赛者会在塔科特纳停留，完成必须的24小时休息。

transcript_json.text: Lucky for them, Tukotna is famous for its delicious fruit pies.
transcript_json.translation: 他们运气不错，图科特纳以美味的水果派闻名。

transcript_json.text: Weeks before the competitors arrive, the residents of Tukotna start preparing for what is, without question, their biggest event of the year.
transcript_json.translation: 在参赛者抵达前的几周，图科特纳的居民就开始筹备这场毫无疑问是他们一年中最盛大的活动。

transcript_json.text: The whole village chips in to help, including the kids, who end up developing their baking skills at an early age.
transcript_json.translation: 全村人都来帮忙，包括孩子们，他们也因此从小就练出了烘焙手艺。

transcript_json.text: The exhausted and hungry racers are greeted with delightful pies of all kinds, such as apple, orange, lemon, or banana.
transcript_json.translation: 疲惫又饥饿的参赛者会受到各种美味派的款待，比如苹果派、橙子派、柠檬派或香蕉派。

transcript_json.text: They consume the pies as stomach-warming race fuel.
transcript_json.translation: 他们把派当作暖胃的赛程补给吃下去。

transcript_json.text: The toughness of the race allows for racers to eat pretty much whatever they want.
transcript_json.translation: 比赛的艰苦让参赛者几乎可以想吃什么就吃什么。

transcript_json.text: The more calories, the better.
transcript_json.translation: 热量越高越好。

transcript_json.text: Tukotna has gained a reputation for its Dessert-based hospitality since the 1970s.
transcript_json.translation: 自20世纪70年代以来，图科特纳就以甜点款客的热情好客出了名。

transcript_json.text: It started with one person, Jan Newton.
transcript_json.translation: 这要从一个人说起，她叫珍·牛顿。

transcript_json.text: Jan moved from Idaho with her husband in 1972 and opened a restaurant.
transcript_json.translation: 1972年，珍和丈夫从爱达荷州搬来，开了一家餐馆。

transcript_json.text: Her rich and filling fruit pies quickly got the racers' attention, and the village gained some fame as a result.
transcript_json.translation: 她做的水果派料足又顶饱，很快引起了参赛者的注意，村子也因此有了些名气。

transcript_json.text: Proud residents then started to refer to Jan as Queen of Tucotna.
transcript_json.translation: 自豪的居民们于是开始把珍称作图科特纳女王。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1: An 81-year-old man ended up in Germany by accident after trying to get from Newcastle, Great Britain, to Rome, Italy.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道1：一名81岁的老人本想从英国纽卡斯尔前往意大利罗马，却不小心到了德国。

transcript_json.text: The old-age pensioner was on a mission to see the Pope, who is head of the Catholic Church, and decided to make his way there by car.
transcript_json.translation: 这位领取养老金的老人此行是为了见天主教会的教皇，他决定开车前往。

transcript_json.text: He was surprised when his GPS system told him he had arrived, although there were no signs of any of the famous buildings or architecture.
transcript_json.translation: GPS提示他已到达目的地时，他吃了一惊，因为眼前完全看不到那些著名建筑和景观。

transcript_json.text: The man parked, but didn't put on the handbrake of his car properly.
transcript_json.translation: 他停好车，但手刹没拉到位。

transcript_json.text: His car rolled backwards and, in a striking display of irony, hit a sign saying Rom, the small town in North Germany he had mistakenly plugged into the GPS system.
transcript_json.translation: 车子向后溜坡，颇具讽刺地撞上了一块写着"罗姆"的路牌——那正是他误输入GPS的德国北部小镇。

transcript_json.text: Police said that the car had come to a halt after hitting the sign, but did not appear to be seriously damaged, although an ambulance was called to check on the pensioner.
transcript_json.translation: 警方说车撞上路牌后停了下来，看上去损坏并不严重，不过还是叫了救护车来检查老人的情况。

transcript_json.text: The man, who lives in the UK and is originally Italian, might have been confused by the fact that Rome is written Roma in Italian and Rom in German.
transcript_json.translation: 这位老人现居英国，原本是意大利人，可能是把意大利语中的Roma（罗马）和德语中的Rom（罗姆）搞混了。
