transcript_json.text: Passage one.
A recent study found that 10% of British children suffer from math anxiety.
transcript_json.translation: 最近一项研究发现，10%的英国儿童有数学焦虑症。

transcript_json.text: This means they have overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject, ranging from rage to despair.
transcript_json.translation: 也就是说，他们对这门学科有压倒性的负面情绪，从愤怒到绝望都有。

transcript_json.text: Other emotions triggered by math include feelings of tension and frustration.
transcript_json.translation: 数学引发的其他情绪还包括紧张和沮丧感。

transcript_json.text: Physical symptoms include a racing heart or struggling to catch breath.
transcript_json.translation: 身体症状包括心跳加快或喘不过气。

transcript_json.text: The phenomenon of math anxiety is characterised as a general sense of feeling that the subject is hard compared with other subjects, leading to a subsequent lack or loss of confidence.
transcript_json.translation: 数学焦虑的表现是，总觉得数学比其他科目难，进而导致信心不足或丧失信心。

transcript_json.text: The researchers said they investigated individuals' attitudes towards mathematics because of what could be Referred to as a mathematics crisis in the UK.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员说，他们之所以调查个人对数学的态度，是因为英国正面临所谓的"数学危机"。

transcript_json.text: There is a widespread misunderstanding that only low-performing children suffer from math anxiety.
transcript_json.translation: 人们普遍误以为只有成绩差的孩子才有数学焦虑。

transcript_json.text: People automatically assume children are anxious about math because they are poor achievers.
transcript_json.translation: 人们想当然地认为，孩子数学焦虑是因为成绩不好。

transcript_json.text: In fact, more than three quarters of children with high levels of math anxiety are normal to high achievers.
transcript_json.translation: 实际上，数学焦虑严重的孩子中，超过四分之三成绩处于中等或中上水平。

transcript_json.text: Probably, their math anxiety will go unnoticed because their performance is good.
transcript_json.translation: 他们的数学焦虑很可能被忽视，因为他们成绩不错。

transcript_json.text: But in the long term, their performance is negatively affected.
transcript_json.translation: 但从长远看，他们的成绩会受到负面影响。

transcript_json.text: So a real danger here is that children who are completely able to do math at a normal level may keep away from it because they feel anxious.
transcript_json.translation: 所以真正的危险在于，那些完全有能力正常学好数学的孩子，可能会因为焦虑而避开数学。

transcript_json.text: Math anxiety can severely disrupt students' performance in the subject in both primary and secondary school.
transcript_json.translation: 数学焦虑会严重影响小学生和中学生在数学上的表现。

transcript_json.text: But importantly, and surprisingly, this new study Suggests that the majority of students experiencing math anxiety have normal to high math ability.

transcript_json.text: Passage 2: People spend a lot of time using phones and computers.
transcript_json.translation: 第2篇：人们花很多时间使用手机和电脑。

transcript_json.text: Much of that time is devoted to text messages and social media.
transcript_json.translation: 这些时间很多都用在了短信和社交媒体上。

transcript_json.text: But many people choose to spend their time playing computer games.
transcript_json.translation: 但也有很多人选择把时间花在玩电脑游戏上。

transcript_json.text: For years, parents and teachers have worried that these games might be addictive.
transcript_json.translation: 多年来，家长和老师一直担心这些游戏可能让人上瘾。

transcript_json.text: And now the World Health Organization has recognized addiction to computer games as a disease.
transcript_json.translation: 而现在，世界卫生组织已将电脑游戏成瘾认定为一种疾病。

transcript_json.text: The organization explains that this decision reflects general agreement among experts around the world that some people have a problem with these games.
transcript_json.translation: 该组织解释说，这一决定反映了世界各地专家的普遍共识：有些人在这些游戏上确实存在问题。

transcript_json.text: They show a pattern of behavior characterized by a lack of control.
transcript_json.translation: 他们表现出一种缺乏自控的行为模式。

transcript_json.text: Such people make computer games a priority over their responsibilities.
transcript_json.translation: 这些人把电脑游戏看得比自己的责任更重要。

transcript_json.text: They may play games instead of attending school or work, or socializing.
transcript_json.translation: 他们可能玩游戏而不去上学或上班，也不参加社交活动。

transcript_json.text: According to the World Health Organization experts, people's use of computer games is different from their use of the Internet, social media, and online shopping.
transcript_json.translation: 世界卫生组织的专家表示，人们对电脑游戏的使用不同于对互联网、社交媒体和网上购物的使用。

transcript_json.text: These experts claim there is not sufficient data to indicate that people's reliance on those other activities is an addiction.
transcript_json.translation: 这些专家称，没有足够的数据表明人们对这些其他活动的依赖是一种成瘾。

transcript_json.text: But they argue that playing computer games to excess is different.
transcript_json.translation: 但他们认为，过度玩电脑游戏则不同。

transcript_json.text: This behavior can become a disorder.
transcript_json.translation: 这种行为可能演变成一种障碍。

transcript_json.text: To meet the new definition for addiction, the behavior must damage a person's relationships or performance at school or work, and this must last for at least a year.
transcript_json.translation: 要符合成瘾的新定义，这种行为必须损害一个人的人际关系或在学校、工作中的表现，而且必须持续至少一年。

transcript_json.text: Still, not all behavior experts agree.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，并非所有行为专家都同意。

transcript_json.text: Some argue that there is not enough research on the subject object.
transcript_json.translation: 有些人认为，关于这一主题的研究还不够。

transcript_json.text: Thus, they claim it is too early to call computer game addiction a disorder.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，他们认为现在把电脑游戏成瘾称为一种障碍还为时过早。

transcript_json.text: Passage 3.
Maybe you carry the most powerful passport in the world, or perhaps the rarest passport.
transcript_json.translation: 也许你拥有的是世界上最强大的护照，或者是最稀有的护照。

transcript_json.text: Whatever the case, your passport will likely be one of four colours: red, blue, green or black, although there are slight variations.
transcript_json.translation: 无论如何，你的护照很可能是这4种颜色之一：红色、蓝色、绿色或黑色，尽管会有一些细微差别。

transcript_json.text: Switzerland's passport is dark red, for example, while most European countries prefer a shade of red that's almost brown.
transcript_json.translation: 比如瑞士的护照是深红色的，而大多数欧洲国家更喜欢接近棕色的红色。

transcript_json.text: There are no official rules regarding passport colours, but countries follow a certain set of norms when designing them.
transcript_json.translation: 关于护照颜色并没有官方规定，但各国在设计护照时都会遵循一套约定俗成的规范。

transcript_json.text: The International Civil Aviation Organization, which works to define the principles of Air travel suggests that countries use a suitable type, size, and style for official documents like passports.
transcript_json.translation: 国际民用航空组织致力于确立航空旅行的原则，该组织建议各国在护照等官方文件上采用合适的字体、尺寸和样式。

transcript_json.text: There are also a few compulsory aspects of passports.
transcript_json.translation: 护照还有几项强制性要求。

transcript_json.text: They must be made from a material that bends.
transcript_json.translation: 它们必须用可以弯折的材料制成。

transcript_json.text: They should be able to be read by a machine at temperatures ranging from 10 degrees Celsius to 50 degrees Celsius, and conditions where the air can be extremely dry or moist.
transcript_json.translation: 它们应该能在10摄氏度到50摄氏度之间、空气极干或极潮湿的条件下被机器读取。

transcript_json.text: Despite these existing recommendations, there is nothing regarding the cover color.
transcript_json.translation: 尽管有这些现行建议，但对于封面颜色却没有任何规定。

transcript_json.text: Why?
Simply put, countries stick to darker and more conservative colors because they appear more official, and they can also hide dirt and wear.
transcript_json.translation: 简单来说，各国都坚持使用较深、较保守的颜色，因为这样看起来更正式，而且还能遮掩污渍和磨损。

transcript_json.text: While there's little innovation when it comes to passport cover color, the same cannot be said for the pages.
transcript_json.translation: 护照封面颜色方面没什么创新，但内页就不同了。

transcript_json.text: The passports of many countries contain images of of their well-known geographical features and wildlife, which also function as security features, as some are only visible under a special light.
transcript_json.translation: 许多国家的护照内页印有本国著名的地理景观和野生动物图案，这些图案同时也能起到防伪作用，因为其中一些只有在特殊光线下才能看到。

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
I can't believe that duck hunting is still legal in so many parts of the world.
transcript_json.translation: 我不敢相信，在世界上这么多地方猎杀鸭子竟然还是合法的。

transcript_json.text: The scientific evidence from countries like Australia, Canada, and the USA clearly indicates a decline in the birds' numbers.
transcript_json.translation: 来自澳大利亚、加拿大和美国等国的科学证据清楚地表明，这些鸟类的数量在下降。

transcript_json.text: But can anyone be sure if the decline is really caused by the hunting or by climate change?
transcript_json.translation: 但谁能确定这种下降真的是由捕猎造成的，还是由气候变化引起的？

transcript_json.text: It's caused by both, in fact.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，两者都有影响。

transcript_json.text: We see more droughts in countries like Australia.
transcript_json.translation: 我们看到澳大利亚等国家的干旱越来越多。

transcript_json.text: Ducks are birds that feed and breed In areas where there is a lot of water.
transcript_json.translation: 鸭子是鸟类，在水源丰富的地方觅食和繁殖。

transcript_json.text: But their habitats have been shrinking in recent decades because of the droughts.
transcript_json.translation: 但近几十年来，由于干旱，它们的栖息地一直在缩小。

transcript_json.text: And I guess, with fewer places to inhabit, they concentrate in greater numbers in few areas, which surely makes them easier targets for the hunters.
transcript_json.translation: 我想，可供栖息的地方变少了，它们就大量集中在少数几个区域，这肯定让它们更容易成为猎人的目标。

transcript_json.text: It does.
My grandfather was a duck hunter.
transcript_json.translation: 我爷爷以前是个猎鸭人。

transcript_json.text: He told me hunting ducks and geese began in the 19th century.
transcript_json.translation: 他告诉我，猎鸭和猎鹅始于19世纪。

transcript_json.text: They were an easily found and plentifully available food source in farming areas, especially for poor immigrants.
transcript_json.translation: 在农业区，它们是容易找到又数量充足的食物来源，对贫穷的移民来说尤其如此。

transcript_json.text: What did they use for hunting during that period?
transcript_json.translation: 那个时期他们用什么来打猎？

transcript_json.text: They used new types of guns, and birds could easily be shot down in flight, and in such great numbers that commercial hunting of ducks and geese became an industry.
transcript_json.translation: 他们用上了新型枪支，飞着的鸟很容易就被打下来，而且数量之大，使得猎鸭猎鹅的商业捕猎发展成了一个产业。

transcript_json.text: Yet there's no commercial farming of these birds nowadays.
transcript_json.translation: 但如今并没有这些禽类的商业化养殖。

transcript_json.text: Their meat is hardly eaten in Western countries.
transcript_json.translation: 在西方国家，人们几乎不吃它们的肉。

transcript_json.text: No, duck hunting seemingly exists as the of a tradition.
transcript_json.translation: 不，猎鸭似乎只是作为一项传统而存在。

transcript_json.text: Wild ducks have never been popular with farmers like my grandfather anyway, because they sometimes destroy crops.
transcript_json.translation: 反正像我爷爷那样的农民从来就不喜欢野鸭，因为它们有时会毁坏庄稼。

transcript_json.text: In fact, farmers used to poison them in large numbers.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，农民过去常常大规模毒杀它们。

transcript_json.text: That somehow doesn't surprise me.
transcript_json.translation: 这倒不怎么让我意外。

transcript_json.text: Nobody places much value on the lives of these poor birds or on their meat.
transcript_json.translation: 没人多么看重这些可怜的鸟的生命，也没人看重它们的肉。

transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
Okay, Miss Bright, I've finished calculating.
transcript_json.translation: 好的，布莱特小姐，我已经算好了。

transcript_json.text: I estimate you have between two hundred and ten and two hundred and fifty acres of arable land.
transcript_json.translation: 我估计你有210到250英亩的可耕地。

transcript_json.text: 140 square meters of walls and ceiling.
transcript_json.translation: 140平方米的墙面和天花板。

transcript_json.text: So, how much would the paint job cost?
transcript_json.translation: 那么，粉刷要花多少钱？

transcript_json.text: That would depend on the quality of paint you choose.
transcript_json.translation: 那要看你选哪种油漆。

transcript_json.text: We carry two brands.
transcript_json.translation: 我们有两个牌子。

transcript_json.text: One costs sixty cents every square meter, and the other ninety cents.
transcript_json.translation: 一种每平方米60美分，另一种90美分。

transcript_json.text: The second is guaranteed to look great for about ten years, whereas the cheaper one will start to dull after around six or seven years.
transcript_json.translation: 贵的那种保证大约10年都好看，便宜的那种大概六七年就会变暗淡。

transcript_json.text: In that case, we would prefer the more expensive option.
transcript_json.translation: 那样的话，我们宁愿选贵的。

transcript_json.text: All right, then.
transcript_json.translation: 好的，那就这样。

transcript_json.text: So, including labor costs, taxes, and everything, this job would come to three thousand dollars.
transcript_json.translation: 那么，算上人工费、税金等等，这项活总共3000美元。

transcript_json.text: Hmm.
To be perfectly honest, that's more than I expected.
transcript_json.translation: 说实话，这比我预期的要多。

transcript_json.text: Please bear in mind that the price includes moving all the furniture, and the whole task would take two days.
transcript_json.translation: 请记住，这个价格包括搬动所有家具，而且整个工作要花两天。

transcript_json.text: Really?
Why?
Well, we can't paint the walls without clearing all the furniture first, so every time we paint a Room, we first have to move the furniture to another room.
transcript_json.translation: 呃，不清空所有家具就没法刷墙，所以每刷一个房间，都得先把家具搬到另一个房间。

transcript_json.text: So that takes more time.
transcript_json.translation: 这样就更费时间。

transcript_json.text: Plus, it requires two people, which works out more expensive.
transcript_json.translation: 而且得两个人干，算下来就更贵。

transcript_json.text: I see.
But does that mean I could not live here in my own house during those two days?
transcript_json.translation: 但这是不是说那两天我不能住在自己家里？

transcript_json.text: That is correct.
transcript_json.translation: 是的。

transcript_json.text: Oh well, that changes everything, I'm afraid.
transcript_json.translation: 唉，那恐怕事情就不一样了。

transcript_json.text: I would have to stay with a friend or check into a hotel.
transcript_json.translation: 那我就得借住朋友家，或者住酒店了。

transcript_json.text: I hadn't considered any of that.
transcript_json.translation: 这些我之前都没考虑过。

transcript_json.text: I'm starting to realize that painting my house is far more troublesome than I had anticipated.
transcript_json.translation: 我开始意识到，刷房子比我预想的麻烦多了。

transcript_json.text: This is usually the case.
transcript_json.translation: 通常都是这样的。

transcript_json.text: Most of our clients go through the same realization.
transcript_json.translation: 我们的大多数客户都会经历同样的认识过程。

transcript_json.text: I see.
You have my number.
transcript_json.translation: 我的电话你有。

transcript_json.text: Please feel free to call me for any further questions.
transcript_json.translation: 有任何问题，随时打给我。

transcript_json.text: Thank you.

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Homework is an important part of schooling, but the purposes of giving children homework will change as they grow older.
transcript_json.translation: 家庭作业是学校教育的重要组成部分，但布置作业的目的会随着孩子年龄增长而改变。

transcript_json.text: At the primary level, the main aim is to cultivate good habits.
transcript_json.translation: 在小学阶段，主要目的是培养良好的习惯。

transcript_json.text: Like learning to plan and exercising self-discipline.
transcript_json.translation: 比如学会制定计划和自我约束。

transcript_json.text: During the secondary school years, extending what is learnt at school is positively related to academic achievement, so the content of homework becomes more important.
transcript_json.translation: 在中学阶段，课外拓展所学与学业成绩呈正相关，因此作业的内容变得更加重要。

transcript_json.text: So how can you help your child do their best?
transcript_json.translation: 那么，怎样才能帮助孩子做到最好呢？

transcript_json.text: Creating an ideal working environment will make it easier for them to get down to their assignments quickly.
transcript_json.translation: 营造一个理想的学习环境，能让他们更快地静下心来完成作业。

transcript_json.text: Make sure it's free of distractions, and for primary school children at least, somewhere near you so you can answer questions and offer encouragement.
transcript_json.translation: 确保环境没有干扰，而且至少对小学生来说，位置要离你近一些，这样你就能解答问题并给予鼓励。

transcript_json.text: You'll probably have to help younger children plan their session, but it's important that by the end of primary school, it's second nature.
transcript_json.translation: 你可能需要帮年幼的孩子安排学习时段，但重要的是，到小学毕业时，这应该成为他们的习惯。

transcript_json.text: Get them to tell you everything they have to do, then encourage them to establish an order in which they do work.
transcript_json.translation: 让他们把要做的所有事情都告诉你，然后鼓励他们确定完成作业的顺序。

transcript_json.text: When there's several different assignments, make sure they begin with one they enjoy, so it seems easy to get started.
transcript_json.translation: 当有几项不同的作业时，确保他们从自己喜欢的那项开始，这样上手会显得容易些。

transcript_json.text: It's best to take on the most difficult task second, once they're settled, but before they get tired.
transcript_json.translation: 最好在他们进入状态之后、还没感到疲倦之前，把最难的任务放在第二位做。

transcript_json.text: If older children have more than an hour of homework, encourage them to schedule a short break to stretch.
transcript_json.translation: 如果大一点的孩子作业超过1小时，鼓励他们安排短暂休息，伸展一下身体。

transcript_json.text: If you encourage them to tell you what they've learned, they'll absorb the information more deeply and remember it more readily.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你鼓励他们把学到的东西讲给你听，他们会对信息理解得更透彻，也记得更牢。

transcript_json.text: Passage two: Workers at Mexican Oil Company will receive a health incentive of almost $300 a year if they meet certain body weight standards.
transcript_json.translation: 短文二：墨西哥石油公司的员工如果达到一定的体重标准，每年将获得近300美元的健康奖励。

transcript_json.text: To qualify for the bonus, they must maintain a healthy weight.
transcript_json.translation: 要想获得奖金，他们必须保持健康的体重。

transcript_json.text: For those who are overweight or obese, they can receive the bonus if they reduce their weight by 10 percent during the year.
transcript_json.translation: 对于超重或肥胖的员工，如果在一年内减重10%，也能拿到奖金。

transcript_json.text: Some apply The policy as fair because it rewards both individuals who maintain a healthy weight and those who are working towards achieving it.
transcript_json.translation: 一些人称赞该政策公平，因为它既奖励保持健康体重的人，也奖励正在努力减重的人。

transcript_json.text: But critics say the policy contradicts recommendations by many health experts, who warn that a person's weight is influenced by genetic and environmental factors.
transcript_json.translation: 但批评者认为，该政策与许多健康专家的建议相矛盾，专家警告说，一个人的体重受遗传和环境因素影响。

transcript_json.text: That means weight can be hard for individuals to control, which makes the bonus unfair.
transcript_json.translation: 这意味着体重很难由个人控制，这让奖金变得不公平。

transcript_json.text: Some experts say the policy is inconsistent with the science of what we know about body weight regulation.
transcript_json.translation: 一些专家说，这项政策与我们所了解的体重调节科学不一致。

transcript_json.text: These experts argue that focusing on weight is the wrong approach.
transcript_json.translation: 这些专家认为，把重点放在体重上是错误的做法。

transcript_json.text: A more productive method of encouraging health among employees is to promote healthy behaviors.
transcript_json.translation: 鼓励员工健康更有效的方法是倡导健康的行为习惯。

transcript_json.text: For example, companies can give workers gym memberships or encourage participation in lectures on healthy eating and living.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，公司可以给员工办健身卡，或鼓励他们参加关于健康饮食和生活的讲座。

transcript_json.text: They can also reduce sweets and provide healthier snacks in the office and healthier meals at the company canteen, or they can give employees more time during their lunch break to exercise.
transcript_json.translation: 公司还可以减少糖果，在办公室提供更健康的零食，在公司食堂提供更健康的餐食，或者给员工更多午休时间去锻炼。

transcript_json.text: These are much better and much more productive ways for companies to move forward on their employees' well-being.
transcript_json.translation: 这些是公司在员工福祉方面推进工作更好、更有效的方式。

transcript_json.text: Passage three: Campaigners have warned that the British government is not doing enough to prevent left-handed pupils from falling behind their peers.
transcript_json.translation: 短文三：活动人士警告说，英国政府在防止左撇子学生落后于同龄人方面做得不够。

transcript_json.text: They claim that thousands of children are still being penalised for being left-handed.
transcript_json.translation: 他们称，成千上万的孩子仍因是左撇子而受到不利对待。

transcript_json.text: This is due to a lack of action from ministers who have failed to take any meaningful action for years.
transcript_json.translation: 这是因为部长们多年来没有采取任何有意义的行动。

transcript_json.text: It is feared that a failure to address early year challenges, such as poor handwriting, leads to much more serious problems down the line, with these pupils facing reduced career prospects.
transcript_json.translation: 人们担心，如果不解决早年遇到的困难，比如字写得不好，日后会导致更严重的问题，这些学生的就业前景会受到影响。

transcript_json.text: Studies in recent years show that left-handed children are more likely to suffer with learning difficulties, and their scores are lower on IQ tests.
transcript_json.translation: 近年的研究表明，左撇子孩子更容易出现学习困难，他们在智商测试中的分数也更低。

transcript_json.text: Campaigners feel it's strange that children in British schools are penalised because they happen to be left-handed.
transcript_json.translation: 活动人士觉得奇怪，英国学校的孩子仅仅因为是左撇子就受到不利对待。

transcript_json.text: They don't understand why successive governments have failed to act on this.
transcript_json.translation: 他们不明白为什么历届政府都不对此采取行动。

transcript_json.text: They want the Department of Education to record which children are left-handed and what their educational attainments are, since they make up some 10% of the population.
transcript_json.translation: 他们希望教育部记录哪些孩子是左撇子以及他们的学业成绩如何，因为左撇子约占人口的10%。

transcript_json.text: In early year education, left-handed children are struggling and making a mess of their handwriting.
transcript_json.translation: 在幼儿教育阶段，左撇子孩子很吃力，字写得一团糟。

transcript_json.text: Educators don't know how to deal with this.
transcript_json.translation: 教育工作者不知道该如何应对这种情况。

transcript_json.text: In many cases, there's no active help and a lack of teacher training.
transcript_json.translation: 很多时候既没有切实的帮助，也缺乏教师培训。

transcript_json.text: Campaigners point out that a high percentage of the prison population is left-handed.
transcript_json.translation: 一些活动人士指出，监狱服刑人员中左撇子的比例很高。

transcript_json.text: They say that these prison numbers are unusually high and Ask why it is the case.
transcript_json.translation: 他们说这些监狱中的数字高得异常，并质疑为什么会这样。

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
A 22-year-old Chinese woman who suffered from a persistent cough was shocked to learn that she had a piece of chicken bone lodged in her lung.
transcript_json.translation: 一名22岁的中国女子长期咳嗽，她震惊地得知自己肺里卡着一块鸡骨头。

transcript_json.text: The unnamed woman from the province of Shandong started to have coughing problems when she was seven or eight years old.
transcript_json.translation: 这名来自山东省的女子（未透露姓名）在七八岁时开始出现咳嗽问题。

transcript_json.text: For 14 years, she made numerous hospital visits.
transcript_json.translation: 14年来，她多次去医院就诊。

transcript_json.text: However, no doctor could identify any problem.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，没有医生能查出任何问题。

transcript_json.text: Her uncontrollable coughing was a mystery.
transcript_json.translation: 她那止不住的咳嗽一直是个谜。

transcript_json.text: Finally, the woman got a full-body scan at a hospital in the city of Qingdao.
transcript_json.translation: 最后，这名女子在青岛市的一家医院做了全身扫描。

transcript_json.text: This special medical procedure revealed she had a chicken bone stuck in her lung.
transcript_json.translation: 这一特殊的医疗检查发现她肺里卡了一根鸡骨头。

transcript_json.text: Doctors performed surgery and removed the bone.
transcript_json.translation: 医生给她做了手术，取出了骨头。

transcript_json.text: The simple procedure went smoothly, and the woman has recovered fully.
transcript_json.translation: 手术很简单，进行得很顺利，女子已经完全康复。

transcript_json.text: With the bone finally removed from her lung, the woman is very happy that she no longer suffers from that annoying cough.
transcript_json.translation: 骨头终于从肺里取出来了，女子非常高兴，再也不用受那烦人的咳嗽折磨了。

transcript_json.text: News report two: A white sheep named Prickles that ran away from an Australian farm during the 2013 bushfires recently returned home.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道2：一只名叫"小刺"的白羊在2013年山火期间从澳大利亚的一个农场跑掉，最近回了家。

transcript_json.text: According to farmer Alice Gray, Prickles was only a lamb when she ran away.
transcript_json.translation: 农场主爱丽丝·格雷说，"小刺"跑掉的时候还只是一只小羊羔。

transcript_json.text: The bushfires that hit the area back then destroyed a large part of her family's massive property.
transcript_json.translation: 当时袭击该地区的山火摧毁了她家大片的农场。

transcript_json.text: They thought Prickles had died in the fire, but instead, the young sheep escaped into a 200-acre forest near the farm.
transcript_json.translation: 他们以为"小刺"死在了火里，但这只小羊却逃进了农场附近一片200英亩的森林。

transcript_json.text: Once the fires were over, the family had to fix the damage done to the farm.
transcript_json.translation: 火灾过后，一家人不得不修复农场的损失。

transcript_json.text: As it was such a large property, this included rebuilding about fifty kilometres of fencing.
transcript_json.translation: 由于农场很大，这包括重建大约50公里的围栏。

transcript_json.text: It was this huge fencing that prevented Prickles from finding her way back.
transcript_json.translation: 正是这长长的围栏挡住了"小刺"回家的路。

transcript_json.text: Over the years, the family spotted her a few times.
transcript_json.translation: 这些年里，一家人曾几次看到她。

transcript_json.text: They even recorded her with cameras installed to monitor deer activity.
transcript_json.translation: 他们甚至用安装来监测鹿群活动的摄像头拍到过她。

transcript_json.text: But while they knew Prickles was alive, they couldn't find her, and never expected her to return by herself.
transcript_json.translation: 但虽然知道"小刺"还活着，他们却找不到她，也从没想过她会自己回来。

transcript_json.text: Seven years later, they were proven wrong.
transcript_json.translation: 7年后，事实证明他们错了。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
A new study carried out by the University of Lincoln has found a link between the personalities of cat owners and the behaviour and well-being of their cats.
transcript_json.translation: 林肯大学的一项新研究发现，猫主人的性格与猫咪的行为和健康状况之间存在关联。

transcript_json.text: The findings suggest that just as a parent's personality can affect the personality of a child, the same is true for a cat and its owner.
transcript_json.translation: 研究结果表明，正如父母的性格会影响孩子的性格一样，猫咪和主人之间也是如此。

transcript_json.text: Owners defined as individuals with high levels of anxiety, fear, anger, depression, and loneliness were more likely to have cats with behavioural issues.
transcript_json.translation: 被归为高度焦虑、恐惧、愤怒、抑郁和孤独的主人，养的猫更可能出现行为问题。

transcript_json.text: Such cats displayed more aggressive and anxious behavioral styles, as well as more stress-related sickness.
transcript_json.translation: 这类猫咪表现出更具攻击性和焦虑的行为方式，也更容易患上与压力有关的疾病。

transcript_json.text: They were also more likely to have an ongoing medical condition and be overweight.
transcript_json.translation: 他们也更有可能患有长期的健康问题并且体重超标。

transcript_json.text: The research also found that mentally well-adjusted owners had calmer, happier, and healthier cats.
transcript_json.translation: 研究还发现，心理状态良好的主人，养的猫更平静、更快乐、也更健康。

transcript_json.text: The researchers explained that many owners regard their pets as a family member and form close social bonds with them.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员解释说，许多主人把宠物视为家庭成员，并与它们建立了亲密的社会纽带。

transcript_json.text: The majority of owners want to provide the best care for their pets, and it is therefore possible that pets could be affected by the way their owners interact with and manage them.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数主人都想给宠物最好的照顾，因此宠物可能会受到主人与它们互动和管理方式的影响。

transcript_json.text: The study highlights an important relationship between our personalities and the well-being of our pets.
transcript_json.translation: 这项研究揭示了我们的性格与宠物健康之间的重要关系。

transcript_json.text: Further research is needed to investigate the causal nature of this relationship and to look at how owners' personalities are directly influenced.
transcript_json.translation: 还需要进一步研究来探究这种关系的因果性质，并了解主人的性格是如何受到影响的。

transcript_json.text: Their pet's behavior and well-being.
transcript_json.translation: 宠物的行为和健康。

transcript_json.text: It is possible that the well-being of pets is driven by the underlying nature of the owner, not simply by their conscious decisions and behaviors.
transcript_json.translation: 宠物的健康可能是由主人内在的本性所驱动的，而不仅仅是他们有意识的决定和行为。

transcript_json.text: Passage two: One 60-minute run can add seven hours to your life.
transcript_json.translation: 短文二：跑一次60分钟能为你的生命增加7个小时。

transcript_json.text: This was a claim made by The Times last week.
transcript_json.translation: 这是《泰晤士报》上周提出的一个说法。

transcript_json.text: The claim was based on a new review of studies about the effects of running.
transcript_json.translation: 这一说法是基于最近一项关于跑步效果的研究综述。

transcript_json.text: The review concluded that on average, runners live three years longer than non-runners, and that running does more to extend life than any other form of exercise.
transcript_json.translation: 该综述得出结论：跑步者平均比不跑步的人多活3年，而且跑步对延长寿命的作用超过任何其他形式的运动。

transcript_json.text: But there's more to running than its health benefits.
transcript_json.translation: 但跑步的好处远不止健康方面。

transcript_json.text: Research published in recent years has shown known that running changes your brain and mind in some fascinating ways, from increasing your brain function to regulating your emotions.
transcript_json.translation: 近年来发表的研究表明，跑步会以一些令人着迷的方式改变你的大脑和心理，从增强大脑功能到调节情绪。

transcript_json.text: However, the precise effects vary according to whether you engage in short, fast running or long-distance running.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，具体效果因你进行的是短程快跑还是长跑而有所不同。

transcript_json.text: For example, in one study, researchers compared participants' ability to learn new words after several minutes of intense running and after 40 minutes of gentle running.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，在一项研究中，研究人员比较了参与者在几分钟的高强度跑步后和40分钟的轻松慢跑后学习新单词的能力。

transcript_json.text: Participants were able to learn 20% faster after the intense running, and they showed a superior memory when tested again a week later.
transcript_json.translation: 参与者在剧烈跑步后学习速度提高了20%，一周后再次测试时，他们的记忆力也表现更出色。

transcript_json.text: In another study, researchers asked volunteers to jog for 30 minutes and then showed them clips from a sad movie.
transcript_json.translation: 在另一项研究中，研究人员让志愿者慢跑30分钟，然后给他们看一部悲伤电影的片段。

transcript_json.text: Participants who usually struggled to handle negative emotions were more intensely affected by the sad clips, just as you expect.
transcript_json.translation: 那些平时不太会处理负面情绪的参与者，受到悲伤片段的影响更强烈，这和你预料的一样。

transcript_json.text: But crucially, this was less so if they had completed the 30-minute jog.
transcript_json.translation: 但关键是，如果他们完成了30分钟的慢跑，这种影响就会减弱。

transcript_json.text: The researchers said moderate exercise appears to have helped those participants to be less vulnerable to the impact of the sad movie.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员说，适度运动似乎帮助这些参与者减少了悲伤电影对他们的影响。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
Welcome to the tour of the Hill House.
transcript_json.translation: 欢迎来到希尔之家参观。

transcript_json.text: This house, built in 1904, is one of the most well-known works of Charles Hill, the famous architect.
transcript_json.translation: 这座房子建于1904年，是著名建筑师查尔斯·希尔最知名的作品之一。

transcript_json.text: It was designed and built for a local entrepreneur and his family.
transcript_json.translation: 它是为一位当地企业家及其家人设计和建造的。

transcript_json.text: Before starting the tour, let me give you a brief introduction about the design of this amazing building.
transcript_json.translation: 在开始参观之前，让我先简单介绍一下这座神奇建筑的设计。

transcript_json.text: Prior to beginning his design, the architect spent some time in the client's old home, observing their life and studying their habits.
transcript_json.translation: 在开始设计之前，建筑师在客户的旧居里待了一段时间，观察他们的生活，研究他们的习惯。

transcript_json.text: This meant that he could design the house according to the needs of the family.
transcript_json.translation: 这样他就能根据这家人的需求来设计房子。

transcript_json.text: The client's main desire was to have a home with a unique design, so the architect was given complete freedom.
transcript_json.translation: 客户最主要的愿望是拥有一座设计独特的房子，所以建筑师被赋予了完全的自由。

transcript_json.text: The building style is radically different from what was the fashion of the period.
transcript_json.translation: 这座建筑的风格与当时的流行风格截然不同。

transcript_json.text: At the time, most large homes were constructed of timber and brick.
transcript_json.translation: 当时，大多数大型住宅都是用木材和砖建造的。

transcript_json.text: This one, however, is made of concrete, a novel construction material in those days.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，这座房子是用混凝土建造的，这在当时是一种新颖的建筑材料。

transcript_json.text: The interior of the house, including fittings and furniture, was also designed by the same person.
transcript_json.translation: 房子的内部，包括配件和家具，也是由同一个人设计的。

transcript_json.text: Most of the furniture you will see is original and in good condition.
transcript_json.translation: 你看到的大多数家具都是原物，而且保存完好。

transcript_json.text: However, those pieces in the children's bedrooms are copies built to the designs of the architect.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，儿童卧室里的那些家具是按照建筑师的设计复制的。

transcript_json.text: Fortunately, all the blueprints for both the building and its contents have been preserved, so we've been able to replace badly damaged damage furniture.
transcript_json.translation: 幸运的是，建筑本身及其内部物品的所有图纸都保存了下来，所以我们能够替换严重受损的家具。

transcript_json.text: Let's begin our tour, starting from the rooms.
transcript_json.translation: 我们这就开始参观，先从房间看起。

transcript_json.text: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第22至25题基于你刚才听到的短文。

transcript_json.text: Question 22: What do we learn about the speaker?
transcript_json.translation: 第22题：关于说话人，我们了解到什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 23: What did the architect do before beginning his design?
transcript_json.translation: 第23题：建筑师在开始设计之前做了什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 24: What did the architect's client mainly want?
transcript_json.translation: 第24题：建筑师的客户主要想要什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 25.
What do we learn about the pieces of furniture in the children's bedrooms?
transcript_json.translation: 关于儿童卧室里的家具，我们了解到什么？

transcript_json.translation: 听力理解到此结束。

transcript_json.text: College English Test, Band 4, Part 2, Listening Comprehension.

transcript_json.text: Section A.
Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports.
transcript_json.translation: 说明：在本节中，你将听到3篇新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: At the end of each news report, you will hear two or three questions.
transcript_json.translation: 每篇新闻报道结束后，你将听到2到3个问题。

transcript_json.text: Both the news report and the questions will be spoken only once.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道和问题都只朗读一遍。

transcript_json.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C, and D.
transcript_json.translation: 听到问题后，请从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳答案。

transcript_json.text: Then mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet 1 with a single line through the center.
transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上对应字母中间划一条横线。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1: A new study finds that beverages containing added sugar might be harmful.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道1：一项新研究发现，含添加糖的饮料可能有害健康。

transcript_json.text: In the study, researchers analyzed information from over 80,000 women and 37,000 men.
transcript_json.translation: 在这项研究中，研究人员分析了8万多名女性和3.7万名男性的信息。

transcript_json.text: Participants worked in the health profession.
transcript_json.translation: 参与者都从事医疗健康行业。

transcript_json.text: They were followed for approximately three Decades.
transcript_json.translation: 他们被跟踪随访了大约30年。

transcript_json.text: They completed surveys about their diet every four years.
transcript_json.translation: 他们每4年完成一次关于饮食的调查。

transcript_json.text: They also answered questions about sleep and exercise and health every two years.
transcript_json.translation: 他们还每2年回答一次有关睡眠、运动和健康的问题。

transcript_json.text: The more beverages containing added sugar that people drank, the greater their risk of death was during the study period.
transcript_json.translation: 研究期间，人们喝的含添加糖的饮料越多，死亡风险就越大。

transcript_json.text: These beverages included soda, energy drinks, and sports drinks.
transcript_json.translation: 这些饮料包括汽水、能量饮料和运动饮料。

transcript_json.text: Beverages like pure fruit juice, which are sweet but do not contain added sugar, were not part of the study.
transcript_json.translation: 像纯果汁这类甜但不含添加糖的饮料不在研究范围内。

transcript_json.text: The findings held even after the researchers considered other factors that could affect people's health.
transcript_json.translation: 在研究人员考虑了其他可能影响健康的因素后，这些结论依然成立。

transcript_json.text: These factors included lack of exercise and not eating enough vegetables.
transcript_json.translation: 这些因素包括缺乏运动和蔬菜摄入不足。

transcript_json.text: They also included consuming too much meat.
transcript_json.translation: 还包括吃肉过多。

transcript_json.text: The scientists say that their results support limiting beverages with added sugar.
transcript_json.translation: 科学家表示，研究结果支持限制含添加糖的饮料。

transcript_json.text: They argue we should replace them with other drinks.
transcript_json.translation: 他们主张用其他饮品来替代。

transcript_json.text: With water being the best choice.
transcript_json.translation: 其中水是最佳选择。

transcript_json.text: However, the researchers admit this is simply their recommendation.
transcript_json.translation: 不过研究人员也承认，这仅仅是他们的建议。

transcript_json.text: The study found only an association.
transcript_json.translation: 该研究只发现了关联性。

transcript_json.text: It did not prove that drinks with added sugar cause early death.
transcript_json.translation: 并未证明含添加糖的饮料会导致早死。

transcript_json.text: News report two.
German police appealed Friday for information about the possible owners of two 17th-century oil paintings.
transcript_json.translation: 德国警方周五公开征集线索，寻找两幅17世纪油画可能的失主。

transcript_json.text: Police said a 64-year-old man found the paintings in a garbage pile at a highway rest stop last month.
transcript_json.translation: 警方称，一名64岁的男子上月在一个高速公路服务区的垃圾堆里发现了这些画。

transcript_json.text: He later handed them in to the Cologne police.
transcript_json.translation: 之后他把画交给了科隆警方。

transcript_json.text: An initial assessment by an art expert concluded the two framed paintings were originals, police said.
transcript_json.translation: 警方称，一名艺术专家的初步评估认为这两幅装裱画作是真品。

transcript_json.text: One is a landscape painted by the Italian artist Pietro Bellotti, dating to 1665.
transcript_json.translation: 其中一幅是意大利画家彼得罗·贝洛蒂创作的风景画，作于1665年。

transcript_json.text: The other is a painting of a boy by the 17th-century Dutch artist Samuel van Hoogstraten, date unknown.
transcript_json.translation: 另一幅是17世纪荷兰画家塞缪尔·范·霍赫斯特拉滕画的一个男孩，创作年代不详。

transcript_json.text: Their combined worth is estimated to be around one million euros.
transcript_json.translation: 这两幅画的总价值估计约为100万欧元。

transcript_json.text: Authorities have not yet confirmed what will happen if the rightful owner is not found.
transcript_json.translation: 当局尚未确认如果找不到合法所有者会如何处理。

transcript_json.text: Nevertheless, it is speculated that they could either be handed over over to the National Art Museum of Cologne or sold to the public by the local government.
transcript_json.translation: 不过据推测，它们可能会被移交给科隆国家艺术博物馆，或由地方政府向公众出售。

transcript_json.text: Questions three and four are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第3题和第4题基于你刚才听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.translation: 第3题：德国警方对一名64岁男子说了什么？

transcript_json.text: Question four: What is the art expert's conclusion about the two framed paintings?
transcript_json.translation: 第4题：艺术专家对这两幅装裱画作得出什么结论？

transcript_json.text: News report three.
A four-year-old girl has walked eight kilometers through a snow snowy forest to seek help for her sick grandmother, who later died of a heart attack.
transcript_json.translation: 一名4岁女孩在雪地森林中步行8公里，为生病的祖母求助，但祖母后来因心脏病发作去世。

transcript_json.text: The young girl braved the threat of bears, wolves, and temperatures far below freezing.
transcript_json.translation: 小女孩冒着熊、狼的威胁，以及远低于冰点的严寒。

transcript_json.text: She made the journey through a remote region in Siberia after waking up to find her grandmother motionless.
transcript_json.translation: 她穿过西伯利亚一个偏远地区，因为醒来后发现祖母一动不动。

transcript_json.text: Named locally as Carla, she lives alone with her elderly grandmother and her blind grandfather.
transcript_json.translation: 她在当地叫卡拉，与年迈的祖母和失明的祖父一起生活。

transcript_json.text: As a result, the girl's mother is facing a criminal case.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，女孩的母亲面临刑事诉讼。

transcript_json.text: She stands accused of leaving a minor in danger in the care of the elderly.
transcript_json.translation: 她被指控将未成年人置于危险之中，并交由老人照料。

transcript_json.text: She also faces investigation from childcare services, who will also be asking why Carla was left alone with her vulnerable relatives.
transcript_json.translation: 她还将接受儿童福利部门的调查，该部门也会追问为什么把卡拉单独留给这些体弱的亲属。

transcript_json.text: The journey took place in February, when temperatures average negative 26 degrees Celsius.
transcript_json.translation: 这趟行程发生在2月，当时平均气温为零下26摄氏度。

transcript_json.text: Russian reports on social media suggest the The forest may have been as cold as -34°C.
transcript_json.translation: 俄罗斯社交媒体上的报道称，森林里的温度可能低至零下34摄氏度。

transcript_json.text: The journey was only recently confirmed by authorities.
transcript_json.translation: 这件事直到最近才得到当局证实。

transcript_json.text: Passage 1.
The Golden Rule is a moral principle which states that you should treat others the way you want to be treated yourself.
transcript_json.translation: 黄金法则是一条道德原则，即你要像希望自己被对待的那样去对待别人。

transcript_json.text: For example, if you want people to treat you with respect, you should treat them with respect.
transcript_json.translation: 比如，如果你希望别人尊重你，你就应该尊重别人。

transcript_json.text: Different people tend to be exposed to different forms of the golden rule, based on factors such as the religion in their society.
transcript_json.translation: 由于社会宗教等因素的不同，人们接触到的黄金法则形式也各不相同。

transcript_json.text: However, all forms of the golden rule revolve around the same concept, namely they help you treat others better by using the way you yourself would want to be treated as a guide of how to behave.
transcript_json.translation: 但所有形式的黄金法则都围绕同一个理念：以自己希望被对待的方式为准则，更好地对待他人。

transcript_json.text: A notable criticism of the golden rule is that its application can lead to undesirable outcomes when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles.
transcript_json.translation: 对黄金法则一个著名的批评是：当它与法律和道德原则冲突时，应用它可能导致不良后果。

transcript_json.text: For example, if someone breaks the law, the golden rule would suggest that we should let them go, because we would not want to be punished ourselves.
transcript_json.translation: 比如，如果有人犯了法，黄金法则会暗示我们应该放了他，因为我们自己也不愿受罚。

transcript_json.text: However, this issue with the golden rule can be dealt with in a general manner by viewing this principle as one of several.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，这个问题可以通过把这条原则看作众多原则之一来妥善解决。

transcript_json.text: Principles that we use to guide our behavior as individuals and as a society.
transcript_json.translation: 这些原则是我们作为个人和社会用来指导行为的。

transcript_json.text: Specifically, in the example described above, most individuals and societies choose to place laws and ethical principles above the golden rule.
transcript_json.translation: 具体到上面的例子，大多数人和社会都选择把法律和道德原则置于黄金法则之上。

transcript_json.text: This means that they strive to implement the golden rule whenever possible, as long as it doesn't clash with a more important concept.
transcript_json.translation: 也就是说，只要不与更重要的理念冲突，他们就尽量奉行黄金法则。

transcript_json.text: Passage two: Today, many large corporations stress the importance of diversity on their websites, but current statistics show that the typical manager in America still tends to be white and male.
transcript_json.translation: 短文二：如今，许多大公司在网站上强调多元化的重要性，但最新统计显示，美国典型的管理者仍以白人男性为主。

transcript_json.text: Obviously, the desire to bring about diversity has not translated Into corporate reality.
transcript_json.translation: 显然，推动多元化的意愿并没有变成企业的现实。

transcript_json.text: Why is this?
transcript_json.translation: 为什么会这样？

transcript_json.text: A team of researchers from the University of Basel published their new study about people's attitudes towards diversity at work.
transcript_json.translation: 巴塞尔大学的一个研究团队发表了他们关于人们职场多元化态度的新研究。

transcript_json.text: They found that people have a wide range of opinions concerning diversity.
transcript_json.translation: 他们发现，人们对多元化的看法差异很大。

transcript_json.text: On the one hand, many see value in diversity, which can contribute a variety of perspectives, encourage new ideas, and generate innovative solutions.
transcript_json.translation: 一方面，很多人看到了多元化的价值，它能带来各种视角，激发新想法，产生创新的解决方案。

transcript_json.text: On the other hand, they assume that it might be difficult to work with someone who has completely different views, speaks a different language, or has a different style of work.
transcript_json.translation: 另一方面，他们又觉得，要跟一个观点完全不同、说不同语言或工作风格不一样的人合作，可能挺难的。

transcript_json.text: The actual value they attribute to diversity depends on the decision-making perspective.
transcript_json.translation: 他们对多元化实际价值的判断，取决于做决策的角度。

transcript_json.text: Doubts about the practicability of diversity have a greater weight if a person is directly affected.
transcript_json.translation: 如果一个人自身受到影响，对多元化可行性的怀疑就会占更大分量。

transcript_json.text: In other words, when a person's own work group is involved, they tend to prefer team members who are similar to themselves.
transcript_json.translation: 换句话说，当涉及自己所在的团队时，他们更倾向于选择跟自己相似的队友。

transcript_json.text: But when people make decisions for others, they typically put together a more diverse team.
transcript_json.translation: 但当他们替别人做决定时，通常会组建一支更多元化的团队。

transcript_json.text: These findings could help organizations become more diverse.
transcript_json.translation: 这些发现有助于让组织变得更加多元化。

transcript_json.text: Companies need to pay attention to who makes hiring and team decisions.
transcript_json.translation: 公司需要注意是谁在做招聘和团队组建的决定。

transcript_json.text: These decisions should not only be made by those directly affected.
transcript_json.translation: 这些决定不应只由直接受影响的人来做。

transcript_json.text: People who are not directly involved in the group's daily work should also take part.
transcript_json.translation: 不直接参与团队日常工作的人也应该参与进来。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
Communication can essentially be divided into two categories.
transcript_json.translation: 交流基本上可以分成两类。

transcript_json.text: The written and the spoken.
transcript_json.translation: 书面的和口头的。

transcript_json.text: How the balance is struck between these two forms of communication, the point at which one needs to be exchanged for another, really depends on individual cultures.
transcript_json.translation: 这两种交流形式之间如何取得平衡、什么时候需要用一种来换掉另一种，其实取决于不同的文化。

transcript_json.text: Understanding when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another can be a major key to success in international business.
transcript_json.translation: 懂得什么时候该把一种形式换成另一种形式，是国际商务成功的一大关键。

transcript_json.text: Many cultures place a much greater value on the spoken word than the American working culture does.
transcript_json.translation: 许多文化对口头言语的重视程度远高于美国职场文化。

transcript_json.text: In parts of the Middle East, you'll find spoken word agreements are seen as seriously binding.
transcript_json.translation: 在中东一些地区，口头达成的协议被认为具有很强的约束力。

transcript_json.text: A person's word is linked to their honor, so verbal agreements are seen as important, whereas written contracts are taken as memos of understanding.
transcript_json.translation: 一个人的话与他的荣誉息息相关，所以口头协议很重要，而书面合同只被看作是谅解备忘录。

transcript_json.text: Western working culture tends to place a high High value on the written word, and this reaches its highest level of intensity when it comes to contracts.
transcript_json.translation: 西方职场文化往往高度重视书面文字，而在合同问题上，这种重视达到最高程度。

transcript_json.text: In the US, France, and Germany, written contracts tend to be seen as something that must be strictly carried out.
transcript_json.translation: 在美国、法国和德国，书面合同往往被视为必须严格执行的东西。

transcript_json.text: By contrast, other cultures may not see written contracts as quite so binding.
transcript_json.translation: 相比之下，其他文化可能并不认为书面合同有那么强的约束力。

transcript_json.text: It can prove a challenge to Western businesses if your business partner wants to renegotiate terms that you thought were already agreed on.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你的商业伙伴想重新谈判你以为早已谈妥的条款，这对西方企业来说可能是个难题。

transcript_json.text: For example, a Japanese firm may have signed a contract, but they may not feel bound by every detail of it, particularly if circumstances later change.
transcript_json.translation: 比如说，一家日本公司可能签了合同，但它未必受合同中每个细节的约束，尤其是后来情况发生变化时。

transcript_json.text: Such differences in value that different working cultures place on the written word tend to cause many problems when it comes to business.
transcript_json.translation: 不同职场文化对书面文字重视程度的这种差异，在商务往来中往往会引发很多问题。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1: White meat, such as chicken, may raise blood cholesterol levels as much as red meat does.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道1：鸡肉等白肉可能会使血液胆固醇水平升高，和红肉一样多。

transcript_json.text: This finding surprised researchers, who admitted they didn't expect that eating white meat would lead to higher blood cholesterol levels.
transcript_json.translation: 这一发现令研究人员感到意外，他们承认没想到吃白肉也会导致血液胆固醇升高。

transcript_json.text: In the study, researchers looked at 113 healthy people.
transcript_json.translation: 在这项研究中，研究人员观察了113名健康人。

transcript_json.text: Participants ate three different diets.
transcript_json.translation: 参与者吃了三种不同的饮食。

transcript_json.text: These were a red meat diet, which is primarily beef, a white meat diet, which is mostly chicken and turkey, and a vegetarian protein diet.
transcript_json.translation: 分别是红肉饮食（主要是牛肉）、白肉饮食（主要是鸡肉和火鸡肉），以及素食蛋白质饮食。

transcript_json.text: Each diet period was four weeks.
transcript_json.translation: 每种饮食周期为4周。

transcript_json.text: Between the diet periods, participants had a break, during which they ate their regular foods.
transcript_json.translation: 两个饮食周期之间，参与者有一段休息期，期间吃他们平时的食物。

transcript_json.text: In addition, participants had blood tests at the start and finish of each new diet.
transcript_json.translation: 此外，每种新饮食开始和结束时，参与者都要验血。

transcript_json.text: The results showed that white and red meat diets had the same effects on blood cholesterol levels.
transcript_json.translation: 结果显示，白肉和红肉饮食对血液胆固醇水平的影响相同。

transcript_json.text: Further, both diets increased blood cholesterol levels compared with the diet built on vegetarian protein sources.
transcript_json.translation: 而且，与以素食蛋白为主的饮食相比，这两种饮食都使血液胆固醇升高。

transcript_json.text: The team acknowledged that it is possible that white meat is better for our health than red meat, despite their findings.
transcript_json.translation: 研究团队承认，尽管有这些发现，白肉仍可能比红肉更有利于健康。

transcript_json.text: This is because other effects of red meat consumption could contribute to heart disease, independent of cholesterol.
transcript_json.translation: 这是因为红肉消费的其他影响可能会导致心脏病，而不只是胆固醇的问题。

transcript_json.text: Their main Recommendations are that people eat less of both kinds of meat and more vegetarian protein.
transcript_json.translation: 他们的主要建议是，两种肉都少吃，多吃素食蛋白。

transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道3：印度于周一推出了直升机出租车服务，承诺在15分钟内把乘客从班加罗尔电子城科技园区运送到40英里外的国际机场航站楼。

For a barbecue, you could have any cheese you want.

It will be very casual.

transcript_json.text: We will just be a small group of friends gathering together at Washington Park.

transcript_json.text: There will be around twenty of us, including children.

So you could have different types of cheese.

transcript_json.text: I would suggest having at least one soft cheese and one hard cheese.

transcript_json.text: That sounds good.

transcript_json.translation: 但一般来说，软奶酪口感细腻，配蜂蜜、果酱这类甜的东西很好吃。

transcript_json.text: I would suggest something like this Spanish goat cheese.

transcript_json.text: It's only fifteen dollars, a very good price.

Children love it.

What about a hard cheese?

Our school is replacing printed textbooks with e-textbooks next semester.

transcript_json.text: The health impacts from making one electronic reader are 70 times greater than those from making a single printed book.

transcript_json.text: A lot of minerals are extracted from the earth to make electronic readers.
transcript_json.translation: 制造电子阅读器要从地下开采大量矿物。

transcript_json.text: It does far more damage to the environment.
transcript_json.translation: 这对环境的破坏大得多。

transcript_json.text: Yes, but the software for electronic readers can be updated instantly, without the need for buying a whole lot of new books.
transcript_json.translation: 话是这么说，但电子阅读器的软件可以随时更新，不用买一大堆新书。

transcript_json.text: Passage one: In social psychology, the term person perception refers to the mental processes that we use to form impressions of other people.
transcript_json.translation: 材料一：在社会心理学中，"人际知觉"指的是我们用来形成对他人印象的心理过程。

transcript_json.text: It includes not just how we form these impressions, but the conclusions we make about other people based on our impressions.
transcript_json.translation: 它不仅包括我们如何形成这些印象，还包括我们基于这些印象对他人得出的结论。

transcript_json.text: Consider how often you make this kind of judgment every day.
transcript_json.translation: 想想你每天做出这类判断的频率有多高。

transcript_json.text: When you meet with a new coworker, you Immediately begin to develop an initial impression of this person.
transcript_json.translation: 当你见到一位新同事时，你马上就会对这个人形成一个初步印象。

transcript_json.text: When you visit the grocery store, you might draw conclusions about the cashier who checks you out.
transcript_json.translation: 当你去杂货店时，你可能会对给你结账的收银员得出某种结论。

transcript_json.text: Obviously, person perception is a very subjective process that can be affected by a number of variables, including the characteristics of the person you are observing, the context of the situation, your own personal traits, and your past experiences.
transcript_json.translation: 显然，人际知觉是一个非常主观的过程，会受到许多变量的影响，包括你所观察的人的特征、情境的背景、你自己的个人特质以及你过去的经历。

transcript_json.text: One of the techniques we use in person perception is social categorization.
transcript_json.translation: 我们在人际知觉中使用的一种技巧是社会分类。

transcript_json.text: In this process, we mentally categorize people into different groups based on common characteristics.
transcript_json.translation: 在这个过程中，我们根据共同特征在心里把人归入不同的群体。

transcript_json.text: Problems with this technique include the fact that it can lead to errors and prejudice.
transcript_json.translation: 这种技巧的问题在于，它会导致错误和偏见。

transcript_json.text: Imagine that you are getting on a bus.
transcript_json.translation: 想象一下你正在上公交车。

transcript_json.text: There are only two seats available.
transcript_json.translation: 只剩下两个座位。

transcript_json.text: One is next to a small, elderly woman.
transcript_json.translation: 一个旁边是一位身材瘦小的老太太。

transcript_json.text: The other is next to a muscular, fierce-looking man.
transcript_json.translation: 另一个旁边是一位肌肉发达、长相凶悍的男子。

transcript_json.text: You sit next to the elderly woman who, unfortunately, turns out to be quite skilled at picking pockets.
transcript_json.translation: 你坐在老太太旁边，结果不幸的是，她是个相当老练的扒手。

transcript_json.text: Because of social categorization, you immediately judge the woman as harmless and the man as threatening, leading to the loss of your wallet.
transcript_json.translation: 由于社会分类，你立刻判断老太太无害、那个男子有威胁，结果钱包被偷了。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Despite smartphones and social media, young people today are as socially competent as those from the previous generation.
transcript_json.translation: 尽管有了智能手机和社交媒体，如今的年轻人在社交能力上和上一代人一样出色。

transcript_json.text: At least, this is what a new study suggests.
transcript_json.translation: 至少，一项新研究是这么说的。

transcript_json.text: For the study, researchers compared teacher and parent evaluations of American children who started kindergarten in 1998 with those who began school in 2010.
transcript_json.translation: 在这项研究中，研究人员比较了老师和家长对1998年上幼儿园和2010年入学的美国孩子的评价。

transcript_json.text: The former group entered kindergarten when mobile phones were luxuries.
transcript_json.translation: 前一组孩子上幼儿园时，手机还是奢侈品。

transcript_json.text: The latter group started school when mobile devices Devices were widespread.
transcript_json.translation: 后一组孩子上学时，移动设备已经很普及了。

transcript_json.text: Results showed both groups of children were rated similarly on important social skills.
transcript_json.translation: 结果显示，两组孩子在重要的社交技能方面得分相近。

transcript_json.text: These included the ability to form and maintain friendships and get along with people who were different.
transcript_json.translation: 这些技能包括建立和维持友谊，以及与不同的人和睦相处。

transcript_json.text: They were also rated similarly on self-control, such as the ability to regulate their temper.
transcript_json.translation: 在自我控制方面，比如控制脾气的能力，两组的评分也相似。

transcript_json.text: In virtually every comparison made, ratings of social skills either remained constant or improved for the children born later.
transcript_json.translation: 几乎在每一项对比中，后来出生的孩子的社交技能评分要么保持不变，要么有所提高。

transcript_json.text: There was one exception: social skills were slightly lower for children who accessed online games and social networking sites many times a day.
transcript_json.translation: 只有一个例外：每天多次玩网络游戏和上社交网站的孩子，社交技能略低一些。

transcript_json.text: Adults are worried when technological change starts to undermine traditional relationships, particularly the parent-child relationship.
transcript_json.translation: 当技术变革开始损害传统关系，尤其是亲子关系时，成年人就会感到担忧。

transcript_json.text: The introduction of telephones, automobiles, and radio all led to moral panic among adults of the time because The technology allowed children to enjoy more freedom.
transcript_json.translation: 电话、汽车和收音机的出现都引发了当时成年人的道德恐慌，因为这些技术让孩子们享有更多自由。

transcript_json.text: Fears over screen-based technology represent the most recent panic in response to technological change.
transcript_json.translation: 对屏幕技术的担忧，是对技术变革反应中最近一次的恐慌。

transcript_json.text: But overall, the study found little evidence that time spent on screens was hurting social skills for most children.
transcript_json.translation: 但总体而言，研究发现几乎没有证据表明，对大多数孩子来说，看屏幕的时间会损害社交技能。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
It's easy to spend all day searching for inspiration.
transcript_json.translation: 我们很容易整天都在寻找灵感。

transcript_json.text: You can find incredible videos, articles, and news stories about the success of others.
transcript_json.translation: 你能找到关于别人成功的精彩视频、文章和新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: The problem is that consuming the success and ideas of others is passive inspiration.
transcript_json.translation: 问题在于，消费别人的成功和想法只是一种被动的灵感。

transcript_json.text: Every time you read an article or listen to an interview, you're practicing passive inspiration.
transcript_json.translation: 每次你读一篇文章或听一段采访，你都是在练习被动的灵感。

transcript_json.text: You might learn something, but you don't actually have to do anything.
transcript_json.translation: 你可能会学到一些东西，但实际上不需要做任何事。

transcript_json.text: Hearing about other people's success isn't the same as creating your own.
transcript_json.translation: 听别人讲述成功，和创造属于自己的成功是两回事。

transcript_json.text: Instead, it is through the process of active inspiration-the act of creating things, applying new ideas to our goals, and making mistakes-that we discover who we are and what is important to us.
transcript_json.translation: 相反，正是通过主动灵感的过程——创造事物、把新想法应用到目标上、犯错误——我们才发现自己是谁，什么对我们最重要。

transcript_json.text: Furthermore, active inspiration is what results in long-term passion and enthusiasm.
transcript_json.translation: 而且，主动的灵感才能带来长久的热情和激情。

transcript_json.text: Watching someone else's success might leave you feeling excited for a few minutes.
transcript_json.translation: 看着别人的成功，你可能只会兴奋几分钟。

transcript_json.text: However, taking action and applying a new idea to your life will inspire you more than anything someone else could say.
transcript_json.translation: 但是，采取行动、把新想法应用到自己的生活中，比任何人说的话都更能激励你。

transcript_json.text: Learning and listening can help you think about things in a different way, but creating, producing, and experimenting is what drives you forward.
transcript_json.translation: 学习和倾听能帮助你换个角度看问题，但创造、产出和实验才是真正推动你前进的力量。

transcript_json.text: Passive inspiration can give you ideas.
transcript_json.translation: 被动的灵感能给你想法。

transcript_json.text: That active inspiration will give you power.
transcript_json.translation: 而主动的灵感会给你力量。

transcript_json.text: Too often we spend our lives consuming the world around us instead of creating it.
transcript_json.translation: 我们常常把一生都用来消费周围的世界，而不是去创造它。

transcript_json.text: And what matters is the power your actions have to inspire you.
transcript_json.translation: 真正重要的，是你的行动对你自身的激励作用。

transcript_json.text: The best inspiration comes from the application of ideas, not the consumption of them.
transcript_json.translation: 最好的灵感来自对想法的运用，而不是对想法的消费。

transcript_json.text: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第22至25题基于你刚听到的短文。

transcript_json.translation: 第22题：对于消费别人的想法和成功故事所带来的灵感，说话者是怎么说的？

transcript_json.translation: 第23题：关于主动的灵感，我们从短文中了解到什么？

transcript_json.translation: 根据短文，最好的灵感来自哪里？

transcript_json.text: News Report 1.
Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had to be temporarily suspended on Friday after a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams.
transcript_json.translation: 周五，澳大利亚最大的金矿之一因矿坝部分墙体坍塌而被迫暂停作业。

transcript_json.text: The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit the area.
transcript_json.translation: 卡迪亚矿的墙体坍塌发生在该地区遭受两次地震仅几天之后。

transcript_json.text: The dam damage to the dam wall was noticed in the late afternoon on Friday, when workers found a section of the northern dam wall had collapsed into the southern dam.
transcript_json.translation: 周五傍晚，工作人员发现大坝北侧墙体有一段坍塌进南侧坝体，由此察觉到坝墙受损。

transcript_json.text: The dams contain waste products of mining and can contain materials which are harmful to the environment and human health.
transcript_json.translation: 这些矿坝储存采矿废料，其中可能含有危害环境和人体健康的物质。

transcript_json.text: The dams are generally constructed using earth fill and are gradually raised over time.
transcript_json.translation: 矿坝一般用土石填筑而成，并随时间逐渐加高。

transcript_json.text: The company was unable to confirm whether the recent earthquakes had contributed to the dam's wall collapse, but said it was conducting a thorough investigation.
transcript_json.translation: 公司无法确认最近的地震是否导致了坝墙坍塌，但表示正在进行彻底调查。

transcript_json.text: A company spokesperson said that operations at the site had been halted while the investigation is ongoing, and that the break had posed no safety threat to workers.
transcript_json.translation: 公司发言人称，调查进行期间矿区作业已暂停，且此次中断未对工人构成安全威胁。

transcript_json.text: This was the first record of six babies being born at the same time in that region.
transcript_json.translation: 这是该地区首次记录到6个婴儿同时出生。

transcript_json.text: The doctors prepared from early in the morning to help deliver five tiny citizens were in the operating room with five teams of doctors, one for each baby.
transcript_json.translation: 医生们从一大早就开始准备接生5个小家伙，手术室里安排了5组医生，每组负责一个婴儿。

transcript_json.text: The first five babies were delivered successfully, and all baby beds were occupied.
transcript_json.translation: 前5个婴儿顺利出生，婴儿床全都占满了。

transcript_json.text: And then, all of a sudden, it turned out there was another waiting to come out.
transcript_json.translation: 然后，突然之间，发现还有一个正等着出来。

transcript_json.text: The doctors said the babies were in healthy condition, but could not go home immediately.
transcript_json.translation: 医生说宝宝们健康状况良好，但不能马上回家。

transcript_json.text: They needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months for medical supervision.
transcript_json.translation: 他们需要在医院住2到3个月，接受医学观察。

transcript_json.text: The mother, who was in stable condition, could return home a day later if all physical tests came back normal.
transcript_json.translation: 妈妈情况稳定，如果各项身体检查都正常，一天后就能回家。

transcript_json.text: The baby's mother commented that they had already prepared room for five babies at home, so they will have to rearrange things for their happy surprise.
transcript_json.translation: 宝宝的妈妈说，他们已经在家里为5个宝宝准备好了房间，所以这次惊喜让他们得重新安排一下。

transcript_json.translation: 新手爸妈还没给第6个宝宝起名字，正在考虑叫莉莉或罗斯。

transcript_json.text: News report three.
News Report 3
A Spanish island called Palma Dor has been bought by a family from Europe for 18 million euros.
transcript_json.translation: 一个叫帕尔马多尔的西班牙岛屿被一个欧洲家庭以1800万欧元买下。

transcript_json.text: The island is often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers.
transcript_json.translation: 这座岛常被度假的人称为人间天堂。

transcript_json.text: For decades, tourists have been flocking to Palma Dor, which is located off the southeast coast of Spain.
transcript_json.translation: 几十年来，游客一直涌向帕尔马多尔岛，它位于西班牙东南海岸附近。

transcript_json.text: They come to enjoy its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters.
transcript_json.translation: 他们来这里欣赏未受破坏的海滩和清澈见底的海水。

transcript_json.text: Its natural beauty is protected as it lies inside a natural park.
transcript_json.translation: 岛上的自然美景得到了保护，因为它位于一个自然公园内。

transcript_json.text: Although Palma Dor is one of the most famous private islands in the world, its seafront is public land and is a favorite destination for famous people.
transcript_json.translation: 尽管帕尔马多尔是世界上最著名的私人岛屿之一，但它的海滨是公共用地，也是名人们喜欢的去处。

transcript_json.text: When the island was put up for sale, it was offered to the local government, but proved too expensive for the local authorities.
transcript_json.translation: 这座岛挂牌出售时，曾优先提供给当地政府，但对当地部门来说太贵了。

transcript_json.text: It is unclear whether the new owners have the power to ban tourists from the island, but with their newfound luxury comes the responsibility for its protection and maintenance.
transcript_json.translation: 目前尚不清楚新主人是否有权禁止游客登岛，但伴随着这份新得到的奢华，也带来了保护和维护它的责任。

transcript_json.text: The island is less than two miles long and half a mile wide.
transcript_json.translation: 这座岛长不到2英里，宽半英里。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
A new study has demonstrated the importance of women's rights.
transcript_json.translation: 一项新研究证明了妇女权利的重要性。

transcript_json.text: The researchers behind the study state that many parts of the world have made good economic progress, but women's rights are often overlooked.
transcript_json.translation: 该研究的研究人员表示，世界许多地方经济取得了良好进展，但妇女权利却常常被忽视。

transcript_json.text: Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，他们想确定保护妇女权利与公共健康之间是否存在联系。

transcript_json.text: The researchers analyzed databases which held information from 162 countries for the period 2004 to 2010.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员分析了涵盖162个国家2004年至2010年信息的数据库。

transcript_json.text: Countries were classified according to the respect they gave to women's economic and social rights.
transcript_json.translation: 各国根据对妇女经济和社会权利的尊重程度进行分类。

transcript_json.text: There were three categories.
transcript_json.translation: 共分为3类。

transcript_json.text: They were high, moderate, and poor.
transcript_json.translation: 分别是高、中、低。

transcript_json.text: Analysis of the data showed that countries with strong women's rights had better health than those where women's rights were not as respected.
transcript_json.translation: 数据分析表明，妇女权利得到充分保障的国家，其健康状况优于妇女权利未获充分尊重的国家。

transcript_json.text: The health indicators studied included disease prevention, reproductive health, death rates, and life expectancy.
transcript_json.translation: 研究的健康指标包括疾病预防、生殖健康、死亡率和预期寿命。

transcript_json.text: Furthermore, in countries where women's rights were most respected, but where access to hospitals and doctors was below average, health outcomes were still better than in countries rated as moderate or poor.
transcript_json.translation: 此外，在女性权利最受尊重、但医院和医生资源低于平均水平的国家，健康状况依然好于那些被评为中等或较差的国家。

transcript_json.text: This confirms that even with a lack of resources, if a country has strong women's rights, the health outcomes are better.
transcript_json.translation: 这证实了，即使资源匮乏，只要一个国家女性权利保障有力，健康状况就更好。

transcript_json.text: Thus, the researchers argue that gender equality is not just a women's rights issue; it is also a development issue.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，研究人员认为，性别平等不仅是女性权利问题，也是发展问题。

transcript_json.text: This is because better health aids economic development.
transcript_json.translation: 因为更好的健康有助于经济发展。

transcript_json.text: They note that the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint.
transcript_json.translation: 他们指出，从经济角度来看，女性权利的价值常受到质疑。

transcript_json.text: Some have argued that ensuring those rights would limit progress, but this study indicates the opposite.
transcript_json.translation: 有人认为保障这些权利会阻碍进步，但这项研究表明事实恰恰相反。

Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics in parks and trips to beaches.

transcript_json.text: First, sunshine can actually affect your breath.
transcript_json.translation: 首先，阳光其实会影响你的口气。

transcript_json.translation: 你可能觉得夏天是约会、和帅哥美女聊天的绝佳时机。

transcript_json.text: But excessive heat can cause you to lose water, which has been proven to have a pretty unattractive side effect: bad breath.
transcript_json.translation: 但过度炎热会导致你体内水分流失，而这一点已被证明会带来一个相当影响形象的副作用：口臭。

transcript_json.text: When you are lacking water, your mouth becomes dry.
transcript_json.translation: 当你缺水时，口腔会变得干燥。

transcript_json.text: Bacteria accumulates.
Because there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away.
transcript_json.translation: 因为口中没有足够的水把它冲走。

transcript_json.text: Sunshine can stop you from sweating too.
transcript_json.translation: 阳光还会让你停止出汗。

transcript_json.text: The body's normal temperature is 36 to 37 degrees centigrade, but if it heats up to 40 to 41 degrees, you may find yourself getting heatstroke.
transcript_json.translation: 人体正常体温是36至37摄氏度，但如果升到40至41度，你可能会中暑。

transcript_json.text: At that point, your heat regulatory system can essentially quit, which stops you from sweating, as your body tries to keep water around your vital organs.
transcript_json.translation: 到那时，你的体温调节系统基本上会失灵，导致你无法出汗，因为身体会尽量把水分留在重要器官周围。

transcript_json.text: However, the sun can have a positive influence on your body by raising your energy levels.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，阳光也能通过提升你的精力水平，对身体产生积极影响。

transcript_json.text: You might feel like the sun is giving you extra energy for your day, which is actually happening.
transcript_json.translation: 你可能会觉得阳光给了你一天所需的额外能量，而事实也确实如此。

transcript_json.text: And vitamin D from sunshine can help your body to absorb certain minerals, which are linked to building stronger bones.
transcript_json.translation: 阳光中的维生素D还能帮助身体吸收某些矿物质，这些矿物质有助于强健骨骼。

transcript_json.text: Therefore, I suggest you spend more time in the park with your friends, but make sure you apply lots of skin protection.

transcript_json.text: And fill up those water bottles too.

transcript_json.text: News Report 1: The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in Glasgow on Saturday.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道一：世界管乐乐队锦标赛将于周六在格拉斯哥举行。

transcript_json.text: Over 120 of the world's best pipe bands will compete at the championships.
transcript_json.translation: 全球120多支顶级管乐乐队将在这项锦标赛上同台竞技。

transcript_json.text: Over 4,000 pipers and drummers are expected to descend on the city for the annual event.
transcript_json.translation: 预计将有4000多名风笛手和鼓手涌入这座城市参加这场年度盛事。

transcript_json.text: It will take place at the St James' Playing Fields in Glasgow on Saturday 18 May from 10 a.m until 7 p.m.
transcript_json.translation: 比赛将于5月18日周六上午10点至晚上7点在格拉斯哥圣詹姆斯球场举行。

transcript_json.text: The event is free.
transcript_json.translation: 活动免费。

transcript_json.text: Also, a free shuttle bus will run between the event car parks and the competition site.
transcript_json.translation: 此外，活动停车场和比赛场地之间有免费班车往返。

transcript_json.text: Shuttle buses will run every 15 minutes from 8 a.m until 8 p.m.
transcript_json.translation: 班车从早8点运行到晚8点，每15分钟一班。

transcript_json.text: Glasgow City Council says it is estimated to bring £300,000 to the local economy.
transcript_json.translation: 格拉斯哥市议会表示，这项活动预计能为当地经济带来30万英镑的收入。

transcript_json.text: The first World Pipe Band Championships were held in Edinburgh in 1947.
transcript_json.translation: 首届世界管乐乐队锦标赛于1947年在爱丁堡举行。

transcript_json.text: The event first took place in Glasgow in 1948.
transcript_json.translation: 该项赛事于1948年首次在格拉斯哥举办。

transcript_json.text: It has been held regularly in Glasgow since 1986.
transcript_json.translation: 自1986年以来，它一直定期在格拉斯哥举行。

transcript_json.text: News report two: Summer doesn't begin for two more days, but scientists are already sounding the alarm about dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道二：还有两天夏天才正式开始，但科学家已经就格陵兰岛眼下正在发生的危险冰层融化拉响了警报。

transcript_json.text: The vast island usually locks away enough fresh water in its ice sheet, which, if melted, can raise global sea levels by six meters.
transcript_json.translation: 这个巨大的岛屿的冰盖通常储存着大量淡水，一旦融化，可使全球海平面上升6米。

transcript_json.text: And research shows that in recent years, its ice has melted faster than ever before.
transcript_json.translation: 研究显示，近年来格陵兰的冰融化速度比以往任何时候都快。

transcript_json.text: This month, as temperatures in North Northwestern Greenland approach all-time highs, researchers are encountering unusual, surprising levels of melting ice in the region.
transcript_json.translation: 本月，随着格陵兰西北部气温逼近历史最高值，研究人员发现该地区出现了异常的、令人吃惊的冰层融化。

transcript_json.text: The most significant concern here is how early this is all happening.
transcript_json.translation: 最令人担忧的是，这一切发生得实在太早了。

transcript_json.text: Greenland experiences annual ice melt and growth cycles, but this year the melting season began in early May.
transcript_json.translation: 格陵兰每年都有冰层融化和增长的周期，但今年的融化季早在5月初就开始了。

transcript_json.text: That's a month earlier than normal, and something that's happened only once before in the historical record in 2016.
transcript_json.translation: 这比正常年份提前了一个月，在历史记录中只有2016年出现过一次类似情况。

transcript_json.text: That means that not only is the ice melting very fast, it has more time to melt this summer than it would in a normal climate system.
transcript_json.translation: 这意味着不仅冰层融化速度极快，而且今年夏天的融化时间比正常气候系统下更长。

transcript_json.text: Longer melt seasons like this one seem to lead to much greater contributions to sea level rise than in previous decades.
transcript_json.translation: 像这样更长的融化季节，似乎比过去几十年导致了更多海平面上升。

transcript_json.text: News report three: Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash keep turning up on the streets of Blackhall Colliery in northern England, according to police.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道3：据警方称，在英格兰北部布莱克霍尔科利里的街道上，不断发现装有数千英镑现金的包裹。

transcript_json.text: Residents of the village have been coming across bundles of 20 pound notes, usually worth 2,000 pounds, in the former mining village in County Durham.
transcript_json.translation: 这个村庄的居民在达勒姆郡这个前矿业村落里，不时发现20英镑面值的钞票捆，每捆通常价值2000英镑。

transcript_json.text: The latest discovery Discovery was on Monday, meaning four of these cash bundles have been handed in this year and 13 since 2014.
transcript_json.translation: 最近一次发现是在周一，这意味着今年已有4捆现金被上交，自2014年以来共有13捆。

transcript_json.text: The bundles are usually left in plain sight and have been scattered across the small coastal village.
transcript_json.translation: 这些现金捆通常放在显眼处，散落在这个沿海小村庄各处。

transcript_json.text: The owner has two weeks to collect the cash, which is then returned to the finder if not claimed, according to Peter Lee, police.
transcript_json.translation: 据警方彼得·李介绍，失主有两周时间来认领现金，如果无人认领，现金将归发现者所有。

transcript_json.text: A Durham police spokesperson said the money has been returned to the lucky finders in all cases except yesterday.
transcript_json.translation: 达勒姆警方发言人表示，除昨天那次外，所有案件中的现金都已归还给幸运的发现者。

transcript_json.text: Policeman John Forster said in a statement, "The circumstances remain a mystery, so we would welcome any information that will help us get to the bottom of these random incidents."
transcript_json.translation: 警察约翰·福斯特在一份声明中说："情况仍然是个谜，欢迎提供任何信息，帮助我们查清这些随机事件的真相。"

transcript_json.text: He told the Northern Echo, "It isn't an affluent part of the world, so for them to find cash of that amount and instantly think about taking it to the police stations shows the community spirit there is."
transcript_json.translation: 他对《北方回声报》说："这里并不富裕，他们捡到那么多现金，第一反应就是送到警察局，这体现了当地的社区精神。"

transcript_json.text: Conversation One.
It's your birthday next week.
transcript_json.translation: 下周就是你的生日了。

transcript_json.text: What have you got planned?
transcript_json.translation: 你有什么安排吗？

transcript_json.text: I'm not sure.
transcript_json.translation: 我不太确定。

transcript_json.text: I often feel strange on my birthday.
transcript_json.translation: 我过生日时经常感觉怪怪的。

transcript_json.text: It's like my brain decides to have a crisis.
transcript_json.translation: 就像我的大脑决定要闹一场危机。

transcript_json.text: It's not entirely unusual to feel anxious or sad around your birthday.
transcript_json.translation: 生日前后感到焦虑或难过，其实并不算太反常。

transcript_json.text: Birthdays can tap into a lot of things people worry about, including their achievements in life, in the past decade, or their accomplishments of the past year.
transcript_json.translation: 生日会触动人们担心的很多事情，包括人生中的成就、过去十年的收获，或者过去一年的成绩。

transcript_json.text: Many begin to search for the meaning of their existence, leading to behaviors such as ending or starting a relationship, or plans like starting a vigorous diet or fitness program.
transcript_json.translation: 很多人会开始寻找存在的意义，从而做出一些行为，比如结束或开始一段感情，或者制定计划，比如开始严格的节食或健身计划。

transcript_json.text: I have wonderful friends, and I love celebrating their birthdays, but I don't like being the center of attention, receiving gifts, and having a fuss made.
transcript_json.translation: 我有很棒的朋友，我也喜欢为他们庆祝生日，但我不喜欢成为众人瞩目的焦点、收礼物、被大张旗鼓地张罗。

transcript_json.text: It seems to trigger a type of social anxiety.
transcript_json.translation: 这似乎会引发某种社交焦虑。

transcript_json.text: I think social media, too, can intensify things, as birthdays now play out more publicly.
transcript_json.translation: 我觉得社交媒体也会让事情变得更严重，因为现在的生日更多是公开进行的。

transcript_json.text: Birthday reminders can be helpful, but I kind of worry I won't be able to drum up my own day and show it to look as exciting as it is supposed to be.
transcript_json.translation: 生日提醒可能会有帮助，但我有点担心自己没法把这一天张罗起来，没法把它表现得像大家期待的那样热闹。

transcript_json.text: Well, to deal with the birthday blues, you should not isolate yourself.
transcript_json.translation: 要应对生日低落情绪，你不该把自己孤立起来。

transcript_json.text: It's best to gradually face your birthday with people you trust.
transcript_json.translation: 最好和你信任的人一起，慢慢去面对你的生日。

transcript_json.text: That would help you learn self-acceptance, or that it's okay to be the focus.
transcript_json.translation: 这样能帮你学会自我接纳，明白成为焦点也没什么不好。

transcript_json.text: Perhaps.
Or I could perceive my birthday as an opportunity to do something Something for others, like asking people to make a donation instead of buying a gift.
transcript_json.translation: 或者我可以把自己的生日当作一个为他人做点事情的机会，比如请大家捐款而不是送礼物。

transcript_json.text: Exactly.
Or even simply see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun.
transcript_json.translation: 甚至简单地把生日看作把大家聚在一起、让大家都开心的机会。

transcript_json.text: Question eight: How does the man often feel on his birthday?
