transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
The metro was absolutely terrible this morning.
transcript_json.translation: 今天早上的地铁简直糟透了。

transcript_json.text: Oh, was there a delay?
transcript_json.translation: 哦，是晚点了吗？

transcript_json.text: No, but the train was so packed that I could barely move, and it was difficult to breathe too.
transcript_json.translation: 不是，是车太挤了，我几乎动不了，连呼吸都困难。

transcript_json.text: At every station, more people squeezed in, and I got pushed further and further inside.
transcript_json.translation: 每到一站，都有更多人挤进来，我被越推越往里。

transcript_json.text: When I got to my station, I could hardly get out.
transcript_json.translation: 到站时，我几乎出不去。

transcript_json.text: Once I did get out, I was totally exhausted.
transcript_json.translation: 终于挤出来之后，我整个人累垮了。

transcript_json.text: That sounds like a nightmare.
transcript_json.translation: 听起来像场噩梦。

transcript_json.text: Why didn't you take the bus?
transcript_json.translation: 你干嘛不坐公交？

transcript_json.text: The bus takes twice as long, and it's just as crowded.
transcript_json.translation: 公交要多花一倍时间，而且一样挤。

transcript_json.text: Well, what's the alternative?
transcript_json.translation: 那还有什么别的选择？

transcript_json.text: Haven't you got a car?
transcript_json.translation: 你没有车吗？

transcript_json.text: I've got a driver's license, but that's all.
transcript_json.translation: 我有驾照，但也仅此而已。

transcript_json.text: I'm saving up to buy something reasonably small and cute, but it's still a bit expensive for me, and it'll take a while before I have enough money.
transcript_json.translation: 我在攒钱想买辆小巧可爱点的车，不过对我还是有点贵，还得再攒一阵子才够。

transcript_json.text: Have you thought about getting an electric motorbike?
transcript_json.translation: 你有没有想过买辆电动摩托车？

transcript_json.text: I considered that for maybe a minute, but honestly, I've just seen too many horrible accidents involving those dangerous monsters.
transcript_json.translation: 我想了大概一分钟吧，但说实话，我见过太多那些危险家伙出的严重事故了。

transcript_json.text: What about those popular share bikes?
transcript_json.translation: 那些很火的共享单车呢？

transcript_json.text: You could register to use one.
transcript_json.translation: 你可以注册一个来用。

transcript_json.text: Yeah, that's a possibility.
transcript_json.translation: 对，这倒是个办法。

transcript_json.text: There are always several of those bikes out in front of our apartment complex.
transcript_json.translation: 我们公寓楼前总是停着好几辆那样的单车。

transcript_json.text: Or you could just walk to work.
transcript_json.translation: 或者你干脆走着去上班。

transcript_json.text: Well, it's five kilometers from home to the office, but you've given me a thought.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，从家到办公室有5公里，不过你倒是提醒我了。

transcript_json.text: I could take a change of clothes and jog to work, but at this time of year the air pollution is a real problem.
transcript_json.translation: 我可以带套换洗衣服慢跑去上班，不过每年这个时候空气污染是个大问题。

transcript_json.text: Oh yeah, I didn't think of that.
transcript_json.translation: 哦对，我倒没想到这个。

transcript_json.text: Get a taxi if you really have to.
transcript_json.translation: 实在不行就打车。

transcript_json.text: Well, that's an expensive way to get to work.
transcript_json.translation: 可是那样上班成本也太高了。

transcript_json.text: Not if you use a ride-sharing app.
transcript_json.translation: 用拼车软件就不贵了。

transcript_json.text: Good idea.
I'll download one immediately.
transcript_json.translation: 我这就去下载一个。

transcript_json.text: Thank you.

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Steve Miller began his career in IT back in the late 1980s.
transcript_json.translation: 史蒂夫·米勒早在1980年代末就开始了他在IT行业的职业生涯。

transcript_json.text: Being a deaf person in tech required a huge amount of effort and organization.
transcript_json.translation: 作为一名听障人士，在科技行业工作需要付出极大的努力，还要做大量的协调安排。

transcript_json.text: Because there was no email or text message service, everything had to be done face to face or by telephone.
transcript_json.translation: 由于当时没有电子邮件或短信服务，所有事情都必须面对面沟通或通过电话完成。

transcript_json.text: Communicating in meetings was very difficult.
transcript_json.translation: 在会议上交流非常困难。

transcript_json.text: He needed a sign language interpreter for every meeting, but it was a huge effort to coordinate.
transcript_json.translation: 每次会议他都需要一名手语翻译，但协调起来费时费力。

transcript_json.text: These days, although challenges still remain, it's a good time to be a deaf person in tech, says Miller.
transcript_json.translation: 米勒说，虽然如今挑战依然存在，但对听障人士来说，现在是进入科技行业的好时机。

transcript_json.text: Big advances in speech recognition technology have enabled communication tools to turn live speech into text in real time on your smartphone or laptop, and sign language into text as well.
transcript_json.translation: 语音识别技术的巨大进步，使沟通工具能够通过手机或笔记本电脑将现场语音实时转成文字，也能把手语转成文字。

transcript_json.text: New tech, coupled with improvements in hearing aid technology and medical advances, means that Miller is able to focus far more on his work.
transcript_json.translation: 新技术加上助听器技术的改进和医疗的进步，意味着米勒可以更加专注于工作。

transcript_json.text: He has benefited to a great extent from a tiny hearing device in his ear.
transcript_json.translation: 他从耳朵里佩戴的一个小小听力装置中获益良多。

transcript_json.text: It gives him a degree of hearing, and he can use a variety of communication methods depending on the situation.
transcript_json.translation: 这个装置让他拥有一定程度的听力，他可以根据不同情况使用多种沟通方式。

transcript_json.text: He can employ lip reading and have meetings via video instead of on the phone.
transcript_json.translation: 他可以看唇语，也可以通过视频开会，而不必打电话。

transcript_json.text: These things have made a huge difference.
transcript_json.translation: 这些改变带来了巨大的不同。

transcript_json.text: He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand.
transcript_json.translation: 他再也不用担心自己能不能听懂了。

transcript_json.text: He can just concentrate on how interesting the meeting might be, and what he needs to get out of it in order to progress.
transcript_json.translation: 他只需专注于会议可能有多有趣，以及为了推进工作他需要从中获得什么。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Passage 2.
Color is now spreading through our homes, up staircases, Across wood frames and ceilings, filling in neutral spaces.
transcript_json.translation: 色彩如今正在走进我们的家，沿着楼梯蔓延，爬过木框和天花板，填满素色的空间。

transcript_json.text: According to one interior designer, when people return home, they want to see colors that cheer them up and give them a hug.
transcript_json.translation: 一位室内设计师说，人们回到家，想看到能让自己开心、给自己一个拥抱的颜色。

transcript_json.text: Pure white walls simply don't do that.
transcript_json.translation: 纯白色的墙做不到这一点。

transcript_json.text: They don't look after you.
transcript_json.translation: 它们不会照顾你的情绪。

transcript_json.text: Another interior designer commented that certain combinations can key into something on a deeper level, transporting you to a different moment in time.
transcript_json.translation: 另一位室内设计师说，某些颜色组合能触动内心深处的某种东西，把你带回过去的某个时刻。

transcript_json.text: That's the power of color.
transcript_json.translation: 这就是色彩的力量。

transcript_json.text: If you are thinking to try color on some of your neutral walls, the advice is refreshingly simple: choose a color you actually like.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你想给家里一些中性色的墙换上色彩，建议其实很简单：选一个你真正喜欢的颜色。

transcript_json.text: Don't go for a color because it's in fashion or you've seen it in a magazine.
transcript_json.translation: 不要因为某个颜色流行，或者在杂志上看到过，就去选它。

transcript_json.text: If you're wary of full color, test your tolerance with smaller spaces, such as the inside of a cupboard or a bright window frame.
transcript_json.translation: 如果你对大面积用色有顾虑，可以先在小空间里试试，比如橱柜内部或明亮的窗框。

transcript_json.text: If it gives you joy every time you open the cupboard, you can start to take it further.
transcript_json.translation: 如果每次打开橱柜都让你感到愉悦，你就可以把颜色用得更大胆一些。

transcript_json.text: One can also paint the Wooden frameworks the same color as the walls, helping the rooms look bigger.
transcript_json.translation: 也可以把木质框架刷成和墙面一样的颜色，让房间显得更大。

transcript_json.text: In the kitchen, painting the overhead cupboards and the walls in the same color can make it feel more spacious, while painting the kitchen counters a bold color can make everything feel more open and lighter.
transcript_json.translation: 在厨房里，把吊柜和墙刷成同一种颜色会显得更宽敞；把厨房台面刷成醒目的颜色，则会让一切显得更开阔、更明亮。

transcript_json.text: Additionally, a painted ceiling is a magical thing without being too obvious, and can affect how the space feels as well.
transcript_json.translation: 此外，刷了颜色的天花板效果很奇妙，又不会太张扬，也会影响空间的整体感受。

transcript_json.text: Passage three: Parents often hear that reading to their children is critical for supporting development, and the message is getting through to them.
transcript_json.translation: 短文三：父母常听说，给孩子读书对支持他们的发展至关重要，这个信息也传达到了他们那里。

transcript_json.text: In fact, in the United States, a little over half of children between the ages of three and five were read to every day in 2007, and 83% of children in that age group in the same country were read two, three, or more times per week in 2012.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，在美国，2007年有略多于一半的3至5岁儿童每天都有人读书给他们听，2012年该国同龄儿童中有83%每周被读两三次或更多次。

transcript_json.text: This is good news because reading to young children helps their language and brain development.
transcript_json.translation: 这是个好消息，因为给幼儿读书有助于他们的语言和大脑发育。

transcript_json.text: In fact, recent research has found that both the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy predicted later childhood vocabulary and reading skills.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，最近的研究发现，婴儿期亲子共读的质量和数量，都能预测孩子日后的词汇量和阅读能力。

transcript_json.text: In other words, the more time parents spend reading, the greater the developmental benefits in their four-year-old children.
transcript_json.translation: 换句话说，父母花在阅读上的时间越多，4岁孩子的发育益处就越大。

transcript_json.text: This is an important finding, but does it matter what books parents read?
transcript_json.translation: 这是一个重要发现，但父母读什么书有关系吗？

transcript_json.text: A new study has investigated this question.
transcript_json.translation: 一项新研究对这个问题进行了探讨。

transcript_json.text: It followed infants across the second six months of life and found that when parents showed babies books that had faces or objects with specific labels, they learned more.
transcript_json.translation: 研究跟踪了婴儿出生后第二个6个月，发现当父母给婴儿看带有面孔或物体并配有具体名称的书时，他们学得更多。

transcript_json.text: This is in contrast to books that did not name images or books that had the same label under each image.
transcript_json.translation: 这与那些没有给图像命名的书，或每张图下面都标注同一个名称的书形成对比。

transcript_json.text: Books that named different also promoted greater learning.
transcript_json.translation: 标注不同名称的书也能促进更好的学习。

transcript_json.text: So what does this mean for parents?
transcript_json.translation: 那么这对父母意味着什么呢？

transcript_json.text: Not all books are created equal, so parents need to choose the books they share with their children with great care.
transcript_json.translation: 并不是所有的书都一样好，所以父母在选择与孩子共读的书时需要非常慎重。

transcript_json.text: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第22至25题基于你刚才听到的短文。

transcript_json.text: Question 22: What does the passage say parents increasingly understand?
transcript_json.translation: 第22题：短文说父母越来越明白什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 23: What can predict children's reading skills according to recent research?
transcript_json.translation: 第23题：根据近期研究，什么可以预测孩子的阅读能力？

transcript_json.text: Question 24.
What kind of books are said to help babies learn more?
transcript_json.translation: 什么样的书据说能帮助婴儿学得更多？

transcript_json.text: Question 25.
What are parents advised to do at the end of the passage?
transcript_json.translation: 短文最后建议父母做什么？

transcript_json.translation: 听力理解到此结束。

transcript_json.text: Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports.

transcript_json.text: News Report One: African leaders plan to turn the continent into a continent without borders.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道一：非洲领导人计划把非洲大陆变成一个没有边界的大陆。

transcript_json.text: They will introduce a single passport policy, allowing free movement between countries.
transcript_json.translation: 他们将推行统一护照政策，允许各国之间自由流动。

transcript_json.text: The idea from the African Union has been modeled on the EU Schengen free movement deal.
transcript_json.translation: 这个来自非盟的想法是效仿欧盟申根自由流动协定设计的。

transcript_json.text: Europe has abolished Many internal borders.
transcript_json.translation: 欧洲已经废除了许多内部边界。

transcript_json.text: This enables visa-free movement across the continent.
transcript_json.translation: 这使得人们可以在整个大陆免签证流动。

transcript_json.text: Currently, thirteen African countries have visa-free deals in place with each other.
transcript_json.translation: 目前，13个非洲国家彼此之间已有免签证协议。

transcript_json.text: These allow citizens to visit another country without a visa.
transcript_json.translation: 这些协议允许公民免签证前往另一个国家。

transcript_json.text: Some countries offer visas on arrival.
transcript_json.translation: 有些国家提供落地签证。

transcript_json.text: In contrast, Americans are able to travel to twenty of the continent's countries without a visa, or secure a visa on arrival.
transcript_json.translation: 相比之下，美国人可以免签前往该大陆的20个国家，或者获得落地签证。

transcript_json.text: The African Union, which represents fifty-four states, wants to abolish the requirement of a visa for Africans visiting other African countries.
transcript_json.translation: 代表54个国家的非盟希望取消非洲人访问其他非洲国家的签证要求。

transcript_json.text: It also wants to establish a free trade deal across the continent in the near future, as trade within the African continent costs more than any other region.
transcript_json.translation: 它还希望在不久的将来在整个大陆建立自由贸易协定，因为非洲大陆内部的贸易成本高于任何其他地区。

transcript_json.text: Questions one and two are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第1题和第2题基于你刚刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question one: What is the news report mainly about?
transcript_json.translation: 第1题：这则新闻报道主要讲的是什么？

transcript_json.text: Question two: What benefit will a free trade deal bring to African economy?
transcript_json.translation: 第2题：自由贸易协定会给非洲经济带来什么好处？

transcript_json.text: News report two.
Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon dioxide underground and turning it into stone.
transcript_json.translation: 冰岛的研究人员找到了一种应对气候变化的新方法，就是把二氧化碳注入地下并将其变成石头。

transcript_json.text: Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas, but problems include a high cost and concern about leaks.
transcript_json.translation: 其他碳捕获和封存方法是把二氧化碳以气体形式储存，但问题包括成本高和泄漏隐患。

transcript_json.text: This new method of Burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone is cheaper and more secure, the Guardian reports.
transcript_json.translation: 据《卫报》报道，这种把二氧化碳埋入地下并转化为石头的新方法更便宜也更安全。

transcript_json.text: To turn carbon dioxide into stone, researchers with the CarbFix project pumped the gas into volcanic rock and sped up the natural process in which the volcanic rock reacts with gas and forms carbon minerals.
transcript_json.translation: 为了把二氧化碳变成石头，CarbFix项目的研究人员将这种气体注入火山岩，并加速了火山岩与气体反应生成碳矿物的自然过程。

transcript_json.text: The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands of years researchers had predicted.
transcript_json.translation: 这种气体仅用了两年就变成了固体，比研究人员此前预测的几百年或几千年快得多。

transcript_json.text: The research took place at Iceland's HelaShi地 power plant.
Already, the project in Iceland has been increased in scale to bury 10,000 tons of carbon dioxide each year.
transcript_json.translation: 目前，冰岛的这个项目已经扩大规模，每年封存1万吨二氧化碳。

transcript_json.text: One potential difficulty is that for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water.
transcript_json.translation: 一个潜在的难题是，每封存1吨二氧化碳，这项技术就需要25吨水。

transcript_json.text: However, the lead researcher said seawater could be used.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，首席研究员说可以用海水。

transcript_json.text: Questions three and four.
transcript_json.translation: 第3题和第4题。

transcript_json.text: Four are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 这4道题基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question three: What new method has been developed to help fight climate change?
transcript_json.translation: 第3题：研发出了什么新方法来帮助应对气候变化？

transcript_json.text: Question four: What is a potential difficulty in applying the new technique?
transcript_json.translation: 第4题：应用这项新技术的一个潜在难题是什么？

transcript_json.text: News report three: People in France are keeping away from the narrow French stick loaf in favor of healthier, cheaper options, a millers' association has said.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道三：法国磨坊师协会表示，法国人正在远离细长的法式棍子面包，转而选择更健康、更便宜的替代品。

transcript_json.text: The National Association of French Millers says bread Consumption is on the decline, with French people eating 9 grams less than in the previous year.
transcript_json.translation: 法国全国磨坊师协会称，面包消费量正在下降，法国人的面包食用量比上一年减少了9克。

transcript_json.text: The association is concerned about the effects this trend will have on their trade, and suggests three reasons why it is happening.
transcript_json.translation: 该协会担心这一趋势会对行业产生影响，并指出了造成这一现象的三个原因。

transcript_json.text: Firstly, the association cited changing diets, in particular the switch to those low in calories, as a factor in the reduction of bread consumption.
transcript_json.translation: 首先，该协会把饮食习惯的改变，尤其是转向低热量饮食，列为面包消费量下降的一个因素。

transcript_json.text: This could explain why the difference in consumption between genders is so big.
transcript_json.translation: 这或许可以解释为什么男女之间的消费差距如此之大。

transcript_json.text: Nowadays, men eat an approximate average of 140 grams of bread daily, whereas women eat 80 to 90 grams.
transcript_json.translation: 如今，男性平均每天吃约140克面包，而女性吃80到90克。

transcript_json.text: The second reason they say is lifestyle changes in the country, with people dedicating less time to breakfast, when bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam.

Good morning.
Our guest today is Karen Brook.
transcript_json.translation: 今天我们请到的嘉宾是凯伦·布鲁克。

transcript_json.text: Karen is the managing director of Cube Movie Theatre, located on Underhill Road.
transcript_json.translation: 凯伦是位于安德希尔路的立方体电影院的总经理。

transcript_json.text: Thank you for coming, Karen.
transcript_json.translation: 凯伦，感谢你来参加节目。

transcript_json.translation: 谢谢你们邀请我。

transcript_json.translation: 那么，跟我们说说你们的电影院——立方体电影院吧。

transcript_json.text: Sure.
Cube Movie Theatre has been around Now for eleven years.
transcript_json.translation: 立方体电影院到现在已经开了11年了。

transcript_json.text: It's located in what used to be a hat factory.
transcript_json.translation: 它坐落在一座以前的帽子工厂里。

transcript_json.text: Oh, really?
Yeah.
There used to be many hat factories in Britain until around the 1950s, but fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats, so practically all of those factories had to close down.
transcript_json.translation: 直到1950年代左右，英国还有很多帽子工厂，但后来时尚变了，大多数人不再戴帽子了，所以那些工厂几乎全都关门了。

transcript_json.text: This one in particular was closed for 47 years before we transformed it into a movie theatre.
transcript_json.translation: 这一座尤其特别，在我们把它改造成电影院之前，已经关闭了47年。

transcript_json.text: I see.
I hear there's something else that makes your theatre special.
transcript_json.translation: 我听说还有别的东西让你们的影院与众不同。

transcript_json.text: What is it that sets you apart from other theatres?
transcript_json.translation: 是什么让你们和其他影院不一样呢？

transcript_json.text: We are the only movie theatre in the whole country that only shows foreign movies.
transcript_json.translation: 我们是全国唯一一家只放映外国电影的影院。

transcript_json.text: Is there enough demand for that?
transcript_json.translation: 这样做有足够的需求吗？

transcript_json.text: I would have thought that in London most people don't speak foreign languages.
transcript_json.translation: 我还以为在伦敦大多数人都不会说外语呢。

transcript_json.text: Sure, there's enough demand.
transcript_json.translation: 当然有，需求很充足。

transcript_json.text: The fact that we have been open and in business for all these years proves it.
transcript_json.translation: 我们这么多年一直开门营业，就证明了这一点。

transcript_json.text: London is a very large and international city.
transcript_json.translation: 伦敦是一座非常大、非常国际化的城市。

transcript_json.text: There are lots of people interested in watching such movies.
transcript_json.translation: 很多人对看这类电影很感兴趣。

transcript_json.text: Furthermore, I might add, all movies come with English text at the bottom of the screen, so even if you don't understand what the actors say, you can still read it.
transcript_json.translation: 另外我还想补充一点，所有电影屏幕底部都配有英文字幕，所以即使你听不懂演员说什么，也还能看字幕。

transcript_json.text: Of course.
What movie are you showing right now?

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Love them or hate them, smartphones have become an integral part of our daily lives.
transcript_json.translation: 不管你爱还是恨，智能手机已经成为我们日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。

transcript_json.text: But should they be left outside the classroom?
transcript_json.translation: 但它们应该被挡在教室门外吗？

transcript_json.text: Nick Gibb, minister for school standards in England, believes schools should ban their pupils from bringing in smartphones.
transcript_json.translation: 英格兰学校标准部长尼克·吉布认为，学校应该禁止学生带智能手机。

transcript_json.text: Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher, incorporates phones into her classroom.
transcript_json.translation: 中学数学教师阿斯特丽德·纳特利把手机用进了她的课堂。

transcript_json.text: My school doesn't have money for tablets, she says.
transcript_json.translation: 她说，我们学校没钱买平板电脑。

transcript_json.text: When students use their phones for research, they learn they have a powerful tool in their hands.
transcript_json.translation: 当学生用手机查资料时，他们会明白自己手里握着一件强大的工具。

transcript_json.text: If we stop children using phones, we're rejecting something they care about.
transcript_json.translation: 如果我们不让孩子用手机，那就是在否定他们所珍视的东西。

transcript_json.text: Meanwhile, Helen Lockhart, a registered nurse working for community Education supports a complete ban.
transcript_json.translation: 与此同时，在社区教育机构工作的注册护士海伦·洛克哈特主张全面禁止。

transcript_json.text: I'm banned from mobile use at work, and my phone must be handed in.
transcript_json.translation: 我在工作时是禁止使用手机的，手机必须上交。

transcript_json.text: If I'm caught with it in my pocket, I will be subject to disciplinary procedure, which will impact on my career.
transcript_json.translation: 要是被发现口袋里揣着手机，我就会受到纪律处分，这会影响我的职业生涯。

transcript_json.text: We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they're striving to become.
transcript_json.translation: 我们要教孩子们，如何像他们努力想成为的专业人士那样行事。

transcript_json.text: Richard Stone, an English teacher, thinks there should be a clear separation between school and home.
transcript_json.translation: 英语教师理查德·斯通认为，学校和家庭之间应该有明确的界限。

transcript_json.text: Students should do things differently in the two environments.
transcript_json.translation: 学生在这两种环境中的做法应该有所不同。

transcript_json.text: Children are getting more than enough screen time in their lives without the need to bring their phone into the classroom.
transcript_json.translation: 孩子们生活中的屏幕时间已经够多了，不必再把手机带进教室。

transcript_json.text: The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool, so let's leave phones and laptops at home and show them a different world in their lessons, one of books and pens, he says.
transcript_json.translation: 他说，互联网这个研究工具用起来太容易、又太不可靠，所以还是把手机和笔记本电脑留在家里，在课堂上给他们展示另一个世界——一个有书本和笔的世界。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Kate, a six-year-old girl, helped her brother wash windows to get a reward promised by her mother, a purple doll that she wanted.
transcript_json.translation: 6岁的女孩凯特帮哥哥擦窗户，是为了得到妈妈答应的奖励——一个她想要的紫色娃娃。

transcript_json.text: She watched her mother order the doll online.
transcript_json.translation: 她看着妈妈在网上下单订了那个娃娃。

transcript_json.text: The next day, Kate asked if she could check the shipping status, so her mom clicked on the web page and then walked out of the room.
transcript_json.translation: 第二天，凯特问能不能查一下物流，于是妈妈点开网页后就走出了房间。

transcript_json.text: Kate saw that her doll would be arriving the next afternoon, but then she noticed something else: suggestions about other dolls and toys she could order.
transcript_json.translation: 凯特看到她的娃娃第二天下午就会送到，但接着她又注意到了别的东西：其他可以订购的娃娃和玩具的推荐。

transcript_json.text: Fifteen minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed the order and ran off to play.
transcript_json.translation: 15分钟、几次点击之后，购物车里放了价值超过350美元的娃娃，凯特下了单就跑去玩了。

transcript_json.text: The next day, while checking on another online order, her mother noticed a long list of dolls on the way.
transcript_json.translation: 第二天，她妈妈在查另一个网上订单时，发现有一长串娃娃正在配送途中。

transcript_json.text: She was able to cancel two of them, but it was too late to cancel the rest.
transcript_json.translation: 她退掉了其中两个，但其余的已经来不及退了。

transcript_json.text: She told her daughter That they were going to be returned.
transcript_json.translation: 她告诉女儿，这些娃娃都要退货。

transcript_json.text: When the packages arrived, Kate wanted to open them, but her parents said no.
transcript_json.translation: 包裹送到时，凯特想拆开，但父母说不行。

transcript_json.text: Instead of sending back the dolls, her father suggested giving them to the local children's hospital.
transcript_json.translation: 她爸爸建议不把娃娃退回去，而是捐给当地的儿童医院。

transcript_json.text: So the next week, Kate's family loaded up their car and took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital.
transcript_json.translation: 于是第二个星期，凯特一家把车装满，把所有娃娃都送到了儿童医院的游戏室。

transcript_json.text: Kate was depressed at first, but then she sat with some girl patients and they opened up all the boxes together, laughing and playing.
transcript_json.translation: 凯特一开始很难过，但后来她和一些女患儿坐在一起，大家一起拆开所有的盒子，又笑又玩。

transcript_json.text: She had a lot of fun and learned a really good lesson.
transcript_json.translation: 她玩得很开心，还学到了很好的一课。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
Can the date you were born affect how successful your life is?
transcript_json.translation: 你的出生日期会影响你一生的成功吗？

transcript_json.text: According to recent research done in Australia, the answer is yes.
transcript_json.translation: 根据澳大利亚最近的一项研究，答案是肯定的。

transcript_json.text: The researchers found that the time when a person starts school has an enduring impact on their lives.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员发现，一个人开始上学的时间会对他们的一生产生持久的影响。

transcript_json.text: Those who are relatively old compared to their classmates have certain advantages over them.
transcript_json.translation: 那些和同学比起来相对年长的人，相比他们有一定优势。

transcript_json.text: Previous research has found older students achieve better results.
transcript_json.translation: 以往的研究发现，年长的学生成绩更好。

transcript_json.text: They are also more likely to attend university and become professional athletes, chief executives, and even important politicians.
transcript_json.translation: 他们也更有可能上大学，成为职业运动员、首席执行官，甚至重要的政治家。

transcript_json.text: But the Australian researchers wanted to discover what was driving these differences.
transcript_json.translation: 但澳大利亚的研究人员想弄清楚是什么导致了这些差异。

transcript_json.text: They suspected older, more mature students obtained more self-confidence than their peers because they achieved better grades.
transcript_json.translation: 他们怀疑，年长、更成熟的学生因为成绩更好，所以比同龄人更自信。

transcript_json.text: To test this out, they conducted two studies.
transcript_json.translation: 为了验证这一点，他们进行了两项研究。

transcript_json.text: One was with high school students, and the other with more than a thousand Australian adults, aged between 24 and 60 years old.
transcript_json.translation: 一项针对高中生，另一项针对1000多名24至60岁的澳大利亚成年人。

transcript_json.text: In the first study, more than 600 high school students were surveyed about their tendency to take risks and feel confident.
transcript_json.translation: 在第一项研究中，600多名高中生接受了关于冒险倾向和自信程度的调查。

transcript_json.text: In the second study, the Those born on both sides of the cutoff date for starting school were asked to complete online math questions and rate their performance.
transcript_json.translation: 在第二项研究中，出生在入学截止日期前后的人被要求完成在线数学题，并给自己的表现打分。

transcript_json.text: They were also asked about the risks they took while riding bicycles and managing their finances.
transcript_json.translation: 他们还被问到骑自行车和理财时所冒的风险。

transcript_json.text: The researchers found that older students displayed greater risk-taking tendencies.
transcript_json.translation: 研究人员发现，年长的学生表现出更强的冒险倾向。

transcript_json.text: While risk-taking can be considered a negative attribute, it's also a characteristic of successful people, including athletes, political leaders, and entrepreneurs.
transcript_json.translation: 虽然冒险可能被视为一种负面特质，但它也是成功人士的特征，包括运动员、政治领袖和企业家。

transcript_json.translation: 每篇新闻报道结束后，你会听到2到3个问题。

transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道和问题都只朗读一遍。

transcript_json.text: News Report One.
A woman was charged with allegedly violating a Rhode Island city law against feeding wild animals.
transcript_json.translation: 一名女子因涉嫌违反罗德岛市禁止投喂野生动物的法规而被起诉。

transcript_json.text: The 55-year-old woman's neighbors blame her for making the area's rat problem worse.
transcript_json.translation: 这名55岁女子的邻居指责她加剧了该地区的鼠患。

transcript_json.text: Newly installed cameras captured several rats active in the middle of the day.
transcript_json.translation: 新安装的摄像头拍到了几只大白天活动的老鼠。

transcript_json.text: Neighbors say that it's even worse during the night.
transcript_json.translation: 邻居们说，晚上的情况更糟。

transcript_json.text: The woman and her parents, who own the told reporters that she's being charged for feeding birds.
transcript_json.translation: 这名女子和她的父母（房子是他们所有的）告诉记者，她是因为喂鸟而被起诉的。

transcript_json.text: "Who would have known just loving animals gets you that much trouble?" she said.
transcript_json.translation: 她说："谁能想到，光是爱护动物会惹上这么大的麻烦？"

transcript_json.text: It is prohibited to feed any wild animals, including birds, in Rhode Island City.
transcript_json.translation: 在罗德岛市，投喂包括鸟类在内的任何野生动物都是被禁止的。

transcript_json.text: Nevertheless, while the woman's intention was to feed birds, it is clear that rats were also benefiting.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，虽然这名女子的本意是喂鸟，但老鼠显然也从中得到了好处。

transcript_json.text: Anthony Moretti, director of the city administration, said he saw more than 20 rats near the woman's home.
transcript_json.translation: 市政管理部门主任安东尼·莫雷蒂说，他在那名女子家附近看到了20多只老鼠。

transcript_json.text: He said it will take months to get the problem under control.
transcript_json.translation: 他说，要控制住这个问题还需要几个月的时间。

transcript_json.text: Questions one and two are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第1题和第2题基于你刚才听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question one: What do we learn from the report about the 55-year-old woman?
transcript_json.translation: 第1题：关于这名55岁的女子，我们从报道中得知了什么？

transcript_json.text: Question two: What did the director of the city administration say at the end of the news report?
transcript_json.translation: 问题二：新闻报道最后，市政管理部门的主管说了什么？

transcript_json.text: News report two.
News Report 2

To prepare for eventually sending astronauts to Mars, NASA began taking applications Friday for four people to live for a year in Mars Juno Alpha, that's a 1,700 square foot Martian habitat inside a building in Houston.
transcript_json.translation: 为了准备最终将宇航员送上火星，NASA周五开始接受申请，招募4人在火星朱诺阿尔法生活一年，那是休斯顿一栋建筑内一个1700平方英尺的火星栖息地。

transcript_json.text: The paid volunteers will work in an environment similar to Mars.
transcript_json.translation: 这些有报酬的志愿者将在类似火星的环境中工作。

transcript_json.text: They will have limited communications with family, restricted food and resources.
transcript_json.translation: 他们与家人的联系会受到限制，食物和资源也受限。

transcript_json.text: NASA is planning three experiments with the first one starting in the fall next year.
transcript_json.translation: NASA计划进行3次实验，第一次将于明年秋天开始。

transcript_json.text: Food, we'll all be ready to eat space food.
transcript_json.translation: 食物方面，我们都会做好吃太空食品的准备。

transcript_json.text: Some plants will be grown, but not potatoes, like in the movie The Martian.
transcript_json.translation: 会种一些植物，但不是土豆，不像电影《火星救援》里那样。

transcript_json.text: We want to understand how humans perform in them, said lead scientist Grace Douglas.
transcript_json.translation: "我们想了解人类在其中的表现如何，"首席科学家格蕾丝·道格拉斯说。

transcript_json.text: We're looking at Mars realistic situations.
transcript_json.translation: 我们着眼于贴近火星的真实情况。

transcript_json.text: The application process opened Friday, and they're not seeking just anybody.
transcript_json.translation: 申请流程周五开启，他们不是随便什么人都要。

transcript_json.text: The requirements are strict, including a master's degree in a science, engineering, or math field, or pilot experience.
transcript_json.translation: 要求很严格，包括拥有科学、工程或数学领域的硕士学位，或有飞行经验。

transcript_json.text: Only American citizens or permanent U.S residents are acceptable.
transcript_json.translation: 只接受美国公民或美国永久居民。

transcript_json.text: Applicants must be between 30 and 55, and in good physical health.
transcript_json.translation: 申请人须在30至55岁之间，身体健康。

transcript_json.text: Attitude is key, said former Canadian astronaut Chris Hadfield.
transcript_json.translation: "态度是关键，"前加拿大宇航员克里斯·哈德菲尔德说。

transcript_json.text: He said the participants need to be super competent, resourceful, and not reliant on other people to feel comfortable.
transcript_json.translation: 他说，参与者需要非常能干、善于随机应变，而且不依赖别人也能感到自在。

transcript_json.text: Questions three and four are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 问题三和问题四基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question three: What does NASA require the paid volunteers to do?
transcript_json.translation: 问题三：NASA要求这些有报酬的志愿者做什么？

transcript_json.text: Question four: What will the participants in the project eat?
transcript_json.translation: 问题四：项目参与者将吃什么？

transcript_json.text: News report three.
A Japanese mayor apologized Thursday for biting the Olympic gold medal of a softball player.
transcript_json.translation: 一位日本市长周四就咬了一名垒球运动员的奥运金牌一事道歉。

transcript_json.text: Nagoya Mayor Takashi Kawamura had praised athlete Mio.
transcript_json.translation: 名古屋市长河村隆之曾称赞运动员美穗。

transcript_json.text: Goto, during a public media event.
transcript_json.translation: 后藤在一次公开媒体活动期间。

transcript_json.text: He asked her to put the medal around his neck.
transcript_json.translation: 他请她把奖牌挂到他脖子上。

transcript_json.text: Kawamura then bit into it.
transcript_json.translation: 川村随后咬了奖牌一口。

transcript_json.text: Biting a medal in front of journalists and photographers has become a common pose for Olympic medalists.
transcript_json.translation: 在记者和摄影师面前咬奖牌，已成为奥运奖牌得主的常见姿势。

transcript_json.text: However, it is only for the winners themselves, not others.
transcript_json.translation: 不过，这只能由获奖者本人来做，不能由别人代劳。

transcript_json.text: "I'm really sorry that I hurt the treasure of the gold medalist," Kawamura told reporters Thursday.
transcript_json.translation: "我弄坏了金牌得主的宝物，真的很抱歉。"川村周四对记者说。

transcript_json.text: The mayor said the medal was undamaged, though he offered to pay for the cost of a new one.
transcript_json.translation: 市长说奖牌并未受损，不过他表示愿意赔偿一枚新奖牌的费用。

transcript_json.text: Goto, however, has accepted the International Olympic Committee's offer of a replacement, according to Japanese media reports.
transcript_json.translation: 据日本媒体报道，后藤还是接受了国际奥委会更换奖牌的提议。

transcript_json.text: The scene, broadcast on television, prompted thousands of complaints to City Hall.
transcript_json.translation: 这一幕在电视上播出后，市政府收到了数千条投诉。

transcript_json.text: Some Olympians said they treat their medals as treasures, and that it was disrespectful and unacceptable for Kawamura to bite one.
transcript_json.translation: 一些奥运选手说，他们把奖牌视若珍宝，川村咬奖牌的做法既不尊重人也无法接受。

transcript_json.text: "I would cry if that "Happen to me," said another athlete, now he said Takato.
transcript_json.translation: 另一位运动员高藤直寿说："如果这种事发生在我身上，我会哭的。"

transcript_json.text: "I handle my own gold medal so gently that I would not scratch it."
transcript_json.translation: "我对待自己的金牌非常小心，绝不会把它刮花。"

transcript_json.text: Questions five to seven are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 5到7题基于你刚听到的这则新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question five: What does the news report say about the Japanese mayor Takashi Karamura?
transcript_json.translation: 第5题：关于日本市长河村隆之，新闻报道说了什么？

transcript_json.text: Question six: What did Mayor Takashi Karamura offer to do?
transcript_json.translation: 第6题：河村隆之市长提出要做什么？

transcript_json.translation: 第7题：一些奥运选手说他们会如何对待自己的奖牌？

transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上对应字母中间画一条横线。

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
What's that orange thing on your computer screen?
transcript_json.translation: 你电脑屏幕上那个橙色的东西是什么？

transcript_json.text: It's something I bought yesterday.
transcript_json.translation: 是我昨天买的。

transcript_json.text: It's a plastic sheet that blocks blue light.
transcript_json.translation: 是一张防蓝光的塑料膜。

transcript_json.text: I have one that I use to cover my phone screen too.
transcript_json.translation: 我还有一个用来贴手机屏幕的。

transcript_json.text: What do you mean by blue light?
transcript_json.translation: 你说的蓝光是什么意思？

transcript_json.text: Includes natural light, but it also includes light that isn't natural, for example, from computers, phones, televisions, and other electronic devices.
transcript_json.translation: 蓝光包括自然光，也包括非自然的光，比如电脑、手机、电视等电子设备发出的光。

transcript_json.text: So, blue light is harmful and that's why you want to block it?
transcript_json.translation: 所以蓝光有害，所以你想把它挡掉？

transcript_json.text: It isn't that simple.
transcript_json.translation: 没那么简单。

transcript_json.text: Blue light isn't necessarily bad for us.
transcript_json.translation: 蓝光对我们不一定有害。

transcript_json.text: In fact, we need blue light during the day to be healthy.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，白天我们需要蓝光来保持健康。

transcript_json.text: But too much blue light, especially from electronic devices, can harm our health by weakening our vision and making it harder for us to fall asleep.
transcript_json.translation: 但过多的蓝光，尤其是来自电子设备的，会削弱视力、让人更难入睡，从而危害健康。

transcript_json.text: And poor sleep can cause all sorts of health problems.
transcript_json.translation: 而睡眠不好会引发各种健康问题。

transcript_json.text: I'm not so sure that sleep is nearly as important as people always say it is.
transcript_json.translation: 我不太确定睡眠真有大家说的那么重要。

transcript_json.text: I haven't slept enough in months because I have too much work to do, and I feel fine.
transcript_json.translation: 我这几个月都睡不够，因为工作太多，可我感觉挺好。

transcript_json.text: And it's the same for most of my friends.
transcript_json.translation: 我大多数朋友也一样。

transcript_json.text: Poor sleep might be a problem for older people, but surely young people can handle late nights.
transcript_json.translation: 睡眠不好对老年人可能是个问题，但年轻人肯定能扛得住熬夜。

transcript_json.text: Well, the research Which I've read shows that sleep is probably even more important than we thought, and that not having enough sleep can contribute to serious health problems like obesity and heart disease.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我读到的研究显示，睡眠可能比我们想象的还重要，睡眠不足会引发肥胖、心脏病等严重健康问题。

transcript_json.text: And all the artificial blue light from electronic devices means we have to try harder to sleep well.
transcript_json.translation: 而电子设备发出的大量人造蓝光，意味着我们得更努力才能睡好。

transcript_json.text: Maybe you're right.
transcript_json.translation: 也许你是对的。

transcript_json.text: I'm on my computer very late most nights, and that's probably why I don't sleep enough.
transcript_json.translation: 我大多数晚上都很晚还在用电脑，这大概就是我睡眠不足的原因。

transcript_json.text: Questions eight to eleven are based on the conversation you have just heard.

transcript_json.text: Question nine: What does the woman say about blue light?
transcript_json.translation: 第9题：女士是怎么说蓝光的？

transcript_json.text: Question ten.
Why does the man say he hasn't slept enough for months?

transcript_json.text: Question eleven.
What has the woman learned from the research she has read?
transcript_json.translation: 女士从她读到的研究中了解到了什么？

transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
As a kid, did you know what job you wanted to do when you grew up?
transcript_json.translation: 你小时候知道自己长大后想做什么工作吗？

transcript_json.text: No, I didn't.
transcript_json.translation: 不，我不知道。

transcript_json.text: And I got sick every time adults asked me what I wanted to be when I grow up."
transcript_json.translation: 每次大人问我长大后想当什么，我就烦得要命。

transcript_json.text: It's the same with me, and I'm tired of people asking that question of my ten-year-old daughter.
transcript_json.translation: 我也一样，而且我很烦别人拿这个问题去问我10岁的女儿。

transcript_json.text: My daughter's stock answers are basketball player, pop singer, mechanical engineer.
transcript_json.translation: 我女儿的固定回答是篮球运动员、流行歌手、机械工程师。

transcript_json.text: Adults love that last one, as it's the perfect mix of the sensible and the ambitious.
transcript_json.translation: 大人特别喜欢最后一个，因为它既务实又有志气，简直是完美结合。

transcript_json.text: When she was much younger, my daughter used to say she wanted to be Queen of the Clouds, which I loved.
transcript_json.translation: 我女儿更小的时候，常说她想当"云中女王"，我喜欢极了。

transcript_json.text: That's the kind of goal setting I like to see in children, springing from their boundless imaginations.
transcript_json.translation: 我就喜欢看到孩子这样设定目标，源自他们无穷无尽的想象力。

transcript_json.text: Yes, we grown-ups can be tedious and limiting in our need for reality, and we teach a very gloomy image of adulthood, that whatever our children's future holds, it must be seen within the context of a job.
transcript_json.translation: 没错，我们大人总爱把现实挂在嘴边，又无聊又局限，还给孩子灌输一种灰暗的成年图景——不管孩子未来如何，都必须放在"一份工作"的框架里来看。

transcript_json.text: How utterly overwhelming and dull!
transcript_json.translation: 这多让人透不过气，多枯燥啊！

transcript_json.text: When people ask my son what he wants to be when he grows up, I have to swallow the urge to say, "Hey, Back off my kids' dreams.
transcript_json.translation: 有人问我儿子长大后想当什么时，我都得强忍住想说"嘿，离我孩子的梦想远点"的冲动。

transcript_json.text: We can't dismiss the idea that teenagers have to plan to do something after they finish school, and parents are entitled to hope it's more than simply spending ten hours a day playing computer games.
transcript_json.translation: 但我们也不能否认，青少年毕业后总得计划做点什么，而父母也有权希望孩子不只是每天花10个小时打电脑游戏。

transcript_json.text: But asking, "What do you want to be?" isn't going to lead a child to a fulfilled life; rather, it leads to false expectations and a high chance of disappointment.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，问"你想成为什么？"并不能引导孩子走向充实的人生；相反，它带来的是虚假的期望和极高的失望概率。

transcript_json.text: Exactly.
We should be helping our kids understand who they are, even if that means letting go of who we think they should be.
transcript_json.translation: 我们应该帮助孩子了解自己是谁，哪怕这意味着放下我们心目中他们"应该成为的样子"。

transcript_json.text: Questions twelve to fifteen are based on the conversation you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第12至15题基于你刚听到的对话。

transcript_json.text: Question twelve: What question were both speakers fed up with when they were kids?
transcript_json.translation: 第12题：两位说话者小时候都厌烦什么问题？

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Greater internet access correlates directly with improved health care, education, and economic development.
transcript_json.translation: 互联网接入越广，医疗、教育和经济发展就越好。

transcript_json.text: People living in rural areas, however, lag behind in online use, which limits their access to government services, banking, and job opportunities.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，农村地区居民上网落后，这限制了他们获得政府服务、银行服务和就业机会。

transcript_json.text: Nowhere is this challenge clearer than in Africa.
transcript_json.translation: 这个挑战在非洲最为明显。

transcript_json.text: Most Africans live in rural areas that are tough to wire for internet access.
transcript_json.translation: 多数非洲人住在农村，这些地方很难铺设网络。

transcript_json.text: Now, some phone companies are trying to introduce internet-ready phones into African markets.
transcript_json.translation: 现在，一些手机公司正试图把能上网的手机引入非洲市场。

transcript_json.text: Certain companies have started selling simple smartphones for only twenty dollars.
transcript_json.translation: 有些公司已开始以仅20美元的价格出售简易智能手机。

transcript_json.text: Previously, the lowest price had been around forty dollars, well out of reach for many people.
transcript_json.translation: 此前最低价约40美元，远超出许多人的承受能力。

transcript_json.text: These devices are powered by software from the giant electronics company KaiOS Technologies Limited.
transcript_json.translation: 这些设备使用大型电子公司KaiOS科技有限公司的软件。

transcript_json.text: Most companies are trying to make phones ever more powerful and capable, but KaiOS went the other way.
transcript_json.translation: 多数公司都想把手机做得越来越强大、功能越来越多，但KaiOS反其道而行。

transcript_json.text: It made every effort to keep the essential capabilities of smartphones, but strip out costs and preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity.
transcript_json.translation: 它竭力保留智能手机的基本功能，同时削减成本、延长电池续航，以照顾那些可能缺电的用户。

transcript_json.text: The KaiOS devices offer an alternative to the more expensive models that remain out of reach of many Africans and contribute to the digital divide.
transcript_json.translation: KaiOS设备为更昂贵的机型提供了替代选择，那些机型许多非洲人仍然买不起，加剧了数字鸿沟。

transcript_json.text: The body of KaiOS phones is as basic as it gets.
transcript_json.translation: KaiOS手机的外观简朴到不能再简朴。

transcript_json.text: Instead of a touch screen, they're controlled with an old school keypad.
transcript_json.translation: 它们不用触摸屏，而是靠老式键盘操作。

transcript_json.text: They're designed for 3G networks because 4G coverage doesn't reach two thirds of Africa's customers.
transcript_json.translation: 它们是为3G网络设计的，因为4G网络覆盖不到非洲三分之二的用户。

transcript_json.text: In total, KaiOS phones are made from about $15 worth of parts, while Apple's top of the line iPhone has $390 worth of stuff.
transcript_json.translation: 总的来说，KaiOS手机的零部件成本约为15美元，而苹果最顶级的iPhone用料价值390美元。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
For years, using recycled plastic to make plastic products was cheap.
transcript_json.translation: 多年来，用回收塑料制造塑料制品一直很便宜。

transcript_json.text: By contrast, fossil fuel plastic was more expensive.
transcript_json.translation: 相比之下，化石燃料塑料更贵。

transcript_json.text: Thus, the sustainable option was an economic option too.
transcript_json.translation: 因此，可持续的选择同时也是经济的选择。

transcript_json.text: But now, it is cheaper for major manufacturers to use new plastic.
transcript_json.translation: 但现在，大型制造商用新塑料反而更便宜。

transcript_json.text: According to one recent business report, recycled plastic now costs an extra $72 a ton compared with newly made plastic.
transcript_json.translation: 根据最近一份商业报告，回收塑料现在每吨比新生产的塑料贵72美元。

transcript_json.text: This may be because of consumer demands; they are pushing for more recycled plastics in new products.
transcript_json.translation: 这可能是消费者需求所致，他们要求新产品中加入更多回收塑料。

transcript_json.text: Meanwhile, new plastic is becoming cheaper.
transcript_json.translation: 与此同时，新塑料正变得越来越便宜。

transcript_json.text: This is because of a boom in petroleum chemical production from the U.S.
transcript_json.translation: 这是因为美国石油化工产量的激增。

transcript_json.text: The price increase of recycled plastic could cost sustainable manufacturers an extra $250 million a year.
transcript_json.translation: 回收塑料涨价，可能让可持续制造商每年多花2.5亿美元。

transcript_json.text: Smaller manufacturers may also be forced to use new plastic to reduce costs.
transcript_json.translation: 较小的制造商也可能被迫改用新塑料来降低成本。

transcript_json.text: Makers of clear plastic bottles may also opt for new fossil fuel-based plastic to save money.
transcript_json.translation: 透明塑料瓶的制造商也可能为了省钱而选用新的化石燃料基塑料。

transcript_json.text: Plastic packaging makers are being pressured to use more recycled plastic.
transcript_json.translation: 塑料包装制造商正面临压力，要求使用更多再生塑料。

transcript_json.text: This is done in hopes of reducing the enormous amount of plastic pollution in the oceans.
transcript_json.translation: 这样做是希望减少海洋中大量的塑料污染。

transcript_json.text: The UK government plans to tax companies which don't use at least 30% recycled plastic in their products.
transcript_json.translation: 英国政府计划对产品中再生塑料含量不足30%的公司征税。

transcript_json.text: Additionally, the government is planning to increase the quantity of recycled plastic in the market.
transcript_json.translation: 此外，政府还计划增加市场上再生塑料的供应量。

transcript_json.text: This could mean incentives for new recycling plants.
transcript_json.translation: 这可能意味着对新建回收厂的激励措施。

transcript_json.text: Additionally, recycling facilities may be improved at a local council level, and recycled plastic could be imported.
transcript_json.translation: 此外，地方议会层面可能会改善回收设施，也可能进口再生塑料。

transcript_json.text: This would help increase the amount of recycled plastic in circulation.
transcript_json.translation: 这将有助于增加流通中的再生塑料数量。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
At The Dreamery, a business in Manhattan, naps are for sale.
transcript_json.translation: 在曼哈顿的"梦乡"这家店里，午睡是要花钱买的。

transcript_json.text: A 45-minute session in a darkened enclosure with peace and quiet costs $25.
transcript_json.translation: 在一个安静黑暗的小隔间里待45分钟要25美元。

transcript_json.text: To be clear, This institution is no hotel.
transcript_json.translation: 说清楚，这家机构不是酒店。

transcript_json.text: This is a nap joint.
transcript_json.translation: 这是一家午睡店。

transcript_json.text: It sells the idea of the nap as much as the nap itself.
transcript_json.translation: 它卖的不只是午睡本身，更是午睡的理念。

transcript_json.text: Is a nap worth $25?
transcript_json.translation: 午睡值25美元吗？

transcript_json.text: The answer is obviously yes.
transcript_json.translation: 答案显然是值。

transcript_json.text: Here, at this point in the argument, it's traditional for me to bring up all the studies that show the benefits of napping.
transcript_json.translation: 说到这里，按惯例我该列举所有关于午睡好处的研究了。

transcript_json.text: But do you really need experts to tell you that?
transcript_json.translation: 但你真的需要专家来告诉你这些吗？

transcript_json.text: Just look at the world around you at 2:30 in the afternoon.
transcript_json.translation: 下午2:30的时候，看看你周围的世界吧。

transcript_json.text: I've been working from home for more than 10 years now, and the quality and quantity of work I can do emerges directly from my ability to concentrate.
transcript_json.translation: 我在家办公已经10多年了，我能完成的工作质量和数量，完全取决于我的专注力。

transcript_json.text: I don't understand how people have creative careers without napping.
transcript_json.translation: 我不明白那些做创意工作的人，不午睡怎么行。

transcript_json.text: Every day, at about 1 p.m., everyone faces the same choice: sleep until 2 p.m and then work until 5, or daydream and drift around social media and attend pointless meetings until 7 p.m.
transcript_json.translation: 每天下午1点左右，每个人都要面对同样的选择：睡到2点，然后工作到5点；或者发发呆、刷刷社交媒体、开些没意义的会，一直熬到7点。

transcript_json.text: The friends I have who still work and officers inform me their bosses insist that they take the second option, and that napping is associated with laziness.
transcript_json.translation: 我那些还在办公室工作的朋友们告诉我，他们的老板坚持让他们选第二种，说午睡就是懒惰的表现。

transcript_json.text: I genuinely find it odd, for if you nap properly, it's like waking up from a full night's sleep, and you can double your day's worth of concentration.
transcript_json.translation: 我真觉得这很奇怪，因为只要午睡睡得好，就像睡了一整夜一样，能让你一天的专注力翻倍。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1: Police have reported a man being bitten by a four-foot snake when he lifted his toilet seat on Sunday morning.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道1：警方通报，一名男子周日早上掀起马桶盖时，被一条4英尺长的蛇咬伤。

transcript_json.text: The snake was not poisonous, so the man did not have to go to the hospital, but his arm was medically treated at the scene.
transcript_json.translation: 那条蛇没有毒，所以男子不必去医院，但他的手臂在现场接受了医疗处理。

transcript_json.text: The police officer interviewed told news reporters the snake didn't belong to the man, and it was unclear how it got into the apartment.
transcript_json.translation: 受访警官告诉记者，那条蛇不是那个男子的，它是怎么进到公寓里的也不清楚。

transcript_json.text: The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers and taken to an animal hospital afterward.
transcript_json.translation: 那条蛇最终被当地的动物处理人员捕获，随后被送往一家动物医院。

transcript_json.text: It was being treated for an outer skin infection.
transcript_json.translation: 它正在接受外皮肤感染的治疗。

transcript_json.text: It was unclear who the owner was.
transcript_json.translation: 蛇的主人是谁还不清楚。

transcript_json.text: The snake may be taken to a local zoo for care if the owner does not come forward.
transcript_json.translation: 如果主人不出面认领，这条蛇可能会被送到当地动物园照料。

transcript_json.text: Over the years, other creatures like frogs and fish have found their way into toilets, but this was the first instance of a snake in recent years.
transcript_json.translation: 这些年来，青蛙、鱼等其他动物也曾出现在马桶里，但近几年来蛇出现在马桶里还是第一次。

transcript_json.translation: 第1题和第2题基于你刚听到的这则新闻报道。

transcript_json.translation: 第1题：从警方报告中我们了解到什么？

transcript_json.translation: 第2题：报道说还有什么情况仍不清楚？

transcript_json.text: News report two.
Every week since last April, Andrea Belcher has been doing something slightly unusual and amusing when she takes out her trash.
transcript_json.translation: 自去年4月以来，每个星期安德烈娅·贝尔彻倒垃圾时都会做一件有点不寻常又有趣的事。

transcript_json.text: It all started off when a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown.
transcript_json.translation: 事情的起因是一位电影明星分享了自己穿着晚礼服倒垃圾的照片。

transcript_json.text: This inspired Andrea to get dressed up to take out the trash.
transcript_json.translation: 这启发了安德烈娅也盛装打扮去倒垃圾。

transcript_json.text: She was too embarrassed to do it during the day, so one dark evening she put on her black off-the-shoulder gown and put her trash bin out.
transcript_json.translation: 她不好意思在白天这么做，于是在一个漆黑的晚上，她穿上黑色露肩长裙，把垃圾桶倒了出去。

transcript_json.text: Her daughter filmed it and the whole family laughed.
transcript_json.translation: 她女儿把这一幕拍了下来，全家人都笑了。

transcript_json.text: But it seemed to go down well.
transcript_json.translation: 不过大家的反应似乎不错。

transcript_json.text: The following weeks, she found other outfits in her dressing-up box and dressed up as different characters and famous people, sharing her exploits on social media.
transcript_json.translation: 接下来的几个星期，她从化妆箱里找出其他服装，打扮成不同角色和名人，并把自己的趣事分享到社交媒体上。

transcript_json.text: Before long, People started offering up their own fancy dresses for her to wear, and, before she knew it, she had done twenty weeks.
transcript_json.translation: 不久，人们开始拿出自己的华丽礼服给她穿，不知不觉间，她已经坚持了20周。

transcript_json.text: Explaining why she has kept up the videos, Andrea explained how nice it was to have a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile.
transcript_json.translation: 在解释自己为何一直坚持拍这些视频时，安德烈娅说，能带来一点让人心情愉悦的快乐和疯狂，感觉真的很棒。

transcript_json.text: Besides, it also helps to remind people in the community to put out their trash bins each week.
transcript_json.translation: 而且，这还能提醒社区居民每周把垃圾桶倒出去。

transcript_json.translation: 没钱，可还是饿？

transcript_json.text: No problem.
Welcome to Frank's restaurant, where customers are paying for meals and leaving receipts on a board.
transcript_json.translation: 欢迎来到弗兰克餐厅，顾客在这里付了饭钱，还把收据留在一块板子上。

transcript_json.text: Anyone who is hungry and wants something to eat can take one, no questions asked, and hand it to the staff for some food.
transcript_json.translation: 任何饿了想吃东西的人都可以取一张收据，不用回答任何问题，交给店员就能换到食物。

transcript_json.text: The idea for the board of free meals started after a donor came in with $100 for each member of its staff.
transcript_json.translation: 这个免费餐板的想法，源于一位捐赠者给每位员工送来100美元。

transcript_json.text: After two staffers returned their share, there was $700 left over, according to Tara Morris, the owner of the restaurant.
transcript_json.translation: 餐厅老板塔拉·莫里斯说，两名员工退回了各自那份，还剩下700美元。

transcript_json.text: So they decided to do something more by creating the board.
transcript_json.translation: 于是他们决定做点更多的事，设立了这块板子。

transcript_json.text: The board of free meals inside the restaurant shows a host of potential meals already paid for by customers, each costing about Ten dollars.
transcript_json.translation: 餐厅里的免费餐板上列出了许多已由顾客付过款的餐食，每份约10美元。

transcript_json.text: The board has messages of kindness, like "If you want more kindness in the world, put it here."
transcript_json.translation: 板子上写着一些暖心的话，比如"想让世界多一点善意，就从这里开始。"

transcript_json.text: The drive has been going on for two weeks, and Morris said just under fifty customers have picked up a free meal.
transcript_json.translation: 这项活动已经进行了两周，莫里斯说，只有不到50名顾客领了免费餐。

transcript_json.text: There have been no reports of anyone taking advantage of the situation.
transcript_json.translation: 目前没有消息说有人占便宜。

transcript_json.text: In fact, there are a lot more people giving tickets than receiving.
transcript_json.translation: 事实上，送餐券的人比领餐的多得多。

transcript_json.text: It seems people want to help and are driven by helping others.
transcript_json.translation: 看来人们愿意帮忙，是帮助别人的愿望在推动他们。

transcript_json.text: Conversation one.
Welcome to our program, Friends and Relationships.
transcript_json.translation: 欢迎收听我们的节目《朋友与人际关系》。

transcript_json.text: Our guest today is psychologist Steve Pinker from McGill University.
transcript_json.translation: 今天请到的嘉宾是麦吉尔大学的心理学家史蒂夫·平克。

transcript_json.text: Glad to be here, Jane.
transcript_json.translation: 很高兴来到这里，简。

transcript_json.text: Hi, Steve.
Our question today is why friends suddenly disappear.
transcript_json.translation: 今天我们的问题是：为什么朋友会突然消失。

transcript_json.text: They may block us on their social media accounts and stop responding to our emails.
transcript_json.translation: 他们可能在社交媒体上把我们拉黑，也不再回复我们的邮件。

transcript_json.text: They simply vanish without a trace.
transcript_json.translation: 就这样消失得无影无踪。

transcript_json.text: The answer may lie in childhood.
transcript_json.translation: 答案可能要追溯到童年。

transcript_json.text: The way the person related to their mum and dad.
transcript_json.translation: 就看这个人小时候是怎么和父母相处的。

transcript_json.text: It's related to their attachment styles.
transcript_json.translation: 这跟他们的依恋类型有关。

transcript_json.text: Attachment styles?
Yeah.
There are two different attachment styles: an anxious attachment style and an avoidant attachment style.
transcript_json.translation: 依恋类型有两种：焦虑型依恋和回避型依恋。

transcript_json.text: When there is a relationship breakdown with their parents, children with an anxious attachment style scream and cry to get their parents to come back, but other children Simply shut down and try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation.
transcript_json.translation: 当与父母关系破裂时，焦虑型依恋的孩子会又哭又闹，想让父母回来，而另一些孩子则干脆封闭自己，靠无视现状来处理情绪。

transcript_json.text: And these attachment styles carry on into adulthood.
transcript_json.translation: 而这些依恋类型会延续到成年。

transcript_json.text: Does avoidance reduce their stress levels?
transcript_json.translation: 回避能降低他们的压力水平吗？

transcript_json.text: Not really.
Their stress levels are actually the same as those experienced by the children who yell and scream.
transcript_json.translation: 其实他们的压力水平和那些大喊大叫的孩子是一样的。

transcript_json.text: And I assume both might be termed insecure.
transcript_json.translation: 那我想这两种都可以称为不安全型吧。

transcript_json.text: Exactly.
And it's a very insecure attachment.
transcript_json.translation: 对，这是非常不安全的依恋。

transcript_json.text: How does an insecure attachment affect relationships between friends, coworkers, and romantic relationships?
transcript_json.translation: 不安全依恋会如何影响朋友之间、同事之间以及恋人之间的关系呢？

transcript_json.text: It's the same as conflicts.
transcript_json.translation: 这跟处理冲突是一回事。

transcript_json.text: So if you have a disagreement with a securely attached person, they're not going to panic.
transcript_json.translation: 所以如果你和一个安全型依恋的人发生分歧，他们不会惊慌。

transcript_json.text: They're able to hear what the other person is saying and express their own feelings and thoughts effectively.
transcript_json.translation: 他们能听进对方的话，并且有效地表达自己的感受和想法。

transcript_json.text: However, an insecurely attached person won't.
transcript_json.translation: 然而，不安全型依恋的人就做不到。

transcript_json.text: They might either attack you, get defensive, or just disappear from your life.
transcript_json.translation: 他们可能会攻击你、自我防卫，或者干脆从你的生活中消失。

transcript_json.text: To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals The end of the relationship.
transcript_json.translation: 对他们来说，任何分歧，无论在你看来多么微不足道，都意味着这段关系的结束。

transcript_json.text: That explains why they suddenly disappear.
transcript_json.translation: 这就解释了他们为什么会突然消失。

transcript_json.text: Conversation two.
I hear you're going to Japan soon.
transcript_json.translation: 听说你快要去日本了。

transcript_json.text: Yes, that's right.

transcript_json.text: Could I ask you a favor?

transcript_json.text: Sure, what is it?

transcript_json.text: I was wondering if you could get me some jeans while you're there.
transcript_json.translation: 你去那边的时候，能不能帮我买条牛仔裤？

transcript_json.text: I'll pay you back, of course.
transcript_json.translation: 钱我当然会还你。

transcript_json.text: A pair of jeans?
transcript_json.translation: 一条牛仔裤？

transcript_json.text: Okay.
I don't see why not.
transcript_json.translation: 没问题啊。

transcript_json.text: But what's wrong with jeans here?
transcript_json.translation: 可这儿的牛仔裤怎么了？

transcript_json.text: Well, I just love good jeans, and Japan happens to make the best in the world.
transcript_json.translation: 嗯，我就是喜欢好牛仔裤，而日本碰巧是全世界牛仔裤做得最好的地方。

transcript_json.text: My friend, Brought me a pair from there five years ago, and they still look new.
transcript_json.translation: 我朋友5年前从那边给我带了一条，到现在还跟新的一样。

transcript_json.text: Really?
I had no idea Japan made jeans.
transcript_json.translation: 我都不知道日本还做牛仔裤。

transcript_json.text: I would have thought America made the best jeans, because it's a typical American garment.
transcript_json.translation: 我还以为美国做的牛仔裤最好呢，因为那是典型的美国服饰。

transcript_json.text: Yeah, I thought so too.
transcript_json.translation: 是啊，我以前也这么想。

transcript_json.text: But it turns out Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools used to make jeans the original way.
transcript_json.translation: 但结果日本还有一些非常古老的工厂，用传统的织布工具，按最初的方式做牛仔裤。

transcript_json.text: It's a slower process of making clothing, but the end result is surely superior.
transcript_json.translation: 做起来是慢一些，但成品确实好得多。

transcript_json.text: Also, the fabric they use is of a higher quality, and the dyes are natural.
transcript_json.translation: 而且他们用的面料质量更高，染料也是天然的。

transcript_json.text: They have a denser weave and are more durable than any other jeans in the world.
transcript_json.translation: 他们织得更密，比世界上任何其他牛仔裤都更耐穿。

transcript_json.text: That sounds cool.
transcript_json.translation: 听起来不错。

transcript_json.text: What size do you want, and how much are they?
transcript_json.translation: 你要什么尺码，多少钱？

transcript_json.text: I have a 34 waist, and size 30 or 32 in length.
transcript_json.translation: 我腰围34，裤长30或32。

transcript_json.text: Either is fine.
transcript_json.translation: 都行。

transcript_json.text: They should be around five hundred dollars, but make double certain they are made in Japan.
transcript_json.translation: 应该在500美元左右，但一定要确认是日本产的。

transcript_json.text: Five hundred dollars?
Boy, that's expensive.
transcript_json.translation: 天哪，太贵了。

transcript_json.text: Do you typically spend that much on a pair of casual trousers?
transcript_json.translation: 你平时一条休闲裤都花这么多钱吗？

transcript_json.text: They are a little pricey, yes, but they are very special.
transcript_json.translation: 是有点贵，不过确实很特别。

transcript_json.text: Bear in mind they will last me several years, and they are very fashionable too.
transcript_json.translation: 记着，它能让我穿好几年，而且也非常时尚。

transcript_json.text: I think they're totally worth it.
transcript_json.translation: 我觉得它们完全值这个价。

transcript_json.text: Passage one.
Every time I walk out of a superhero movie, I feel the same way.
transcript_json.translation: 每次看完超级英雄电影走出来，我的感觉都一样。

transcript_json.text: I experience a sense of longing, realizing that there should be more in life.
transcript_json.translation: 我会有一种渴望，觉得人生应该有更多的东西。

transcript_json.text: The desire for adventure is a human one.
transcript_json.translation: 对冒险的渴望是人类共有的。

transcript_json.text: Superhero films capture this desire perfectly.
transcript_json.translation: 超级英雄电影完美地捕捉到了这种渴望。

transcript_json.text: The plot of each superhero film has become relatively predictable.
transcript_json.translation: 每部超级英雄电影的情节都变得相对可预测了。

transcript_json.text: The world is in peril.
transcript_json.translation: 世界陷入危机。

transcript_json.text: The world needs a hero.
transcript_json.translation: 世界需要一个英雄。

transcript_json.text: The hero is in peril.
transcript_json.translation: 英雄陷入危机。

transcript_json.text: The hero resolves the peril.
transcript_json.translation: 英雄化解危机。

transcript_json.text: The hero saves the world.
transcript_json.translation: 英雄拯救了世界。

transcript_json.text: Each film has an attractive lead, several expensive explosions, a few jokes to lighten the mood.
transcript_json.translation: 每部电影都有一个有魅力的主角、几场昂贵的爆炸场面、几个缓解气氛的笑点。

transcript_json.text: And numerous punches that land unrealistically well.
transcript_json.translation: 还有数不清的拳头，命中率高得离谱。

transcript_json.text: Even though we basically know what will happen, we keep coming back for more.
transcript_json.translation: 尽管我们基本上知道接下来会发生什么，却还是忍不住一次又一次去看。

transcript_json.text: The elites of our society have rejected superhero films.
transcript_json.translation: 我们社会的精英阶层拒绝超级英雄电影。

transcript_json.text: They say the films lack any form of artistry.
transcript_json.translation: 他们说这类电影毫无艺术性可言。

transcript_json.text: These movies are criticized as being too simple, but they give the fans what they want: entertainment.
transcript_json.translation: 这些电影被批评为太过简单，但它们给了粉丝想要的东西：娱乐。

transcript_json.text: No matter the form in which they reveal themselves, hero stories will always be present in life.
transcript_json.translation: 不管以什么形式出现，英雄故事永远存在于生活中。

transcript_json.text: It's not just about being entertained, but also being inspired.
transcript_json.translation: 这不只是为了娱乐，也是为了受到激励。

transcript_json.text: One author has mentioned that women desire to play an irreplaceable role in a great adventure.
transcript_json.translation: 有一位作者提到，女性渴望在一场伟大的冒险中扮演不可替代的角色。

transcript_json.text: Most young women want to be a part of something grand, something important.
transcript_json.translation: 大多数年轻女性想成为某个宏大而重要的事业的一部分。

transcript_json.text: It seems clear that this principle applies to men as well.
transcript_json.translation: 很显然，这一原则同样适用于男性。

transcript_json.text: So next time you see your favorite superhero film, be entertained, but also be inspired.
transcript_json.translation: 所以下次看最喜欢的超级英雄电影时，要好好享受，也要从中获得激励。

transcript_json.text: Let that small longing you feel motivate you to make a difference.
transcript_json.translation: 让心中那份小小的渴望推动你去改变些什么。

transcript_json.text: Passage two.
Telling stories is one of the most powerful means leaders have to influence, teach, and inspire.
transcript_json.translation: 讲故事是领导者用来影响、教育和激励他人最有力的手段之一。

transcript_json.text: Storytelling forges connections among people.
transcript_json.translation: 讲故事能拉近人与人之间的联系。

transcript_json.text: When it comes to our countries, our communities, and our families, we understand instinctively that the stories we hold in common are an important part of the ties that bind.
transcript_json.translation: 谈到我们的国家、社区和家庭，我们本能地明白，我们共同拥有的故事是维系彼此纽带的重要组成部分。

transcript_json.text: This understanding also holds true in the business world, where an organization's stories and the stories its leaders tell help solidify relationships in a way that factual statements don't.
transcript_json.translation: 这种认识在商界同样成立：一个组织的故事以及领导者讲述的故事，能以客观陈述无法做到的方式巩固关系。

transcript_json.text: Good stories do more.
transcript_json.translation: 好故事的作用不止于此。

transcript_json.text: More than create a sense of connection, they build familiarity and trust.
transcript_json.translation: 它们不仅能营造联系感，还能建立熟悉感和信任。

transcript_json.text: They allow the listener to enter the story, making them more open to learning.
transcript_json.translation: 它们让听众走进故事，从而更愿意接受新知。

transcript_json.text: Good stories can contain multiple meanings, so they're surprisingly economical in conveying complex ideas in graspable ways.
transcript_json.translation: 好故事可以蕴含多重含义，因此能以易于理解的方式传达复杂思想，效率高得出奇。

transcript_json.text: And stories are more engaging than the recital of data points or a discussion of abstract ideas.
transcript_json.translation: 而且，讲故事比罗列数据或讨论抽象概念更吸引人。

transcript_json.text: Stories about professional mistakes and what leaders learned from them are another great avenue for learning.
transcript_json.translation: 关于职场失误以及领导者从中吸取教训的故事，是另一条极好的学习途径。

transcript_json.text: Because people identify so closely with stories, they can imagine how they would have acted in similar circumstances.
transcript_json.translation: 由于人们对故事有很强的代入感，他们会想象自己在类似情况下会怎么做。

transcript_json.text: They're able to work through situations in a way that's risk-free.
transcript_json.translation: 他们能以没有风险的方式推演各种情形。

transcript_json.text: There are extra benefits for leaders.
transcript_json.translation: 对领导者来说，还有额外的好处。

transcript_json.text: With a simple personal story, they can convey fundamental values.
transcript_json.translation: 用一个简单的亲身故事，他们就能传达核心价值观。

transcript_json.text: They can offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge.
transcript_json.translation: 他们可以让人了解自己经验和知识的积累过程。

transcript_json.text: Presenting themselves as more approachable, and then they are more likely to inspire others to want to know more.
transcript_json.translation: 让自己显得更平易近人，也就更能激发他人想要进一步了解的愿望。

transcript_json.text: Passage three.
The U.S was founded by successive waves of immigrants, and immigrants are still contributing to America today.
transcript_json.translation: 美国是由一批又一批移民建立的，时至今日移民仍在为美国做贡献。

transcript_json.text: Statistics prove it.
transcript_json.translation: 统计数据证明了这一点。

transcript_json.text: On two key measures of financial performance, immigrants outperform native-born Americans.
transcript_json.translation: 在衡量财务表现的两个关键指标上，移民都优于土生土长的美国人。

transcript_json.text: First, they're more likely to be entrepreneurs.
transcript_json.translation: 首先，他们更有可能成为创业者。

transcript_json.text: From 1996 to 2016, the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.-born individuals.
transcript_json.translation: 1996年至2016年间，移民创业的速度是美国本土出生者的两倍。

transcript_json.text: Immigrants aren't just becoming entrepreneurs more frequently; they're often succeeding.
transcript_json.translation: 移民不仅创业更频繁，而且往往能成功。

transcript_json.text: Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one.
transcript_json.translation: 财富500强公司中，超过40%的创始人要么是移民，要么是移民的子女。

transcript_json.text: Another Another key measure of financial strength is debt level.
transcript_json.translation: 衡量财务实力的另一个关键指标是负债水平。

transcript_json.text: Immigrants do better in this area too.
transcript_json.translation: 在这方面移民也做得更好。

transcript_json.text: Immigrants use credit less often for purchasing cars, homes, or starting businesses.
transcript_json.translation: 移民较少使用信贷来买车、买房或创业。

transcript_json.text: This results in significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans.
transcript_json.translation: 这使得他们的负债水平明显低于土生土长的美国人。

transcript_json.text: For example, 34% of Americans born in Latin America report no credit card or installment loan debt.
transcript_json.translation: 例如，在拉丁美洲出生的美国人中，34%表示自己没有信用卡或分期贷款债务。

transcript_json.text: This can be compared to just 19% of the general population.
transcript_json.translation: 而在总人口中，这一比例只有19%。

transcript_json.text: Why are immigrants doing so well?
transcript_json.translation: 为什么移民做得这么好？

transcript_json.text: The values and habits they bring from their own homelands help explain some of the success.
transcript_json.translation: 他们从祖国带来的价值观和习惯，可以部分解释这种成功。

transcript_json.text: Unemployment tends to be higher in developing countries.
transcript_json.translation: 发展中国家的失业率往往较高。

transcript_json.text: That means more people must become entrepreneurs.
transcript_json.translation: 这意味着更多人不得不成为创业者。

transcript_json.text: Credit is also scarcer in most developing countries.
transcript_json.translation: 在大多数发展中国家，信贷也更为稀缺。

transcript_json.text: This means individuals must save more in order to achieve their goals.
transcript_json.translation: 这意味着个人必须多存钱才能实现目标。

transcript_json.text: Or they borrow money from friends and family rather than a bank.
transcript_json.translation: 或者他们向亲友借钱，而不是向银行借。

transcript_json.text: That means less debt and potentially better credit outcomes when they reach the U.S.
transcript_json.translation: 这意味着负债更少，来到美国后信用状况也可能更好。

transcript_json.text: Questions 22 to 25 are based on the passage you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 问题22到25基于你刚刚听到的短文。

transcript_json.text: Question 22: What does the passage say statistics prove?
transcript_json.translation: 问题22：短文说统计数字证明了什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 23: What do we learn about immigrants in the U.S compared with native-born Americans?
transcript_json.translation: 问题23：与美国本土出生的人相比，我们了解到美国移民的哪些情况？

transcript_json.text: What does the passage say about immigrants in the U.S in terms of financial strength?
transcript_json.translation: 就财力而言，短文对美国移民是怎么说的？

transcript_json.text: Question 25.
What do immigrants do to achieve their goals in the U.S.
transcript_json.translation: 移民在美国是如何实现他们的目标的？

transcript_json.text: That's the end of listening comprehension.
transcript_json.translation: 听力理解到此结束。

transcript_json.text: College English Test, Band 4, Part 2, Listening Comprehension, Section A.

transcript_json.text: Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports.
transcript_json.translation: 说明：在本节中，你将听到3篇新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: At the end of each news report, you will hear two or three questions.
transcript_json.translation: 每篇新闻报道结束后，你将听到2到3个问题。

transcript_json.text: Both the news report and the questions will be spoken only once.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道和问题都只读一遍。

transcript_json.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C, and D.
transcript_json.translation: 听到问题后，你必须从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳答案。

transcript_json.text: Then mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet 1 with a single line through the center.
transcript_json.translation: 然后在答题卡1上，把对应的字母中间划一条横线。

transcript_json.text: News Report 1.
Have you noticed how similar you are to your friends?
transcript_json.translation: 你有没有注意到，你和你的朋友有多像？

transcript_json.text: It may be because your brains operate in harmony with each other.
transcript_json.translation: 这可能是因为你们的大脑在相互协调地运作。

transcript_json.text: We know that friends are more likely to be the same age, gender, and ethnic background as each other.
transcript_json.translation: 我们知道，朋友之间往往年龄、性别和种族背景相似。

transcript_json.text: Now it seems that Their brains are alike too.
transcript_json.translation: 现在看来，他们的大脑也很相似。

transcript_json.text: Researchers at the University of California scanned the brains of 42 classmates while they watched videos intended to provoke varying responses.
transcript_json.translation: 加州大学的研究人员在42名同学观看旨在引发不同反应的视频的同时，扫描了他们的大脑。

transcript_json.text: Some people might find a romantic scene touching, for instance, while others would feel it was embarrassing.
transcript_json.translation: 比如，有些人可能觉得浪漫场景很感人，而另一些人则觉得尴尬。

transcript_json.text: The activity of friends' brains was more similar than that of people who didn't know each other, particularly in regions involved in attention, emotion, and language.
transcript_json.translation: 朋友之间的大脑活动比互不相识的人更为相似，尤其是在与注意力、情感和语言相关的区域。

transcript_json.text: This similarity was strong enough that it could be used to predict whether two people were already friends or not.
transcript_json.translation: 这种相似性足够明显，可以用来预测两个人是否已经是朋友。

transcript_json.text: The relationship probably goes two ways.
transcript_json.translation: 这种关系可能是双向的。

transcript_json.text: We are drawn to people who think like us.
transcript_json.translation: 我们会被和自己想法相似的人吸引。

transcript_json.text: We then influence their thoughts over time, which may push their brain activity into more closely resembling our own.
transcript_json.translation: 随后我们会影响他们的想法，这可能会使他们的大脑活动越来越接近我们自己的。

transcript_json.text: Questions one and two are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第1题和第2题基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question 1: What may be the reason that friends are similar to each other, according to the recent research?
transcript_json.translation: 第1题：根据最近的研究，朋友之间彼此相似的原因可能是什么？

transcript_json.text: Question 2: What does the news report say about the relationship between friends?
transcript_json.translation: 第2题：新闻报道是怎么说朋友之间的关系的？

transcript_json.text: News report 2: Two men who have been best friends for 60 years have just realized they are actually brothers.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道2：做了60年最好朋友的两个男子刚刚发现他们其实是亲兄弟。

transcript_json.text: It's reported that Alan Allen Robinson and Walter McDonald met in the sixth grade at a school in Hawaii.
transcript_json.translation: 据报道，艾伦·艾伦·罗宾逊和沃尔特·麦克唐纳在夏威夷一所学校上六年级时相识。

transcript_json.text: They have been best friends ever since.
transcript_json.translation: 从那以后他们一直是最好的朋友。

transcript_json.text: Allen was given away for adoption soon after he was born, and Walter never knew his father.
transcript_json.translation: 艾伦出生后不久就被送人收养，而沃尔特从未见过自己的父亲。

transcript_json.text: So recently, they made separate attempts on DNA matching websites to discover more about their ancestry.
transcript_json.translation: 于是最近，他们分别在DNA配对网站上寻找更多关于自己身世的信息。

transcript_json.text: Walter was astonished to find that he matched with website user Robbie 737.
transcript_json.translation: 沃尔特惊讶地发现，他和网站用户Robbie 737匹配上了。

transcript_json.text: He knew immediately that this was his best friend Allen, whose friends call him Robbie, and flew 737 airplanes when he was a pilot.
transcript_json.translation: 他立刻知道这就是他最好的朋友艾伦——朋友们叫他Robbie，而且他当飞行员时驾驶过737飞机。

transcript_json.text: The pair were born to the same mother, fifteen months apart.
transcript_json.translation: 两人是同一个母亲所生，相差15个月。

transcript_json.text: Questions three and four are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 第3题和第4题基于你刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question three: What did both Allen Robinson and Walter McDonald attempt to do on DNA matching websites?
transcript_json.translation: 第3题：艾伦·罗宾逊和沃尔特·麦克唐纳都想在DNA配对网站上做什么？

transcript_json.text: Question four: What did the news report say about Alan Robinson and Walter Macdonald?
transcript_json.translation: 第4题：新闻报道是怎么说艾伦·罗宾逊和沃尔特·麦克唐纳的？

transcript_json.text: News report three: Amid all the election drama, air pollution problems, and disease outbreaks, five tourists' good work is being spread online.
transcript_json.translation: 新闻报道3：在选举风波、空气污染问题和疾病暴发之际，5名游客的善举正在网上传播。

transcript_json.text: Yesterday, two male and three female tourists were spotted walking the kilometre-long beach, picking up trash.
transcript_json.translation: 昨天，2名男性和3名女性游客被看到沿着1公里长的海滩捡垃圾。

transcript_json.text: One of the male tourists from Australia commented that although Although there was a lot of trash, nobody was doing anything.
transcript_json.translation: 其中一名来自澳大利亚的男性游客说，虽然垃圾很多，但没人采取任何行动。

transcript_json.text: The beach was not as nice or beautiful as it should be.
transcript_json.translation: 这片海滩没有它应有的那么好、那么美。

transcript_json.text: He felt so sad to see such a gorgeous place littered with so much trash.
transcript_json.translation: 看到这么美的地方被这么多垃圾弄得乱七八糟，他感到很难过。

transcript_json.text: Thus, he and his friends decided to grab a few trash bags and clean it all up.
transcript_json.translation: 于是，他和朋友们决定拿几个垃圾袋，把这里彻底清理干净。

transcript_json.text: A man passing by decided to video their good deed and put it on the Internet.
transcript_json.translation: 一个路过的男子把他们的善举拍成视频，发到了网上。

transcript_json.text: It was unclear where the rest of the group was from, but they were most likely traveling together.
transcript_json.translation: 不清楚这一群人中的其他人是哪里来的，但他们很可能是结伴旅行。

transcript_json.text: One local woman commented on being embarrassed that tourists were cleaning up their beach.
transcript_json.translation: 一位当地女士评论说，让游客来清理他们的海滩，她觉得很丢脸。

transcript_json.text: Another mentioned that it was actually the natives who brought food and drinks, then left trash all along the island.
transcript_json.translation: 另一位提到，其实是当地人带着食物和饮料来，然后把垃圾扔得全岛都是。

transcript_json.text: Questions five to seven are based on the news report you have just heard.
transcript_json.translation: 问题5到7基于你刚刚听到的新闻报道。

transcript_json.text: Question five: Why did one of the male tourists feel sad?
transcript_json.translation: 问题5：那位男游客为什么感到难过？

transcript_json.text: Question six: Who put the good deed video on the Internet?
transcript_json.translation: 问题6：是谁把这段善举视频发到网上的？

transcript_json.text: Question seven: Why did one local woman say she was embarrassed?
transcript_json.translation: 问题7：那位当地女士为什么说她感到丢脸？

transcript_json.translation: B节：说明：在本节中，你将听到两段长对话。
